meaning_cn: 移改变，变动。稳定坚强，毫不动摇。
meaning_en: unswerving; unflinching

meaning_cn: ①指依照当时当地情形；在不同的时间、地点。②任何时间、地点；时时处处。
meaning_en: anytime and anywhere

meaning_cn: 赴前往。把全部力量都投入进去。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make an all-out effort

meaning_cn: 内容丰富，花色繁多。
meaning_en: richly colorful

meaning_cn: 颖尖子。锥尖透过布囊显露出来。比喻本领全部显露出来。
meaning_en: to reveal one's talent (idiom); to rise above others; to distinguish oneself

meaning_cn: 指从实际对象出发，探求事物的内部联系及其发展的规律性，认识事物的本质。通常指按照事物的实际情况办事。
meaning_en: lit. to seek truth from facts (idiom); fig. to be practical and realistic

meaning_cn: 一完全；既往从前，已往。指态度没有变化，完全象从前一样。
meaning_en: (idiom) just as in the past; as before; continuing as always

meaning_cn: 大家普遍知道的。
meaning_en: variant of 眾所周知|众所周知[zhong4 suo3 zhou1 zhi1]

meaning_cn: 指每年一次。
meaning_en: (idiom) annual; once a year

meaning_cn: 因依据；制制定；宜适当的措施。根据各地的具体情况，制定适宜的办法。
meaning_en: (idiom) to use methods in line with local circumstances

meaning_cn: 想尽或用尽一切办法。
meaning_en: lit. thousand ways, a hundred plans (idiom); by every possible means

meaning_cn: 息呼吸时进出的气◆吸也相互关联。形容彼此的关系非常密切。
meaning_en: closely bound up (idiom); intimately related

meaning_cn: 层重复；穷尽。接连不断地出现，没有穷尽。
meaning_en: more and more emerge; innumerable succession; breeding like flies (idiom)

meaning_cn: 注目注视。吸引人们注意。
meaning_en: to attract attention; eye-catching; conspicuous

meaning_cn: 当务指应当办理的事。当前任务中最急切要办的事。
meaning_en: (idiom) top priority job; a matter of the greatest urgency

meaning_cn: 指过分地或非法地行使自己掌握的权力。
meaning_en: abuse of power

meaning_cn: 指理论、学说、政策等为人们深切了解和信服。
meaning_en: to enter deeply into people's hearts; to have a real impact on the people (idiom)

meaning_cn: 看到正义的事，就勇敢地去做。
meaning_en: (idiom, from the Analects) (usu. of a passer-by who comes across a critical situation) to step in and help; to take brave or selfless action

meaning_cn: 依仗势力或抓籽柄进行恐吓，用威胁手段索取财物。
meaning_en: extortion and blackmail (idiom)

meaning_cn: 虚假。传出的名声不是虚假的。指实在很好，不是空有虚名。
meaning_en: (idiom) to live up to one's famous name; its reputation is well deserved

meaning_cn: 来之使之来。得到它不容易。表示财物的取得或事物的成功是不容易的。
meaning_en: (idiom) hard to come by; not easily obtained

meaning_cn: 名声或名义和实际相符。
meaning_en: not just in name only, but also in reality (idiom); aptly named; worthy of the name

meaning_cn: 下落着落，去处。指不知道要寻找的人或物在什么地方。
meaning_en: unaccounted; unknown whereabouts

meaning_cn: 懈松懈。坚持到底，一点不忪懈。
meaning_en: (idiom) to persevere unremittingly; to keep going until the end

meaning_cn: 形容接连不断。
meaning_en: (idiom) in an unending stream; continuous

meaning_cn: 形容行人车马来来往往，接连不断。
meaning_en: (idiom) continuously; in an endless stream

meaning_cn: 耍花招欺骗人。
meaning_en: to practice fraud (idiom); by trickery

meaning_cn: 原有神秘奥妙的意思。现多指无法想象，难以理解。
meaning_en: (idiom) inconceivable; unimaginable; unfathomable

meaning_cn: 不正当的社会风气。
meaning_en: unhealthy tendency

meaning_cn: 翼翼严肃谨慎。本是严肃恭敬的意思。现形容谨慎小心，一点不敢疏忽。
meaning_en: (idiom) cautious; careful; prudent

meaning_cn: 治太平；安安定。形容国家长期安定、巩固。
meaning_en: long-term peace and stability (of governments)

meaning_cn: 荼茅草的白花。象火那样红，象荼那样白。原比喻军容之盛。现用来形容大规模的行动气势旺盛，气氛热烈。
meaning_en: like wildfire (idiom); unstoppable

meaning_cn: 折、扣出售商品时，按定价减去的成数。没有折扣，表示完全、十足的意思。
meaning_en: a hundred percent; to the letter; out-and-out

meaning_cn: 顾回头看。来自后方的忧患。指在前进过程中，担心后方发生问题。
meaning_en: fears of trouble in the rear (idiom); family worries (obstructing freedom of action); worries about the future consequences; often in negative expressions, meaning "no worries about anything"

meaning_cn: 原意是让闪光的金纸把人弄迷糊了。形容叫人沉迷的奢侈繁华环境。
meaning_en: lit. dazzling with paper and gold (idiom); fig. indulging in a life of luxury

meaning_cn: 力体力，能力；及达到。在自己力量的限度内所能做到的。
meaning_en: as far as one's capabilities extend (idiom); to the best of one's ability; within one's powers

meaning_cn: 供供给，供应；求需求，需要。供应不能满足需求。
meaning_en: supply does not meet demand

meaning_cn: 目看；了然清楚，明白。一眼就看得很清楚。
meaning_en: obvious at a glance (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容事情或道理很明显，极容易看清楚。
meaning_en: clearly and easy to see (idiom); obviously; clearly; it goes without saying

meaning_cn: 持坚持；恒恒心。长久坚持下去。
meaning_en: to pursue unremittingly (idiom); to persevere

meaning_cn: 形容数量很多。
meaning_en: (lit.) by the thousands and tens of thousands (idiom); (fig.) untold numbers; innumerable; countless

meaning_cn: 城镇里的街道里弄，概指都市里的各处地方。
meaning_en: great streets and small alleys (idiom); everywhere in the city

meaning_cn: 不用说明就能想象得到。
meaning_en: (idiom) (it) goes without saying; can well be imagined

meaning_cn: 安安定；乐喜爱，愉快；业职业。指安定愉快地生活和劳动。
meaning_en: to live in peace and work happily (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容认识一致，共同努力。
meaning_en: to work with a common purpose (idiom); to make concerted efforts; to pull together; to work as one

meaning_cn: 天天然，自然；厚优厚。具备的条件特别优越，所处环境特别好。
meaning_en: blessed by heaven (idiom); enjoying exceptional advantages; favored by nature

meaning_cn: 钟集中；钟情爱情专注。旧指男女之间一见面就产生爱情。也指对事物一见就产生了感情。
meaning_en: to fall in love at first sight (idiom)

meaning_cn: 不怕艰难困苦，坚持英勇斗争。
meaning_en: to struggle arduously

meaning_cn: 投入全部精力，一点没有保留。
meaning_en: (idiom) heart and soul; wholeheartedly

meaning_cn: 没有相同的或没有可以相比的。
meaning_en: (idiom) unique; unmatched; unrivalled

meaning_cn: 约相约。事先没有约定而相互一致。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of two or more people) to take the same action without prior consultation; (usu. used adverbially) all (or both) of them, independently; as if by prior agreement

meaning_cn: 锣鼓点敲得很密。比喻公开活动前的紧张气氛和舆论准备。
meaning_en: (lit.) urgent beating of gongs and drums (idiom); (fig.) to urgently prepare for an upcoming event

meaning_cn: 原指五行阵和八门阵。这是古代两种战术变化很多的阵势。比喻变化多端或花样繁多。
meaning_en: myriad; all kinds of; all sorts of

meaning_cn: 一应一切；俱都。一切齐全，应有尽有。
meaning_en: with everything needed available

meaning_cn: 应顺应；运原指天命，泛指时机。旧指应天命而产生。现指适应时机而产生。
meaning_en: to emerge to meet a historic destiny (idiom); to arise at an opportune time; able to take advantage of an opportunity; to rise to the occasion

meaning_cn: 跟大家不一样。
meaning_en: (idiom) to stand out from the crowd; distinctive; different from the rest

meaning_cn: 看见某种严重情况，心里感到震惊。
meaning_en: lit. shocks the eye, astonishes the heart (idiom); shocking; horrible to see; a ghastly sight

meaning_cn: 屡多次；鲜新鲜，新奇。常常见到，并不新奇。
meaning_en: a common occurrence (idiom)

meaning_cn: 独一个；偶一双。不只一个，竟然还有配对的。表示两事或两人十分相似。
meaning_en: not alone but in pairs (idiom, usually derog.); not a unique occurrence; it's not the only case

meaning_cn: 之代词，它，指办法、措施等；效成效，效果。实行起来有成效。指某种方法或措施已经实行过，证明很有效用。
meaning_en: to be effective (idiom)

meaning_cn: 知知道；觉觉察。没有意识到，没有觉察到。现多指未加注意。
meaning_en: (idiom) unconsciously; unwittingly

meaning_cn: 大势指整个局势。整个局势发展的趋向。
meaning_en: (idiom) the prevailing trend; the trend of the times; an inevitable direction

meaning_cn: 指众多人家。
meaning_en: every family (idiom)

meaning_cn: 悸因害怕而心跳得厉害。危险的事情虽然过去了，回想起来心里还害怕。
meaning_en: to have lingering fears; trepidation remaining after a trauma (idiom)

meaning_cn: 得能够。没有办法知道。
meaning_en: unknown; unable to find out

meaning_cn: 从来没有过的。
meaning_en: (idiom) unprecedented

meaning_cn: 近紧急。急迫得不能等待。形容心情急切。
meaning_en: (idiom) unable to hold oneself back; eager to do sth without delay

meaning_cn: 比喻接连遭受灾难，损害愈加严重。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make matters even worse; to add insult to injury

meaning_cn: 形容事情已到眼前，情势十分紧迫。
meaning_en: pressing in on one's eyelashes (idiom); imminent

meaning_cn: 这里起来，那里下去。形容接连不断。
meaning_en: up here, down there (idiom); to rise and fall in succession; no sooner one subsides, the next arises; repeating continuously; occurring again and again (of applause, fires, waves, protests, conflicts, uprisings etc)

meaning_cn: 脚踏在坚实的土地上。比喻做事踏实，认真。
meaning_en: to have one's feet firmly planted on the ground (idiom); realistic without flights of fancy; steady and serious character

meaning_cn: 料想不到，没有料到。
meaning_en: unexpected; previously unimagined

meaning_cn: 错交错，交叉；综合在一起。形容头绪多，情况复杂。
meaning_en: tangled and complicated (idiom)

meaning_cn: 厚深重；非非议，否定。不能过分责备。指说话做事虽有缺点，但还有可取之处，应予谅解。
meaning_en: see 未可厚非[wei4 ke3 hou4 fei1]

meaning_cn: 源头很远，水流很长。比喻历史悠久。
meaning_en: (idiom) of long standing; with a long history; stretching back to ancient times

meaning_cn: 反类推。比喻从一件事情类推而知道其他许多事情。
meaning_en: to raise one and infer three; to deduce many things from one case (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指学习工作等按照一定的步骤逐渐深入或提高。
meaning_en: in sequence, step by step (idiom); to make steady progress incrementally

meaning_cn: 遗留；余力剩下的力量。把全部力量都使出来，一点不保留。
meaning_en: to spare no pains or effort (idiom); to do one's utmost

meaning_cn: 喻了解，明白。不用说话就能明白。形容道理很明显。
meaning_en: (idiom) it goes without saying; it is self-evident

meaning_cn: 讨索取。买卖东西，卖主要价高，买主给价低，双方要反复争议。也比喻在进行谈判时反复争议，或接受任务时讲条件。
meaning_en: to haggle over price; to bargain

meaning_cn: 恶厌恶；痛痛恨；绝极。指对某人或某事物极端厌恶痛恨。
meaning_en: to detest bitterly (idiom); implacable hatred; to abhor; anathema

meaning_cn: 比喻三个人、三件事或三个方面联成的一个整体。
meaning_en: Holy Trinity; trinity

meaning_cn: 截然很分明地、断然分开的样子。形容两件事物毫无共同之处。
meaning_en: entirely different; different as black and white

meaning_cn: 犹还。过去的事，至今印象还非常清楚，就象刚才发生的一样。
meaning_en: to remain fresh in one's memory (idiom)

meaning_cn: 喜欢听，乐意看。指很受欢迎。
meaning_en: to love to hear and see (idiom); well received; to one's liking

meaning_cn: 喻明白；晓知道。家家户户都知道。形容人所共知。
meaning_en: understood by everyone (idiom); well known; a household name

meaning_cn: 新更新；异不同。每天都在更新，每月都有变化。指发展或进步迅速，不断出现新事物、新气象。
meaning_en: daily renewal, monthly change (idiom); every day sees new developments; rapid progress

meaning_cn: 指夺取别人的地位而由自己代替。现也指以某一事物代替另一事物。
meaning_en: (idiom) to replace; to supersede; to take its (or her etc) place

meaning_cn: 说不出其中的奥妙。指事情很奇怪，说不出道理来。
meaning_en: (idiom) baffling; bizarre; without rhyme or reason; inexplicable

meaning_cn: 比喻名次列在前面。
meaning_en: to rank among the best

meaning_cn: 排除忧愁，解除困难。
meaning_en: to resolve a difficult situation and leave worries behind (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指多种不同的式样、种类或方式。
meaning_en: (of) all kinds and sorts; various

meaning_cn: 不认真、不负责地对待本职工作。
meaning_en: to neglect one's duty; dereliction of duty; malpractice

meaning_cn: 任负担；道路途。担子很重，路很远。比喻责任重大，要经历长期的奋斗。
meaning_en: a heavy load and a long road; fig. to bear heavy responsibilities through a long struggle (cf Confucian Analects, 8.7)

meaning_cn: 只要脚移动一下，就会影响两边的轻重。指处于重要地位，一举一动都足以影响全局。
meaning_en: to play a critical role (idiom); influential

meaning_cn: 比比一个挨一个。到处都是，形容极其常见。
meaning_en: can be found everywhere

meaning_cn: 卓卓越，高超。有突出的成绩和效果。
meaning_en: highly effective; fruitful

meaning_cn: 比喻长期安家落户或切切实实、一心一意地做好所从事的工作。
meaning_en: air plant (Bryophyllum pinnatum); to put down roots

meaning_cn: 行做。从事情发展的趋势看，必须采取行动。
meaning_en: circumstances require action (idiom); absolutely necessary; imperative

meaning_cn: 历史上从来没有过的事。指前所未有。
meaning_en: (idiom) unprecedented in history

meaning_cn: 当然应当如此。按道理应当这样。
meaning_en: as it should be by rights (idiom); proper and to be expected as a matter of course; inevitable and right

meaning_cn: 指听得多了，能够说得很清楚、很详细。
meaning_en: what's frequently heard can be repeated in detail (idiom)

meaning_cn: 样子完全相同。
meaning_en: (idiom) exactly alike; identical; also pr. [yi1mo2-yi1yang4]

meaning_cn: 厉严格。严格地实行节约。
meaning_en: to practice strict economy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 许多坏事互为因果，循环不已，越来越坏。
meaning_en: vicious circle

meaning_cn: 铤急走的样子；走险奔赴险处。指在无路可走的时候采取冒险行动。
meaning_en: (idiom) to take a risk out of desperation

meaning_cn: 全世界的人都注视着。
meaning_en: to receive worldwide attention

meaning_cn: 接接战；厉磨快，引伸为奋勉，努力。指公鸡相斗，每次交锋以前先磨一下嘴。比喻继续努力，再加一把劲。
meaning_en: to continue the struggle (idiom); to persist; unremitting efforts

meaning_cn: 脚不跨出家门。
meaning_en: (idiom) to not leave one's home; to stay indoors

meaning_cn: 覆翻过来。形容变化巨大而彻底。也指闹得很凶。
meaning_en: sky and the earth turning upside down (idiom); fig. complete confusion; everything turned on its head

meaning_cn: 寻常平常。形容人和事物很突出，不同于一般。
meaning_en: (idiom) extraordinary

meaning_cn: 每家每户，户户不漏。挨，依次，顺次。
meaning_en: to go from house to house

meaning_cn: 翼翅膀。没有翅膀却飞走了。比喻物品忽然丢失。也比喻事情传播得很迅速。
meaning_en: to disappear without trace; to vanish all of a sudden; to spread fast; to spread like wildfire

meaning_cn: 参差长短、高低不齐。形容水平不一或很不整齐。
meaning_en: (idiom) variable; uneven; irregular

meaning_cn: 水位升高，船身也随之浮起。比喻事物随着它所凭借的基础的提高而增长提高。
meaning_en: the tide rises, the boat floats (idiom); fig. to change with the overall trend; to develop according to the situation

meaning_cn: 沸沸水翻滚的样子；扬扬喧闹、翻动的样子。象沸腾的水一样喧闹。形容人声喧闹。
meaning_en: bubbling and gurgling; hubbubing; abuzz

meaning_cn: 发开始行动；制控制，制服。原指丢动手的牌主动地位，可以控制对方◇也泛指争取主动，先动手来制服对方。
meaning_en: (idiom) to gain the initiative by striking first; to preempt

meaning_cn: 轩然波涛高高涌起的样子。高高涌起的波涛。比喻大的纠纷或乱子。
meaning_en: huge waves; (fig.) ruckus; controversy; sensation

meaning_cn: 当地生长的。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of people) born and raised in the locality; (of art forms, political parties, enterprises, products etc) developed locally from the outset; wholly indigenous

meaning_cn: 出乎人们意料之外。
meaning_en: unexpected (idiom); surprising

meaning_cn: 统筹通盘筹划；兼本义为一手执两禾，引伸为同时进行几桩事情或占有几样东西；顾照顾。统一筹划，全面照顾。
meaning_en: an overall plan taking into account all factors

meaning_cn: 从明里细心察看，从暗里询问了解。指用各种方法进行调查研究。
meaning_en: open enquiries and secret search (idiom); to investigate openly and in secret; taking information from all sides

meaning_cn: 刻指短暂的时间；缓延迟。指形势紧迫，一刻也不允许拖延。
meaning_en: to brook no delay; to demand immediate action

meaning_cn: 融合为整体。比喻几种事物关系密切，配合自然，如同一个整体。
meaning_en: to fuse together (idiom); hypostatic union (religion)

meaning_cn: 焕然鲜明光亮的样子。改变旧面貌，出现崭新的气象。
meaning_en: to look completely new (idiom); brand new; changed beyond recognition

meaning_cn: 则准则，榜样。以自己的行动做出榜样。
meaning_en: to set an example (idiom); to serve as a model

meaning_cn: 潜暗中同，不见形迹；默不说话，没有声音。指人的思想或性格不知不觉受到感染、影响而发生了变化。
meaning_en: imperceptible influence; to influence secretly

meaning_cn: 比喻激烈尖锐的社会斗争前哨。
meaning_en: where the wind and the waves are the fiercest; at the heart of the struggle

meaning_cn: 紊乱。形容有条有理，一点不乱。
meaning_en: regular and thorough (idiom); methodically arranged

meaning_cn: 归结到根本上。同归根结蒂”。
meaning_en: in the final analysis; ultimately

meaning_cn: 发扬发展，提倡；光大辉煌而盛大。使好的作风、传统等得到发展和提高。
meaning_en: to develop and promote; to carry forward; to bring to great height of development

meaning_cn: 本指军旗耀眼，军容整齐。现比喻立场、观点、态度等十分明确。
meaning_en: to show one's colors; to have a clear-cut stand (idiom)

meaning_cn: 失差错。指非常有把握，绝对不会出差错。
meaning_en: surefire; absolutely safe (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指圣人对百姓一样看待，同施仁爱◇多表示对人同样看待，不分厚薄。
meaning_en: to treat everyone equally favorably (idiom); not to discriminate between people

meaning_cn: 辅辅助。指两件事物互相配合，互相辅助，缺一不可。
meaning_en: (idiom) to complement one another

meaning_cn: 淋漓形容湿淋淋往下滴，比喻尽情，酣畅；尽致达到极点。形容文章或说话表达得非常充分、透彻，或非常痛快。
meaning_en: lit. extreme saturation (idiom); fig. vividly and thoroughly; in great detail; without restraint; (of a performance) brilliant

meaning_cn: 耳目指见闻。听到的、看到的跟以前完全不同，使人感到新鲜。
meaning_en: a pleasant change; a breath of fresh air; refreshing

meaning_cn: 了了结，结束。用不了结的办法去了结。指把事情放在一边不管，就算完事。
meaning_en: to settle a matter by leaving it unsettled; to end up with nothing definite

meaning_cn: 形容群众性的活动情绪热烈，气氛高涨，就象炽热的火焰照天燃烧一样。
meaning_en: in full swing (idiom); (in a) frenzy; buzzing with activity

meaning_cn: 睹看见。指非常明显，谁都看得见。
meaning_en: anyone with eyes can see it (idiom); obvious to all; sth speaks for itself; is there for all to see

meaning_cn: 经过了相当长的时间。
meaning_en: over time; as time passes; in the fullness of time

meaning_cn: 指不注意，不重视，睁着眼却没看见。也指不理睬，看见了当作没看见。
meaning_en: (idiom) to turn a blind eye to; to ignore

meaning_cn: 自强自己努力向上；息停止。自觉地努力向上，永不松懈。
meaning_en: to strive unremittingly; self-improvement

meaning_cn: 以凭借；权权力；谋谋求；私私利。用手中的权力牟取私利。
meaning_en: to use one's position for personal gain (idiom)

meaning_cn: 继继承；开开辟。继承前人的事业，开辟未来的道路。
meaning_en: to follow the past and herald the future (idiom); part of a historical transition; forming a bridge between earlier and later stages

meaning_cn: 不住口地称赞。
meaning_en: (idiom) can't stop praising

meaning_cn: 容允许；辞推托。道义上不允许推辞。
meaning_en: not to be shirked without dishonor (idiom); incumbent; bounden (duty)

meaning_cn: 绸缪紧密缠缚。天还没有下雨，先把门窗绑牢。比喻事先做好准备工作。
meaning_en: lit. before it rains, bind around with silk (idiom, from Book of Songs 詩經|诗经); fig. to plan ahead; to prepare for a rainy day

meaning_cn: 指人的每一个动作。
meaning_en: (idiom) every movement; each and every move

meaning_cn: 根据法律制裁。
meaning_en: to punish according to the law; to bring to justice

meaning_cn: 尽全；如依照，符合。事情完全符合人的心意。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be everything one could wish for

meaning_cn: 可以做事情，并能取得较大的成绩。
meaning_en: (idiom) to achieve sth worthwhile; to make a positive contribution

meaning_cn: 针对病症用药。比喻针对事物的问题所在，采取有效的措施。
meaning_en: lit. to prescribe the right medicine for an illness (idiom); fig. to study a problem to find the right way to solve it; to take appropriate steps

meaning_cn: 谋计谋；划筹划。制定计谋策略。指为人出主意。
meaning_en: to put forward plans and ideas (also derogatory); to give advice (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指各个方面或各个地方。
meaning_en: (idiom) all directions; all around

meaning_cn: 当承当，承受；冲要冲，交通要道。比喻最先受到攻击或遭到灾难。
meaning_en: to bear the brunt

meaning_cn: 比喻不停顿地向前走。
meaning_en: unrelenting; without stopping to rest

meaning_cn: 然是，对。不认为是对的。表示不同意或否定。
meaning_en: not to accept as correct (idiom); to object; to disapprove; to take exception to

meaning_cn: 由经由。必定要经过的道路。泛指事物必须遵循的规律或做事必须遵守的法则。
meaning_en: see 必經之路|必经之路[bi4 jing1 zhi1 lu4]

meaning_cn: 指人所做的事。
meaning_en: one's conduct and deeds

meaning_cn: 蹴踏；就成功。踏一步就成功。比喻事情轻而易举，一下子就成功。
meaning_en: to get there in one step (idiom); easily done; success at a stroke; to get results overnight

meaning_cn: 因人多造成了困难。
meaning_en: packed with people; overcrowded; overpopulation

meaning_cn: 身亲身；体体验。亲身体验，努力实行。
meaning_en: to practice what one preaches (idiom)

meaning_cn: 精完美，好；益更加∶了还求更好。
meaning_en: (idiom) to constantly seek to improve; to keep perfecting

meaning_cn: 形容对发生的事感到十分意外。
meaning_en: (idiom) astounded; flabbergasted; taken aback

meaning_cn: 竭尽用尽。用尽全部力量。
meaning_en: (idiom) to spare no effort; to do one's utmost

meaning_cn: 拭擦；待等待。擦亮眼睛等着瞧。形容期望很迫切。也表示确信某件事情一定会出现。
meaning_en: lit. to wipe one's eyes and wait (idiom); to wait and see

meaning_cn: 没有家可回。指流离失所。
meaning_en: (idiom) homeless

meaning_cn: 哭也不好，笑也不好。形容很尴尬。
meaning_en: lit. not to know whether to laugh or cry (idiom); both funny and extremely embarrassing; between laughter and tears

meaning_cn: 铺张讲究排场。为了场面好看而浪费人力物力。
meaning_en: extravagance and waste (idiom)

meaning_cn: 措安置，处理。不知道怎么办才好。形容处境为难或心神慌乱。
meaning_en: not knowing what to do (idiom); at one's wits' end; embarrassed and at a complete loss

meaning_cn: 虚空。座位没有空着的。形容出席的人很多。
meaning_en: lit. a banquet with no empty seats; full house; capacity crowd; standing room only

meaning_cn: 可以利用的时机。
meaning_en: (idiom) an opportunity that someone (usually a villain or adversary) can exploit

meaning_cn: 琳琅精美的玉石。满眼都是珍贵的东西。形容美好的事物很多。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be a feast for the eyes; to be a cornucopia of delights; to be diverse and abundant

meaning_cn: 卷土人马奔跑时尘土飞卷。比喻失败之后，重新恢复势力。
meaning_en: lit. to return in a swirl of dust (idiom); fig. to regroup and come back even stronger; to make a comeback

meaning_cn: 一下子到处都是。形容来势很猛。
meaning_en: (lit.) eclipsing the sky and blanketing the earth (idiom); (fig.) arriving in overwhelming quantities; engulfing; all-pervasive

meaning_cn: 理直理由正确、充分；气壮气势旺盛。理由充分，说话气势就壮。
meaning_en: in the right and self-confident (idiom); bold and confident with justice on one's side; to have the courage of one's convictions; just and forceful

meaning_cn: 非不相似。样子完全不同了。形容改变得不成样子。
meaning_en: nothing remains the same (idiom); change beyond recognition

meaning_cn: 忡忡忧虑不安的样子。形容心事重重，非常忧愁。
meaning_en: deeply worried and sick at heart (idiom)

meaning_cn: 免避免。指由于某种限制而难于避免。
meaning_en: to be unavoidable (idiom)

meaning_cn: 燃烧。火烧眉毛那样紧急。形容事情非常急迫。
meaning_en: lit. the fire burns one's eyebrows (idiom); fig. desperate situation; extreme emergency

meaning_cn: 绝断。声音在耳边不断鸣响。
meaning_en: (of sound) to never stop; to fall incessantly on the ear; to linger on

meaning_cn: 津津兴趣浓厚的样子；乐道喜欢谈讲≤有兴趣地说个不停。
meaning_en: to discuss sth enthusiastically

meaning_cn: 在阳光下把竿子竖起来，立刻就看到影子。比喻立刻见到功效。
meaning_en: (lit.) set up a pole and immediately see its shadow (idiom); (fig.) to get instant results

meaning_cn: 形容意见不一，议论很多。
meaning_en: to discuss spiritedly (idiom); tongues are wagging

meaning_cn: 与跟，和。随着时间一天天地增长。形容不断增长。
meaning_en: to increase steadily; to grow with each passing day

meaning_cn: 泛指穿衣、吃饭、住房、行路等生活上的基本需要。
meaning_en: (lit.) clothing, food, housing and transportation (idiom); (fig.) people's basic needs

meaning_cn: 功成功；近眼前的。急于求成，贪图眼前的成效和利益。
meaning_en: seeking instant benefit (idiom); shortsighted vision, looking only for fast return

meaning_cn: 比喻基础深厚，不容易动摇。
meaning_en: deep-rooted (problem etc)

meaning_cn: 博广，多。形容思想和学识广博高深。
meaning_en: (idiom) wide-ranging and profound

meaning_cn: 事情有发展前途，很值得做。
meaning_en: with great prospects for the future (idiom); well worth doing

meaning_cn: 轰轰象声词，形容巨大的声响；烈烈火焰炽盛的样子。形容事业的兴旺。也形容声势浩大，气魄宏伟。
meaning_en: strong; vigorous; large-scale

meaning_cn: 使人神魂震惊。原指文辞优美，意境深远，使人感受极深，震动极大◇常形容使人十分惊骇紧张到极点。
meaning_en: (idiom) heart-stopping; hair-raising; breathtaking

meaning_cn: 乎文言中用为疑问或反问的语气助词，这里相当于吗”。用来表示极度、非常、淋漓尽致地意思。
meaning_en: lit. isn't that a joy? (quote from Confucius); fig. (jocular) extremely; awfully

meaning_cn: 去离开；从跟随。离开哪儿，走向哪儿。多指在重大问题上选择什么方向。
meaning_en: what course to follow; what path to take

meaning_cn: 多指国家或政党维护主权，不受别人的控制或支配。
meaning_en: independent and autonomous (idiom); self-determination; to act independently; to maintain control over one's own affairs

meaning_cn: 相行互相配合、映衬；益更加；彰显著。指两个人或两件事物互相配合，双方的能力和作用更能显示出来。
meaning_en: to bring out the best in each other (idiom); to complement one another well

meaning_cn: 耐禁得起；寻味探索体味。意味深长，值得人仔细体会琢磨。
meaning_en: (idiom) thought-provoking; to provide food for thought

meaning_cn: 生面新的面目。原意是凌烟阁里的功臣画像本已褪色，经曹将军重画之后才显得有生气。比喻另外创出一种新的形式或局面。
meaning_en: to start sth new or original (idiom); to break a new path; to break fresh ground

meaning_cn: 汇排泄。象是连水也流不出去。形容拥挤或包围的非常严密。
meaning_en: (lit.) not one drop can trickle through (idiom); (fig.) (of crowds, traffic etc) impenetrable

meaning_cn: 一个接着一个，接连不断。
meaning_en: (idiom) one after another; in quick succession

meaning_cn: 不能施展力量。指使不上劲或没有能力去做好某件事情、解决某个问题。
meaning_en: (idiom) powerless to do anything about it

meaning_cn: 难于继续下去。
meaning_en: (idiom) difficult to carry on; unsustainable

meaning_cn: 感感激；身亲身。心里很感激，就象自己亲身领受到一样。
meaning_en: to feel as if it had happened to oneself; to sympathize; (polite expression of gratitude for a favor received by a friend etc) I take it as a personal favor

meaning_cn: 向方向。不知道哪里去了。
meaning_en: whereabouts unknown; gone missing

meaning_cn: 匪不是；夷平常。指言谈行动离奇古怪，不是一般人根据常情所能想象的。
meaning_en: unimaginable; outrageous; freakish

meaning_cn: 背背向；道道路；驰奔跑。朝相反的方向跑去。比喻彼此的方向和目的完全相反。
meaning_en: to run in the opposite direction (idiom); to run counter to

meaning_cn: 不容易相信。
meaning_en: (idiom) hard to believe; incredible

meaning_cn: 用拳打，用脚踢。形容痛打。
meaning_en: lit. to punch and kick (idiom); to beat up; fig. determined to sort out a problem

meaning_cn: 船挂着满帆顺风行驶。比喻非常顺利，没有任何阻碍。
meaning_en: propitious wind throughout the journey (idiom); plain sailing; to go smoothly; have a nice trip!

meaning_cn: 掉摆动；轻轻率。对事情采取轻率的漫不经心的态度。
meaning_en: (idiom) to treat sth lightly; to lower one's guard

meaning_cn: 畅尽情，痛快。畅快地把要说的话都说出来。
meaning_en: lit. fluently saying all one wants (idiom); to preach freely on one's favorite topic; to hold forth to one's heart's content

meaning_cn: 习习惯。指某种事情经常去做，或某种现象经常看到，也就觉得很平常了。
meaning_en: accustomed to; used to

meaning_cn: 百极言其多。有很多漏洞。形容文章、说话或办事，破绽很多。
meaning_en: (of an argument, theory etc) full of flaws (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指出人意料。
meaning_en: (idiom) unexpected

meaning_cn: 从同一血统、派别世代相承流传下来。批某种思想、行为或学说之间有继承关系。
meaning_en: traceable to the same stock (idiom); of a common origin (of trends, ideas etc)

meaning_cn: 无愧毫无愧色。当得起某种称号或荣誉，无须感到惭愧。
meaning_en: fully deserving, without any reservations (idiom); entirely worthy (of a title, honor etc)

meaning_cn: 肆放肆；忌顾忌；惮害怕。非常放肆，一点没有顾忌。
meaning_en: absolutely unrestrained; unbridled; without the slightest scruple

meaning_cn: 寥寥形容数量少。非常稀少，没有几个。
meaning_en: (idiom) very few

meaning_cn: 摸寻找。比喻按照某个线索查究事情。
meaning_en: lit. to follow the vine to get to the melon; to track sth following clues

meaning_cn: 帮助人就是快乐。
meaning_en: pleasure from helping others (idiom)

meaning_cn: 欢乐地聚集在一起。
meaning_en: to gather happily under one roof

meaning_cn: 眼泪流了一脸。形容极度悲伤。
meaning_en: cheeks streaming with tears (idiom)

meaning_cn: 讳避忌，隐讳。说话坦率，毫无顾忌。
meaning_en: to speak bluntly (idiom); not to mince words

meaning_cn: 义道义；反顾向后看。从道义上只有勇往直前，不能犹豫回顾。
meaning_en: honor does not allow one to glance back (idiom); duty-bound not to turn back; no surrender; to pursue justice with no second thoughts

meaning_cn: 心里想做，可是力量够不上。
meaning_en: (idiom) to lack the ability to do what one would wish

meaning_cn: 比喻好的事物到处涌现或普遍发展。
meaning_en: (idiom) to blossom everywhere; to spring up all over the place; to flourish on a large scale

meaning_cn: 指仰慕名声而来。
meaning_en: to come to a place on account of its reputation (idiom); attracted to visit a famous location

meaning_cn: 纷众多，杂乱；沓多，重复。形容接连不断的到来。
meaning_en: to come thick and fast (idiom)

meaning_cn: 兴致兴趣；勃勃旺盛的样子。形容兴头很足。
meaning_en: to become exhilarated (idiom); in high spirits; full of zest

meaning_cn: 指家中日常的饭食。也比喻常见的事情。
meaning_en: simple home-style meal; common occurrence; nothing out of the ordinary

meaning_cn: 措手着手处理。来不及动手应付。指事出意外，一时无法对付。
meaning_en: no time to deal with it (idiom); caught unprepared

meaning_cn: 心里急得象着了火一样。形容非常着急。
meaning_en: (idiom) burning with anxiety; extremely anxious or impatient

meaning_cn: 放一个席位的地方。比喻应有的一个位置。
meaning_en: (acknowledged) place; a role to play; niche

meaning_cn: 栩栩活泼生动的样子。指艺术形象非常逼真，如同活的一样。
meaning_en: vivid and lifelike (idiom); true to life; realistic

meaning_cn: 缭乱纷乱。看着复杂纷繁的东西而感到迷乱。也比喻事物复杂，无法辨清。
meaning_en: to be dazzled

meaning_cn: 在下雪天给人送炭取暖。比喻在别人急需时给以物质上或精神上的帮助。
meaning_en: lit. to send charcoal in snowy weather (idiom); fig. to provide help in sb's hour of need

meaning_cn: 偿抵得上。所得的利益抵偿不了所受的损失。
meaning_en: the gains do not make up for the losses (idiom)

meaning_cn: 恙病。原指人平安没有疾病。现泛指事物平安未遭损害。
meaning_en: safe and sound (idiom); to come out unscathed (e.g. from an accident or illness)

meaning_cn: 指讲话或文章的内容深刻，语言文字却浅显易懂。
meaning_en: to explain a complicated subject matter in simple terms (idiom); (of language) simple and easy to understand

meaning_cn: 从开始到末了。表示一贯到底。
meaning_en: from start to finish (idiom)

meaning_cn: 拉一拉衣襟，就露出臂肘。形容衣服破烂。比喻顾此失彼，穷于应付。
meaning_en: lit. pulling on the lapels exposes the elbows (idiom); strapped for cash; unable to make ends meet

meaning_cn: 拒拒绝。把人挡在门外，不让其进入，形容拒绝协商或共事。
meaning_en: to lock one's door and refuse to see sb

meaning_cn: 却步不敢前进，向后退。形容事物可怕或讨厌，使人一看就往后退缩。
meaning_en: (lit.) to shrink back at the sight of (sth daunting) (idiom); (fig.) to be deterred

meaning_cn: 无声无息，没人知道。指没有什么名声。
meaning_en: (idiom) unknown; unrenowned

meaning_cn: 顺依顺；理条理；章章法。指写文章或做事情顺着条理就能做好。也比喻某种情况自然产生某种结果。
meaning_en: logical; only to be expected; rational and clearly structured (of text)

meaning_cn: 难能极难做到。指不容易做到的事居然能做到，非常可贵。
meaning_en: rare and precious; valuable; remarkable

meaning_cn: 本指山脉的走势和去向。现比喻一件事的前因后果。
meaning_en: (lit.) the rise and fall of the terrain (idiom); (fig.) the whole sequence of events; causes and effects

meaning_cn: 谋商量；合相符。事先没有商量过，意见或行动却完全一致。
meaning_en: to agree without prior consultation; to happen to hold the same view

meaning_cn: 辙车轮碾轧的痕迹∶象出自同一个车辙。比喻两件事情非常相似。
meaning_en: to be precisely the same; to be no different

meaning_cn: 形容十分担心或害怕。
meaning_en: (idiom) nervous; fearful; on edge

meaning_cn: 徇曲从；舞舞弄，耍花样。为了私人关系而用欺骗的方法做违法乱纪的事。
meaning_en: (idiom) to abuse one's position for personal gain

meaning_cn: 什么也不知道。
meaning_en: (idiom) not knowing anything at all; completely ignorant

meaning_cn: 锲镂刻；舍停止。不断地镂刻。比喻有恒心，有毅力。
meaning_en: to chip away at a task and not abandon it (idiom); to chisel away at sth; to persevere; unflagging efforts

meaning_cn: 用心居心，打算。心中另有算计。指言论或行动另有不可告人的企图。
meaning_en: to have an ulterior motive (idiom)

meaning_cn: 打出手戏曲中的一种武打技术，一出剧中的主要人物与多个对手相打，形成种种武打场面。比喻逞凶打人或殴斗。
meaning_en: to come to blows; to start a fight; (derived from the term for a type of theatrical fight scene, 打出手[da3 chu1 shou3])

meaning_cn: 舟船；济渡，过洒。坐一条船，共同渡河。比喻团结互助，同心协力，战胜困难。也比喻利害相同。
meaning_en: cross a river in the same boat (idiom); fig. having common interests; obliged to collaborate towards common goals

meaning_cn: 指春天下雨后，竹笋一下子就长出来很多。比喻事物迅速大量地涌现出来。
meaning_en: lit. after rain, the spring bamboo (idiom); fig. rapid new growth; many new things emerge in rapid succession

meaning_cn: 兢兢形容小心谨慎；业业畏惧的样子。形容做事谨慎、勤恳。
meaning_en: (idiom) conscientious; assiduous

meaning_cn: 哭得噎住了，出不来声音。形容非常伤心。
meaning_en: (idiom) unable to speak through tears; sobbing uncontrollably

meaning_cn: 问津询问渡口。比喻没有人来探问、尝试或购买。
meaning_en: to be of no interest to anyone (idiom)

meaning_cn: 该有的全都有。形容很齐全。
meaning_en: everything that should be here is here (idiom); all one can think of is on hand; to have all one needs

meaning_cn: 引用；戒鉴戒。指把过去犯错误的教训拿来作为警戒，避免重犯。
meaning_en: to take sth as a warning (idiom); to draw a lesson from a case where things turned out badly

meaning_cn: 异军另外一支军队。比喻一支新生力量突然出现。
meaning_en: to emerge as a new force to be reckoned with (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原形容水面辽阔。现比喻声势雄壮或规模巨大。
meaning_en: surging forward with great momentum; unfolding on a magnificent scale

meaning_cn: 奈何如何，怎么办。指感到没有办法，只有这样了。
meaning_en: have no way out; have no alternative; abbr. to 無奈|无奈[wu2 nai4]

meaning_cn: 归结到根本上。
meaning_en: after all; in the final analysis; ultimately

meaning_cn: 兼都。思想品德和学业都很优秀。
meaning_en: excelling both in morals and studies (idiom); top marks for studies and for behavior (at school); a paragon of virtue and learning

meaning_cn: 司空古代官名。指某事常见，不足为奇。
meaning_en: a common occurrence (idiom)

meaning_cn: 澜大波浪。比喻从旁鼓动、助长事物（多指坏的事物）的声势和发展，扩大影响。
meaning_en: to push the wave and add to the billows (idiom); to add momentum; to encourage sth to get bigger; to add fuel to the fire

meaning_cn: 形容非常小或非常少。
meaning_en: a tiny bit; very little; next to nothing (idiom)

meaning_cn: 相提相对照；并齐。把不同的人或不同的事放在一起谈论或看待。
meaning_en: to discuss two disparate things together (idiom); to mention on equal terms; to place on a par with; (often with negatives: impossible to mention X in the same breath as Y)

meaning_cn: 策办法。遇到问题，就象手被捆住一样，一点办法也没有。
meaning_en: lit. to have one's hands bound and be unable to do anything about it (idiom); fig. helpless in the face of a crisis

meaning_cn: 相信他是真的。指把假的当作真的。
meaning_en: to take sth to be true

meaning_cn: 冷灰重新烧了起来。原比喻失势的人重新得势。现常比喻已经消失了的恶势力又重新活动起来。
meaning_en: lit. ashes burn once more (idiom); fig. sb lost returns to have influence; sth malevolent returns to haunt one

meaning_cn: 堪能。痛苦或困苦到了极点，已经不能用言语来表达。
meaning_en: to suffer unspeakable misery; indescribably painful; hellish

meaning_cn: 一分一秒也不放过。形容充分利用时间。
meaning_en: lit. fight minutes, snatch seconds (idiom); a race against time; making every second count

meaning_cn: 集集中；思思考，意见；广扩大。指集中群众的智慧，广泛吸收有益的意见。
meaning_en: collecting opinions is of wide benefit (idiom); to pool wisdom for mutual benefit; to profit from widespread suggestions

meaning_cn: 态度粗暴，不讲道理。
meaning_en: completely unreasonable

meaning_cn: 更生再次获得生命，比喻振兴起来。指不依赖外力，靠自己的力量重新振作起来，把事情办好。
meaning_en: regeneration through one's own effort (idiom); self-reliance

meaning_cn: 的箭靶子；矢箭。放箭要对准靶子。比喻说话做事有针对性。
meaning_en: lit. to have a target in mind when shooting one's arrows (idiom); fig. to have a clear objective

meaning_cn: 建建立；功功勋；业事业。建立功勋，成就大业。
meaning_en: to achieve or accomplish goals

meaning_cn: 人群如山似海。形容人聚集得非常多。
meaning_en: (idiom) multitude; vast crowd

meaning_cn: 溃溃败，散乱。被打得七零八落，不成队伍。形容惨败。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of troops) to be utterly routed and dispersed

meaning_cn: 国家经济和人民生活。
meaning_en: (idiom) national economy and people's livelihood

meaning_cn: 年事年纪。指一个人的岁数已经很大了。
meaning_en: old in years

meaning_cn: 半壁半边；江山比喻国家疆土。指在敌人入侵后残存或丧失的部分国土。
meaning_en: half of the country (esp. when half the country has fallen into enemy hands); vast swathe of territory

meaning_cn: 求寻求；存保留；异不同的。找出共同点，保留不同意见。
meaning_en: (idiom) to put aside differences and work together; to seek common ground and cooperate

meaning_cn: 从挂下来的蜘蛛丝可以找到蜘蛛的所在，从马蹄的印子可以查出马的去向。比喻事情所留下的隐约可寻的痕纪线索。
meaning_en: lit. spider's thread and horse track; tiny hints (of a secret); traces; clue

meaning_cn: 比喻坏人和好人混在一起。
meaning_en: lit. fish and dragons mixed in together (idiom); fig. crooks mixed in with the honest folk

meaning_cn: 指难辨兔的雌雄。形容事情错综复杂，难以辨别清楚。
meaning_en: impossible to unravel; confusing

meaning_cn: 熙熙和乐的样子；攘攘纷乱的样子。形容人来人往，非常热闹拥挤。
meaning_en: (idiom) bustling with activity

meaning_cn: 技技能，本领；长擅长、长处。指有某种技能或特长。
meaning_en: proficiency in a particular field (idiom); skill in a specialized area (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指靠临长江中下游两岸的广大地区。
meaning_en: north and south sides of the Yangtze River (idiom); (fig.) all over China

meaning_cn: 形容数目很少，扳着手指头就能数过来。
meaning_en: (lit.) can be counted on one's fingers (idiom); (fig.) very few

meaning_cn: 公公开；之代指事物的内容；于向；众大众。把事情真相向大家公布。
meaning_en: to make known to the masses (idiom); to publicize widely; to let the world know

meaning_cn: 拍乐曲的段落，也称打拍子。一打拍子就合于乐曲的节奏。比喻困情意相投或有利害关系，一下子就说到一起或结合在一起。
meaning_en: lit. to be together from the first beat (idiom); to hit it off; to click together; to chime in easily

meaning_cn: 形容说话罗嗦，唠叨。
meaning_en: long-winded; garrulous; to talk endlessly without getting to the point

meaning_cn: 苟苟且，马虎。指做事认真细致，一点儿不马虎。
meaning_en: not one thread loose (idiom); strictly according to the rules; meticulous; not one hair out of place

meaning_cn: 互相依靠着过日子。泛指互相依靠，谁也离不开谁。
meaning_en: mutually dependent for life (idiom); to rely upon one another for survival; interdependent

meaning_cn: 微细，小；足值得；道谈起。微小得很，不值得一提。指意义、价值等小得不值得一提。
meaning_en: (idiom) negligible; insignificant

meaning_cn: 作为做出成绩。能够极大地发挥作用，作一番贡献。
meaning_en: to accomplish much; to have good prospects; to have a promising future

meaning_cn: 莠狗尾草，很象谷子，常混在禾苗中∶人坏人都有，混杂在一起。
meaning_en: good and bad people intermingled

meaning_cn: 瞩注视。使人注视。
meaning_en: (idiom) attention-grabbing; noteworthy

meaning_cn: 原意是说，劈竹子时，头上几节一破开，下面的顺着刀口自己就裂开了。比喻处理事情、解决问题很顺利。
meaning_en: lit. (bamboo) splits when it meets the knife's edge (idiom); fig. easily solved

meaning_cn: 降下落。比喻出于意外，突然出现。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fall from the sky; (idiom) (fig.) to appear unexpectedly; to drop into one's lap

meaning_cn: 时宜当时的需要和潮流。不适合时代形势的需要。也指不合世俗习尚。
meaning_en: out of step with current thinking; outmoded; inappropriate for the occasion

meaning_cn: 佛教用语。指佛力广大，能现出种种人相，向人说法。现指以亲身经历和体验为例来说明某种道理。
meaning_en: to talk from one's personal experience; to use oneself as an example

meaning_cn: 陈陈旧的；代替换；谢凋谢，衰亡。指生物体不断用新物质代替旧物质的过程。也指新事物不断产生发展，代替旧的事物。
meaning_en: metabolism (biology); the new replaces the old (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指地位高，现在形容领导者脱离实际，脱离群众。
meaning_en: (idiom) situated high; aloft; (idiom) (fig.) aloof and remote; situated above the masses and out of touch with reality

meaning_cn: 符合情理。
meaning_en: (idiom) reasonable; fair

meaning_cn: 量估量；行行事。按照自己力量的大小去做，不要勉强。
meaning_en: to assess one's capabilities and act accordingly (idiom); to act within one's competence; One does what one can.

meaning_cn: 指不符合实际。
meaning_en: unrealistic; impractical

meaning_cn: 针锋针尖。针尖对针尖。比喻双方在策略、论点及行动方式等方面尖锐对立。
meaning_en: to oppose each other with equal harshness (idiom); tit for tat; measure for measure

meaning_cn: 贷推卸。自己应尽的责任，不能推卸给旁人。
meaning_en: to be duty bound; to be one's unshirkable responsibility

meaning_cn: 瞻视，望；瞩注视。站得高，看得远。比喻眼光远大。
meaning_en: to stand tall and see far (idiom); taking the long and broad view; acute foresight

meaning_cn: 形容为数极多。
meaning_en: lit. by the thousands and tens of thousands (idiom); untold numbers; innumerable; thousands upon thousands

meaning_cn: 明目睁亮眼睛；张胆放开胆量。原指有胆识，敢做敢为◇形容公开放肆地干坏事。
meaning_en: openly and without fear; brazenly

meaning_cn: 连锁像锁链似的一环扣一环。比喻相关的事物发生相应的变化。
meaning_en: (physics) chain reaction; (idiom) chain reaction; series of events each caused by the previous one

meaning_cn: 适正，恰好。恰恰得到与预期相反的结果。
meaning_en: to produce the opposite of the desired result

meaning_cn: 旧时神怪小说中描写有神通的人能用法术一晃身子就改变自己本来的模样。现用来形容人不讲道义原则，一下子来个大改变。
meaning_en: to change shape in a single shake; fig. to take on a new lease of life

meaning_cn: 跃跃急于要行动的样子；欲要。形容急切地想试试。
meaning_en: to be eager to give sth a try (idiom)

meaning_cn: 会集中。原指君臣协力，集思广益◇形容精神高度集中。
meaning_en: to concentrate one's attention (idiom)

meaning_cn: 承承接；启开创。承接前面的，开创后来的。指继承前人事业，为后人开辟道路。
meaning_en: to follow the past and herald the future (idiom); part of a historical transition; forming a bridge between earlier and later stages

meaning_cn: 用一杯水去救一车着了火的柴草。比喻力量太小，解决不了问题。
meaning_en: lit. a cup of water on a burning cart of firewood (idiom); fig. an utterly inadequate measure

meaning_cn: 比喻一个不漏地全部抓住或彻底肃清。
meaning_en: lit. to catch everything in the one net (idiom); fig. to scoop up the whole lot; to capture them all in one go

meaning_cn: 原指经播种耕耘后有了收获。现比喻工作有进展，并取得了成果。
meaning_en: (lit.) to blossom and bear fruit (idiom); (fig.) to come to fruition; to yield favorable results

meaning_cn: 慷慨豪爽，大方；解囊解开钱袋拿出钱来。形容极其大方地在经济上帮助别人。
meaning_en: to contribute generously (idiom); help sb generously with money; to give generously to charity

meaning_cn: 素平素，向来。向来不认识。
meaning_en: to be total strangers (idiom)

meaning_cn: 格格阻碍，隔阂。形容彼此不协调，不相容。
meaning_en: (idiom) inharmonious; incompatible

meaning_cn: 蔚然草木茂盛的样子。指一件事情逐渐发展盛行，形成一种良好风气。
meaning_en: to have become common practice (idiom); to become a general trend

meaning_cn: 形容自然界充满生命力，或社会生活活跃。
meaning_en: (idiom) vibrant; full of vitality

meaning_cn: 耐禁受得住。能过困苦的生活，也经得起劳累。
meaning_en: hardworking and enduring hardships (idiom)

meaning_cn: 神志昏沉，不省人事。
meaning_en: to remain unconscious

meaning_cn: 径小路；庭院子；径庭悬殊，偏激。比喻相差很远，大不相同。
meaning_en: as different as can be (idiom); poles apart

meaning_cn: 堂皇官署的大堂，引申为气势盛大的样子。形容端正庄严或雄伟有气派。也指表面上庄严正大，堂堂正正，实际却不然。
meaning_en: overt; to make no secret (of one's presence); grandiose; with great scope

meaning_cn: 好象数自己家藏的珍宝那样清楚。比喻对所讲的事情十分熟悉。
meaning_en: lit. as if enumerating one's family valuables (idiom); fig. to be very familiar with a matter

meaning_cn: 抢着向前，唯恐落后。
meaning_en: (idiom) to compete to be first; to scramble to get ahead; to rush forward for fear of falling behind

meaning_cn: 用浓重的墨汁和颜色来描绘。形容着力描写。
meaning_en: thick and heavy in colors; to describe sth in colorful language with attention to detail (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指使用阔大的刀斧砍杀敌人◇比喻办事果断而有魄力。
meaning_en: bold and decisive

meaning_cn: 失措失去常态。由于惊慌，一下子不知怎么办才好。
meaning_en: to lose one's head out of fear (idiom)

meaning_cn: 剩余留下来的。剩下的没有多少了。
meaning_en: there is not much left

meaning_cn: 禄俸禄。泛指职位高，待遇优。
meaning_en: high post and generous salary (idiom); promotion to a high official position

meaning_cn: 只有一个心眼儿，没有别的考虑。
meaning_en: concentrating one's thoughts and efforts; single-minded; bent on; intently

meaning_cn: 井然整齐不乱的样子。序次序。整整齐齐，次序分明，条理清楚。
meaning_en: everything clear and in good order (idiom); neat and tidy

meaning_cn: 原指写字的笔法曲折多变。现比喻文章的结构起伏曲折。也比喻事情进行中意外的变化很多。
meaning_en: calligraphic flourish with many twists; fig. many twists and turns

meaning_cn: 手摸上去感到热得烫人。比喻权势大，气焰盛，使人不敢接近。
meaning_en: lit. burn your hand, feel the heat (idiom); fig. arrogance of the powerful; a mighty figure no-one dares approach; hot (exciting or in favor)

meaning_cn: 临到；境境界，地方。亲自到了那个境地。
meaning_en: (idiom) to experience it for oneself; to actually *be* there (as opposed to reading about it etc)

meaning_cn: 不说任何别的话。指立即行动。
meaning_en: (idiom) not saying anything further; not raising any objection; without demur

meaning_cn: 流连留恋不止。玩乐时留恋不愿离开。留恋得忘记了回去。
meaning_en: to linger; to remain enjoying oneself and forget to go home

meaning_cn: 盈充满；眶眼眶。因感情激动而使眼泪充满了眼眶，形容感动至极或非常悲伤。
meaning_en: eyes brimming with tears of excitement (idiom); extremely moved

meaning_cn: 销通消”，消失；匿隐藏；迹踪迹。指隐藏起来，不公开露面。
meaning_en: to vanish without trace (idiom); to lie low

meaning_cn: 打击攻击。用敌对的态度回击对方。
meaning_en: (idiom) to retaliate

meaning_cn: 指费尽心力。
meaning_en: making an all-out effort (idiom); to try one's heart out; to do one's utmost

meaning_cn: 贯贯穿。用一个根本性的事理贯通事情的始末或全部的道理。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a principle, purpose etc) consistently upheld; adhered to from beginning to end

meaning_cn: 恍然猛然清醒的样子；悟心里明白。形容一下子明白过来。
meaning_en: (idiom) to suddenly realize; to suddenly see the light

meaning_cn: 之代词，它；理理睬。放在一边，不理不睬。
meaning_en: to pay no heed to (idiom); to ignore; to brush aside

meaning_cn: 形容事情容易做，不费力气。
meaning_en: easy; with no difficulty

meaning_cn: 人来来往往连续不断。也形容忙于应酬。
meaning_en: (idiom) people coming and going; bustling with activity

meaning_cn: 泛称美好山河。
meaning_en: (lit.) green hills and clear waters (idiom); (fig.) picturesque natural scenery

meaning_cn: 多方面同时前进。多形容几件事情或几项工作同时进行。
meaning_en: to go forward together (idiom); to undertake simultaneous tasks; going hand in hand

meaning_cn: 筹筹划、计谋；展施展。一点计策也施展不出，一点办法也想不出来。
meaning_en: to be unable to find a solution; to be at wits' end

meaning_cn: 形容百花盛开，丰富多彩。比喻各种不同形式和风格的艺术自由发展。也形容艺术界的繁荣景象。
meaning_en: a hundred flowers bloom (idiom); let the arts have free expression

meaning_cn: 执坚持。各人坚持各人的说法。形容意见不一致。
meaning_en: each sticks to his own version (idiom); a dialogue of the deaf

meaning_cn: 道途径。志趣相同，意见一致。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be devoted to a common cause; to be like-minded

meaning_cn: 费尽脑筋。
meaning_en: to rack one's brains

meaning_cn: 首首先。扳指头计算，首先弯下大拇指，表示第一。指居第一位。引申为最好的。
meaning_en: to count as number one (idiom); second to none; outstanding

meaning_cn: 渠水道。水流到的地方自然形成一条水道。比喻条件成熟，事情自然会成功。
meaning_en: lit. where water flows, a canal is formed (idiom); fig. when conditions are right, success will follow naturally

meaning_cn: 廉便宜。东西价钱便宜，质量又好。
meaning_en: good quality and cheap; a bargain

meaning_cn: 纷纭多而姑乱。人多嘴杂，议论纷纷。
meaning_en: opinions differ (idiom)

meaning_cn: 为政管理政事，泛指行事。各自按自己的主张办事，不互相配合。比喻不考虑全局，各搞一套。
meaning_en: to do things each in one's own way

meaning_cn: 话深刻有力，情意深长。
meaning_en: meaningful and heartfelt words (idiom); sincere and earnest wishes

meaning_cn: 德品德；才才能；备具备。既有好的思想品质，又有工作的才干和能力。
meaning_en: (idiom) possessing both integrity and talent

meaning_cn: 此这。因酷爱干某事而不感觉厌烦。形容对某事特别爱好而沉浸其中。
meaning_en: (idiom) to enjoy sth and never tire of it

meaning_cn: 方正在；兴兴起；艾停止。事物正在发展，尚未达到止境。
meaning_en: flourishing and still in the ascendant (idiom); rapidly expanding; still growing strong; on the up

meaning_cn: 形容色彩复杂或花样繁多。引伸为各色各样。
meaning_en: multicolored; every color under the sun

meaning_cn: 衷内心。心里一点儿也没有触动。指对应该关心、注意的事情毫不关心，置之不理。
meaning_en: aloof; indifferent; unconcerned

meaning_cn: 锦有彩色花纹的丝织品。在锦上再绣花。比喻好上加好，美上添美。
meaning_en: (lit.) to add flowers to brocade (idiom); (fig.) to make sth good even better; to add an extra (often nonessential) benefit or embellishment

meaning_cn: 指对旧的文化进行批判地继承，剔除其糟粕，吸取其精华，创造出新的文化。
meaning_en: to push out the old and bring in the new (idiom); to innovate

meaning_cn: 树立；帜旗帜。单独树起一面旗帜。比喻独特新奇，自成一家。
meaning_en: lit. to fly one's banner on a solitary tree (idiom); fig. to act as a loner; to stand out; to develop one's own school; to have attitude of one's own

meaning_cn: 形容生活简朴，吃用节俭。
meaning_en: (idiom) to live frugally

meaning_cn: 济补益，帮助。对事情没有什么帮助或益处。比喻不解决问题。
meaning_en: (idiom) to no avail; of no use

meaning_cn: 禁抑制。感情激动得不能控制。强调完全被某种感情所支配。
meaning_en: (idiom) cannot refrain from; cannot help; cannot but

meaning_cn: 足值得。不值得奇怪。指某种事物或现象很平常，没有什么奇怪的。
meaning_en: not at all surprising (idiom)

meaning_cn: 再也忍受不下去了。
meaning_en: more than one can bear (idiom); at the end of one's patience; the last straw

meaning_cn: 专心一意地刻苦工作。
meaning_en: to bury oneself in work (idiom); to be engrossed in work; to make an all-out effort; up to the neck in work

meaning_cn: 形容草木苍翠茂盛。也形容气势美好蓬勃。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of plants) verdant; lush

meaning_cn: 指做事得法，因而费力小，收效大。
meaning_en: (idiom) to achieve twice the result with half the effort

meaning_cn: 省知觉。指昏迷过去，失去知觉。也指不懂人情世故。
meaning_en: to lose consciousness; unconscious; in a coma

meaning_cn: 分、别分辨、区别；门一般事物的分类；类许多相似或相同事物的综合。把一些事物按照特性和特征分别归入各种门类。
meaning_en: (idiom) to organize by categories; to classify

meaning_cn: 别另外；心裁心中的设计、筹划。另有一种构思或设计。指想出的办法与众不同。
meaning_en: to hit on sth new (idiom); to display originality; to adopt an original approach

meaning_cn: 热烈的感情充分地流露出来。
meaning_en: brimming with enthusiasm (idiom); full of warmth

meaning_cn: 张陈设，展示；旗鼓旗帜和战鼓。形容进攻的声势和规能大。也形容群众活动声势和规能大。
meaning_en: (idiom) with great fanfare; on a grand scale

meaning_cn: 防防备；胜尽。形容防备不过来。
meaning_en: (idiom) virtually impossible to prevent

meaning_cn: 用欺骗的手段逃过关口。
meaning_en: to get away with it; to slip through; to bluff one's way out; Taiwan pr. [meng1 hun4 guo4 guan1]

meaning_cn: 错落参差不齐。致情趣。形容事物的布局虽然参差不齐，但却极有情趣，使人看了有好感。
meaning_en: in picturesque disorder (idiom); irregular arrangement with charming effect

meaning_cn: 形容微小零星。
meaning_en: bit by bit; every little bit

meaning_cn: 敷够，足。收入不够支出。
meaning_en: income does not cover expenditure; unable to make ends meet

meaning_cn: 素平素，向来。不管人家怎样说，仍旧按照自己平素的一套去做。
meaning_en: to continue in one's own way (idiom)

meaning_cn: 反复深入地考虑。
meaning_en: mature reflection; after careful deliberations

meaning_cn: 趋快走；鹜野鸭。象鸭子一样成群跑过去。比喻很多人争着赶去。
meaning_en: to rush like ducks (idiom); the mob scrabbles madly for sth unobtainable; an unruly crowd on a wild goose chase

meaning_cn: 微微细；至到。没有一处细微的地方不照顾到。形容关怀、照顾得非常细心周到。
meaning_en: in every possible way (idiom); meticulous

meaning_cn: 超出言语以外，指某种思想感情虽未说明却能使人体会出来。
meaning_en: to exhibit one's feelings in one's speech

meaning_cn: 车象流水，马象游龙。形容来往车马很多，连续不断的热闹情景。
meaning_en: endless stream of horse and carriages (idiom); heavy traffic

meaning_cn: 同德为同一目的而努力。指思想统一，信念一致。
meaning_en: of one mind (idiom)

meaning_cn: 适归向；从跟从。不知听从哪一个好。指不知怎么办才好。
meaning_en: not knowing which course to follow (idiom); at a loss what to do

meaning_cn: 厉猛烈。指比原来更加发展。现指情况变得比本来更加严重。
meaning_en: lit. change to more severe (idiom); to become more intense (esp. of shortcoming); to aggravate; to intensify

meaning_cn: 勃勃旺盛的样子。形容雄心很大，很有理想。
meaning_en: aggressive and grand (idiom); ambitious; pushy

meaning_cn: 崭突出；露显露。头上的角已明显地突出来了。指初显露优异的才能。
meaning_en: to reveal outstanding talent (idiom); to stand out as conspicuously brilliant

meaning_cn: 为了实际应用而学习。
meaning_en: (idiom) to study sth in order to apply it

meaning_cn: 对情况和问题有基本的了解，处理事情有一定把握。
meaning_en: to know what's going on

meaning_cn: 指全国各地，有时也指世界各地。现有时也比喻广泛的团结。
meaning_en: all parts of the country

meaning_cn: 审仔细研究；时时局；度估计；势发展趋势。观察分析时势，估计情况的变化。
meaning_en: to judge the hour and size up the situation; to take stock

meaning_cn: 择选择。指为了达到目的，什么手段都使得出来。
meaning_en: by fair means or foul; by hook or by crook; unscrupulously

meaning_cn: 大幅度地起落。形容变化大。
meaning_en: (of market prices etc) to rapidly fluctuate (idiom); volatile; significant ups and downs; roller coaster

meaning_cn: 厌嫌。不嫌麻烦。
meaning_en: not to mind taking all the trouble (idiom); to take great pains; to be very patient

meaning_cn: 比喻说话直截了当，切中要害。
meaning_en: lit. to draw blood on the first prick (idiom); fig. to hit the nail on the head

meaning_cn: 四面八方都有路可通。形容交通极便利。也形容通向各方。
meaning_en: roads open in all directions (idiom); accessible from all sides

meaning_cn: 开打开，解开；交相错，纠缠。形容没法解开或摆脱。
meaning_en: to be awfully (busy etc)

meaning_cn: 春天气候温暖，百花盛开，景色优美。比喻游览、观赏的大好时机。
meaning_en: (lit.) springtime when the weather is warm and flowers are in bloom (idiom); (fig.) a time of renewal and flourishing

meaning_cn: 经规范，原则；义正理。天地间历久不变的常道。指绝对正确，不能改变的道理。也指理所当然的事。
meaning_en: lit. heaven's law and earth's principle (idiom); fig. right and proper; right and unalterable; a matter of course

meaning_cn: 一直拖在那里，没有得到解决。
meaning_en: (idiom) pending a decision; hanging in the balance

meaning_cn: 一句话也不说。
meaning_en: to not say a word (idiom)

meaning_cn: 像一窝蜂似地一拥而来。形容很多人乱哄哄地朝一个地方聚拢。
meaning_en: to arrive in huge numbers; to flock there

meaning_cn: 大模大样地径自走了。
meaning_en: to swagger off; to walk off (or drive off etc) without a second thought for those left behind

meaning_cn: 水落下去，水底的石头就露出来。比喻事情的真相完全显露出来。
meaning_en: (lit.) as the water recedes, the rocks appear (idiom); (fig.) the truth comes to light

meaning_cn: 开阔视野，增回见识。
meaning_en: (idiom) to broaden one's horizons greatly

meaning_cn: 边唱歌，边跳舞。形容尽情欢乐。
meaning_en: singing and dancing (idiom); festive celebrations

meaning_cn: 子虚并非真实；乌有哪有。指假设的、不存在的、不真实的事情。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have no basis in fact; to be the product of sb's imagination

meaning_cn: 了明白；指掌指着手掌。形容对事物了解得非常清楚，象把东西放在手掌里给人家看一样。
meaning_en: variant of 了如指掌[liao3 ru2 zhi3 zhang3]

meaning_cn: 历历清楚，分明的样子。指远方的景物看得清清楚楚，或过去的事情清清楚楚地重现在眼前。
meaning_en: vivid in one's mind (idiom)

meaning_cn: 迁就私情而违反法纪。
meaning_en: to bend the law in order to favor one's relatives or associates (idiom)

meaning_cn: 象风云那样变化不定。比喻时局变化迅速，动向难以预料。
meaning_en: changeable situation (idiom)

meaning_cn: 千条丝，万条线。原形容一根又一根，数也数不清。现多形容相互之间种种密切而复杂的联系。
meaning_en: (idiom) intricately interconnected

meaning_cn: 奋勇向前，不考虑个人安危。
meaning_en: to dash on bravely with no thought of personal safety (idiom); undaunted by dangers; regardless of perils

meaning_cn: 原指描绘时用浅淡的颜色轻轻地着笔。现多指说话写文章把重要问题轻轻带过。
meaning_en: (idiom) to treat sth as no big deal; to downplay; to understate

meaning_cn: 又像是有意的，又像是无意的。存心与不经意。
meaning_en: intentionally or otherwise

meaning_cn: 顾看；义意义，含义。从名称想到所包含的意义。
meaning_en: as the name implies

meaning_cn: 形容说话或表演精彩生动。
meaning_en: having sound and color (idiom); vivid; dazzling

meaning_cn: 流离转徒离散。无处安身，到处流浪。
meaning_en: destitute and homeless (idiom); forced from one's home and wandering about; displaced

meaning_cn: 诸众多；此这，这样。象这类的各种事物。
meaning_en: things like this (idiom); and so on; and the rest; etc

meaning_cn: 十分清楚、明白。
meaning_en: to be very clear about sth (idiom)

meaning_cn: 万众一心，象坚固的城墙一样不可摧毁。比喻团结一致，力量无比强大。
meaning_en: unity of will is an impregnable stronghold (idiom)

meaning_cn: 扶扶助，照料。抢救生命垂危的人，照顾受伤的人。现形容医务工作者全心全意为人民服务的精神。
meaning_en: to help the dying and heal the injured

meaning_cn: 寐睡着。做梦的时候都在追求。形容迫切地期望着。
meaning_en: (lit.) to yearn for sth even in one's dreams (idiom); (fig.) to deeply long for; to covet

meaning_cn: 逍遥优游自得的样子。指犯法的人没有受到法律制裁，仍然自由自在。
meaning_en: unfettered and beyond the law (idiom); evading retribution; getting away with it (e.g. crimes); still at large

meaning_cn: 按捺压抑，忍耐。心里急燥，克制不住。
meaning_en: to be unable to hold back

meaning_cn: 信誓表示诚意的誓言；旦旦诚恳的样子。誓言说得真实可信。
meaning_en: to make a solemn vow

meaning_cn: 没法计算数目。形容很多。
meaning_en: lit. their number cannot be counted (idiom); fig. countless; innumerable

meaning_cn: 少一样也不行。
meaning_en: not a single one is dispensable; can't do without either

meaning_cn: 原为道教用语。指修道者得道以后，就转凡胎为圣胎，换凡骨为仙骨。现比喻通过教育，思想得到彻底改造。
meaning_en: to shed one's mortal body and exchange one's bones (idiom); born again Daoist; to turn over a new leaf; fig. to change wholly; to create from other material (story, artwork etc)

meaning_cn: 心意真实诚恳，没有虚假。
meaning_en: (idiom) genuine; sincere; wholehearted

meaning_cn: 簿文状、起诉书之类；对簿受审问；公堂旧指官吏审理案件的地方。在法庭上受审问。
meaning_en: public courtroom accusation (idiom); legal confrontation; to take sb to court; to sue

meaning_cn: 指大风大雨。亦比喻猛烈的声势或处境险恶。
meaning_en: (idiom) howling wind and torrential rain; furious storm; (fig.) (idiom) difficult circumstances; dangerous situation

meaning_cn: 复再，又。过了一天又一天。比喻日子久，时间长。也形容光阴白白地过去。
meaning_en: day after day

meaning_cn: 苍苍灰白色。头发灰白。形容人的苍老。
meaning_en: old and gray-haired

meaning_cn: 形容风景优美。
meaning_en: lit. verdant hills and limpid water (idiom); fig. enchanting scenery

meaning_cn: 随任凭；欲想要。随着自己的意思，想要干什么就干什么。
meaning_en: (idiom) to follow one's heart's desires; to do as one pleases

meaning_cn: 原形容水势广大的样子◇形容事物的广阔壮大，或前进的人流声势浩大。
meaning_en: (idiom) grandiose; majestic

meaning_cn: 未来情况不能想象。指预料事情会发展到很坏的地步。
meaning_en: too horrible to contemplate; unthinkable; inconceivable

meaning_cn: 叹赞赏；观止看到这里就够了。指赞美所见到的事物好到了极点。
meaning_en: (idiom) to gasp in amazement; to acclaim as the peak of perfection

meaning_cn: 由不得自己，控制不住自己。
meaning_en: (idiom) can't help but; involuntarily

meaning_cn: 形容没有人能比得上。
meaning_en: first under heaven; number one in the country

meaning_cn: 偿实现、满足。按所希望的那样得到满足。指愿望实现。
meaning_en: to have one's wish fulfilled

meaning_cn: 吸取别人的长处，来弥补自己的不足之处。也泛指在同类事物中吸取这个的长处来弥补那个的短处。
meaning_en: lit. use others' strengths to make up for one's weak points (idiom from Mencius); to use this in place of that; what you lose on the swings, you win on the roundabouts

meaning_cn: 看到的和听到的。
meaning_en: what one hears and sees (idiom)

meaning_cn: 咫尺很近的距离。形容距离很近。
meaning_en: (idiom) very close; almost within reach; close at hand

meaning_cn: 每句话，每个行动。
meaning_en: every word and action (idiom)

meaning_cn: 睹看。凄惨得叫人不忍心看。
meaning_en: lit. so horrible that one cannot bear to look (idiom); fig. miserable; horrendous; atrocious

meaning_cn: 一无全无。什么东西都没有获得。
meaning_en: to gain nothing; to end up empty-handed

meaning_cn: 指人们或集团已经获得的，法定的某种特别权益。
meaning_en: vested interest

meaning_cn: 呼叫，喊。形容人像画得逼真，似乎叫一声就会从画中走出来。泛指文学作品中人物的描写十分生动。
meaning_en: lit. ready to appear at the call (idiom); fig. on the verge of coming out into the open; (of a person's choice etc) on the point of being disclosed; (of an artistic depiction) vividly portrayed

meaning_cn: 指单方面的愿望或不考虑客观实际情况的主观意愿。同一相情愿”。
meaning_en: one's own wishful thinking

meaning_cn: 指人一生中最为宝贵的时期。也指国家政治、经济、文化最繁荣的时期。
meaning_en: golden age

meaning_cn: 伦比类比，匹敌。指事物非常完美，没有能跟它相比的。
meaning_en: incomparable

meaning_cn: 道家认为，天下万物生于有，有生于无。把没有的说成有。比喻毫无事实，凭空捏造。
meaning_en: to create something from nothing (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容在一个时期里到处传播，影响很大。
meaning_en: to cause a sensation (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指大街小巷。
meaning_en: top of streets, bottom of alleys (idiom); everywhere in the city

meaning_cn: 金石钟磬之类的乐器，声音清脆优美。比喻文章文辞优美，语言铿锵有力。
meaning_en: lit. if thrown on the floor, it will make a sound (idiom); fig. (of one's words) powerful and resonating; to have substance

meaning_cn: 戛象声词。形容声音突然终止。
meaning_en: with a grunting sound it stops (idiom); to come to an end spontaneously (esp. of sound)

meaning_cn: 念念时刻思念着。形容牢记于心，时刻不忘。
meaning_en: to keep in mind constantly (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指商人为了牟取暴利而暗中降低产品质量，削减工料。现也指做事图省事，马虎敷衍。
meaning_en: to skimp on the job and stint on materials (idiom); jerry-building; sloppy work

meaning_cn: 津津兴趣浓厚的样子。指吃得很有味道或谈得很有兴趣。
meaning_en: with keen interest (idiom); with great pleasure; with gusto; eagerly

meaning_cn: 原指人的容貌发生了改变。现多比喻只改外表和形式，内容实质不变。
meaning_en: to change outwardly while remaining essentially the same (derog.) (idiom); (Tw) (non-derogatory) to change considerably; to undergo a transformation

meaning_cn: 将别人的东西拿来作为自己的。
meaning_en: (idiom) to illegally take possession of; to appropriate

meaning_cn: 大体相同，略有差异。
meaning_en: virtually the same; differing only on small points

meaning_cn: 指别人已有进步，不能再用老眼光去看他。
meaning_en: to have a whole new level of respect for sb or sth; to sit up and take notice (of sb's improved performance etc)

meaning_cn: 发指头发竖起来，形容极为愤怒。使人头发都竖起来了。形容使人极度愤怒。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make one feel a sense of revulsion; abhorrent; heinous; deeply disturbing

meaning_cn: 形容因吃惊或害怕而发愣的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) dumbstruck; stupefied; stunned

meaning_cn: 三个两个地在一起。形容人数不多。
meaning_en: in twos and threes

meaning_cn: 厉猛烈。象雷那样猛烈，象风那样快。比喻执行政策法令严厉迅速。也形容办事声势猛烈，行动迅速。
meaning_en: pass like thunder and move like the wind (idiom); swift and decisive reaction

meaning_cn: 不受刮风下雨的阻碍。指预先约好的事情，一定按期进行。
meaning_en: regardless of weather conditions; rain, hail or shine

meaning_cn: 江郎指南朝江淹。原指江淹少有文名，晚年诗文无佳句。比喻才情减退。
meaning_en: Jiang Yan has exhausted his talent (idiom); fig. to have used up one's creative powers; to have writer's block

meaning_cn: 轮高大；奂众多。形容房屋高大华丽。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of houses, scenery etc) magnificent

meaning_cn: 货物不是冒牌的，价钱也是实在的。形容实实在在，一点不假。
meaning_en: (lit.) genuine goods at fair prices (idiom); (fig.) genuine; real; true

meaning_cn: 令命令；申表达，说明。多次命令和告诫。
meaning_en: to order again and again (idiom)

meaning_cn: 彼此和好地相处。
meaning_en: to live in harmony; to get along with each other

meaning_cn: 金原指钱财，现泛指各种贵重物品；昧隐藏。拾到东西并不隐瞒下来据为己有。指良好的仆人道德和社会风尚。
meaning_en: to pick up money and not hide it (idiom); to return property to its owner

meaning_cn: 因人的不同而有所差异。
meaning_en: varying from person to person (idiom); different for each individual

meaning_cn: 只是写在纸上没有兑现或不能兑现的东西。
meaning_en: a worthless piece of paper (idiom)

meaning_cn: 管指笔。原指手握双笔同时作画◇比喻做一件事两个方面同时进行或两种方法同时使用。
meaning_en: lit. to paint holding two brushes (idiom); fig. to work on two tasks at the same time; to attack one problem from two angles at the same time

meaning_cn: 不经考虑，随口说出。
meaning_en: (idiom) to blurt out; to let slip (an indiscreet remark)

meaning_cn: 曾曾经；几何若干、多少。才有多少时候。指没过多久。
meaning_en: just a while before; not so long ago; everyone can remember when..

meaning_cn: 本意是形容桃花茂盛艳丽◇借用逃之夭夭”表示逃跑，是诙谐的说法。
meaning_en: to escape without trace (idiom); to make one's getaway (from the scene of a crime); to show a clean pair of heels

meaning_cn: 心里完全愿意，没有一点勉强。多指自愿做出某种牺牲。
meaning_en: delighted to (do sth, idiom); perfectly happy to do; most willing to do

meaning_cn: 朝早晨；夕晚上。一个早晨或一个晚上。形容很短的时间。
meaning_en: lit. one morning and one evening (idiom); fig. in a short period of time; overnight

meaning_cn: 倾倒出；荡扫除，弄光。全部家产都被弄光了。
meaning_en: to lose a family fortune (idiom)

meaning_cn: 图谋取。有利益可谋求。
meaning_en: profitable

meaning_cn: 千万人一条心。形容团结一致。
meaning_en: millions of people all of one mind (idiom); the people united

meaning_cn: 形容器物书画等富有古雅的色彩和情调。
meaning_en: interesting and appealing (of old locations, objects etc)

meaning_cn: 铭刻在心灵深处。形容记忆深刻，永远不忘。
meaning_en: lit. carved in bones and engraved in the heart (idiom); fig. etched in one's memory; unforgettable

meaning_cn: 比喻阴谋已败露。
meaning_en: (of a plot etc) to be exposed (idiom); to come to light

meaning_cn: 打开门就能看见山。比喻说话或写文章直截了当谈本题，不拐弯抹角。
meaning_en: lit. to open the door and see the mountain; fig. to get right to the point (idiom)

meaning_cn: 蒸蒸一升、兴盛的样子。形容事业一天天向上发展。
meaning_en: becoming more prosperous with each passing day

meaning_cn: 大风刮起，乌云涌现。比喻新事物相继兴起，声势很盛。
meaning_en: to surge like a gathering storm (idiom); to grow by leaps and bounds

meaning_cn: 形容无秩序，无条理，乱得不成样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) chaotic; in disorder; muddled

meaning_cn: 浑身全身，指所有的；解数那套数，指武艺。所有的本领，全部的权术手腕。
meaning_en: to give it your all; to go at it with all you've got; to throw your whole weight behind it; also pr. [hun2 shen1 jie3 shu4]

meaning_cn: 指不接受别人的劝告，顽固地按照自己的主观想法去做。
meaning_en: obstinately clinging to one's course (idiom); willful; one's own way; dogmatic

meaning_cn: 形容某一种人为数不少。
meaning_en: there are plenty of such people

meaning_cn: 一年又一年。比喻日子久，时间长。也形容光阴白白地过去。
meaning_en: (idiom) over the years; year after year

meaning_cn: 对于一个地方的气候条件或饮食习惯不能适应。
meaning_en: not acclimatized

meaning_cn: 只有一个，再没有别的。形容非常少有。
meaning_en: one and only (idiom); rarely seen; unique of its kind

meaning_cn: 奄奄呼吸微弱的样子。只剩下一口气。形容临近死亡。
meaning_en: dying; at one's last gasp

meaning_cn: 生生中国哲学术语，指变化和新生事物的发生；不已没有终止。不断地生长、繁殖。
meaning_en: to grow and multiply without end

meaning_cn: 从开头到结尾。指某件事物的全过程或全部内容。
meaning_en: from start to finish; from head to tail; the whole (thing)

meaning_cn: 被逼得没有办法，不得不这样。
meaning_en: to have no alternative (idiom); compelled by circumstances; forced into sth

meaning_cn: 指处理事情公正符合情理。
meaning_en: fair; equitable

meaning_cn: 独唯独；善好，维护。原意是做不上官就修养好自身。现指只顾自己，不管别人。
meaning_en: (idiom) (originally, in Mencius) to cultivate one's moral character in solitude; (modern sense) to look after only one's own interests

meaning_cn: 指说话做事恰好到了最合适的地步。
meaning_en: it's just perfect; it's just right

meaning_cn: 触碰；即就。原指把箭扣在弦上，拉开弓等着射出去。比喻事态发展到了十分紧张的阶段，稍一触动就立即会爆发。
meaning_en: could happen at any moment; on the verge

meaning_cn: 形容不负责任地胡乱议论。
meaning_en: to make thoughtless remarks (idiom); to criticize; gossip

meaning_cn: 胜尽；枚个。不能一个个地列举出来。形容数量很多。
meaning_en: too numerous to mention individually or one by one

meaning_cn: 抒抒发，发表。各人充分发表自己的意见。
meaning_en: everyone gives their own view

meaning_cn: 意味情调，趣味。意思含畜深远，耐人寻味。
meaning_en: profound; significant; meaningful

meaning_cn: 指有丰富敏捷的智力和显著的才能。
meaning_en: intelligence and ability

meaning_cn: 生存或者死亡。形容局势或斗争的的发展已到最后关头。
meaning_en: matter of life and death

meaning_cn: 蠢蠢爬虫蠕动的样子。比喻敌人准备进攻或坏人阴谋捣乱。
meaning_en: to begin to stir (idiom); to get restless; to become threatening

meaning_cn: 摇摇摇动，摇晃；坠落下。形容十分危险，很快就要掉下来，或不稳固，很快就要垮台。
meaning_en: tottering; on the verge of collapse

meaning_cn: 原指与现实社会隔绝、生活安乐的理想境界◇也指环境幽静生活安逸的地方。借指一种空想的脱离现实斗争的美好世界。
meaning_en: see 桃花源[tao2 hua1 yuan2]

meaning_cn: 滔滔形容流水不断。象流水那样毫不间断。指话很多，说起来没个完。
meaning_en: (idiom) to produce a torrent of words; to talk on and on

meaning_cn: 欣欣形容草木生长旺盛；荣茂盛。形容草木长得茂盛。比喻事业蓬勃发展，兴旺昌盛。
meaning_en: (idiom) flourishing; thriving

meaning_cn: 比喻做一些工作，尽一点力量。
meaning_en: lit. contribute bricks and tiles for a building (idiom); fig. to do one's bit to help

meaning_cn: 将来有那么一天。
meaning_en: one day; sometime in the future

meaning_cn: 难辨或难治的各种病症。比喻难以理解或解决的问题。
meaning_en: dubious or hard-to-treat cases (medicine); hard cases

meaning_cn: 指日可以指出日期，为期不远；待期待。为期不远，不久就可以实现。
meaning_en: imminent; just around the corner (idiom)

meaning_cn: 越往下越明显。表示情况越来越坏。
meaning_en: to steadily deteriorate

meaning_cn: 打规划。精密地计划，详细地计算。指在使用人力物力时计算得很精细。
meaning_en: meticulous planning and careful accounting (idiom)

meaning_cn: 灼明白，透彻。正确而透彻的见解。
meaning_en: penetrating insight

meaning_cn: 形容时间还远得很，不知道哪一天。
meaning_en: far in the indefinite future (idiom); so far away it seems forever

meaning_cn: 一代接一代地相继传下去。
meaning_en: passed on from generation to generation (idiom); to hand down

meaning_cn: 勇敢地一直向前进。
meaning_en: to advance bravely

meaning_cn: 景境况，光景；长长久。美好的光景不能永远存在。
meaning_en: a good thing doesn't last forever (idiom)

meaning_cn: 另外开辟一条路。比喻另创一种风格或方法。
meaning_en: to take an alternate route (idiom); to find an alternative; to take a different approach; to blaze a new trail

meaning_cn: 朝气早上的空气，引伸为新生向上，努力进取的气象；蓬勃旺盛的样子。形容充满了生命和活力。
meaning_en: full of youthful energy (idiom); vigorous; energetic; a bright spark

meaning_cn: 看到怪异的现象不要大惊小怪。指遇到不常见的事物或意外情况，要沉着镇静。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have seen sth so often that it doesn't seem strange at all; to be well accustomed (to sth)

meaning_cn: 逸安逸。辛苦一次，把事情办好，以后就可以不再费力了。
meaning_en: to get sth done once and for all

meaning_cn: 指东西多，眼睛都看不过来。
meaning_en: lit. too much for the eye to take in (idiom); a feast for the eyes

meaning_cn: 热气蒸腾的样子。形容气氛热烈或情绪高涨。
meaning_en: piping hot

meaning_cn: 脍切细的肉；炙烤熟的肉。脍和炙都是人们爱吃的食物。指美味人人爱吃。比喻好的诗文受到人们和称赞和传讼。
meaning_en: appealing to the masses; universally appreciated (idiom)

meaning_cn: 事事前一事”为动词，做；后一事”为名词，事情。闲着什么事都不干。
meaning_en: to have nothing to do; to idle one's time away (idiom)

meaning_cn: 甚很；嚣喧嚷。人声喧嚷，尘土飞扬。原形容军中正忙于准备的状态◇来形容消息普遍淬，议论纷纷。现多指反动言论十分嚣张。
meaning_en: clamor raises the dust (idiom); a tremendous clamor; to raise a tremendous stink

meaning_cn: 我待待我”的倒装，等待我。时间不会等待我们。指要抓紧时间。
meaning_en: (idiom) time and tide wait for no man

meaning_cn: 原指形成一个整体。现多形容感情融洽，成为一体。
meaning_en: (idiom) to become as one (with a particular group of people); to mix well; to bond

meaning_cn: 成制定，形成。一经形成，不再改变。
meaning_en: (idiom) immutable; impervious to change; set in stone

meaning_cn: 把怨恨藏在心里。形容对人记下仇恨，以伺机报复。
meaning_en: to harbor hard feelings

meaning_cn: 总的说起来。
meaning_en: in short; in a word; in brief

meaning_cn: 指说话吞吞吐吐，含混躲闪。亦作支支梧梧”。
meaning_en: to hem and haw; to stall; to stammer; to mumble; to falter

meaning_cn: 务从事。指丢下本职工作不做，去搞其他的事情。
meaning_en: not to engage in honest work; to ignore one's proper occupation; not to attend to one's proper duties

meaning_cn: 形容非常贫穷。
meaning_en: (idiom) penniless; completely broke

meaning_cn: 别另外。另有一种独特的风格。
meaning_en: having a unique or distinctive style

meaning_cn: 治好惭人挽救过来。比喻帮助犯错误的人改正错误。
meaning_en: to treat the disease to save the patient; to criticize a person in order to help him

meaning_cn: 岌岌山高陡峭，就要倒下的样子。形容非常危险，快要倾覆或灭亡。
meaning_en: imminent danger (idiom); approaching a crisis

meaning_cn: 丰大。伟大的功绩。
meaning_en: glorious achievement (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指回避重的责任，只拣轻的来承担。也指回避要点，只谈无关紧要的事情。
meaning_en: to avoid the important and dwell on the trivial; to keep silent about major charges while admitting minor ones

meaning_cn: 部、班门类，次序；就归于。按照一定的步骤、顺序进行。也指按老规矩办事，缺乏创新精神。
meaning_en: (idiom) to follow the prescribed order; to keep to the working routine

meaning_cn: 形容形势或文笔等突然转变，并且很快地顺势发展下去。
meaning_en: to develop rapidly after abrupt turn (idiom); dramatic change

meaning_cn: 做一件事得到两方面的好处。
meaning_en: (lit.) one action, two gains (idiom); (fig.) two birds with one stone

meaning_cn: 兴原指志趣，后指兴致；采原指神采，后指精神；烈旺盛。原指文章志趣高尚，言词犀利◇多形容兴致高，精神饱满。
meaning_en: happy and excited (idiom); in high spirits; in great delight

meaning_cn: 心思想；协合。团结一致，共同努力。
meaning_en: to work with a common purpose (idiom); to make concerted efforts; to pull together; to work as one

meaning_cn: 侃侃理直气壮，从容不迫。理直气壮、从容不迫地说话。
meaning_en: to speak frankly with assurance

meaning_cn: 由于羞愧到了极点，下不了台而发怒。
meaning_en: (idiom) to become enraged over a perceived humiliation

meaning_cn: 壤地。天和地，一极在上，一级在下，比喻差别极大。
meaning_en: (lit.) the difference between heaven and earth (idiom); (fig.) night and day difference; a world of difference; a far cry (from)

meaning_cn: 咄咄使人惊奇的声音。形容气势汹汹，盛气凌人，使人难堪。也指形势发展迅速，给人压力。
meaning_en: overbearing; forceful; aggressive; menacing; imperious

meaning_cn: 一千篇文章都一个样。指文章公式化。也比喻办事按一个格式，非常机械。
meaning_en: thousand articles, same rule (idiom); stereotyped and repetitive; once you've seen one, you've seen them all

meaning_cn: 连一步都难以进行。形容走路困难。也比喻处境艰难。
meaning_en: unable to move a single step (idiom); to be in an (extremely) difficult situation

meaning_cn: 嘘缓缓吹气。形容对人的生活十分关切，问冷问热。
meaning_en: to enquire solicitously about sb's well-being (idiom); to pamper

meaning_cn: 失耽误，错过。时机具有时间性的机会。不错过当前的机会。指办事要抓住适宜的时间和有利的机会。
meaning_en: to seize the opportune moment; to lose no time

meaning_cn: 形容说话做事爽快、干脆。
meaning_en: direct and plainspoken (idiom); blunt; straightforward

meaning_cn: 白手空手；起家创建家业。形容在没有基础和条件很差的情况下自力更生，艰苦创业。
meaning_en: (idiom) to build up from nothing; to start from scratch

meaning_cn: 人已离去，楼中空空。比喻故地重游时睹物思人的感慨。
meaning_en: (lit.) the occupants have gone and the place is now empty (idiom); (fig.) (of a dwelling) empty; deserted

meaning_cn: 置放，摆；若好象。放在一边，好象没有听见似的。指不予理睬。
meaning_en: to turn a deaf ear to (idiom); to pretend not to hear

meaning_cn: 瞪瞪着眼；结舌说不出话来。瞪着眼睛说不出话来。形容窘困或惊呆的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) dumbfounded; flabbergasted; stunned

meaning_cn: 跋涉翻山越岭、趟水过河。指远距离的翻山渡水。形容路途遥远，行路辛苦。
meaning_en: long and difficult trek

meaning_cn: 连说带笑。形容十分欢快。
meaning_en: talking and laughing; to jest; cheerful and lively

meaning_cn: 律约束。严格地约束自己。
meaning_en: to be strict with oneself

meaning_cn: 群大家，集体；策谋划，主意。指发挥集体的作用，大家一起来想办法，贡献力量。
meaning_en: (idiom) to act in concert; to pool ideas and efforts

meaning_cn: 鉴镜子，为教训。前面车子翻倒的教训。比喻先前的失败，可以做为以后的教训。
meaning_en: variant of 前車之鑑|前车之鉴[qian2 che1 zhi1 jian4]

meaning_cn: 一下子全都围上去。形容周围的人同时向一个目标猛挤过去。
meaning_en: to swarm around; flocking (to see)

meaning_cn: 违犯法令，破坏纲纪。
meaning_en: (lit.) to break the law and violate the rules (idiom); (fig.) misconduct

meaning_cn: 重大的政策与措施，引导事业前进的方向和指针。
meaning_en: major policy of the national government

meaning_cn: 指悲痛的心情平静以后，再追想当时所受的痛苦。超有警惕未来之意。
meaning_en: to think of the pain when the pain is gone (idiom); to ponder about a painful experience

meaning_cn: 始开始；终结束。自始自终一个样子。指能坚持，不间断。
meaning_en: unswerving from start to finish (idiom)

meaning_cn: 数计算。数都数不过来。形容数量极多，很难计算。
meaning_en: (idiom) too many to count; innumerable

meaning_cn: 啼哭；皆非都不是。哭也不是，笑也不是，不知如何才好。形容处境尴尬或既令人难受又令人发笑的行为。
meaning_en: lit. not to know whether to laugh or cry (idiom); between laughter and tears

meaning_cn: 闻听。人家说的不听，也不主动去问。形容对事情不关心。
meaning_en: not to hear, not to question (idiom); to show no interest in sth; uncritical; not in the least concerned

meaning_cn: 分不出高低好坏。形容水平相当。
meaning_en: equally matched; about the same

meaning_cn: 给供给。依靠自己的生产，满足自己的需要。
meaning_en: self-sufficiency; autarky

meaning_cn: 一生之中最后的年月，即余年。
meaning_en: (idiom) during one's lifetime; while one is on this earth; in one's remaining years

meaning_cn: 打草惊了草里的蛇。原比喻惩罚了甲而使乙有所警觉◇多比喻做法不谨慎，反使对方有所戒备。
meaning_en: lit. beat the grass to scare the snake (idiom); fig. to inadvertently alert an enemy; to punish sb as a warning to others

meaning_cn: 守望防守了望。为了对付来犯的敌人或意外的灾祸，邻近各村落互相警戒，互相援助。
meaning_en: to keep watch and defend one another (idiom, from Mencius); to join forces to defend against external aggressors; mutual help and protection

meaning_cn: 几个人、几个人在一起。
meaning_en: in groups of three or four (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指人们前脚跟着后脚，接连不断地来。形容来者很多，络绎不绝。
meaning_en: to come one after the other

meaning_cn: 悦目看了舒服。指看到美好的景色而心情愉快。
meaning_en: warms the heart and delights the eye (idiom); pleasing; delightful

meaning_cn: 晚上连着白天。形容加紧工作或学习。
meaning_en: night and day (idiom); continuous strenuous effort

meaning_cn: 起得早，睡得晚。形容辛勤劳动。
meaning_en: to be industrious, rising early and going to bed late

meaning_cn: 释放下。喜爱得舍不得放手。
meaning_en: (idiom) to like sth so much that one is reluctant to put it down; to find sth utterly irresistible

meaning_cn: 措安放。手脚不知放到哪儿好。形容举动慌张，或无法应付。
meaning_en: at a loss to know what to do (idiom); bewildered

meaning_cn: 哲学用语，指事物作为矛盾的统一体，都包含着相互矛盾对立的两个方面。通常指全面看待人或事物，看到积极方面，也看到消极方面。
meaning_en: one divides into two; to be two-sided; there are two sides to everything; to see both sb's good points and shortcomings (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容非常稀少，很难得到（多指人才或稀有物品）。
meaning_en: hard to come by; rare

meaning_cn: 望希望，意料。由于没有想到的好事而非常高兴。
meaning_en: to be pleased beyond one's expectations (idiom); overjoyed at the turn of events

meaning_cn: 朝早晨；夕晚上；朝夕形容时间短暂。比喻抓紧时间，力争在最短的时间内达到目的。
meaning_en: (idiom) to seize every minute; to make the best use of one's time

meaning_cn: 形容呼吸急促，大声喘气。
meaning_en: to pant; to gasp for breath

meaning_cn: 猝突然，出其不意。事情来得突然，来不及防备。
meaning_en: to be caught off guard; without warning

meaning_cn: 示显示，表现。不甘心表示自己比别人差。表示要较量一下，比个高低。
meaning_en: (idiom) not to be outdone

meaning_cn: 亡逃亡，丢失；牢关牲口的圈。羊逃跑了再去修补羊圈，还不算晚。比喻出了问题以后想办法补救，可以防止继续受损失。
meaning_en: lit. to mend the pen after sheep are lost (idiom); fig. to act belatedly; better late than never; to lock the stable door after the horse has bolted

meaning_cn: 意气意志和气概；风发象风吹一样迅猛。形容精神振奋，气概豪迈。
meaning_en: (idiom) high-spirited; full of mettle

meaning_cn: 形容战斗或劳动之前，人们精神振奋，跃跃欲试的样子。
meaning_en: fig. to rub one's fists and wipe one's palms (idiom); to roll up one's sleeves for battle; eager to get into action or start on a task

meaning_cn: 喜欢、恼怒、悲哀、快乐。泛指人的各种不同的感情。
meaning_en: (lit.) happiness, anger, sorrow, and joy (idiom); (fig.) emotions

meaning_cn: 形容各类多，差别大。
meaning_en: (idiom) extremely diverse; to vary greatly

meaning_cn: 指各种味道。比喻幸福、痛苦等各种境遇。
meaning_en: (lit.) sour, sweet, bitter and spicy (idiom); (fig.) all kinds of flavors; the joys and sorrows of life

meaning_cn: 描写或模仿的非常逼真。
meaning_en: to imitate to perfection; to be remarkably true to life

meaning_cn: 矛进攻敌人的刺击武器；盾保护自己的盾牌。比喻自己说话做事前后抵触。
meaning_en: to contradict oneself; self-contradictory; inconsistent

meaning_cn: 就象屹立在黄河急流中的砥柱山一样。比喻坚强独立的人能在动荡艰难的环境中起支柱作用。
meaning_en: mainstay; cornerstone; tower of strength

meaning_cn: 大白彻底弄清楚。真实情况完全弄明白了。
meaning_en: the whole truth is revealed (idiom); everything becomes clear

meaning_cn: 早晨出动，晚上归来。
meaning_en: to leave early and return late (idiom)

meaning_cn: 繁荣兴旺发达；昌盛兴旺。指国家兴旺发达，欣欣向荣。
meaning_en: glorious and flourishing (idiom); thriving

meaning_cn: 不同的嘴说出相同的话。指大家说得都一样。
meaning_en: different mouths, same voice; to speak in unison (idiom)

meaning_cn: 洋洋得意的样子。充满了欢喜的神色或气氛。
meaning_en: full of joy (idiom); jubilation

meaning_cn: 依靠自己的劳动所得来生活。
meaning_en: lit. to eat off one's own strength (idiom); fig. to stand on one's own feet; to earn one's own living

meaning_cn: 言传用言语讲解、传授；身教以行动示范。既用言语来教导，又用行动来示范。指行动起模范作用。
meaning_en: to teach by words and example (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容顽强地拼死战斗。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fight bravely amid bloodshed and great sacrifice

meaning_cn: 形容对没有什么了不起的的事情过分惊讶。
meaning_en: to make a fuss about nothing (idiom)

meaning_cn: 由危险转为平安（多指局势或病情）。
meaning_en: to turn peril into safety (idiom); to avert a danger (esp. political or medical)

meaning_cn: 比喻尽可能利用一切可以利用的空间或时间。
meaning_en: lit. to see a gap and stick in a needle (idiom); fig. to make use of every second and every inch

meaning_cn: 对人和蔼可亲，没有架子，使人容易接近。也指文字浅显，容易了解。
meaning_en: amiable and approachable (idiom); easygoing; modest and unassuming; (of writing) plain and simple; easy to understand

meaning_cn: 指从古代到现代，从国内到国外。泛指时间久远，空间广阔。
meaning_en: at all times and in all places (idiom)

meaning_cn: 载充满。怨恨的声音充满道路。形容人民群众普遍强烈不满。
meaning_en: lit. cries of complaint fill the roads (idiom); complaints rise all around; discontent is openly voiced

meaning_cn: 鼎古代煮食器；沸沸腾。形容人群的声音吵吵嚷嚷，就象煮开了锅一样。
meaning_en: lit. a boiling cauldron of voices (idiom); hubbub; brouhaha

meaning_cn: 迢迢遥远。形容路途遥远。
meaning_en: (idiom) from a great distance; (to come) from afar

meaning_cn: 融会融合领会；贯通贯穿前后。把各方面的知识和道理融化汇合，得到全面透彻的理解。
meaning_en: (idiom) to integrate knowledge from various sources into a deep and coherent understanding of a subject

meaning_cn: 整理好行装，等待出发。
meaning_en: to get ready (for a journey); ready and waiting

meaning_cn: 得得到，想到；应反应，配合。心里怎么想，手就能怎么做。比喻技艺纯熟或做事情非常顺利。
meaning_en: lit. what the heart wishes, the hand accomplishes (idiom) skilled at the job; entirely in one's element; going smoothly and easily

meaning_cn: 指军人或地方官有保卫国土的责任。
meaning_en: duty to defend the country (idiom)

meaning_cn: 用恶语骂人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to let out a torrent of abuse

meaning_cn: 磨灭消失。永远消失不了。指事迹言论等将始终保留在人们的记忆中。
meaning_en: indelible

meaning_cn: 止境尽头。永远没有到头的时候。
meaning_en: (idiom) without end; never-ending

meaning_cn: 犹豫迟疑。拿不定主意。
meaning_en: hesitancy; indecision; to waver

meaning_cn: 原指《西游记》中孙悟空能识别妖魔鬼怪的眼睛◇用以形容人的眼光锐利，能够识别真伪。
meaning_en: piercing eyes; discerning eyes

meaning_cn: 把手笼在袖子里，在一旁观看。比喻置身事外，既不过问，也不协助别人。
meaning_en: to watch with folded arms (idiom); to look on without lifting a finger

meaning_cn: 苦口反复规劝；婆心仁慈的心肠。比喻善意而又耐心地劝导。
meaning_en: earnest and well-meaning advice (idiom); to persuade patiently

meaning_cn: 刀刃运转于骨节空隙中，在有回旋的余地。比喻工作熟练，有实际经验，解决问题毫不费事。
meaning_en: handling a butcher's cleaver with ease (idiom); to do sth skillfully and easily

meaning_cn: 渝改变，违背。自始自终一直不变。指守信用。
meaning_en: unswerving; unflinching

meaning_cn: 耿耿有心事的样子。不能忘怀，牵萦于心。
meaning_en: to take troubles to heart (idiom); brooding

meaning_cn: 自然地产生（某种思想感情）。
meaning_en: arising involuntarily (idiom); spontaneous; to spring up unbidden (of emotion)

meaning_cn: 桅马群的劣马。比喻桅社会或集体的人。
meaning_en: lit. a horse that brings trouble to its herd (idiom); fig. troublemaker; black sheep; rotten apple

meaning_cn: 权宜暂时适宜，变通；计计划，办法。指为了应付某种情况而暂时采取的办法。
meaning_en: plan of convenience (idiom); stop-gap measure; makeshift stratagem; interim step

meaning_cn: 背离开；井古制八家为井，引伸为乡里，家宅。离开家乡到外地。
meaning_en: to leave one's native place, esp. against one's will (idiom)

meaning_cn: 支离零散，残缺。形容事物零散破碎，不完整。
meaning_en: scattered and smashed (idiom)

meaning_cn: 皆都。人人都高兴满意。
meaning_en: to everyone's delight and satisfaction

meaning_cn: 鼎鼎盛大的样子。形容名气很大。
meaning_en: grand reputation; renowned; famous

meaning_cn: 风稍一吹，草就摇晃。比喻微小的变动。
meaning_en: (lit.) grass stirring in the wind (idiom); (fig.) the slightest whiff of trouble

meaning_cn: 依依依恋的样子；舍放弃。形容舍不得离开。
meaning_en: reluctant to part (idiom); broken-hearted at having to leave

meaning_cn: 形容秋季晴空万里，天气清爽。
meaning_en: clear and refreshing autumn weather

meaning_cn: 挺身撑直身体。挺直身体站出来。形容面对着艰难或危险的事情，勇敢地站出来。
meaning_en: to step forward bravely

meaning_cn: 遮掩别人的耳朵和眼睛。比喻用假象迷惑人，欺骗人。
meaning_en: to fool people (idiom); to pull the wool over people's eyes

meaning_cn: 姗姗形容走得缓慢从容。慢腾腾地来晚了。
meaning_en: to be late; to arrive slowly; to be slow in the coming

meaning_cn: 实实际的成就；至达到；名名誉；归到来。有了真正的学识、本领或功业，自然就有声誉。
meaning_en: fame follows merit (idiom)

meaning_cn: 事实与愿望相反。指原来打算做的事没能做到。
meaning_en: things turn out contrary to the way one wishes (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容轻快地跳起舞来。
meaning_en: (to start) dancing lightly and gracefully

meaning_cn: 指事物的花样或名称非常多。
meaning_en: names of many kinds (idiom); items of every description

meaning_cn: 凤凰的羽毛，麒麟的角。比喻珍贵而稀少的人或物。
meaning_en: lit. as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns (idiom); fig. few and far between

meaning_cn: 忍气受了气不发作；吞声不敢出声。指受了气勉强忍耐，有话不敢说出来。
meaning_en: to submit to humiliation (idiom); to suffer in silence; to swallow one's anger; to grin and bear it

meaning_cn: 濡沾湿；染沾染。耳朵经常听到，眼睛经常看到，不知不觉地受到影响。
meaning_en: to be influenced

meaning_cn: 天伦旧指父子、兄弟等亲属关系。泛指家庭的乐趣。
meaning_en: family love and joy; domestic bliss

meaning_cn: 一口气做成。形容文章结构紧凑，文气连贯。也比喻做一件事安排紧凑，迅速不间断地完成。
meaning_en: to do something at one go; to flow smoothly

meaning_cn: 一千年里也难碰到一次。形容机会极其难得。
meaning_en: extremely rare (idiom); once in a blue moon

meaning_cn: 比喻眼前看到的都是灾祸的景象。
meaning_en: a scene of devastation meets the eye everywhere one looks (idiom)

meaning_cn: 聚集成堆，如同小山。形容极多。
meaning_en: to pile up like a mountain (idiom); a mountain of (paperwork etc); a large number of sth

meaning_cn: 什么也没有。指钱财，也指成绩、知识。
meaning_en: not having anything at all (idiom); utterly lacking; without two sticks to rub together

meaning_cn: 指追溯事物发生的根源。同追本溯源”。
meaning_en: to pursue sth back to its origins; to trace back to the source; to get to the bottom of sth

meaning_cn: 抖擞振动，引伸为振作。形容精神振奋。
meaning_en: spirit trembling with excitement (idiom); in high spirits; lively and full of enthusiasm; full of energy; con brio

meaning_cn: 惶惶也作皇皇”，惊惶不安的样子。人们心中惊惶不安。
meaning_en: (idiom) everyone is anxious; (of a group of people) to feel anxious

meaning_cn: 从早到晚都在一起。形容常生活在一起，关系密切。
meaning_en: to spend all one's time together (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指以仁为任，无所谦让◇指遇到应该做的事就积极主动去做，不推让。
meaning_en: to be unwilling to pass on one's responsibilities to others

meaning_cn: 形容要求不遂就纠缠个没烷完。
meaning_en: not to overlook, nor spare (idiom); unwilling to forgive; to treat severely without listening to excuses

meaning_cn: 设设想。设想自己处在别人的那种境地。指替别人的处境着想。
meaning_en: to put oneself in sb else's shoes

meaning_cn: 风景优美和有古代遗迹的著名地方。
meaning_en: historical sites and scenic spots

meaning_cn: 烧焦了头，灼伤了额。比喻非常狼狈窘迫。有时也形容忙得不知如何是好，带有夸张的意思。
meaning_en: lit. badly burned about the head (from trying to put out a fire) (idiom); fig. hard-pressed; under pressure (from a heavy workload, creditors etc)

meaning_cn: 没有一点原因。
meaning_en: (idiom) no cause or reason; completely uncalled for

meaning_cn: 一天一天地、一月一月地不断积累。指长时间不断地积累。
meaning_en: to accumulate over a long period of time

meaning_cn: 旷荒废，耽误。荒废时间，拖得很久。
meaning_en: protracted (idiom); long and drawn-out

meaning_cn: 胫小腿；走跑。没有腿却能跑。比喻事物无需推行，就已迅速地传播开去。
meaning_en: to get round fast; to spread like wildfire

meaning_cn: 忍俊含笑；不禁无法控制自己。指忍不住要发笑。
meaning_en: cannot help laughing; unable to restrain a smile

meaning_cn: 成成为，变成。一群群人集合在一起。
meaning_en: (idiom) making up a group; forming a troupe; in large numbers; as a large crowd

meaning_cn: 一个接着一个而不间断。
meaning_en: (idiom) in unbroken succession; continuous

meaning_cn: 无稽无法考查。没有根据的说法。
meaning_en: (idiom) complete nonsense

meaning_cn: 形容欠债很多。
meaning_en: lit. build a high desk of debt (idiom); heavily in debt

meaning_cn: 因根据；材资质；施施加；教教育。指针对学习的人的志趣、能力等具体情况进行不同的教育。
meaning_en: (idiom) to teach in accordance with the student's aptitude; to tailor instruction to the individual student

meaning_cn: 居处于；思想。虽然处在平安的环境里，也想到有出现危险的可能。指随时有应付意外事件的思想准备。
meaning_en: to think of danger in times of safety; to be vigilant in peacetime (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容遇事慌张，不知如何是好。
meaning_en: (idiom) to act with confusion or in a disorderly manner; flustered

meaning_cn: 指各种事情中有主要的和次要的，有急于要办的和可以慢一点办的。
meaning_en: slight or important, urgent or non-urgent (idiom); to deal with important matters first; sense of priority

meaning_cn: 暇空闲。原形容景物繁多，来不及观赏◇多形容来人或事情太多，应付不过来。
meaning_en: more than one can attend to (idiom); deluged (with inquiries etc); overwhelmed (by the beauty of the scenery)

meaning_cn: 近在手边，一伸手就可以接触到。
meaning_en: within reach

meaning_cn: 发启发；省醒悟。启发人深刻思考，有所醒悟。
meaning_en: to provide food for thought (idiom); thought-provoking

meaning_cn: 砸开门进去。多指盗贼行为。
meaning_en: to break the door down and enter (idiom)

meaning_cn: 工细致，巧妙；异不同的。不同的曲调演得同样好。比喻话的说法不一而用意相同，或一件事情的做法不同而都巧妙地达到目的。
