meaning_en: different tunes played with equal skill (idiom); different methods leading to the same result; different approach but equally satisfactory outcome

meaning_cn: 自己一个人低声嘀咕。
meaning_en: (idiom) to talk to oneself; to think aloud; to soliloquize

meaning_cn: 左右的邻居。也比喻关系比较接近的其它单位。
meaning_en: neighbors; next-door neighbors; related work units; colleagues doing related work

meaning_cn: 喜欢做某事，并在其中获得乐趣。
meaning_en: to take pleasure in sth (idiom)

meaning_cn: 身亲身，亲自；试尝试。试着亲身去做触犯法律的事。指明知故犯。
meaning_en: to challenge the law (idiom); to knowingly violate the law

meaning_cn: 指勉强养活家人，使不饿肚。
meaning_en: (idiom) to provide for one's family

meaning_cn: 矢箭；的箭靶的中心。众箭所射的靶子。比喻大家攻击的对象。
meaning_en: lit. target of a multitude of arrows (idiom); the butt of public criticism; attacked on all sides

meaning_cn: 心情平静，态度温和。指不急躁，不生气。
meaning_en: tranquil and even-tempered (idiom); calmly and without stress

meaning_cn: 隐隐约约，看不清楚。
meaning_en: (idiom) faint; indistinct

meaning_cn: 以浮夸的言论迎合群众，骗取群众的信赖和支持。
meaning_en: sensationalism; vulgar claptrap to please the crowds; playing to the gallery; demagogy

meaning_cn: 横的竖的交叉在一起。也形容情况复杂。
meaning_en: criss-crossed (idiom)

meaning_cn: 穴孔、洞；来招致。有了洞穴才进风。比喻消息和谣言的传播不是完全没有原因的。也比喻流言乘机会传开来。
meaning_en: lit. wind from an empty cave (idiom); fig. unfounded (story); baseless (claim)

meaning_cn: 不迭不停止。形容连声叫苦。
meaning_en: to complain without stopping (idiom); to bitch endlessly; incessant grievances

meaning_cn: 因顺着；势趋势；利导引导。顺着事情发展的趋势，加以引导。
meaning_en: to take advantage of the new situation (idiom); to make the best of new opportunities

meaning_cn: 德品德；望声望。道德高尚，名望很大。
meaning_en: (idiom) a person of virtue and prestige; a person of good moral standing and reputation

meaning_cn: 恃倚仗，依靠；恐害怕。因为有所依杖而毫不害怕，或毫无顾忌。
meaning_en: secure in the knowledge that one has backing

meaning_cn: 关天比喻关系重大。指有关人命的事情关系及重大。
meaning_en: human life is beyond value (idiom)

meaning_cn: 昙花即优昙钵花，开放时间很短。比喻美好的事物或景象出现了一下，很快就消失。
meaning_en: lit. the night-blooming cactus shows once; flash in the pan (idiom); short-lived

meaning_cn: 息平息；宁使安定。原指不生事，不骚扰百姓，后指调解纠纷，使事情平息下来，使人们平安相处。
meaning_en: to keep the peace; to patch up a quarrel (idiom)

meaning_cn: 荡然完全空无。形容东西完全失去，一点没有留下。
meaning_en: to obliterate completely; to vanish from the face of the earth

meaning_cn: 欢欣欣喜；鼓舞振奋。形容高兴而振奋。
meaning_en: (idiom) elated and excited; overjoyed

meaning_cn: 惊惊动；动震撼。使天地惊动。形容某个事件的声势或意义极大。
meaning_en: (idiom) world-shaking

meaning_cn: 险阻危险和障碍。前进道路上的困难、危险和障碍。
meaning_en: untold dangers and difficulties (idiom)

meaning_cn: 危险的局面不断产生。
meaning_en: dangers spring up all around (idiom); surrounded by perils

meaning_cn: 不算第一也算第二。形容突出。
meaning_en: (idiom) reckoned to be best or second best; one of the very best; (idiom) to list one by one

meaning_cn: 以用；乱混乱。用假的东西去冒充或混杂真的东西。
meaning_en: (idiom) to pass off the fake as genuine; to blur the line between fake and real so convincingly that the fake is mistaken for the real thing

meaning_cn: 不断地刮风下雨。比喻障碍重重。又比喻时代动荡，谣言纷传。
meaning_en: trials and tribulations; ups and downs

meaning_cn: 形容天气极为寒冷。
meaning_en: (idiom) bitterly cold; frigid

meaning_cn: 形容负债甚多。
meaning_en: deep in debt

meaning_cn: 任担当，经受。不怕吃苦，也不怕招怨。
meaning_en: to work hard without complaint (idiom)

meaning_cn: 投投奔。无路可走，已到绝境。比喻处境极困难，找不到出路。
meaning_en: to be at an impasse (idiom); in a tight spot; at the end of one's rope; desperate

meaning_cn: 下令行动就立即行动，下令停止就立即停止。形容法令严正，执行认真。
meaning_en: (lit.) orders are carried out and prohibitions are observed (idiom); (fig.) to execute every order without fail

meaning_cn: 蹈踏；覆翻；辙车轮辗过的痕迹。重新走上翻过车的老路。比喻不吸取教训，再走失败的老路。
meaning_en: lit. to follow in the tracks of an overturned cart (idiom); fig. to follow a path that led to failure in the past; to repeat a disastrous mistake

meaning_cn: 时时刻刻。表示毫不间断。
meaning_en: (idiom) (when followed by 不[bu4]) at no time; never (Note: 無時無刻不|无时无刻不[wu2 shi2 wu2 ke4 bu4] therefore means "at no time not ...", i.e. "at all times".); (when not followed by 不[bu4]) at all times; always

meaning_cn: 指男的结了婚，有职业，能独立生活。
meaning_en: to get married and start a career (idiom); to settle down; to establish oneself

meaning_cn: 炎黄炎帝神农氏和黄帝有熊氏，代表中华民族的祖先。炎帝和黄帝的后代。指中华民族的后代。亦作黄炎子孙”。
meaning_en: descendants of the Fiery Emperor and the Yellow Emperor (i.e. Han Chinese people)

meaning_cn: 张弓上弦。剑拔出来了，弓张开了。原形容书法笔力遒劲◇多形容气势逼人，或形势紧张，一触即发。
meaning_en: lit. with swords drawn and bows bent (idiom); fig. a state of mutual hostility; at daggers drawn

meaning_cn: 设身处地地为别人着想。
meaning_en: to put oneself in sb else's shoes (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指人手大，脚大◇多用来形容花钱、用东西不节省。
meaning_en: extravagant (idiom); to throw away money by the handful; wasteful

meaning_cn: 览看；余剩余。一眼看去，所有的景物全看见了。形容建筑物的结构没有曲折变化，或诗文内容平淡，没有回味。
meaning_en: to cover all at one glance (idiom); a panoramic view

meaning_cn: 为做。本指做自己想做的事◇指想干什么就干什么。
meaning_en: (idiom) to do whatever one pleases

meaning_cn: 名名分，名义；顺合理、顺当。原指名分正当，说话合理◇多指做某事名义正当，道理也说得通。
meaning_en: in a way that justifies the use of the term; genuine; proper; in a way that conforms to logic; justifiable; appropriate; perfectly legitimate

meaning_cn: 在纸面上谈论打仗。比喻空谈理论，不能解决实际问题。也比喻空谈不能成为现实。
meaning_en: lit. military tactics on paper (idiom); fig. theoretical discussion that is worse than useless in practice; armchair strategist; idle theorizing; cf Zhao Kuo 趙括|赵括[Zhao4 Kuo4] leading an army of 400,000 to total annihilation at battle of Changping 長平之戰|长平之战[Chang2 ping2 zhi1 Zhan4] in 260 BC

meaning_cn: 川河流。形容行人、车马等象水流一样连续不断。
meaning_en: the stream flows without stopping (idiom); unending flow

meaning_cn: 深夜没有人声，非常寂静。
meaning_en: in the dead of night (idiom)

meaning_cn: 胜尽。美好的东西很多，一时看不过来。
meaning_en: nothing more beautiful can be imagined (idiom)

meaning_cn: 做事情有好的开头，也有好的结尾。形容办事认真。
meaning_en: where there's a start, there's a finish (idiom); to finish once one starts sth; to carry things through; I started, so I'll finish.

meaning_cn: 枝叶繁密茂盛。
meaning_en: (of plants) to grow luxuriantly; (fig.) (of a family or business etc) to prosper; to flourish

meaning_cn: 没有想到的。
meaning_en: (idiom) contrary to expectation; unexpected

meaning_cn: 形容说话或行动坚决果断，毫不犹豫。
meaning_en: (lit.) to chop the nail and slice the iron (idiom); (fig.) resolute and decisive; unhesitating; categorical

meaning_cn: 指活跃一时，言论行为能影响大局的人物。
meaning_en: the man (or woman) of the moment (idiom); influential figure

meaning_cn: 裨益益处、好处。形容益处很大。
meaning_en: bringing great benefits (idiom); very useful; of great service; to help greatly; to serve one well

meaning_cn: 微微小；杜堵住；渐指事物的开端。比喻在坏事情坏思想萌芽的时候就加以制止，不让它发展。
meaning_en: to nip in the bud (idiom)

meaning_cn: 踪踪迹。没有一点踪影。形容完全消失，不知去向。
meaning_en: (idiom) (to disappear) without a trace

meaning_cn: 一举手那样的辛劳。形容轻而易举，毫不费力。
meaning_en: (lit.) the exertion of lifting one's hand (idiom); (fig.) a very slight effort

meaning_cn: 合璧圆形有孔的玉叫璧，半圆形的叫半璧，两个半璧合成一个圆叫合璧”。比喻中国和外国的好东西合到一块。
meaning_en: harmonious combination of Chinese and Western elements (idiom)

meaning_cn: 走马骑着马跑；任职务。旧指官吏到任。现比喻接任某项工作。
meaning_en: (idiom) to take office; to assume a post

meaning_cn: 形容言行慎重，不敢疏忽。
meaning_en: cautious and timid (idiom); prudent; careful

meaning_cn: 纳容纳，包容。大海可以容得下成百上千条江河之水。比喻包容的东西非常广泛，而且数量很大。
meaning_en: all rivers run into the sea; use different means to obtain the same result (idiom)

meaning_cn: 来历由来。人或事物的来历与经过不清楚。
meaning_en: (idiom) of unknown origin; of dubious background

meaning_cn: 浃湿透」流得满背都是。形容非常恐惧或非肠怕。现也形容出汗很多，背上的衣服都湿透了。
meaning_en: to sweat profusely (idiom); drenched in sweat

meaning_cn: 形容人多口杂。
meaning_en: lively discussion with everybody talking at once

meaning_cn: 本树根；末树梢；置放。比喻把主次、轻重的位置弄颠倒了。
meaning_en: lit. to invert root and branch (idiom); fig. confusing cause and effect; to stress the incidental over the fundamental; to put the cart before the horse

meaning_cn: 什么都不顾。
meaning_en: (idiom) to disregard all negative considerations; to cast aside all concerns

meaning_cn: 混淆混杂。用假象或谎言让旁人分辨不清是非。
meaning_en: to obscure the facts (idiom); to mislead the public with prevarication and deliberate falsehoods

meaning_cn: 比喻激情高涨。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be fired up; to have one's blood racing; to be burning (with excitement, passion, anger etc)

meaning_cn: 左也不好，右也不是。形容无论怎样做都有难处。
meaning_en: (idiom) between a rock and a hard place; in a dilemma

meaning_cn: 指没有风浪。比喻平静无事。
meaning_en: lit. breeze is still, waves are quiet (idiom); tranquil environment; all is quiet; a dead calm (at sea)

meaning_cn: 履践、踩在上面。象走在薄冰上一样。比喻行事极为谨慎，存有戒心。
meaning_en: (lit.) as if walking on thin ice (idiom); (fig.) extremely cautious

meaning_cn: 先天人或动物的胚胎时期。原指人或动物生下来体质就不好◇也指事物的根基差。
meaning_en: to suffer from a congenital deficiency; to have an inherent weakness

meaning_cn: 撞骗寻机骗人。假借名义，进行蒙骗欺诈。
meaning_en: (idiom) to dupe people by passing oneself off as a well-connected individual or a figure of authority

meaning_cn: 解解释；释消除。解答疑难问题，消除困惑情绪。
meaning_en: (idiom) to solve a problem; to resolve a difficult issue

meaning_cn: 速邀请。指没有邀请突然而来的客人。
meaning_en: (idiom) uninvited or unexpected guest

meaning_cn: 服信服。心里嘴上都信服。指真心信服。
meaning_en: (idiom) to accept wholeheartedly; to embrace; to be won over

meaning_cn: 比喻零乱地加以拼凑。
meaning_en: (idiom) to assemble from bits and pieces; to combine items from disparate sources

meaning_cn: 原指琴声陡然降落◇用来形容声誉、地位或经济状况急剧下降。
meaning_en: lit. to drop a thousand zhang in one fall (idiom); fig. (of business, popularity etc) to suffer a sudden, devastating decline; to take a dive

meaning_cn: 从头到尾按原来的样子。指详细叙述事情的全部起因和整个过程，一点不漏。
meaning_en: from beginning to end; in its entirety; in accord with fact; literal

meaning_cn: 往火上倒油。比喻使人更加愤怒或使情况更加严重。
meaning_en: to pour oil on the fire (idiom); fig. to aggravate a situation; to enrage people and make matters worse

meaning_cn: 按照事物本身的性质来评定是非得失。现常指仅从事物的表面现象孤立、静止、片面地议论。
meaning_en: to discuss sth on its own merits; to judge the matter as it stands

meaning_cn: 无穷尽。
meaning_en: without end; incessantly; on and on

meaning_cn: 既使人民劳苦，又耗费钱财。现也指滥用人力物力。
meaning_en: (idiom) to waste both manpower and resources

meaning_cn: 危言使人吃惊的话；耸惊动；耸听使听话的人吃惊。指故意说些夸大的吓人的话，使人惊疑震动。
meaning_en: frightening words to scare people (idiom); alarmist talk; reds under the beds

meaning_cn: 天马神马。天马奔腾神速，象是腾起在空中飞行一样。比喻诗文气势豪放。也比喻人浮躁，不踏实。
meaning_en: like a heavenly steed, soaring across the skies (idiom); (of writing, calligraphy etc) bold and imaginative; unconstrained in style

meaning_cn: 煞委。形容费尽心思。
meaning_en: to take a lot of trouble (idiom); painstaking; at the cost of a lot of effort

meaning_cn: 欺骗自己，也欺骗别人。
meaning_en: to deceive others and to deceive oneself; to believe one's own lies

meaning_cn: 讳隐讳；深事件重大。原意为事件重大，讳而不言◇指把事情隐瞒得很紧。
meaning_en: (idiom) to steadfastly refuse to discuss the matter; to treat it as an untouchable subject

meaning_cn: 断截断；章音乐一曲为一章。指不顾全篇文章或谈话的内容，孤立地取其中的一段或一句的意思。指引用与原意不符。
meaning_en: (idiom) to quote out of context

meaning_cn: 五彩各种颜色；缤纷繁多交错的样子。指颜色繁多，非趁看。
meaning_en: all the colors in profusion (idiom); a garish display

meaning_cn: 前进和后退都难。比喻事情无法决定，因而难以行动。
meaning_en: no room to advance or to retreat (idiom); without any way out of a dilemma; trapped; in an impossible situation

meaning_cn: 自新自觉改正，重新做人。改正错误，重新做起。
meaning_en: to reform and start afresh (idiom); to turn over a new leaf

meaning_cn: 一口咬住不放。比喻坚持一个廉洁，再不改口。
meaning_en: to arbitrarily assert; to allege; to stick to one's statement; to cling to one's view

meaning_cn: 急急切。急着要取得成功。
meaning_en: anxious for quick results (idiom); to demand instant success; impatient for result; impetuous

meaning_cn: 惩处罚；贷宽容。严厉惩罚，绝不宽恕。
meaning_en: to punish severely (idiom)

meaning_cn: 疲惫极度疲乏；不堪不能忍受。形容非常疲乏。
meaning_en: exhausted; fatigued to the extreme

meaning_cn: 折挫折；挠弯曲。比喻意志坚强，无论受到多少次挫折，毫不动摇退缩。
meaning_en: to keep on fighting in spite of all setbacks (idiom); to be undaunted by repeated setbacks; to be indomitable

meaning_cn: 显表露，表现；身手指本领。充分显示出本领和才能。
meaning_en: (idiom) fully displaying one's capabilities

meaning_cn: 头打破了，血流满面。多用来形容惨败。
meaning_en: lit. head broken and blood flowing; fig. badly bruised

meaning_cn: 浑水不清的水。比喻乘混乱的时候从中捞取利益。
meaning_en: to fish in troubled water (idiom); to take advantage of a crisis for personal gain

meaning_cn: 不允许有什么怀疑。表示论证严密，无可怀疑。
meaning_en: unquestionable

meaning_cn: 孜孜勤勉，不懈怠。指工作或学习勤奋不知疲倦。
meaning_en: lit. diligent and never slacking (idiom); continuous concentrated effort; assiduous (in study); to concentrate

meaning_cn: 遐远；迩近。形容名声很大，远近都知道。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be famous far and wide

meaning_cn: 各种各样的艰难困苦。
meaning_en: to suffer untold hardships (idiom); trials and tribulations; with difficulty; after some effort

meaning_cn: 指说话时做出各种动作。形容说话时放肆或得意忘形。
meaning_en: to gesticulate while talking (idiom); to explain by waving one's hands; to criticize or give orders summarily

meaning_cn: 赫赫显著盛大的样子。声名非常显赫。
meaning_en: illustrious; prominent; prestigious; well-known

meaning_cn: 灭顶水漫过头顶。指被水淹死。比喻毁灭性的灾难。
meaning_en: (idiom) catastrophic disaster; devastating calamity

meaning_cn: 好象影子总是跟着身体一样。比喻两个人关系亲密，常在一起。
meaning_en: (lit.) as the shadow follows the body (idiom); (fig.) closely associated with each other; inseparable; to follow relentlessly

meaning_cn: 调调和；顺和协。风雨及时适宜。形容风雨适合农时。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have good weather for crops

meaning_cn: 作为作出成绩。没有做出任何成绩。指工作中安于现状，缺乏创造性。
meaning_en: attempting nothing and accomplishing nothing (idiom); without any initiative or drive; feckless

meaning_cn: 泛指休息或空闲的时候。
meaning_en: leisure time (over a cup of tea, after a meal etc)

meaning_cn: 涕眼泪。形容伤心到极点。
meaning_en: weeping bitter tears

meaning_cn: 走马骑着马跑。骑在奔跑的马上看花。原形容事情如意，心境愉快◇多指大略地观察一下。
meaning_en: lit. flower viewing from horseback (idiom); a fleeting glance in passing; fig. superficial understanding from cursory observation; to make a quick judgment based on inadequate information

meaning_cn: 步调行进的步伐。比喻行动和谐一致。
meaning_en: to be united in action

meaning_cn: 好象被包在鼓里一样。比喻受人蒙蔽，对有关的事情一点儿也不知道。
meaning_en: lit. kept inside a drum (idiom); fig. completely in the dark

meaning_cn: 多次教育，仍不改正。
meaning_en: lit. not to change, despite repeated admonition; incorrigible; unrepentant

meaning_cn: 歪、邪不正当，不正派。指不良的作风和风气。
meaning_en: noxious winds, evil influences (idiom); malignant social trends

meaning_cn: 交臂胳膊碰胳膊，指擦肩而过。形容当面错过。
meaning_en: to miss narrowly; to let a great opportunity slip

meaning_cn: 无限度地乱要价。形容所提出的条件、要求过高。
meaning_en: to ask for sky-high prices

meaning_cn: 平心心情平和，不动感情；论评论。平心静气地给予客观评价。
meaning_en: (idiom) in all fairness; objectively speaking

meaning_cn: 指事物轻微，或者理所当然，不值得一提。
meaning_en: to be nothing difficult; to be a cinch

meaning_cn: 形容十分担心或害怕。
meaning_en: (idiom) apprehensive; alarmed; anxious

meaning_cn: 指事物的名称或社会习惯往往是由人民群众经过长期社会实践而确定或形成的。
meaning_en: established by popular usage (idiom); common usage agreement; customary convention

meaning_cn: 果然如此。指事物的发展变化跟预料的一样。
meaning_en: (idiom) just as expected

meaning_cn: 霹雳响雷。晴天打响雷。比喻突然发生意外的，令人震惊的事件。
meaning_en: lit. thunderclap from a clear sky (idiom); fig. a bolt from the blue

meaning_cn: 负辜负；众众人；望期望。不辜负大家的期望。
meaning_en: to live up to expectations (idiom)

meaning_cn: 瞬一眨眼；息呼吸。在极短的时间内就有很多变化。形容变化很多很快。
meaning_en: in an instant a myriad changes (idiom); rapid substantial change

meaning_cn: 逾越过。不可能超过或不可能越过。
meaning_en: impassable; insurmountable; insuperable

meaning_cn: 指虽然提到了，但说得不详细。
meaning_en: to mention sth without elaborating (idiom); not giving details

meaning_cn: 绝穷尽。悲哀伤心到了极点。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be overcome with grief

meaning_cn: 前面的冲上去了，后面的紧跟上来。形容不断投入战斗，奋勇冲杀向前。
meaning_en: to advance dauntlessly in wave upon wave (idiom)

meaning_cn: 翻翻过；越过；岭山岭。翻越不少山头。形容野外工作或旅途的辛苦。
meaning_en: lit. to pass over mountain ridges (idiom); fig. hardships of the journey

meaning_cn: 在危难之际接受任命。
meaning_en: (idiom) to take on a leadership role at a time of crisis

meaning_cn: 忐忑心神不定。心神极为不安。
meaning_en: (idiom) anxious; in turmoil

meaning_cn: 拘限制；格规格，方式。不局限于一种规格或一个格局。
meaning_en: not stick to one pattern

meaning_cn: 有空子可钻。
meaning_en: to have an opportunity that one can exploit (idiom)

meaning_cn: 漫满；遍到处。山上和田野里到处都是。形容很多。
meaning_en: lit. covering the mountains and the plains (idiom); fig. as far as the eye can see; covering everything; omnipresent

meaning_cn: 已止，完。连声赞赏不止。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be full of praise and admiration; to marvel endlessly; to be in awe

meaning_cn: 人到三十岁可以自立的年龄◇为三十岁的代称。
meaning_en: (idiom) the age of 30

meaning_cn: 假假借，依靠。形容做事答话敏捷、熟练，用不着考虑。
meaning_en: (idiom) to act without taking time to think; to react instantly; to fire from the hip

meaning_cn: 屈屈服；挠弯曲。比喻在压力和面前不屈服，表现十分顽强。
meaning_en: unyielding; indomitable

meaning_cn: 潸然流泪的样子。形容泪流不止。
meaning_en: to shed silent tears (idiom)

meaning_cn: 尚注重。指礼节上应该有来有往。现也指以同样的态度或做法回答对方。
meaning_en: lit. proper behavior is based on reciprocity (idiom); fig. to return politeness for politeness

meaning_cn: 被视为固定的、不能变通的条例规定。
meaning_en: fixed framework (idiom); restriction of social conventions and taboos (usually derogatory); regulations and restrictions

meaning_cn: 灵机灵活的心思。急忙中转了一下念头（多指临时想出了一个办法）。
meaning_en: a bright idea suddenly occurs (idiom); to hit upon an inspiration; to be struck by a brainwave

meaning_cn: 胜胜境。引人进入佳境。现多用来指风景或文艺作品特别吸引人。
meaning_en: to enchant; fascinating

meaning_cn: 象没有那回事一样。形容遇事沉着镇定或不把事情放在心上。
meaning_en: (idiom) as if nothing had happened; calm and composed; nonchalant

meaning_cn: 熟视经常看到，看惯；无睹没有看见。看惯了就象没看见一样。也指看到某种现象，但不关心，只当没有看见。
meaning_en: (idiom) to turn a blind eye to (sth one sees regularly)

meaning_cn: 骇震惊。使人听了非常吃惊、害怕。
meaning_en: shocking; horrifying; atrocious; terrible

meaning_cn: 趋奔向。奔向有利的一面，而避开有害的一面。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make the most of the benefits while avoiding adverse effects

meaning_cn: 供给的数量超过需要的数量。
meaning_en: supply exceeds demand

meaning_cn: 体力强盛，精神充足。
meaning_en: vigorous; energetic

meaning_cn: 冠冕古代帝王、官吏的帽子；堂皇很有气派的样子。形容外表庄严或正大的样子。
meaning_en: high-sounding; dignified; pompous (idiom)

meaning_cn: 分路而行。比喻目标不同，各走各的路或各干各的事。
meaning_en: lit. to take different roads and urge the horses on (idiom); fig. to part ways

meaning_cn: 荷扛。扛着枪，上了子弹。形容全副武装，准备投入战斗。
meaning_en: (idiom) armed; carrying a loaded firearm

meaning_cn: 老书生经常说的话。比喻人们听惯了的没有新鲜意思的话。
meaning_en: an old observation (idiom); a truism; banal comments

meaning_cn: 彻通，透。从头到尾，全部，十足的意思。
meaning_en: lit. from head to tail (idiom); thoroughgoing; through and through; out and out; from top to bottom

meaning_cn: 形容神情逼真，使人感到好象亲眼看到一般。
meaning_en: living spirit, living image (idiom); true to life; vivid and realistic

meaning_cn: 安身在某处安下身来；立命精神有所寄托。指生活有着落，精神有所寄托。
meaning_en: (idiom) to settle down and pursue one's path in life

meaning_cn: 在狂风暴雨中同乘一条船，一起与风雨搏斗。比喻共同经历患难。
meaning_en: lit. in the same boat under wind and rain (idiom); fig. to stick together in hard times

meaning_cn: 指人游荡懒散，不愿参加劳动。
meaning_en: to idle about

meaning_cn: 灰心失望，意志消沉。
meaning_en: discouraged; downhearted

meaning_cn: 耸惊动。夸大或捏造事实，使人听了感到惊异或震动。
meaning_en: to sensationalize (idiom); deliberate exaggeration to scare people

meaning_cn: 把捕禽的网撤去三面，只留一面。比喻采取宽大态度，给人一条出路。
meaning_en: open the net on one side (idiom); let the caged bird fly; to give one's opponent a way out; lenient treatment

meaning_cn: 罗罗列；布分布。象天空的星星和棋盘上的棋子那样分布着。形容数量很多，分布很广。
meaning_en: scattered about like stars in the sky or chess pieces on a board (idiom); spread all over the place

meaning_cn: 原指臣下向君主进言很不容易◇指事情做起来并不象说的那样简单。
meaning_en: easier said than done (idiom)

meaning_cn: 缄封。在他嘴上贴了三张封条。形容说话谨慎。现在也用来形容不肯或不敢开口。
meaning_en: (idiom) reluctant to speak about it; tight-lipped

meaning_cn: 睽睽张目注视的样子。许多人争着眼睛看着。指在广大群众注视之下。
meaning_en: (idiom) (under) the public eye; the stares of many people

meaning_cn: 把不同的事物混在一起，当作同样的事物谈论。
meaning_en: to confuse one thing with another (idiom); to muddle

meaning_cn: 具有多方面的才能和技艺。
meaning_en: multitalented

meaning_cn: 散离开，分手≤不愉快地分手。
meaning_en: to part on bad terms; (of a meeting etc) to break up in discord

meaning_cn: 井井形容有条理。形容说话办事有条有理。
meaning_en: everything clear and orderly (idiom); neat and tidy

meaning_cn: 栉梳篦的总称。象鱼鳞和梳子齿那样有次序地排列着。多用来形容房屋或船只等排列得很密很整齐。
meaning_en: row upon row

meaning_cn: 是对。总以为自己是对的。形容主观，不虚心。
meaning_en: to believe oneself infallible (idiom); to be opinionated

meaning_cn: 腾空向天空飞升。向高空升起。
meaning_en: (idiom) to rise into the air

meaning_cn: 声言谈；色脸色。在紧急情况下，说话、神态仍跟平时一样没有变化。形容非常镇静。
meaning_en: not a word or movement (idiom); remaining calm and collected; not batting an eyelid

meaning_cn: 扎安营。稳当而有把握地打击敌人。比喻有把握、有步骤地工作。
meaning_en: to go steady and strike hard (in fighting); fig. steadily and surely

meaning_cn: 好象曾经见过。形容见过的事物再度出现。
meaning_en: déjà vu (the experience of seeing exactly the same situation a second time); seemingly familiar; apparently already acquainted

meaning_cn: 空空诚恳，虚心。原形容诚恳、虚心的样子。现形容一无所有。
meaning_en: as empty as anything (idiom); completely bereft; to have nothing; vacuous; hollow; empty (argument, head etc)

meaning_cn: 旦夕早晨和晚上，形容时间短。形容危险就在眼前。
meaning_en: in imminent peril (idiom); on the brink of crisis

meaning_cn: 开诚敞开胸怀，显示诚意。指以诚心待人，坦白无私。
meaning_en: lit. deal sincerely and fairly (idiom); frank and open-minded; plain speaking; Let's talk frankly and openly between ourselves.; to put one's cards on the table

meaning_cn: 泣不出声地流泪。值得歌颂、赞美，使人感动流泪。形容英勇悲壮的感人事迹。
meaning_en: lit. you can sing or you can cry (idiom); fig. deeply moving; happy and sad; inspiring and tragic

meaning_cn: 诛痛斥，责罚；伐声讨，攻打。从口头和书面上对坏人坏事进行揭露和声讨。
meaning_en: to condemn in speech and in writing (idiom); to denounce by word and pen

meaning_cn: 釜古代的一种锅；薪柴。把柴火从锅底抽掉。比喻从根本上解决问题。
meaning_en: to take drastic measures to deal with a situation; to pull the carpet from under sb

meaning_cn: 形容一次一次地说，或经常说。
meaning_en: to keep on saying (idiom); to repeat over and over again

meaning_cn: 举世全世界。全世界都知道。形容非常著名。
meaning_en: world-famous (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指明白不偏邪。现多指心怀坦白，言行正派。
meaning_en: (of a person) honorable; not devious; (of a behavior) fair and aboveboard; without tricks; openly; (of a situation) out in the open

meaning_cn: 指一心一意。
meaning_en: to set one's heart on sth (idiom)

meaning_cn: 足充足。指同类的事物不只一个而是很多，无法列举齐全。
meaning_en: by no means an isolated case; numerous

meaning_cn: 形容文件会议多得泛滥成灾。
meaning_en: a mountain of paperwork and a sea of meetings (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容一个人的德行和艺术（技艺）都具有良好的声誉。一般指从事艺术的人。
meaning_en: (idiom) possessing both integrity and artistic skills

meaning_cn: 指从整体的利益着想，使不遭受损害。
meaning_en: to take the big picture into consideration (idiom); to work for the benefits of all

meaning_cn: 指干部不计较职位高低，不论处于领导岗位或在基层从事实际工作，都能踏踏实实地干。实行能上能下，是对干部职务终身制的一项重要改革。
meaning_en: ready to take any job, high or low

meaning_cn: 战通颤”，发抖。形容十分害怕。
meaning_en: to tremble with fear (idiom); scared witless

meaning_cn: 坚坚定；韧柔韧。形容意志坚定，不可动摇。
meaning_en: firm and indomitable (idiom); tenacious and unyielding

meaning_cn: 把快要死的人救活。形容医术高明。也比喻把已经没有希望的事物挽救过来。
meaning_en: to rise from the dead (idiom); fig. an unexpected recovery

meaning_cn: 贯注集中。全部精神集中在一点上。形容注意力高度集中。
meaning_en: (idiom) to concentrate one's attention completely; with rapt attention

meaning_cn: 从极危险的境地中逃脱，幸免于死。
meaning_en: mortal danger, escape alive (idiom); a narrow escape; to survive by the skin of one's teeth

meaning_cn: 原指作战时策马冲锋在前。形容领先。也比喻工作走在群众前面，积极带头。
meaning_en: (idiom) to take the lead

meaning_cn: 平平安安，没出什么事故。
meaning_en: safe and sound (idiom)

meaning_cn: 厚积指大量地、充分地积蓄；薄发指少量地、慢慢地放出。多多积蓄，慢慢放出。形容只有准备充分才能办好事情。
meaning_en: lit. to have accumulated knowledge and deliver it slowly (idiom); good preparation is the key to success; to be well prepared

meaning_cn: 毫无理由地跟人吵闹。指故意捣乱。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make trouble without reason; to be deliberately provocative

meaning_cn: 当机抓住时机。在紧要时刻立即做出决断。
meaning_en: to make prompt decisions (idiom)

meaning_cn: 深厚的感情和友谊。
meaning_en: deep friendship

meaning_cn: 名义上还存在，实际上已消亡。
meaning_en: the name remains, but the reality is gone (idiom)

meaning_cn: 释放下；重负重担子。象放下重担那样轻松。形容紧张心情过去以后的的轻松愉快。
meaning_en: as if relieved from a burden (idiom); to have a weight off one's mind

meaning_cn: 形容态度坚定，不可动摇。也形容严格遵守规定，决不变更。
meaning_en: not shaken by thunder (idiom); the arrangements are unalterable; to adhere rigidly to regulations; will go ahead whatever happens (of an arrangement or plan)

meaning_cn: 际边。一眼望不到边。形容非常辽阔。
meaning_en: as far as the eye can see (idiom)

meaning_cn: 与社会上的人们隔离，断绝来往。形容隐居或人迹不到的极偏僻地方。
meaning_en: to be cut off from the rest of the world (idiom)

meaning_cn: 罗张网捕捉。大门之前可以张起网来捕麻雀。形容十分冷落，宾客稀少。
meaning_en: (lit.) you can net sparrows at the door (idiom); (fig.) completely deserted

meaning_cn: 走路时身子摇亿摆。形容自以为了不起的傲慢神态。
meaning_en: to strut; swaggering

meaning_cn: 将且，又。有点相信，又有点怀疑。
meaning_en: see 半信半疑[ban4 xin4 ban4 yi2]

meaning_cn: 形容勤劳踏实。也形容勤恳的样子。
meaning_en: industrious and conscientious; assiduous

meaning_cn: 旷开阔；怡愉快。心境开阔，精神愉快。
meaning_en: lit. heart untroubled, spirit pleased (idiom); carefree and relaxed

meaning_cn: 泛指一日三餐的生活必需品。
meaning_en: (lit.) firewood, rice, oil and salt (idiom); (fig.) life's daily necessities

meaning_cn: 照知道；宣公开说出。彼此心里明白，而不公开说出来。
meaning_en: to have a tacit understanding

meaning_cn: 废停止。指做事不能坚持到底，中途停顿，有始无终。
meaning_en: to give up halfway (idiom); leave sth unfinished

meaning_cn: 有点相信，又有点怀疑。表示对真假是非不能肯定。
meaning_en: (idiom) half believing, half doubting; not quite convinced; skeptical

meaning_cn: 计策略、办法；施施展。没有办法可用。
meaning_en: (lit.) to have no strategy to apply (idiom); (fig.) to be out of ideas; at one's wit's end

meaning_cn: 形容混乱或败坏到了不可收拾的程度。
meaning_en: muddled and completely collapsing (idiom); in an awful condition; complete shambles; a total mess

meaning_cn: 后来的超过先前的。有以称赞后起之秀超过前辈。
meaning_en: (idiom) see 後來者居上|后来者居上[hou4 lai2 zhe3 ju1 shang4]

meaning_cn: 并驾几匹马并排拉着一辆车；齐驱一齐快跑。并排套着的几匹马一齐快跑。比喻彼此的力量或才能不分高下。
meaning_en: (idiom) to run neck and neck; to keep pace with; to keep abreast of; on par with one another

meaning_cn: 不时不是预定的时间。说不定什么时候会出现的需要。
meaning_en: a possible period of want or need

meaning_cn: 告称说，表示。主动要求担任某项艰巨的任务。
meaning_en: to volunteer for; to offer to undertake

meaning_cn: 指再度出任要职。也比喻失势之后又重新得势。
meaning_en: lit. to return to office after living as a hermit on Mount Dongshan (idiom); fig. to make a comeback

meaning_cn: 锒铛铁索链相撞击的声音。用铁链锁起来，投入监狱。
meaning_en: lit. to get shackled and thrown in jail (idiom); fig. to be put behind bars; to get jailed

meaning_cn: 行装简单，跟随的人少（多指有地位的人）。
meaning_en: (of an official) to travel with little luggage and just a small escort; to travel without ostentation

meaning_cn: 通力一起出力。不分彼此，一齐出力。
meaning_en: to join forces; to give full cooperation

meaning_cn: 石头沉到海底。比喻从此没有消息。
meaning_en: lit. to throw a stone and see it sink without trace in the sea (idiom); fig. to elicit no response

meaning_cn: 隐瞒自己的真实姓名，不让别人知道。
meaning_en: to conceal one's identity; living incognito

meaning_cn: 愤愤很生气的样子。心中不服，感到气愤。
meaning_en: to feel indignant; to feel aggrieved

meaning_cn: 一鼓第一次击鼓；作振作；气勇气。第一次击鼓时士气振奋。比喻趁劲头大的时候鼓起干劲，一口气把工作做完。
meaning_en: in a spurt of energy

meaning_cn: 得适合。自以为做的事情合乎道理，心里很坦然。
meaning_en: to have a clear conscience; to have no qualms about sth

meaning_cn: 绪丝头。比喻事情的开端，头绪非常多。也形容事情复杂纷乱。
meaning_en: plethora of things to tackle; multitude of loose ends; very complicated; chaotic

meaning_cn: 形容冰雪漫天盖地。
meaning_en: a world of ice and snow

meaning_cn: 后来出现的或新成长起来的优秀人物。
meaning_en: (idiom) an up-and-coming youngster; new talent; a brilliant younger generation

meaning_cn: 迁变动。随着时间的推移，情况发生变化。
meaning_en: things change with the passage of time (idiom)

meaning_cn: 唯只有；图图谋，追求。只要有利可图，什么事都干。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be bent solely on profit; to put profit before everything else

meaning_cn: 居站在，处于；临面对。占据高处，俯视下面。形容占据的地势非常有利。
meaning_en: lit. to be in a high location, overlooking the scene below (idiom); fig. to occupy a commanding position; to assume a haughty attitude

meaning_cn: 事情不分大小。形容什么事都管。同事无大小”。
meaning_en: lit. things are not separated according to their size (idiom); fig. to deal with any matter, regardless of its importance

meaning_cn: 来势迅猛，不可抵挡。
meaning_en: see 勢不可當|势不可当[shi4 bu4 ke3 dang1]

meaning_cn: 象烟云消散一样。比喻事物消失得干干净净。
meaning_en: (idiom) to vanish like smoke in thin air; to disappear

meaning_cn: 泛指在地上坐。
meaning_en: (idiom) to sit on the ground or the floor

meaning_cn: 豁然形容开阔；开朗开阔明亮。从黑暗狭窄变得宽敞明亮。比喻突然领悟了一个道理。
meaning_en: suddenly opens up to a wide panorama (idiom); to come to a wide clearing; fig. everything becomes clear at once; to achieve speedy enlightenment

meaning_cn: 义愤对违反正义的事情所产生的愤怒；膺胸。发于正义的愤懑充满胸中。
meaning_en: righteous indignation fills one's breast (idiom); to feel indignant at injustice

meaning_cn: 作战时将领亲自带头，冲在士兵前面。现在也用来比喻领导带头，走在群众前面。
meaning_en: to fight at the head of one's troops; (fig.) to take the lead

meaning_cn: 一概同一标准，一律。指处理事情或问题不分性质，不加区别，用同一标准来对待或处理。
meaning_en: to lump different matters together (idiom)

meaning_cn: 敷衍做事不认真；了完。指办事马马虎虎，只求应付过去就算完事。
meaning_en: (idiom) to do things half-heartedly; to merely go through the motions

meaning_cn: 垫高枕头睡觉，无忧无虑。比喻思想麻痹，丧失警惕。
meaning_en: to sleep peacefully (idiom); (fig.) to rest easy; to be free of worries

meaning_cn: 变着法定出一些名目来达到某种不正当的目的。
meaning_en: to fabricate excuses (idiom); to concoct various items (e.g. to pad an expense account)

meaning_cn: 表示无可奈何，不得不如此。
meaning_en: only when absolutely essential (idiom); as a last resort

meaning_cn: 形容声音很大，耳朵都快震聋了。
meaning_en: ear-splitting (idiom); deafening

meaning_cn: 昔过去。现在不是过去能比得上的。多指形势、自然面貌等发生了巨大的变化。
meaning_en: (idiom) things are very different now; times have changed

meaning_cn: 没有一点忧愁和顾虑。
meaning_en: (idiom) carefree; without worries

meaning_cn: 蹈顿足踏地。两手舞动，两只脚也跳了起来。形容高兴到了极点。也手乱舞、脚乱跳的狂态。
meaning_en: lit. to move one's hands and feet about (idiom); fig. to dance about; to express one's feelings in body language; to gesture animatedly; (TCM) involuntary movements of the limbs

meaning_cn: 各自选取自己所需要的。
meaning_en: each takes what he needs (idiom)

meaning_cn: 遥遥远远。远远地走在最前面。
meaning_en: (idiom) a long way in front; to lead by a wide margin

meaning_cn: 音信消息，回信。没有一点消息。
meaning_en: to have no news whatever

meaning_cn: 濡沾湿；沫唾沫。泉水干了，鱼吐沫互相润湿。比喻一同在困难的处境里，用微薄的力量互相帮助。
meaning_en: (lit.) (of fish) to moisten each other with spittle (when out of the water) (idiom); (fig.) to share meager resources and support each other in times of difficulty

meaning_cn: 指先听进去的话或先获得的印象往往在头脑中占有主导地位，以后再遇到不同的意见时，就不容易接受。
meaning_en: (idiom) the first impression is the strongest; to hold a preconceived notion (about sth)

meaning_cn: 有的横，有的竖，杂乱无章。形容纵横杂乱。
meaning_en: in disorder; at sixes and sevens (idiom)

meaning_cn: 疾首头痛。形容痛恨到了极点。
meaning_en: bitter and hateful (idiom); to grieve and lament (over sth)

meaning_cn: 形容雄壮的队伍或浩大的声势。
meaning_en: magnificent army with thousands of men and horses (idiom); impressive display of manpower; all the King's horses and all the King's men

meaning_cn: 可以有，也可以没有。指有没有都无关紧要。
meaning_en: not essential; dispensable

meaning_cn: 把一个整体分成许多零散部分。
meaning_en: to break up the whole into pieces (idiom); dealing with things one by one; divide and conquer

meaning_cn: 阳表面上；奉遵守，听从；阴暗地里。指玩弄两面派手法，表面上遵从，暗地里违背。
meaning_en: outward devotion but inner opposition (idiom); to pay lip service; to agree overtly, but oppose in secret

meaning_cn: 沉默不出声；寡少。不声不响，很少说话。
meaning_en: habitually silent (idiom); reticent; uncommunicative

meaning_cn: 形容竞赛激烈，大家都不甘落后。
meaning_en: friendly one-upmanship; to try to emulate

meaning_cn: 顺手把人家的羊牵走。比喻趁势将敌手捉住或乘机利用别人。现比喻乘机拿走别人的东西。
meaning_en: lit. to lead away a goat while passing by (idiom); fig. to opportunistically pocket sb's possessions and walk off

meaning_cn: 佳好；境境地。原指甘蔗下端比上端甜，从上到下，越吃越甜◇比喻境况逐渐好转或兴趣逐渐浓厚。
meaning_en: (idiom) to gradually improve; to get better and better

meaning_cn: 听、任随，任凭；之代词，代人或事物。任凭事物存在发展而不去过问。
meaning_en: (idiom) to take a laissez-faire attitude; to turn a blind eye (towards sth undesirable)

meaning_cn: 束手自缚其手，比喻不想方设法；就受；擒活捉。捆起手来让人捉住。指毫不抵抗，乖乖地让人捉住。
meaning_en: (lit.) to submit to having one's hands tied and being taken prisoner (idiom); (fig.) to surrender without a fight

meaning_cn: 旁；另外的；骛追求。心思没有另外的追求，形容心思集中，专心致志。
meaning_en: completely focused; free of distractions

meaning_cn: 万一意外变化。用以防备难以预料的事情。
meaning_en: to guard against the unexpected (idiom); just in case; prepared for any eventualities

meaning_cn: 聩天生耳聋，引伸为不明事理。声音很大，使耳聋的人也听得见。比喻用语言文字唤醒糊涂麻木的人，使他们清醒过来。
meaning_en: lit. so loud that even the deaf can hear (idiom); rousing even the apathetic

meaning_cn: 按情理，有可原谅的地方。
meaning_en: pardonable (of interruption, misunderstanding etc)

meaning_cn: 尽全部用出。用全部的力量去做。
meaning_en: to try one's utmost; to strive

meaning_cn: 指用不正当的手段谋取私利。也指靠小聪明占便宜。
meaning_en: to gain advantage by any means, fair or foul; to be opportunistic; to be full of tricks

meaning_cn: 指拿小题目作大文章。比喻不恰当地把小事当作大事来处理，有故意夸张的意思。
meaning_en: to make a big fuss over a minor issue (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指订立法律与人民相约遵守◇泛指订立简单的条款。
meaning_en: to agree on three laws (idiom); three-point covenant; (fig.) preliminary agreement; basic rules

meaning_cn: 不屑不值得，不愿意；顾看。认为不值得一看。形容极端轻视。
meaning_en: to disdain as beneath contempt (idiom)

meaning_cn: 圆圆满，周全。指说话的人能使自己的论点或谎话没有漏洞。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make a story or theory consistent; to give a plausible explanation; to plug the holes in one's story

meaning_cn: 每个人都能充分发挥自己的才能。
meaning_en: employ one's talent to the fullest; everyone gives of their best

meaning_cn: 走的欢送，来的欢迎。形容忙于交际应酬。
meaning_en: lit. to meet those arriving, to send of those departing (idiom); busy entertaining guests; all time taken over with social niceties

meaning_cn: ①指富有财产，气派不凡。②指仗着钱财多而气势凌人。
meaning_en: rich and imposing; rich and overbearing

meaning_cn: 逐追随。随着波浪起伏，跟着流水漂荡。比喻没有坚定的立场，缺乏判断是非的能力，只能随着别人走。
meaning_en: to drift with the waves and go with the flow (idiom); to follow the crowd blindly

meaning_cn: 希望自己的子女能在学业和事业上有成就。
meaning_en: lit. to hope one's son becomes a dragon (idiom); fig. to long for one' s child to succeed in life; to have great hopes for one's offspring; to give one's child the best education as a career investment

meaning_cn: 比喻无关紧要的琐碎事情。
meaning_en: lit. chicken feathers and garlic skins (idiom); fig. trivial (matter)

meaning_cn: 肃然恭敬的样子；起敬产生敬佩的心情。形容产生严肃敬仰的感情。
meaning_en: to feel deep veneration for sb (idiom)

meaning_cn: 公平合理的买卖。
meaning_en: fair dealing

meaning_cn: 高阁储藏器物的高架。捆起来以后放在高高的架子上。比喻放着不用。
meaning_en: tied up in a bundle on a high shelf; to put sth on the back burner; no longer a high priority

meaning_cn: 原意是说，因为有人吃饭噎死了，就想让天下人都不吃饭，这太荒谬了。比喻要做的事情由于出了点小毛病或怕出问题就索性不去干。
meaning_en: lit. not eating for fear of choking (idiom); fig. to cut off one's nose to spite one's face; to avoid sth essential because of a slight risk

meaning_cn: 另外重支炉灶。比喻放弃原来的，另外从头做起。
meaning_en: lit. to set up a separate kitchen (idiom); to start from scratch; back to square one; to start of on a new path

meaning_cn: 青田时的青苗；黄成熟的谷物。旧粮已经吃完，新粮尚未接上。也比喻人才或物力前后接不上。
meaning_en: lit. yellow does not reach green (idiom); the yellow autumn crop does not last until the green spring crop; temporary deficit in manpower or resources; unable to make ends meet

meaning_cn: 各方面都能照顾到，没有遗漏疏忽。也指虽然照顾到各方面，但一般化。
meaning_en: (idiom) take care of everything; handle everything

meaning_cn: 形容极远的地方，或相隔极远。
meaning_en: the ends of the earth; separated worlds apart

meaning_cn: 伦次条理。话讲得乱七八糟，毫无次序。
meaning_en: incoherent speech; to talk without rhyme or reason (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指诵读诗文时的声音响亮而顺口。
meaning_en: to flow right off the tongue (of lyrics or poetry); to recite with ease; catchy (of a song)

meaning_cn: 身自身。把自己放在事情之外，毫不关心。
meaning_en: (idiom) not to get involved; to stay out of it

meaning_cn: 指恭敬谨慎，竭尽心力。
meaning_en: to bend to a task and spare no effort (idiom); striving to the utmost

meaning_cn: 欢蹦乱跳，活泼、欢乐，生气勃勃的样子。
meaning_en: to leap and frisk about (idiom); lively; healthy and active

meaning_cn: 栗畏惧，发抖。不冷而发抖。形容非常恐惧。
meaning_en: lit. not cold, yet shivering (idiom); fig. to tremble with fear; to be terrified

meaning_cn: 分清楚是和非、正确和错误。
meaning_en: to distinguish right and wrong (idiom)

meaning_cn: 赅完备。话不多，但意思都有了。形容说话写文章简明扼要。
meaning_en: concise and comprehensive (idiom)

meaning_cn: 鸟叫得好听，花开得喷香。形容春天的美好景象。
meaning_en: lit. birdsong and fragrant flowers (idiom); fig. the intoxication of a beautiful spring day

meaning_cn: 本为佛家语，指道无所不在◇多形容说话做事很有条理。
meaning_en: clear and logical

meaning_cn: 安、扎建立，安置；寨防守用的栅栏。指部队驻扎下来。也比喻建立临时的劳动或工作基地。
meaning_en: to set up camp; Taiwan pr. [an1 ying2 zha2 zhai4]

meaning_cn: 风尘指行旅，含有辛苦之意；仆仆行路劳累的样子。形容旅途奔波，忙碌劳累。
meaning_en: lit. covered in dust (idiom); fig. travel-worn

meaning_cn: 指以前的人从来没有做过的。也指空前的。
meaning_en: (idiom) unprecedented; unheard of

meaning_cn: 非议责备，批评。没有什么可以指责的。表示做得妥当。
meaning_en: irreproachable (idiom); nothing blameworthy about it at all

meaning_cn: 没有什么不能做的。指样样能做。
meaning_en: omnipotent

meaning_cn: 筋筋骨；尽完。形容非常疲乏，一点力气也没有了。
meaning_en: body weary, strength exhausted (idiom); extremely tired; spent

meaning_cn: 指一回又一回，经过一段时间。表示逐渐的意思。
meaning_en: gradually; little by little; in the course of time

meaning_cn: 挂上灯笼，系上彩绸。形容节日或有喜庆事情的景象。
meaning_en: to be decorated with lanterns and colored banners (idiom)

meaning_cn: 由听从，顺便；分说辩白，解说。不容人分辩解释。
meaning_en: to allow no explanation

meaning_cn: 酣畅畅饮，引伸为舒适、畅快；淋漓畅快的样子。形容非常畅快。
meaning_en: to one's heart's content (idiom)

meaning_cn: 想往南而车子却向北行。比喻行动和目的正好相反。
meaning_en: to act in a way that defeats one's purpose (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容没有约束，十分安闲随意。
meaning_en: free and easy (idiom); carefree; leisurely

meaning_cn: 形容急急忙忙，冒冒失失的样子。
meaning_en: bustling; energetic

meaning_cn: 冒冒充，以假充真。为了达到自己的某种目的，假冒别人的姓名，代他去干事或窃取他的权力、地位。
meaning_en: to assume sb's name and take his place (idiom); to impersonate; to pose under a false name

meaning_cn: 保卫家乡和祖国。
meaning_en: guard home, defend the country (idiom); national defense

meaning_cn: 年富未来的年岁多。形容年纪轻，精力旺盛。
meaning_en: young and vigorous (idiom)

meaning_cn: 不义不正当，不合理。不应该得到的或以不正当的手段获得的钱财。
meaning_en: ill-gotten wealth or gains

meaning_cn: 模棱含糊，不明确；两可可以这样，也可以那样。指不表示明确的态度，或没有明确的主张。
meaning_en: equivocal; ambiguous

meaning_cn: 中饱从中得利。指侵吞经手的钱财使自己得利。
meaning_en: to stuff one's pockets; to take bribes

meaning_cn: 隔一天，或几乎每天。形容经常、频繁。
meaning_en: lit. twice every three days (idiom); practically every day; frequently

meaning_cn: 穷得象用水洗过似的，什么都没有。形容十分贫穷。
meaning_en: (idiom) penniless; destitute

meaning_cn: 犹言不分白天夜晚。
meaning_en: day and night; regardless of the time of day or night

meaning_cn: 贤德才兼备的人；齐相等。见到德才兼备的人就想赶上他。
meaning_en: see a worthy, think to imitate (idiom, from Analects); emulate the virtuous; Follow the example of a virtuous and wise teacher.

meaning_cn: 戒警戒；备防备。警戒防备极严密。
meaning_en: heavily-guarded

meaning_cn: 形容各种各样奇怪的事物。
meaning_en: fantastic oddities of every description (idiom)

meaning_cn: 麻痹肢体失去知觉和运动机能障碍，比喻失去警觉。指粗心、疏忽，对事物不敏感，失去警惕性。
meaning_en: unwary; negligent

meaning_cn: 载装载；归回来。装得满满地回来。形容收获很大。
meaning_en: (idiom) to return from a rewarding journey

meaning_cn: 至最。高到顶点，再也没有更高的了。
meaning_en: supreme; paramount; unsurpassed

meaning_cn: 发挥或发扬优点或有利条件，克服或回避缺点或不利条件。
meaning_en: to foster strengths and avoid weaknesses (idiom); to play to one's strengths

meaning_cn: 甘甜。共同享受幸福，共同担当艰苦。
meaning_en: shared delights and common hardships (idiom); to share life's joys and sorrows; for better or for worse

meaning_cn: 原比喻防御十分坚固，不可摧毁。也比喻团结一致。
meaning_en: copper wall, iron bastion (idiom); impenetrable defense

meaning_cn: 孜孜勤勉的样子。不知疲倦地探求。
meaning_en: diligent and tireless (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指十分伤心或感动，抱头大哭。
meaning_en: to weep disconsolately; to cry on each other's shoulder

meaning_cn: 移改变；易变换。改变旧的风俗习惯。
meaning_en: (idiom) to reform habits and customs

meaning_cn: 匠心巧妙的心思。具有独到的灵巧的心思。指在技巧和艺术方面的创造性。
meaning_en: original and ingenious (idiom); to show great creativity

meaning_cn: 后悔也来不及了。
meaning_en: too late for regrets (idiom); It is useless to repent after the event.

meaning_cn: 负承受，承担，引申为享有。长时期地享有好的名声。
meaning_en: seasoned; honed to perfection over centuries; special reserve

meaning_cn: 冷不热情，引伸为严峻；热温度高，引伸为辛辣。用尖刻辛辣的语言进行讥笑和讽刺。
meaning_en: frigid irony and scorching satire (idiom); to mock and ridicule

meaning_cn: 江河湖泊的水溢出，造成灾害。比喻不好的文章或思想到处传播，影响极坏。
meaning_en: lit. to flood (idiom); fig. rampant; in plague proportions

meaning_cn: 乱冲乱撞，蛮横无理。
meaning_en: (idiom) to barge through, jostling and elbowing; to charge around; to rampage

meaning_cn: 形容自以为不错而得意的样子。
meaning_en: immeasurably self-satisfied

meaning_cn: 恍忽糊里糊涂的样子。形容神思不定或神志不清。
meaning_en: (idiom) absent-minded; in a trance

meaning_cn: 盘盘曲；错交错；节枝节。树木的根枝盘旋交错。比喻事情纷难复杂。
meaning_en: twisted roots and intertwined joints (idiom); complicated and very tricky; knotty and deeply-rooted difficulties

meaning_cn: 兴创办；土木指建筑工程。大规模地盖房子。
meaning_en: to carry out large scale construction

meaning_cn: 用欺骗的手段在暗地里活动。
meaning_en: to cross the sea by a trick (idiom); to achieve one's aim by underhanded means

meaning_cn: 丧失理智，象发了疯一样。形容言行昏乱而荒谬，或残忍可恶到了极点。
meaning_en: (idiom) deranged; demented; berserk

meaning_cn: 眼珠子一动不动地盯着看。形容注意力集中。
meaning_en: unable to take one's eyes off (idiom); to gaze steadily; to stare

meaning_cn: 相互相；安安稳。指彼此相处没有什么争执或冲突，还过得去。
meaning_en: (idiom) to live together in harmony

meaning_cn: 乐好，喜欢。喜欢做善事，乐于拿财物接济有困难的人。
meaning_en: kind and charitable

meaning_cn: 跑得很快的马再加上一鞭子，使马跑得更快。比喻快上加快，加速前进。
meaning_en: to spur the horse to full speed (idiom); to go as fast as possible

meaning_cn: 紧要急切的，重要的。不重要，不会影响大局。
meaning_en: indifferent; insignificant

meaning_cn: 旧时土葬，人死后埋入土中，死者方得其所，家属方觉心安。
meaning_en: buried and at rest (idiom); Resquiescat in pacem (RIP)

meaning_cn: 峰峦重叠环绕，山路蜿蜒曲折。形容山水名胜路径曲折复杂。
meaning_en: the mountain road twists around each new peak (idiom); (of a mountain road) twisting and turning; fig. an opportunity has come unexpectedly; things have taken a new turn

meaning_cn: 闻听到。听到了从来没有听到过的事。形容事物新奇罕见。
meaning_en: unheard of; an extremely rare and unprecedented event

meaning_cn: 寸形容细微短小；铁指武器。手里没有任何武器。
meaning_en: lit. not an inch of steel (idiom); unarmed and defenseless

meaning_cn: 依据道理，竭力维护自己方面的权益、观点等。
meaning_en: to contend on strong grounds; to argue strongly for what is right

meaning_cn: 虚空、白。没有空跑这一趟。表示某种行动还是有所收获的。
meaning_en: (idiom) it's been a worthwhile trip

meaning_cn: 逃脱鱼网的鱼。比喻侥幸逃脱的罪犯或敌人。
meaning_en: (lit.) a fish that escaped the net (idiom); (fig.) sb or sth that slips through the net

meaning_cn: 船只乘着风势破浪前进。比喻排除困难，奋勇前进。
meaning_en: to brave the wind and the billows (idiom); to have high ambitions

meaning_cn: 拔超出；类同类；萃原为草丛生的样子，引伸为聚集。超出同类之上。多指人的品德才能。
meaning_en: to excel the common (idiom); surpassing; preeminent; outstanding

meaning_cn: 只要有人请求帮助，就一定答应。
meaning_en: to grant whatever is asked for; to accede to every plea

meaning_cn: 比喻想尽一切办法。
meaning_en: to dig for thoughts (idiom); to search everything for an answer; to rack one's brains

meaning_cn: 暴露显露，显现；遗遗漏。全都暴露出来。
meaning_en: to lay bare; to come to light

meaning_cn: 廉便宜。东西价钱便宜，质量又好。
meaning_en: inexpensive and of good quality (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容漏洞、弊病很多，或破坏的程度严重。
meaning_en: see 百孔千瘡|百孔千疮[bai3 kong3 qian1 chuang1]

meaning_cn: 一口咬定，死不承认。
meaning_en: to deny flatly

meaning_cn: 嗤讥笑。用鼻子吭声冷笑。表示轻蔑。
meaning_en: to snort disdainfully; to scoff at; to turn up one's nose

meaning_cn: 原封没有开封。原来贴的封口没有动过。比喻完全按照原样，一点不加变动。
meaning_en: (lit.) the original seal has not been disturbed (idiom); (fig.) left completely unchanged; untouched; intact

meaning_cn: 番遍数。一再，多次。
meaning_en: over and over again (idiom)

meaning_cn: 登上高处，看得更远。也比喻思想境界高，目光远大。
meaning_en: to stand tall and see far (idiom); taking the long and broad view; acute foresight

meaning_cn: 在石板上钉上铁钉。比喻事情已经决定，不能改变。
meaning_en: that clinches it; that's final; no two ways about it

meaning_cn: 杞周代诸侯国名，在今河南杞县一带。杞国有个人怕天塌下来。比喻不必要的或缺乏根据的忧虑和担心。
meaning_en: (lit.) like the man of 杞[Qi3] who feared the sky would fall (idiom); (fig.) to entertain groundless fears

meaning_cn: 形容心中非常满意。
meaning_en: perfectly contented (idiom); perfectly satisfied

meaning_cn: 到处都存在，到处都有。
meaning_en: omnipresent

meaning_cn: 一抬手，一动脚。形容轻而易举，毫不费力。
meaning_en: one's every movement (idiom); comportment; gestures

meaning_cn: 张看。形容这里那里地到处看。
meaning_en: to look in all directions (idiom); to glance around

meaning_cn: 比喻三方面对立的局势。
meaning_en: (idiom) to form a tripartite balance of power

meaning_cn: 归还给。把物品还给原来的主人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to return sth to its rightful owner

meaning_cn: 悬在半空中的阁楼。比喻虚幻的事物或脱离实际的空想。
meaning_en: pavilion in the air (idiom); unrealistic Utopian construction; castles in Spain; imaginary future plans

meaning_cn: 通宵通夜，整夜；达到；旦天亮。整整一夜，从天黑到天亮。
meaning_en: overnight until daybreak (idiom); all night long; day and night

meaning_cn: 指用钱满不在乎，一花就是一大笔。
meaning_en: lit. stake a thousand pieces of gold on one throw (idiom); to throw away money recklessly; extravagant

meaning_cn: 凿凿确实。形容说得非常确实。
meaning_en: (idiom) to speak with conviction

meaning_cn: 挥洒，泼。形容天热出汗多。
meaning_en: to drip with sweat; sweat poured off (him)

meaning_cn: 神话传说，仙女的衣服没有衣缝。比喻事物周密完善，找不出什么毛病。
meaning_en: lit. seamless heavenly clothes (idiom); fig. flawless

meaning_cn: 好象鱼得到水一样。比喻有所凭借。也比喻得到跟自己十分投合的人或对自己很合适的环境。
meaning_en: like a fish back in water (idiom); glad to be back in one's proper surroundings

meaning_cn: 和尚多，而供和尚喝的粥少。比喻物少人多，不够分配。
meaning_en: lit. many monks and not much gruel (idiom); fig. not enough to go around; demand exceeds supply

meaning_cn: 诿也作委”，推辞；推诿把责任推给别人。彼此之间互相推托，谁也不愿承担责任。
meaning_en: mutually shirking responsibilities (idiom); each blaming the other; passing the buck to and fro; each trying to unload responsibilities onto the other

meaning_cn: 原为佛家语，指人的本性◇多比喻事物原来的模样。
meaning_en: (idiom) true colors; true features; original appearance

meaning_cn: 拒拒绝。对于有所求而来的人或送上门来的东西概不拒绝。
meaning_en: to refuse nobody (idiom); all comers welcome

meaning_cn: 欣喜快乐；若好象；狂失去控制。形容高兴到了极点。
meaning_en: to be wild with joy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 呕吐；沥一滴一滴。比喻用尽心思。多形容为事业、工作、文艺创作等用心的艰苦。
meaning_en: lit. to spit out one's heart and spill blood (idiom); to work one's heart out; blood, sweat and tears

meaning_cn: 指农业上认真细致地耕作。
meaning_en: intensive farming

meaning_cn: 汗马将士骑的马奔驰出汗，比喻征战劳苦。指在战场上建立战功。现指辛勤工作做出的贡献。
meaning_en: war exploits; (fig.) heroic contribution

meaning_cn: 纵放；逝消失。稍微一放松就消失了。形容时间或机会等很容易过去。
meaning_en: transient; fleeting

meaning_cn: 有远大的眼光和高明的见解。
meaning_en: visionary and sagacious (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻情况万分危急。
meaning_en: (lit.) a thousand pounds hangs by a thread (idiom); (fig.) (at the) critical; perilous (moment)

meaning_cn: 无须攻击，自己就会破灭。形容论点站不住脚，经不起反驳或攻击。
meaning_en: (of a rumor etc) to collapse (in the light of facts etc); to be discredited

meaning_cn: 图谋求。振作精神，以求强盛。
meaning_en: to work energetically for prosperity (of the country)

meaning_cn: 筹计谋、谋划；帷幄古代军中帐幕。指拟定作战策略。引申为筹划、指挥。
meaning_en: lit. to devise battle plan in a tent (idiom); fig. planning strategies

meaning_cn: 尽完。一起死亡或一同毁灭。
meaning_en: to die in such a way that sb (or sth) else also perishes; to take sb down with oneself; to end in mutual destruction

meaning_cn: 并都；茂草木丰盛的样子，引伸为美好。指演唱的音色、唱腔和表达的感情都很动人。
meaning_en: (of a singer etc) excellent in voice and expression (idiom)

meaning_cn: 颜开脸面舒开，指笑容。形容心里高兴，满面笑容。
meaning_en: grinning from ear to ear (idiom); beaming with happiness

meaning_cn: 就随。在本地找需要的材料。比喻不依靠外力，充分发挥本单位的潜力。
meaning_en: to draw on local resources; using materials at hand

meaning_cn: 有说有笑，兴致高。形容谈话谈得高兴而有风趣。
meaning_en: to talk cheerfully and wittily; to joke together

meaning_cn: 原指一部合乎道德规范的经典◇用以形容态度庄重严肃，郑重其事。有时含讽刺意味。
meaning_en: (idiom) in deadly earnest; deadpan

meaning_cn: 按止住。使军队暂不行动。现也比喻暂不开展工作。
meaning_en: to hold back one's troops without moving (idiom); to bide one's time

meaning_cn: ①真实的刀枪。②比喻毫不作假，实实在在。
meaning_en: (lit.) real swords and spears (idiom); (fig.) very much for real; genuine

meaning_cn: 化化生和养育。指适宜于草木生长的风雨。比喻良好的薰陶和教育。
meaning_en: lit. spring wind and rain (idiom); fig. the long-term influence of a solid education

meaning_cn: 天罗张在空中捕鸟的网。天空地面，遍张罗网。指上下四方设置的包围圈。比喻对敌人、逃犯等的严密包围。
meaning_en: inescapable net (idiom); trap; dragnet

meaning_cn: 肩碰着肩，脚碰着脚。形容人多拥挤。
meaning_en: lit. rubbing shoulders and following in each other's footsteps; a thronging crowd

meaning_cn: 意外的灾祸。
meaning_en: sudden and unexpected disaster (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指画竹子要在心里有一幅竹子的形象◇比喻在做事之前已经拿定主意。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have a well-thought-out plan in mind

meaning_cn: 指地理位置靠近山岭和水流。
meaning_en: mountains on one side and water on the other

meaning_cn: 眈眈注视的样子。象老虎那样凶狠地盯着。形容心怀不善，伺机攫取。
meaning_en: (lit.) to fix one's eyes on sth like a tiger watching its prey (idiom); (fig.) to eye covetously

meaning_cn: 吉吉利，顺利。什么事都很圆满顺利。也指一切事情都已办好。
meaning_en: everything is fine (idiom); all is well with the world

meaning_cn: 萎靡颓丧。形容精神不振，意志消沉。
meaning_en: dispirited and listless (idiom); downcast

meaning_cn: 鳌头宫殿门前台阶上的鳌鱼浮雕，科举进士发榜时状元站此迎榜。科举时代指点状元。比喻占首位或第一名。
meaning_en: (idiom) to come first in triennial palace examinations (refers to the carved stone turtle head in front of the imperial palace, next to which the most successful candidate in the imperial examinations was entitled to stand); to be the champion; to be the very best in any field

meaning_cn: 从古到今。泛指很长一段时间。
meaning_en: since ancient times; since times immemorial

meaning_cn: 舍己牺牲自己。不惜牺牲自己去救别人。
meaning_en: to abandon self for others (idiom); to sacrifice oneself to help the people; altruism

meaning_cn: 欲想；罢停，歇。要停止也不能停止。
meaning_en: want to stop but can't (idiom); to be unable to stop oneself; to feel an urge to continue

meaning_cn: 穷极端。形容极端残暴凶恶。
meaning_en: fiendish; black-hearted

meaning_cn: 险险阻；夷平坦。化危险为平安。比喻转危为安。
meaning_en: to turn peril into safety (idiom); to avert disaster

meaning_cn: 映对照，映衬。相互衬托着，显得很有趣味，很有意思。
meaning_en: to set each other off nicely

meaning_cn: 索找；骥良马。按照画像去寻求好马。比喻墨守成规办事；也比喻按照线索去寻求。
meaning_en: lit. looking for a fine horse using only a picture (idiom); fig. to do things along rigid, conventional lines; to try and find sth with the help of a clue

meaning_cn: 倚偏。不偏向任何一方。表示中立或公正。
meaning_en: (idiom) even-handed; impartial; unbiased

meaning_cn: 使线的一头通过针眼。比喻从中联系、拉拢。
meaning_en: lit. to thread a needle (idiom); fig. to act as a go-between

meaning_cn: 关起门来造车子。比喻脱离实际，只凭主观办事。
meaning_en: lit. to shut oneself away and build a cart (idiom); fig. to work on a project in isolation, without caring for outside realities

meaning_cn: 迎向着；头走在前面的。加紧追过最前面的。
meaning_en: to try hard to catch up

meaning_cn: 到一个地方，就顺从当地的习俗。
meaning_en: (idiom) when in Rome, do as the Romans do

meaning_cn: 不堪经不起。形容力量薄弱，经不起一击。也形容论点不严密，经不起反驳。
meaning_en: (idiom) unable to withstand a single blow; to collapse at the first blow

meaning_cn: 具有才能和远见卓识的人。
meaning_en: a person with knowledge and experience (idiom)

meaning_cn: 尔你；反通返”，回。原意是你怎样做，就会得到怎样的后果。现指人的言行反复无常，前后自相矛盾。
meaning_en: old: to reap the consequences of one's words (idiom, from Mencius); modern: to go back on one's word; to blow hot and cold; to contradict oneself; inconsistent

meaning_cn: 形容神态失常，失去自制。
meaning_en: (idiom) enthralled; mesmerized; enraptured

meaning_cn: 覆翻过来。形容变化巨大。也形容闹得很凶。
meaning_en: sky and the earth turning upside down (idiom); fig. complete confusion; everything turned on its head

meaning_cn: 于在；一旦一天。在一天的功夫全被毁掉。多指长期劳动的成果一下子被毁掉。
meaning_en: (idiom) ruined in a short time (esp. of sth that took a long time or great effort to achieve)

meaning_cn: 个别词句或片断的话。
meaning_en: (idiom) just a word or two; a few isolated phrases

meaning_cn: 原指仁爱而有节操，能为正义牺牲生命的人。现在泛指爱国而为革命事业出力的人。
meaning_en: gentleman aspiring to benevolence (idiom); people with lofty ideals

meaning_cn: 期约定时间。没有约定而遇见。指意外碰见。
meaning_en: meet by chance; have a chance encounter

meaning_cn: 原指因受命奔走而搞得很累◇也指忙于奔走应付，弄得非常疲乏。
meaning_en: (idiom) terribly busy; up to one's ears in work

meaning_cn: 横生层出不穷地表露。洋溢着美妙的意趣（多指语言、文章或美术作品）。
meaning_en: endlessly interesting (idiom); very witty

meaning_cn: 汹汹气势盛大的样子。形容气势凶猛。
meaning_en: aggressive; truculent; overbearing

meaning_cn: 在大海里捞一根针。比喻极难找到。
meaning_en: lit. to fish a needle from the sea; to find a needle in a haystack (idiom)

meaning_cn: 似象；是对；非不对∶象是对的，实际上不对。
meaning_en: apparently right but actually wrong; specious (idiom)

meaning_cn: 差尚，略；强振奋。勉强使人满意。
meaning_en: (idiom) just passable; barely satisfactory

meaning_cn: 辛辣；茹吃。形容忍受辛苦或吃尽辛苦。
meaning_en: to suffer every possible torment (idiom); bitter hardship; to bear one's cross

meaning_cn: 风华风采、才华；茂旺盛。正是青春焕发、风采动人和才华横溢的时候。形容青年朝气蓬勃、奋发有为的精神面貌。
meaning_en: in one's prime

meaning_cn: 赃赃物；枉歪曲，破坏。贪污受贿，违犯法纪。
meaning_en: corruption and abuse of the law (idiom); to take bribes and bend the law

meaning_cn: 旧时指组织或扩充武装力量◇比喻组织或扩充人力。
meaning_en: lit. to recruit soldiers and buy horses (idiom); fig. to raise an army; to recruit new staff

meaning_cn: 劈开丛生多刺的野生植物。比喻在创业过程中或前进道路上清除障碍，克服重重困难。
meaning_en: lit. to cut one's way through thistles and thorns (idiom); fig. to overcome all obstacles on the way; to break through hardships; to blaze a new trail

meaning_cn: 飘摇飘荡。在风雨中飘荡不定。比喻局势动荡不安，很不稳定。
meaning_en: tossed about by the wind and rain (idiom); (of a situation) unstable

meaning_cn: 殚竭尽；虑思虑。形容用尽心思。
meaning_en: to exhaust one's thoughts and ingenuity (idiom); to think sth through thoroughly; to rack one's brains; to leave no stone unturned

meaning_cn: 极其完善，极其美好。指完美到没有一点缺点。
meaning_en: perfect (idiom); perfection; the best of all possible worlds; as good as it gets

meaning_cn: 活跃地呈现在纸上。形容文学作品叙述描写真实生动。
meaning_en: to appear vividly on paper (idiom); to show forth vividly (in writing, painting etc); to stand out markedly

meaning_cn: 豪迈雄壮的言语。形容充满英雄气概的话。
meaning_en: bold, visionary words

meaning_cn: 以用；偏片面；概概括；全全部。用片面的观点看待整体问题。
meaning_en: (lit.) to take a part for the whole; to generalize

meaning_cn: 功功劳；尽完全；弃丢失。以前的功劳全部丢失。也指以前的努力全部白费。
meaning_en: to waste all one's previous efforts (idiom); all that has been achieved goes down the drain

meaning_cn: 指再做以前曾做的事。
meaning_en: (idiom) to resume one's old trade

meaning_cn: 像诗画里所描摩的能给人以美感的意境。
meaning_en: picturesque charm; idyllic appeal; poetic grace

meaning_cn: 祟古人想象中的鬼怪或鬼怪出而祸人。指行动偷偷摸摸，不光明正大。
meaning_en: (idiom) sneaky; secretive; furtive

meaning_cn: 摸着胸口，自己问自己怎么样。指自己反省。
meaning_en: to ask oneself honestly; to search in one's heart

meaning_cn: 用心认真思考；良很≤费心思地反复思考。
meaning_en: to ponder earnestly; to give a lot of thought to sth

meaning_cn: 指办事或说话正合分寸。
meaning_en: (idiom) appropriate; apt; just right

meaning_cn: 经过长时间停不下来。
meaning_en: (idiom) prolonged (applause, cheering etc)

meaning_cn: 形容姿态多种多样。
meaning_en: (idiom) to come in many different shapes; to display a great variety of forms

meaning_cn: 蹒跚走路一瘸一拐的样子。形容走路腿脚不方便，歪歪倒倒的样了。
meaning_en: (idiom) to walk unsteadily; to hobble along

meaning_cn: 休养何处保养；生息人口繁殖。指在战争或社会大动荡之后，减轻人民负担，安定生活，恢复元气。
meaning_en: to recover; to recuperate

meaning_cn: 风靡草木随风倒下，引伸为很风行。形容事物在一个时期里极其盛行，象风吹倒草木一样。
meaning_en: fashionable for a while (idiom); all the rage

meaning_cn: 指说话含含糊糊，很不清楚。也形容行为暧昧。
meaning_en: (idiom) obscure; dubious; shady

meaning_cn: 重视男子，看轻女性。指轻视妇女的封建思想。
meaning_en: to value males and attach less importance to females (idiom)

meaning_cn: 舌如剑，唇象枪。形容辩论激烈，言词锋利，象枪剑交锋一样。
meaning_en: (idiom) to cross verbal swords; to have a heated verbal exchange

meaning_cn: 家庭破产，人口死亡。形容家遭不幸的惨相。
meaning_en: family bankrupt and the people dead (idiom); ruined and orphaned; destitute and homeless

meaning_cn: 指行走不稳，身不由主。也形容物体倾斜不正。
meaning_en: to lean unsteadily from side to side (idiom); to sway; (of buildings etc) to lean at a crazy angle

meaning_cn: 行色出发前后的神态。行走或出发前后的神态举止急急忙忙的样子。
meaning_en: hurried; in a haste

meaning_cn: 十分完美，毫无欠缺。
meaning_en: complete and beautiful; to be perfect (idiom)

meaning_cn: 包罗包括；万象宇宙间的一切景象，指各种事物。形容内容丰富，应有尽有。
meaning_en: all-embracing; all-inclusive

meaning_cn: 获获取，得到。自己不劳动却占有别人的劳动成果。
meaning_en: (idiom) to reap without sowing; to get sth without working for it; to sponge off others

meaning_cn: 感感想；交同时发生。各种感触交织在一起。形容感触很多，心情复杂。
meaning_en: all sorts of feelings well up in one's heart

meaning_cn: 通往来。拿出自己多余的东西给对方主，与之进行交换，以得到自己所缺少的东西。
meaning_en: (idiom) mutual exchange of assistance; to benefit from each other's strengths and make up each other's shortfalls; to reciprocate with material assistance; to scratch each other's back

meaning_cn: 泰平安，安定。国家太平，人民安乐。
meaning_en: the country prospers, the people at peace (idiom); peace and prosperity

meaning_cn: 身穿西装，脚穿皮鞋。形容衣着入时。
meaning_en: dressed in Western-style clothes; impeccably attired

meaning_cn: 一百年也碰不到一次。形容很少见到过或少有的机会。
meaning_en: only met with once every hundred years (drought, flood etc)

meaning_cn: 扶帮助；济搭救，拯救。扶助有危难的人，救济困苦的人。
meaning_en: to help those in distress (idiom)

meaning_cn: 一点儿也不动。形容没有丝毫改变。
meaning_en: to not move a single jot (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指行走困难行动不方便。
meaning_en: to have difficulty walking (idiom); to walk with difficulty

meaning_cn: 付给；之它；炬火把。一把火给烧了。
meaning_en: to put to the torch (idiom); to commit to the flames; to burn sth down deliberately

meaning_cn: 众望众人的希望；归归向。大家一致期望的。指得到群众的信任。
meaning_en: (idiom) to enjoy popular support; to receive general approval

meaning_cn: 形容十分彻底，一点儿也不剩。
meaning_en: thoroughly (idiom); completely; one and all; very clean

meaning_cn: 指不顾而去。
meaning_en: to avoid a problem by walking away from it; to quit

meaning_cn: 红指结婚做寿，白指丧事，并到一起说就是红白喜事。
meaning_en: weddings and funerals

meaning_cn: 同仇共同对敌；敌对抗，抵拒；忾愤怒。指全体一致痛恨敌人。
meaning_en: anger against a common enemy (idiom); joined in opposition to the same adversary

meaning_cn: 滥过多，不加节制。写文章或做东西马虎草率，只求数量，不顾质量。
meaning_en: to churn out large quantities without regard for quality (idiom); rough and slipshod work

meaning_cn: 崇高；峻山高而陡。高大险峻的山岭。
meaning_en: towering mountains and precipitous ridges (idiom)

meaning_cn: 回味指吃过东西以后的余味。比喻回想某一事物，越想越觉得有意思。
meaning_en: to have a rich aftertaste; (fig.) memorable; to linger in one's memory

meaning_cn: 不合乎人的常情。也指性情或言行怪僻。
meaning_en: (idiom) not amenable to reason; unreasonable

meaning_cn: 表面上表示尊敬，实际上不愿接近。也用作不愿接近某人的讽刺话。
meaning_en: to show respect from a distance (idiom); to remain at a respectful distance

meaning_cn: 形容心情平静，行动从容。
meaning_en: (idiom) to take one's time; unhurried; leisurely

meaning_cn: 砺奋勉；图设法；治治理好国家。振奋精神，想办法治理好国家。
meaning_en: (of a ruler) to strive to make one's nation strong and prosperous (idiom)

meaning_cn: 知道法律，又违反法律。指明知故犯。
meaning_en: to know the law and break it (idiom); consciously going against the rules

meaning_cn: 把黑的说成白的，白的说成黑的。比喻歪曲事实，混淆是非。
meaning_en: lit. to invert black and white (idiom); to distort the truth deliberately; to misrepresent the facts; to invert right and wrong

meaning_cn: 庭院子；若象；市集市。门前和院子里人很多，象市场一样。原形容进谏的人很多。现形容来的人很多，非常热闹。
meaning_en: front yard as busy as a marketplace (idiom); a place with many visitors

meaning_cn: 俱都。斗争双方都受到损伤，谁也没得到好处。
meaning_en: both sides suffer (idiom); neither side wins

meaning_cn: 逸安乐、休息。工作与休息相结合。
meaning_en: to strike a balance between work and rest (idiom)

meaning_cn: 来潮潮水上涨。指心里突然或偶然起了一个念头。
meaning_en: to be prompted by a sudden impulse; carried away by a whim; to have a brainstorm

meaning_cn: 保持自己纯洁，不同流合污。也指怕招惹是非，只顾自己好，不关心公众事情。
meaning_en: clean-living and honest (idiom); to avoid immorality; to shun evil influence; to mind one's own business and keep out of trouble; to keep one's hands clean

meaning_cn: 形容热闹至极。
meaning_en: a magnificent and unprecedented event (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指绝大多数，大致不差，差不离。
meaning_en: most likely; mostly (in 8 or 9 cases out of 10); vast majority

meaning_cn: 比喻暗中玩弄手法，以假代真，以劣代优。
meaning_en: lit. to steal a rafter and replace it with a column; to replace the original with a fake; to perpetrate a fraud (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指面容污秽。
meaning_en: head and face filthy with grime (idiom); covered in dirt; dejected and depressed

meaning_cn: 偃仰卧，引伸为倒下。放倒旗子，停止敲鼓。原指行军时隐蔽行踪，不让敌人觉察。现比喻事情终止或声势减弱。
meaning_en: lit. lay down the flag and still the drums (idiom); fig. to cease; to give in

meaning_cn: 获擒获俘虏，夺取敌方辎重；全完全。形容获得完全的胜利。
meaning_en: to seize total victory (idiom); an overwhelming victory; to win by a landslide (in election)

meaning_cn: 株露出地面的树根。原比喻希图不经过努力而得到成功的侥幸心理。现也比喻死守狭隘经验，不知变通。
meaning_en: lit. to guard a tree-stump, waiting for rabbits (idiom); to wait idly for opportunities; to trust to chance rather than show initiative

meaning_cn: 整个军队全部被消灭。比喻事情彻底失败。
meaning_en: total defeat of an army (idiom); fig. a complete wipeout

meaning_cn: 浮想飘浮不定的想象；联翩鸟飞的样子，比喻连续不断。指许许多多的想象不断涌现出来。
meaning_en: to let one's imagination roam

meaning_cn: 慷慨情绪激动；激昂振奋昂扬。精神振奋，情绪激昂，充满正气。
meaning_en: impassioned; vehement

meaning_cn: 安安置；落户指定居。到一个新地方安家，长期居住。
meaning_en: to make one's home in a place; to settle

meaning_cn: 象形体和它的影子那样分不开。形容彼此关系亲密，经常在一起。
meaning_en: inseparable (as form and shadow)

meaning_cn: 湖的风光，山的景色。指有水有山，风景秀丽。
meaning_en: scenic lakes and mountain (idiom); beautiful lake and mountain landscape

meaning_cn: 问心问问自己。扪心自问，毫无愧色。
meaning_en: lit. look into one's heart, no shame (idiom); with a clear conscience

meaning_cn: 长年整年；累月很多个月。形容经过了很多年月。
meaning_en: year in, year out (idiom); (over) many years

meaning_cn: 形容冬末春初气侯忽冷忽热，冷热不定。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of early spring weather) alternating between warm and cold

meaning_cn: 没有必要而插手管别人的事。
meaning_en: meddling in other people's business

meaning_cn: 继继承。有后人继承前人的事业。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have qualified successors to carry on one's undertaking

meaning_cn: 踌躇从容自得的样子；满满足；志志愿。形容对自己取得的成就非常得意。
meaning_en: enormously proud of one's success (idiom); smug; complacent

meaning_cn: 背水背向水，表示没有退路。比喻与敌人决一死战。
meaning_en: lit. fight with one's back to the river (idiom); fig. to fight to win or die

meaning_cn: 形容距离遥远的不同地区。亦形容（谈话）漫无边际。
meaning_en: see 天南地北[tian1 nan2 di4 bei3]

meaning_cn: 原指花草树木鲜艳多彩；形容颜色鲜明多彩。
meaning_en: brightly colored; gaudy

meaning_cn: 道说；破揭穿。一句话就说穿了。
meaning_en: one word says it all (idiom); to hit the nail on the head; to be pithy and correct

meaning_cn: 拨治理；乱指乱世；反通返”，回复。消除混乱局面，恢复正常秩序。
meaning_en: bring order out of chaos; set to rights things which have been thrown into disorder

meaning_cn: 经营筹划，管理。用尽心思去筹划安排。
meaning_en: to build up an enterprise through painstaking efforts

meaning_cn: 原形容年老视力差，看东西凝，后也比喻看事情不真切。
meaning_en: lit. to look at flowers in the fog (idiom); fig. blurred vision

meaning_cn: 理直气壮的样子。形容自以为理由很充分，说个不休。
meaning_en: to speak forcefully and with justice (idiom); to argue with the courage of one's convictions

meaning_cn: 一边说一边哭。形容极其悲恸。
meaning_en: to shed tears while recounting sth; speaking in a tearful voice

meaning_cn: 指特别擅长的技能。
meaning_en: (idiom) one's forte

meaning_cn: 辞告辞；别离别。没有告辞就离开了。或悄悄溜走了。
meaning_en: to leave without saying good-bye

meaning_cn: 敷衍马虎，不认真，表面上应付；塞责搪塞责任。指工作不认真负责，表面应付了事。
meaning_en: (idiom) to skimp on the job; to work half-heartedly; not to take the job seriously

meaning_cn: 蹶栽跟头；振振作。一跌倒就再也爬不起来。比喻遭受一次挫折以后就再也振作不起来。
meaning_en: one stumble, unable to rise (idiom); a setback leading to total collapse; ruined at a stroke; unable to recover after a minor hitch

meaning_cn: 听凭自然的发展，不加领导或过问。
meaning_en: to let sb do whatever they want; to indulge; to give free reins to; to let things slide; to drift aimlessly; laissez-faire

meaning_cn: 只一个。一个字也不谈起。比喻有意不说。
meaning_en: (idiom) to say not a single word about it

meaning_cn: 铁要趁烧红的时候打。比喻要抓紧有利的时机和条件去做。
meaning_en: to strike while the iron is hot

meaning_cn: 悲痛得不想活下去。形容悲痛到极点。
meaning_en: to be so in pain as to not want to live; to be so grieved as to wish one were dead

meaning_cn: 和风习习，阳光灿烂。形容晴朗暖和的天气。
meaning_en: moderate wind, beautiful sun (idiom); fine sunny weather, esp. in springtime

meaning_cn: 指我国长城。也比喻国家所依赖的大将。现也比喻人民的军队。
meaning_en: the Great Wall

meaning_cn: 周环绕一圈；复又，再。转了一圈又一圈，不断循环。
meaning_en: lit. the cycle comes back to the start (idiom); to move in circles; the wheel comes full circle

meaning_cn: 一直往前，无所阻挡。形容勇猛无畏地前进。
meaning_en: to advance courageously (idiom); to press forward

meaning_cn: 乘趁着。趁着胜利的形势继续追击敌人，扩大战果。
meaning_en: to follow up a victory and press home the attack; to pursue retreating enemy

meaning_cn: 原是江浙一带的方言。指装模作样，活象真有那么一回事似的。多指大模大样，好象很了不起的样子。
meaning_en: to make a show of being very much in earnest (idiom); to act as if one is taking things very seriously

meaning_cn: 温文态度温和，有礼貌；尔雅文雅。形容人态度温和，举动斯文。现有时也指缺乏斗争性，做事不大胆泼辣，没有闯劲。
meaning_en: cultured and refined (idiom); gentle and cultivated

meaning_cn: 多指国内不安定和外敌侵略。有时也比喻个人的情况。
meaning_en: internal trouble and outside aggression (idiom); in a mess both domestically and abroad

meaning_cn: 制造铜锣时最后一锤决定锣的音色。借指凭一句话作出最后决定。
meaning_en: lit. to fix the tone with a single hammer blow; fig. to make the final decision

meaning_cn: 操做，从事。处理事情，解决问题过于急躁。
meaning_en: to act with undue haste (idiom); eager and impatient; overhasty

meaning_cn: 澎湃波涛冲击的声音。心里象浪潮翻腾。形容心情十分激动，不能平静。
meaning_en: to be overwhelmed by emotions

meaning_cn: 形容一次又一次。也形容来回翻动身体。
meaning_en: to toss and turn (sleeplessly); again and again

meaning_cn: 斤斤形容明察，引伸为琐碎细小。只对无关紧要的事过分计较。
meaning_en: to haggle over every ounce; (fig.) to fuss over minor matters; to split hairs

meaning_cn: 积劳长期劳累过度；疾病。因长期工作，劳累过度而生了病。
meaning_en: to accumulate work causes sickness (idiom); to fall ill from constant overwork

meaning_cn: 象蜜糖一样甜的话。比喻为了骗人而说得动听的话。
meaning_en: (idiom) sweet words; sweet talk; cajolery

meaning_cn: 漠冷淡。态度冷淡，毫不关心。
meaning_en: not the least bit concerned; completely indifferent

meaning_cn: 疾快。大声呼喊，引起人们注意。
meaning_en: to call loudly (idiom); to get people's attention; to make one's views known

meaning_cn: 章条理。乱七八糟，没有条理。
meaning_en: disordered and in a mess (idiom); all mixed up and chaotic

meaning_cn: 振作起来，紧紧赶上去。
meaning_en: to catch up vigorously; to set off in hot pursuit

meaning_cn: 头顶云天，脚踏大地。形容形象高大，气慨豪迈。
meaning_en: lit. able to support both heaven and earth; of indomitable spirit (idiom)

meaning_cn: 鸣鸟叫。一叫就使人震惊。比喻平时没有突出的表现，一下子做出惊人的成绩。
meaning_en: to amaze the world with a single brilliant feat (idiom); an overnight celebrity

meaning_cn: 比喻力量分散，没有组织起来。
meaning_en: lit. like a sheet of loose sand; fig. unable to cooperate (idiom)

meaning_cn: 道、途路。路上听来的、路上传播的话。泛指没有根据的传闻。
meaning_en: gossip; hearsay; rumor

meaning_cn: 指对人不照料。也指举动莽撞，不顾别人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to pay scant regard to (sth); (idiom) unheeding; reckless

meaning_cn: 说的和做的完全一个样。
meaning_en: (idiom) one's actions are in keeping with what one says

meaning_cn: 美美好。指做一件事顾全到双方，使两方面都得到好处。
meaning_en: to satisfy rival demands (idiom); to get the best of both worlds; to have it both ways; to have one's cake and eat it too

meaning_cn: 以拿，把；讹谬误。指把本来就不正确的话又错误地传出去，越传越错。
meaning_en: to spread falsehoods; to increasingly distort the truth; to pile errors on top of errors (idiom)

meaning_cn: 正确还是不正确，有理还是无理。
meaning_en: lit. right and wrong, crooked and straight (idiom); fig. merits and demerits; pros and cons

meaning_cn: 比喻考虑问题时从主观愿望出发，只从好的方面着想打算。
meaning_en: counting one's chickens before they are hatched

meaning_cn: 兴、作引起。原指神话小说中妖魔鬼怪施展法术掀起风浪◇多比喻煽动情绪，挑起事端。
meaning_en: to incite trouble; to stir up havoc

meaning_cn: 一辈子。
meaning_en: a whole lifetime (idiom); all my life

meaning_cn: 狂风吹，烈日晒。形容无所遮挡。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be exposed to the elements

meaning_cn: 原指佛教徒修行时，排除物欲，保持心地洁净。现泛指丝毫不受坏习惯，坏风气的影响。也用来形容非常清洁、干净。
meaning_en: (idiom) untainted by even a speck of dust; spotlessly clean; (of a person) honest; incorruptible

meaning_cn: 妄为胡搞，乱做×无顾忌地干坏事。
meaning_en: daring; presumptuous; daredevil

meaning_cn: 指各种学术流派的自由争论互相批评。也指不同意见的争论。百家，这种观点的人或各种学术派别。鸣，发表见解。
meaning_en: a hundred schools of thought contend (idiom); refers to the classical philosophic schools of the Warring States period 475-221 BC

meaning_cn: 亏欠缺；篑盛土的筐子。堆九仞高的山，只缺一筐土而不能完成。比喻作事情只差最后一点没能完成。
meaning_en: lit. to ruin the enterprise for the sake of one basketful; to fail through lack of a final effort; to spoil the ship for a ha'penny worth of tar (idiom)

meaning_cn: 起因和结果。泛指事情的整个过程。
meaning_en: cause and effects (idiom); entire process of development

meaning_cn: 置放，立；可行；否不行。不说行，也不说不行。指不表明态度。
meaning_en: decline to comment; not express an opinion; be noncommittal; hedge

meaning_cn: 富丽华丽；堂皇盛大，雄伟。形容房屋宏伟豪华。也形容诗文词藻华丽。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of houses etc) sumptuous

meaning_cn: 致尽，极；志意志。把心思全放在上面。形容一心一意，聚精会神。
meaning_en: (idiom) single-minded; fully focused

meaning_cn: 轻轻率；妄任意。指不经慎重考虑，轻率地采取行动。
meaning_en: to act blindly without thinking (idiom)

meaning_cn: 丝、毫十丝为一毫，十毫为一厘。一点点儿，极小或极少。
meaning_en: one thread, one hair (idiom); a tiny bit; an iota

meaning_cn: 顾了这个，丢了那个。形容忙乱或慌张的情景。
meaning_en: lit. to attend to one thing and lose sight of another (idiom); fig. to be unable to manage two or more things at once; cannot pay attention to one thing without neglecting the other

meaning_cn: 对事情毫无补益。
meaning_en: unhelpful; useless

meaning_cn: 粉、墨搽脸和画眉用的化妆品。原指演员化妆上台演戏。比喻坏人经过一番打扮，登上政治舞台。
meaning_en: to make up and go on stage (idiom); to embark on a career (esp. in politics or crime)

meaning_cn: 形容变化极多。
meaning_en: countless changes; constant permutation

meaning_cn: 重新看到了天和太阳。比喻脱离黑暗，重见光明。
meaning_en: to see the light again (idiom); delivered from oppression

meaning_cn: 旧指不顾国法和天理，任意干坏事。现多形容违法乱纪，不受管束。
meaning_en: (idiom) defiant of the law and lacking any sense of morality; lawless; out of control; unruly

meaning_cn: 强调错误到极点。
meaning_en: to be gravely mistaken (idiom)

meaning_cn: 收收成。连一粒米也没收获到。多指因灾祸造成绝收。
meaning_en: not a single grain was reaped (as in a bad harvest year)

meaning_cn: 不把它放在心上。表示对人、对事抱轻视态度。
meaning_en: not to mind; unconcerned

meaning_cn: 坐着也不是，站着也不是。形容心情紧张，情绪不安。
meaning_en: lit. agitated sitting or standing (idiom); restless; fidgety

meaning_cn: 原指铺张修饰、内容空泛的言语或文辞◇多指用来骗人的虚伪动听的话。
meaning_en: graceful words, flowery speech (idiom); elegant but insincere words; cheating wheedling; dishonest rhetoric

meaning_cn: 战通颤”，发抖。形容十分害怕。
meaning_en: lit. heart alarmed, trembling in fear (idiom); prostrate with fear; scared witless

meaning_cn: 均平；敌相当。双方力量相等，不分高低。
meaning_en: (idiom) evenly matched

meaning_cn: 上气不接下气，狼狈不堪。形容十分荒张或恼怒。
meaning_en: flustered and exasperated; utterly discomfited

meaning_cn: 比喻说话办事留下可以回旋的地方。
meaning_en: to leave some leeway; to allow for the unpredictable

meaning_cn: 标提出，写明；异不同的，特别的。提出新奇的主张，表示与众不同。
meaning_en: to make a show of being original or unconventional (idiom)

meaning_cn: 步古时以五尺为一步，步步”表示距离短。军队每向前推进一步就设下一首营垒。形容防守严密，行动谨慎。
meaning_en: to advance gradually and entrench oneself at every step; to consolidate at every step

meaning_cn: 重程度深；返回转。经过长时间形成的思想作风或习惯，很难改变。
meaning_en: ingrained habits are hard to overcome (idiom); bad old practices die hard

meaning_cn: 喃喃连续不断地小声说话。小声地自己跟自己说话。
meaning_en: to mumble to oneself

meaning_cn: 比喻浮夸或不切实际，敷衍塞责的做法。
meaning_en: superficial show; going through the motions

meaning_cn: 游览、玩赏山水景物。
meaning_en: to go on a scenic tour

meaning_cn: 暴糟蹋、损害；弃鄙弃。自己瞧不起自己，甘于落后或堕落。
meaning_en: to abandon oneself to despair; to give up and stop bothering

meaning_cn: 有愿望和打算，但没有力量付诸实现。
meaning_en: (idiom) to want to do sth but be unable to; willing but unable

meaning_cn: 心心愿，愿望。得不到群众的支持拥护；得不到众人的好评。
meaning_en: not to enjoy popular support; to be unpopular

meaning_cn: 囤、居积聚；奇稀少的物品。把稀少的货物储藏起来。指商人囤积大量商品，等待高价出卖，牟取暴利。
meaning_en: to hoard and profiteer; to speculate

meaning_cn: 知道得不全面，理解得也不透彻。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have a superficial knowledge of a subject; to know a smattering of sth

meaning_cn: 形容色彩华丽。
meaning_en: (idiom) bright and colorful; gorgeous; magnificent

meaning_cn: 明明知道不能做，却故意违犯。
meaning_en: deliberate violation (idiom); intentional crime

meaning_cn: 锦有文彩的丝织品；簇丛聚。形容五彩缤纷，十分鲜艳多彩的景象。也形容文章辞藻华丽。
meaning_en: brightly colored decorations (idiom); splendid

meaning_cn: 指情意十分真切。
meaning_en: (idiom) sincere; heartfelt

meaning_cn: 灵灵验。非常灵验、能起死回生的奇药。比喻幻想中的某种能解决一切问题的有效方法。
meaning_en: effective cure, miracle medicine (idiom); fig. wonder-cure for all problems; panacea; elixir

meaning_cn: 悚然害怕的样子」毛竖起，脊梁骨发冷。形容十分恐惧。
meaning_en: to have one's hair stand on end (idiom); to feel one's blood run cold

meaning_cn: 副相称，符合。名声或名义和实际不相符。指空有虚名。
meaning_en: the name does not reflect the reality (idiom); more in name than in fact; Reality does not live up to the name.; Excellent theory, but the practice does not bear it out.

meaning_cn: 浑然混同在一起的样子。融合成一个整体，不可分割。也形容文章绘画，布置匀整，结构谨严。
meaning_en: to blend into one another; to blend together well

meaning_cn: 顾、盼看。向左右两边看。形容人骄傲得意的神情。
meaning_en: glancing to left and right (idiom); to look all around

meaning_cn: 形容非常高兴。
meaning_en: delighted; with great joy; in high spirits

meaning_cn: 形容着重或隆重的样子。
meaning_en: solemn; presentable; decent; Taiwan pr. [xiang4 mo2 xiang4 yang4]

meaning_cn: 象大海一样辽阔，象天空一样无边无际。形容大自然的广阔。比喻言谈议论等漫无边际，没有中心。
meaning_en: wide sea and sky (idiom); boundless open vistas; the whole wide world; chatting about everything under the sun

meaning_cn: 单独负责一个方面的工作。
meaning_en: to assume personal responsibility (idiom); to take charge of a section

meaning_cn: 形容担心灾祸临头，恐慌不安。
meaning_en: lit. heart alarmed, body leaping (idiom); fear and trepidation in the face of disaster

meaning_cn: 到处隐藏着危险的祸根。
meaning_en: danger lurks on every side (idiom)

meaning_cn: 炮制用烘、炒等针药材制成中药。本指按照一定的方法制作中药。现比喻照着现成的样子做。
meaning_en: lit. to follow the recipe (idiom); fig. to follow a set pattern

meaning_cn: 彬彬原意为文质兼备的样子，后形容文雅。形容文雅有礼貌的样子。
meaning_en: refined and courteous; urbane

meaning_cn: 异奇异；天开比喻凭空的、根本没有的事情。指想法很不切实际，非常奇怪。
meaning_en: (idiom) to imagine the wildest thing; to indulge in fantasy

meaning_cn: 不以千里为远。形容不怕路途遥远。
meaning_en: make light of traveling a thousand li; go to the trouble of traveling a long distance

meaning_cn: 师表榜样，表率。在人品学问方面作别人学习的榜样。
meaning_en: to serve as a model for others (idiom); to be a worthy teacher

meaning_cn: 弥留本指久病不愈，后多指病重将死；际时候。病危将死的时候。
meaning_en: on one's deathbed; at the point of death

meaning_cn: 好象太阳正在天顶。比喻事物正发展到十分兴盛的阶段。
meaning_en: lit. like the sun at noon (idiom); fig. to be at the peak of one's power, career etc

meaning_cn: 各种东西凡有可用之处，都要尽量利用。指充分利用资源，一点不浪费。
meaning_en: to use sth to the full; to make the best use of everything

meaning_cn: 一句话就说中要害。同一语破的”。
meaning_en: (idiom) to hit the mark with a comment; to say sth spot on

meaning_cn: 快痛快。指坏人坏事受到惩罚或打击，使大家非常痛快。
meaning_en: to the satisfaction of everyone

meaning_cn: 屡次试验都不错。
meaning_en: well-tried; time-tested

meaning_cn: 脸笔耳朵都红了。形容因激动或羞惭而脸色发红。
meaning_en: flushed with anger (or excitement)

meaning_cn: 迥然相距很远或差别很大的样子。形容相差得远，很明显不一样。
meaning_en: widely different; utterly different

meaning_cn: 隐藏在内心深处不便说出口的原因或事情。
meaning_en: a hidden trouble hard to mention (idiom); sth too embarrassing to mention; an embarrassing illness

meaning_cn: 泾河水清，渭河水浑，泾河的水流入渭河时，清浊不混。比喻界限清楚或是非分明。
meaning_en: as rivers Jing and Wei separate clearly (idiom); to be entirely different

meaning_cn: 华开花。花开得好看，但不结果实。比喻外表好看，内容空虚。
meaning_en: flower but no fruit (idiom); handsome exterior but hollow inside; flashy

meaning_cn: 扣敲打。形容事物激动人心。
meaning_en: to excite; to thrill; exciting; thrilling; cliff-hanging

meaning_cn: 表示原来的希望完全落空。
meaning_en: greatly disappointed

meaning_cn: 不能告诉别人。指见不得人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be kept secret; not to be divulged

meaning_cn: 驾赶马车。驾轻车，走熟路。比喻对某事有经验，很熟悉，做起来容易。
meaning_en: lit. an easy drive on a familiar path (idiom); fig. experience makes progress easy; a task that is so familiar one can do it with one's hand tied behind one's back

meaning_cn: 领、会领悟，理解。指对方没有明说，心里已经领会。
meaning_en: to understand tacitly (idiom); to know intuitively; to understand thoroughly

meaning_cn: 不是你死，就是我活。形容双方斗争非常激烈。
meaning_en: lit. you die, I live (idiom); irreconcilable adversaries; two parties cannot coexist

meaning_cn: 一条衣带那样狭窄的水。指虽有江河湖海相隔，但距离不远，不足以成为交往的阻碍。
meaning_en: (separated only by) a narrow strip of water

meaning_cn: 恋恋爱慕，留恋。原形容极其爱慕，不能丢开。现多形容非常留恋，舍不得离开。
meaning_en: reluctant to part

meaning_cn: 浑身受伤，伤痕象鱼鳞一样密。形容受伤很重。
meaning_en: (idiom) covered all over with cuts and bruises; beaten black and blue

meaning_cn: 指时而冷静，时而感情冲动，情绪不稳定。
meaning_en: now hot, now cold; (of one's mood, affection etc) to alternate

meaning_cn: 奕奕精神焕发的样子。形容精神饱满，容光焕发。
meaning_en: in glowing spirits (idiom); bursting with life; radiating health and vigor

meaning_cn: 翻倒，反转。把箱子柜子都翻倒过来。形容彻底翻检。
meaning_en: to overturn trunks and boxes; to make a thorough search (idiom)

meaning_cn: 利落灵活敏捷，也指整齐，有条理。形容没有多余的东西。令人爽心悦目。也形容动作熟练、敏捷准确。
meaning_en: squeaky clean; neat and tidy; efficient

meaning_cn: 行事专断，不考虑别人的意见。形容作风不民主。
meaning_en: to decide and act alone (idiom); to take arbitrary action; a law unto oneself

meaning_cn: 处心存心；积虑经过长时间的老虎。形容蓄谋已久。
meaning_en: to plot actively (idiom); scheming; calculating

meaning_cn: 指批评恰到事物的紧要处。
meaning_en: to hit the target and do real damage (idiom); fig. to hit where it hurts; fig. to hit home; an argument that hits the nail on the head

meaning_cn: 质朴实在而不浮华。
meaning_en: (idiom) simple; plain; unadorned

meaning_cn: 和蔼和善。态度温和，容易接近。
meaning_en: affable; genial

meaning_cn: 地方大，人烟少。
meaning_en: vast, but sparsely populated

meaning_cn: 后悔事后的懊悔。指事后的懊悔也来不及了。
meaning_en: too late for regrets (idiom); It is useless to repent after the event.

meaning_cn: 乘趁。趁着虚弱疏漏的地方进入。
meaning_en: to enter by exploiting a weak spot (idiom); to take advantage of a lapse

meaning_cn: 形容不完整，不集中，不团结，不统一。
meaning_en: (idiom) fragmented; scattered; in disarray; at sixes and sevens

meaning_cn: 英姿英勇威武的姿态；飒爽豪迈矫健。形容英俊威武、精神焕发的样子。
meaning_en: (of a person) valiant and formidable-looking; to carry oneself tall

meaning_cn: 莫不；及赶上。望见前面骑马的人走过扬起的尘土而不能赶上。比喻远远落在后面。
meaning_en: lit. to see only the other rider's dust and have no hope of catching up (idiom); to be far inferior

meaning_cn: 比喻由于偶然的因素而造成了差错。
meaning_en: (idiom) due to an unexpected turn of events

meaning_cn: 其代词，对方；不意没有料到。趁对方没有意料到就采取行动。
meaning_en: to do sth when least expected (idiom); to catch sb off guard

meaning_cn: 头大如虎，尾细如蛇。比喻开始时声势很大，到后来劲头很小，有始无终。
meaning_en: lit. tiger's head, snake's tail (idiom); fig. a strong start but weak finish

meaning_cn: 指蜻蜓在水面飞行时用尾部轻触水面的动作。比喻做事肤浅不深入。
meaning_en: lit. the dragonfly touches the water lightly; superficial contact (idiom)

meaning_cn: 丝得一根一根地抽，茧得一层一层地剥。形容分析事物极为细致，而且一步一步很有层次。
meaning_en: (lit.) to unwind the silk thread from the cocoon (idiom); (fig.) to unravel a mystery; to painstakingly follow the clues to eventually get to the bottom of the matter

meaning_cn: 崩倒塌；析分开。崩塌解体，四分五裂。形容国家或集团分裂瓦解。
meaning_en: to collapse and fall apart (idiom); to break up; falling to pieces

meaning_cn: 悖违背，冲突。同时进行，不相冲突。
meaning_en: to run in parallel without hindrance; not mutually exclusive; two processes can be implemented without conflict

meaning_cn: 指有重大的消息时，人们奔跑着相互转告。
meaning_en: to spread the news (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容证据确凿，象山一样不能动摇。
meaning_en: irrefutable evidence

meaning_cn: 按照身材裁剪衣服。比喻按照实际情况办事。
meaning_en: (lit.) to cut cloth according to the body (idiom); (fig.) to act according to actual circumstances

meaning_cn: 指疯狂地轰炸。
meaning_en: to bomb indiscriminately

meaning_cn: 本指蔺相如将和氏璧完好地自秦送回赵国◇比喻把原物完好地归还本人。
meaning_en: lit. to return the jade annulus to Zhao (idiom); fig. to return something intact to its rightful owner

meaning_cn: 没有什么可以告诉对方的。
meaning_en: (idiom) no comment

meaning_cn: 兼施同时施展。软的和硬的手段都用上了。
meaning_en: use both carrot and stick; use gentle methods and force; an iron hand in a velvet glove

meaning_cn: 意思是天道公平，作恶就要受惩罚，它看起来似乎很不周密，但最终不会放过一个坏人。比喻作恶的人逃脱不了国法的惩处。
meaning_en: loose, but allows no escape (idiom, from Laozi 老子[Lao3 zi3]); the way of Heaven is fair, but the guilty will not escape

meaning_cn: 闷闷心情不舒畅，心烦。形容心事放不下，心里不快活。
meaning_en: depressed; sulky; moody; unhappy

meaning_cn: 智智谋。紧急的时候，猛然想出办法。
meaning_en: quick witted in an emergency; able to react resourcefully

meaning_cn: 监守监管；盗偷窃。窃取公务上自己看管的财物。
meaning_en: to embezzle

meaning_cn: 心心意，思想感情；印符合。彼此的心意不用说出，就可以互相了解。形容彼此思想感情完全一致。
meaning_en: two hearts beat as one (idiom); a kindred spirit

meaning_cn: 杰杰出；灵好。指有杰出的人降生或到过，其地也就成了名胜之区。
meaning_en: illustrious hero, spirit of the place (idiom); a place derives reflected glory from an illustrious son

meaning_cn: 由听从。身体不由自己作主。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of one's circumstances) beyond one's control; unable to do anything about it; (of one's actions) not subject to conscious control (i.e. done in spite of oneself)

meaning_cn: 佛教指人的四苦，即出生、衰老、生病、死亡。今泛指生活中生育、养老、医疗、殡葬。
meaning_en: (lit.) to be born, to grow old, to get sick and to die (idiom); (fig.) the fate of humankind (i.e. mortality)

meaning_cn: 捷报胜利的消息；频屡次。胜利的消息不断地传来。
meaning_en: victory reports pour in (idiom); news of success in an endless stream

meaning_cn: 粗粗蔬。指做事马虎，不细心。
meaning_en: negligent; careless; inadvertent

meaning_cn: 开宗阐发宗旨；明义说明意思。指说话、写文章一开始就讲明主要意思。
meaning_en: to declare at the outset (idiom)

meaning_cn: 像用瓢泼水那样的大雨。形容雨下得非常大的样子。
meaning_en: downpour (idiom)

meaning_cn: 使人内心深深感动。
meaning_en: (idiom) deeply touching

meaning_cn: 任任用；唯只；亲关系密切。指用人不问人的德才，只选跟自己关系亲密的人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to practice nepotism or cronyism in making appointments

meaning_cn: 惴忧愁、恐惧。形容因害怕或担心而不安。
meaning_en: to be on tenterhooks (idiom); to be anxious and frightened
