meaning_cn: 沁渗入。原指芳香凉爽的空气或饮料使人感到舒适。也形容诗歌和文章优美动人，给人清新爽朗的感觉。
meaning_en: (lit.) to penetrate deeply into the heart (idiom); (fig.) to gladden the heart; to be refreshing

meaning_cn: 指有这个意思，但没有在话里明说出来。
meaning_en: (idiom) unspoken implication; the actual meaning of what was said

meaning_cn: 昏昏沉沉，只想睡觉。形容极其疲劳或精神不振。
meaning_en: drowsy; sleepy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 采兴致。形容精神不振，提不起劲头。
meaning_en: dispirited and downcast (idiom); listless; in low spirits; washed out

meaning_cn: 事由变化，在预料之中。形容原先预料的准确。
meaning_en: as expected

meaning_cn: 形容文章自然不受约束，就象漂浮着的云和流动着的水一样。
meaning_en: lit. moving clouds and flowing water (idiom); fig. very natural and flowing style of calligraphy, writing, etc; natural and unforced

meaning_cn: 穷指物质基础差；白指文化和科学落后。比喻基础差，底子薄。
meaning_en: impoverished; backward both economically and culturally

meaning_cn: 指高人一等。形容德才超众或成就突出。
meaning_en: to stand out among one's peers (idiom); to excel

meaning_cn: 切肤切身，亲身。亲身经受的痛苦。比喻感受深切。
meaning_en: keenly felt pain; bitter anguish

meaning_cn: 赤子初生的婴儿。比喻人心地纯洁善良。
meaning_en: pure and innocent like the heart of a newborn; sincere

meaning_cn: 功事业；告宣告。指巨大工程或重要任务宣告完成。
meaning_en: successfully accomplished (project or goal); to be highly successful

meaning_cn: 拍桌子叫好。形容非常赞赏。
meaning_en: lit. slap the table and shout with praise (idiom); fig. wonderful!; amazing!; great!

meaning_cn: 举全。指全国上上下下的人。
meaning_en: the entire nation; the whole country, from the leadership to the rank and file

meaning_cn: 且暂且。只要能够过得去，就这样过下去。形容胸无大志。
meaning_en: satisfied just to get through (idiom); to muddle through; without high ambitions, but getting by

meaning_cn: 趁乘机。趁人家失火时去抢劫。比喻乘人之危谋取私利。
meaning_en: (lit.) to loot a burning house (idiom); (fig.) to take advantage of sb's misfortune

meaning_cn: 乌烟黑烟；瘴气热带山林中的一种湿热空气，旧时认为是瘴疠的病原。比喻环境嘈杂、秩序混乱或社会黑暗。
meaning_en: (idiom) full of smoke and noxious fumes; (fig.) toxic atmosphere; chaotic environment

meaning_cn: 对同一个问题，不同的人从不同的立场或角度有不同的看法。
meaning_en: opinions differ (idiom)

meaning_cn: 寸步形容距离很近。原指夫妻和睦，一步也不离开。现在泛指两人感情好，总在一起。
meaning_en: to follow sb closely (idiom); to keep close to

meaning_cn: 形容景色柔和美好。
meaning_en: (idiom) idyllic scenery; picturesque landscape

meaning_cn: 碑指记功碑。所有人的嘴都是活的记功碑。比喻人人称赞。
meaning_en: every voice gives praise (idiom); with an extensive public reputation

meaning_cn: 原指各人都得到满足◇指每个人或事物都得到恰当的位置或安排。
meaning_en: (idiom) each in the correct place; each is provided for

meaning_cn: 既不是痛，也不是痒。原形容说不出的一种难受。现多比喻不触及实质，不切中要害，不解决问题。
meaning_en: lit. doesn't hurt, doesn't tickle (idiom); sth is wrong, but not quite sure what; fig. not getting to any matter of substance; scratching the surface; superficial; perfunctory

meaning_cn: 济济形容人多。形容很多有才能的人聚集在一起。
meaning_en: to congregate in one hall (idiom); to gather under one roof

meaning_cn: 去掉外饰，还其本质。比喻回复原来的自然状态。同返朴归真”。
meaning_en: to return to one's true self; to regain the natural state

meaning_cn: 不慌张，不忙乱。形容态度镇定，或办事稳重、踏实。
meaning_en: (idiom) calm; unhurried; composed

meaning_cn: 贪财图利的欲望迷住了心窍。
meaning_en: blinded by greed (idiom)

meaning_cn: 才华表现于外的才能。多指文学艺术方面而言，很有才华。
meaning_en: brimming over with talent (esp. literary); brilliant

meaning_cn: 既成已成。已经形成的事实。
meaning_en: fait accompli

meaning_cn: 比喻彼此地位或权力平等。
meaning_en: to be on an equal footing

meaning_cn: 形容心满意足，事情的发展完全符合心意。
meaning_en: (idiom) after one's own heart; gratifying; satisfactory; everything one could wish

meaning_cn: 千秋千年，引伸为久远。各有各的存在的价值。比喻各人有各人的长处，各人有各人的特色。
meaning_en: each has its own merits (idiom)

meaning_cn: 叱咤怒喝声。一声呼喊、怒喝，可以使风云翻腾起来。形容威力极大。
meaning_en: lit. to rebuke Heaven and Earth (idiom); fig. shaking the whole world; all-powerful

meaning_cn: 终最后，结局。不知道结局或下落。
meaning_en: (idiom) to vanish without a trace; to go missing

meaning_cn: 没有根据或没有道理地瞎说。
meaning_en: to talk rubbish

meaning_cn: 完全改变了平时的态度。
meaning_en: complete change from the normal state (idiom); quite uncharacteristic; entirely outside the norm; out of character

meaning_cn: 大雁飞过时也能拔下毛来。原形容武艺高超◇比喻人爱占便宜，见有好处就要乘机捞一把。
meaning_en: lit. to grab feathers from a flying goose; fig. to seize any opportunity; pragmatic

meaning_cn: 毅然顽强地；决然坚决地。意志坚决，毫不犹豫。
meaning_en: without hesitation; resolutely; firmly

meaning_cn: 遇见不公平的事，挺身而出，帮助受欺负的一方。
meaning_en: (idiom) to aid sb suffering an injustice; to fight for justice

meaning_cn: 指保养年寿。
meaning_en: lit. to nurture one's years (idiom); fig. to enjoy one's later years

meaning_cn: 心怦怦地跳动。
meaning_en: (idiom) to feel a rush of excitement

meaning_cn: 旧指神仙道士的法力。现比喻人具有支配自然的伟大力量。也可形容反动势力猖獗。
meaning_en: to call the wind and summon the rain (idiom); to exercise magical powers; fig. to stir up troubles

meaning_cn: 把人物的声音、神色都描绘出来了。形容叙述或描写生动逼真。
meaning_en: vivid and colorful (idiom); true to life; lively and realistic

meaning_cn: 适可恰好可以。到适当的程度就停下来，不要过头。
meaning_en: (idiom) to refrain from going too far; to know when to stop

meaning_cn: 漫随便。随随便便，不放在心上。
meaning_en: careless; heedless; absent-minded; indifferent

meaning_cn: 指吃苦耐劳、勤俭节约的作风。
meaning_en: leading a plain, hardworking life (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指看起来或听起来凝，不很清楚，感觉不很明显。
meaning_en: (idiom) vaguely; faintly; indistinctly

meaning_cn: 碧翠绿色。形容建筑物装饰华丽，光彩夺目。
meaning_en: gold and jade in glorious splendor (idiom); fig. a dazzling sight (e.g. royal palace)

meaning_cn: 睹看见。以能尽先看到为快乐。形容盼望殷切。
meaning_en: (idiom) to consider it a pleasure to be among the first to read (or watch or enjoy)

meaning_cn: 功功业。就达到。功绩取得了，名声也有了。
meaning_en: to win success and recognition (idiom)

meaning_cn: 风风声，消息。一听到风声，就立刻起来响应。
meaning_en: to respond instantly; to act at once on hearing the news

meaning_cn: 掩遮蔽，遮盖；盗偷。偷铃铛怕别人听见而捂住自己的耳朵。比喻自己欺骗自己，明明掩盖不住的事情偏要想法子掩盖。
meaning_en: lit. to cover one's ears whilst stealing a bell; to deceive oneself; to bury one's head in the sand (idiom)

meaning_cn: 徒只，仅仅。家里只有四面的墙壁。形容十分贫困，一无所有。
meaning_en: lit. with only four bare walls for a home (idiom); fig. very poor; wretched

meaning_cn: 好象老虎长上了翅膀。比喻强有力的人得到帮助变得更加强有力。
meaning_en: lit. like a tiger that has grown wings; with redoubled power (idiom)

meaning_cn: 连城连在一起的许多城池。形容物品十分贵重。
meaning_en: invaluable; priceless

meaning_cn: 儆使人警醒，不犯错误；效仿效，效法；尤过失。指处理一个坏人或一件坏事，用来警告那些学着做坏事的人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to warn against following bad examples; as a warning to others

meaning_cn: 不伦不同类。既非这一类，又非那一类，形容成样子或没有道理。
meaning_en: out of place; inappropriate; incongruous

meaning_cn: 身身分，地位；败毁坏；裂破损。地位丧失，名誉扫地。指做坏事而遭到彻底失败。
meaning_en: to lose one's standing; to have one's reputation swept away; a complete defeat and fall from grace

meaning_cn: 形容波光明净。波光阳光或月光照在水波上反射过来的光。粼粼形容水石明净。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of water) shimmering with ripples; glistening

meaning_cn: 身旁好象没有人。形容态度傲慢，不把别人放在眼里。
meaning_en: to act as though there were nobody else present; unselfconscious; fig. without regard for others

meaning_cn: 赶着装载很轻的车子走熟悉的路。比喻事情又熟悉又容易。
meaning_en: lit. to drive a lightweight chariot on a familiar road (idiom); fig. to do sth routinely and with ease; a walk in the park

meaning_cn: 节、缩节省。省吃省穿。形容节约。
meaning_en: to save on food and clothing (idiom); to live frugally

meaning_cn: 一句话也不说。
meaning_en: to keep silent

meaning_cn: 肝胆比喻真心诚意。比喻以真心相见。
meaning_en: to treat one another with absolute sincerity (idiom); to show total devotion

meaning_cn: 尽全部用出；竭用尽。用尽心思，使出全力。形容做事十分努力。
meaning_en: to spare no effort (idiom); to do one's utmost

meaning_cn: 懈松懈，引伸为漏洞、破绽。没有一点弱点可以让人攻击。形容十分严密，找不到一点漏洞。
meaning_en: (idiom) impossible to fault; impeccable

meaning_cn: 里手内行人。指精通这种业务的人。
meaning_en: connoisseur; expert

meaning_cn: 增加岁数，延长寿命。
meaning_en: (idiom) to prolong life; to extend lifespan

meaning_cn: 把事情说得超过原有的程度。
meaning_en: to exaggerate

meaning_cn: 本指身受重伤◇比喻事物受到重大损害。
meaning_en: to suffer serious injury (idiom)

meaning_cn: 跋山翻过山岭；涉水用脚趟着水渡过大河。翻山越岭，趟水过河。形容走远路的艰苦。
meaning_en: to travel over land and water (idiom)

meaning_cn: 仆倒下；继接着，跟上。前面的倒下了，后面的紧跟上去。形容斗争的英勇壮烈。
meaning_en: one falls, the next follows (idiom); stepping into the breach to replace fallen comrades; advancing wave upon wave

meaning_cn: 略掠夺。攻打城市，掠夺土地。
meaning_en: to take cities and seize territories (idiom)

meaning_cn: 负依靠；隅山势弯曲险阻的地方。凭借险阻，顽固抵抗。指依仗某种条件，顽固进行抵抗。
meaning_en: (idiom) to put up fierce resistance despite being surrounded; to stubbornly refuse to admit defeat

meaning_cn: 风和影子都是抓不着的。比喻说话做事丝毫没有事实根据。
meaning_en: lit. chasing the wind and clutching at shadows (idiom); fig. groundless accusations; to act on hearsay evidence

meaning_cn: 越跨过；俎古代祭祀时摆祭品的礼器；庖厨师。主祭的人跨过礼器去代替厨师办席。比喻超出自己业务范围去处理别人所管的事。
meaning_en: lit. to go beyond the sacrificial altar and take over the kitchen (idiom); fig. to exceed one's place and meddle in other people's affairs; to take matters into one's own hands

meaning_cn: 好喜欢、贪于。贪于吃喝，懒于做事。
meaning_en: happy to partake but not prepared to do any work (idiom); all take and no give

meaning_cn: 祸灾难。指不幸的事接二连三地发生。
meaning_en: misfortune does not come singly (idiom); it never rains but it pours

meaning_cn: 不能决定哪个是对的。形容意见分歧，没有一致的看法。
meaning_en: unable to reach a decision (idiom); cannot agree on the right choice; no unanimous decision; still a matter of discussion

meaning_cn: 拘、束限制、约束。形容自由自在，没有牵挂。
meaning_en: free and unconstrained (idiom); unfettered; unbuttoned; without care or worries

meaning_cn: 牢牢固。异常坚固，不可摧毁。也用在指人固执己见或保守旧习。
meaning_en: (idiom) (usu. of sth abstract: an alliance, a conviction etc) unbreakable; rock-solid

meaning_cn: 坚坚固，结实；磐大石头。象大石头一样坚固。比喻不可动摇。
meaning_en: solid as a boulder (idiom); absolutely secure; rock-firm and unyielding

meaning_cn: 云说；亦也。人家怎么说，自己也跟着怎么说。指没有主见，只会随声附和。
meaning_en: to say what everyone says (idiom); to conform to what one perceives to be the majority view; to follow the herd

meaning_cn: 悬崖高而陡的山崖；勒马收住缰绳，使马停步。在高高的山崖边上勒住马。比喻到了危险的边缘及时清醒回头。
meaning_en: lit. to rein in the horse at the edge of the precipice (idiom); fig. to act in the nick of time

meaning_cn: 雨后转晴。也比喻政治上由黑暗到光明。
meaning_en: sky clears after rain; new hopes after a disastrous period (idiom); every cloud has a silver lining (idiom); see also 雨過天青|雨过天青[yu3 guo4 tian1 qing1]

meaning_cn: 原指一旦中了科举就扬名天下◇指一下子就出了名。
meaning_en: (idiom) to become famous in one stroke; to shoot to fame (originally referred to passing the imperial examination)

meaning_cn: 变幻变化不可测度。变化很多，不能预料。
meaning_en: to change unpredictably; unpredictable; erratic; treacherous

meaning_cn: 与赞许，赞助；为做；善好事。指赞成人学好。现指善意帮助人。
meaning_en: to be of service to others; to help others; benevolent

meaning_cn: 激冲去；浊脏水；清清水。冲去污水，让清水上来。比喻清除坏的，发扬好的。
meaning_en: lit. drain away filth and bring in fresh water (idiom); fig. dispel evil and usher in good; eliminate vice and exalt virtue

meaning_cn: 光天最大的天，大白天；化日生长万物的太阳。原形容太平盛世◇比喻大家看得非常清楚的场合。
meaning_en: the full light of day (idiom); fig. peace and prosperity; in broad daylight

meaning_cn: 向归向，向往。指人民群众所拥护的，向往的。
meaning_en: that which is yearned for by the public

meaning_cn: 形容零散稀疏的样子。特指原来又多又整齐的东西现在零散了。
meaning_en: (idiom) everything broken and in disorder

meaning_cn: 桑田农田。大海变成桑田，桑田变成大海。比喻世事变化很大。
meaning_en: lit. the blue sea turned into mulberry fields (idiom); fig. the transformations of the world

meaning_cn: 又是刮风，又是下雨。比喻几种灾难同时袭来。
meaning_en: (idiom) wild and stormy; windy and wet

meaning_cn: 也称充血性心力衰竭或心功能不全。心脏因疾病、过劳、排血功能减弱，以至排血量不能满足器官及组织代谢的需要。主要症状是呼吸困难、喘息、水肿等。
meaning_en: heart failure

meaning_cn: 心、意心思；回、转掉转。重新考虑，改变原来的想法和态度。
meaning_en: to change one's mind (idiom)

meaning_cn: 畏恐惧，害怕。看见了就害怕。
meaning_en: (idiom) to feel intimidated

meaning_cn: 是对，正确。没有一点儿对的或好的地方。
meaning_en: (idiom) not one good point; everything about it is wrong

meaning_cn: 养育儿子是为了防备年老。亦泛指养育子女以防老年无依靠。
meaning_en: (of parents) to bring up children for the purpose of being looked after in old age

meaning_cn: 逊谦让，有礼貌。说话粗暴无礼。
meaning_en: to speak rudely

meaning_cn: 磊落心地光明坦白。胸怀坦白，正大光明。
meaning_en: open and candid (idiom); straightforward and upright

meaning_cn: 人寰人世。世界上再没有比这更惨痛的事。形容惨痛到了极点。
meaning_en: extremely tragic (idiom); with unprecedented brutality

meaning_cn: 乌有哪有，何有。变得什么都没有。指全部消失或完全落空。
meaning_en: (idiom) to go up in smoke; to vanish

meaning_cn: 家家点上了灯。指天黑上灯的时候。也形容城市夜晚的景象。
meaning_en: (of a city etc) ablaze with lights

meaning_cn: 比喻煽动别人闹事。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fan the flames; to incite people; to stir up trouble

meaning_cn: 挽挽回；狂澜猛烈的大波浪。比喻尽力挽回危险的局势。
meaning_en: to pull strongly against a crazy tide (idiom); fig. to try hard to save a desperate crisis

meaning_cn: 荡动摇；回回转。形容文章、乐曲十分婉转动人。
meaning_en: heart-rending (drama, music, poem etc); deeply moving

meaning_cn: 形容十分真挚诚恳。
meaning_en: earnestly and sincerely (idiom); with all sincerity

meaning_cn: 矫扭转；枉弯曲。把弯的东西扳正，又歪到了另一边。比喻纠正错误超过了应有的限度。
meaning_en: to overcorrect (idiom); to overcompensate

meaning_cn: 噪群鸣。一时名声很大。名声传扬于一个时期。
meaning_en: to achieve fame among one's contemporaries (idiom); temporary or local celebrity

meaning_cn: 苍白灰白。形容贫弱无力。
meaning_en: pale and feeble; powerless

meaning_cn: 形容关系密切，感情深厚。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of siblings, spouses etc) very close to each other; inseparable; devoted to each other

meaning_cn: ①形容人神志清爽，心情舒暢。②形容人长得神态清明，气质爽朗。
meaning_en: (idiom) full of vitality; relaxed and alert

meaning_cn: 连珠串珠。巧妙风趣的话一个接一个。
meaning_en: sparkling with wit (idiom)

meaning_cn: 姹、嫣娇艳。形容各种花朵娇艳美丽。
meaning_en: lit. beautiful purples and brilliant reds (idiom); fig. beautiful flowers

meaning_cn: 想说，但又不痛痛快快地说。形容说话有顾虑。
meaning_en: to hum and haw (idiom); to mumble as if hiding sth; to speak and break off, then start again; to hold sth back

meaning_cn: 识知道。见过的多，知道的广。形容阅历深，经验多。
meaning_en: (idiom) experienced and knowledgeable

meaning_cn: 临面临∶象面对着强大的敌人。形容把本来不是很紧迫的形势看得十分严重。
meaning_en: lit. as if meeting a great enemy (idiom); fig. cautious; with great preoccupation; with strict precaution

meaning_cn: 患祸患，灾难。事先有准备，就可以避免祸患。
meaning_en: Preparedness averts peril.; to be prepared, just in case (idiom)

meaning_cn: 废被废置的事情；待等待；兴兴办。许多被搁置的事情等着要兴办。
meaning_en: many things waiting to be done (idiom); a thousand things to do

meaning_cn: 雨大得象盆里的水直往下倒。形容雨大势急。
meaning_en: see 傾盆大雨|倾盆大雨[qing1 pen2 da4 yu3]

meaning_cn: 自己开辟一条路。比喻独创一种风格或新的方法。
meaning_en: to blaze a new trail (idiom); to display originality

meaning_cn: 指没有根据，不符实际的瞎说，或说胡话。
meaning_en: babbling nonsense (idiom); crazy and unfounded ravings; double Dutch

meaning_cn: 积累少量的东西，能成为巨大的数量。
meaning_en: (idiom) many little things add up to sth great; many little drops make an ocean

meaning_cn: 交一齐，同时；瘁疲劳。精神和体力都极度劳累。
meaning_en: to be both mentally and physically exhausted (idiom)

meaning_cn: 茅庐草房。原比喻新露头脚。现比喻刚离开家庭或学校出来工作。缺乏经验。
meaning_en: venturing from one's thatched hut for the first time (idiom); young and inexperienced; novice; greenhorn

meaning_cn: 形容待人处事随随便便，满不在乎。
meaning_en: (idiom) carefree; offhand; casual

meaning_cn: 形容诗文结构严密自然，用词运典毫无斧凿痕迹。亦形容人的才德完美自然。
meaning_en: to resemble nature itself; of the highest quality (idiom)

meaning_cn: 象牛身上的的毛那样多。形容极多。
meaning_en: (lit.) as numerous as the hairs of an ox (idiom); (fig.) innumerable; countless

meaning_cn: 心里急得像火烧一样。形容非常焦急。
meaning_en: see 心急如焚[xin1 ji2 ru2 fen2]

meaning_cn: 颠沛跌倒，比喻穷困，受挫折；流离浪落。由于灾荒或战乱而流转离散。形容生活艰难，四处流浪。
meaning_en: homeless and miserable (idiom); to wander about in a desperate plight; to drift

meaning_cn: 逆着水流的方向行船。比喻不努力就要后退。
meaning_en: lit. navigating a boat against the current (idiom); fig. in a tough environment (one needs to work hard)

meaning_cn: 号号令；施发布。发布命令。现在也用来形容指挥别人。
meaning_en: to boss people around (idiom)

meaning_cn: 投迎合；其代词，他，他的；好爱好。迎合别人的喜好。
meaning_en: to adapt to sb's taste; to fit sb's fancy

meaning_cn: 老花招或老手法又重新施展。同故技重演”。
meaning_en: to repeat an old stratagem; up to one's old tricks

meaning_cn: 照按照；本书本；宣宣读；科科条，条文。照着本子念条文。形容讲课、发言等死板地按照课文、讲稿，没有发挥，不生动。
meaning_en: a wooden word-by-word reading

meaning_cn: 把一种花木的枝条或嫩芽嫁接在另一种花木上。比喻暗中用手段更换人或事物来欺骗别人。
meaning_en: (lit.) to graft flowers onto a tree (idiom); (fig.) to surreptitiously substitute one thing for another

meaning_cn: 原指打仗时一个人上阵。比喻行动没人帮助。
meaning_en: (idiom) single-handed; on one's own

meaning_cn: 尊称死者的精神。
meaning_en: soul and spirit of the deceased

meaning_cn: 嘶哑；竭尽。嗓子喊哑，气力用尽。形容竭力呼喊。
meaning_en: to shout oneself hoarse (idiom)

meaning_cn: 举行动。指多余的，没有必要的举动。
meaning_en: to do more than is required (idiom); superfluous; gilding the lily

meaning_cn: 混搀杂，冒充。拿鱼眼睛冒充珍珠。比喻用假的冒充真的。
meaning_en: to pass off fish eyes for pearls; to pass off fake products as genuine (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容人规规矩矩，谨慎胆小的样子。
meaning_en: (coll.) docile; well-behaved; biddable

meaning_cn: 舟车船与车，泛指一切水陆交通工具。劳顿劳累疲倦。形容旅途疲劳困顿。
meaning_en: travel-worn

meaning_cn: 指很少见，很奇异，不同一般。
meaning_en: (idiom) crazy; bizarre; weird; fantastic; strange

meaning_cn: 指形象丑恶，使人看不下去。
meaning_en: unbearable to look at; an eyesore

meaning_cn: 展舒展。由于忧愁而双眉紧锁。形容心事重重的样子。
meaning_en: with a worried frown

meaning_cn: 大计长远的重要的计划。指关系到长远利益的计划或措施。
meaning_en: a project of vital and lasting importance

meaning_cn: 末节小事情，小节。细小的树枝，策末的环节。比喻事情或问题的细小而无关紧要的部分。
meaning_en: minor details; trifles

meaning_cn: 窍洞，指心窍。没有一窍是贯通的。比喻一点儿也不懂。
meaning_en: lit. doesn't (even) enter a single aperture (of one's head); I don't understand a word (idiom); it's all Greek to me

meaning_cn: 形容吃了败仗慌张逃跑。
meaning_en: to flee in defeat; to bolt

meaning_cn: 和连同。连盘子也端出来了。比喻全都讲出来，毫不保留。
meaning_en: lit. to put everything out including the tray; to reveal everything; to make a clean breast of it all

meaning_cn: 大体很好，但还有不足。
meaning_en: everything is fine except for one small defect (idiom); the fly in the ointment

meaning_cn: 甘甘心；寂寞孤寂、冷落。形容不甘心被冷落或急于想参与某件事情。
meaning_en: unwilling to remain lonely or idle; unwilling to be left out

meaning_cn: 在很窄的路上相遇，没有地方可让◇多用来指仇人相见，彼此都不肯轻易放过。
meaning_en: lit. to meet face to face on a narrow path (idiom); fig. enemies or rivals meet face to face

meaning_cn: 喝水的时候想起水是从哪儿来的。比喻不忘本。
meaning_en: lit. when you drink water, think of its source (idiom); gratitude for blessings and their well-spring; Don't forget where your happiness come from.; Be grateful for all your blessings!

meaning_cn: 绰绰宽裕的样子。形容房屋或钱财非常宽裕，用不完。
meaning_en: (idiom) more than enough

meaning_cn: 形容战斗频仍、激烈。
meaning_en: fire of war everywhere (idiom); enveloped in the flames of war

meaning_cn: 既得名声，又获利益。
meaning_en: both fame and fortune (idiom); both virtue and reward

meaning_cn: 思考虑；前前因；后后果。对事情发生的缘由，发展后果，作再三考虑。
meaning_en: to consider past cause and future effect (idiom); to think over the past and future; to ponder over reasons and connection

meaning_cn: 大庭宽大的场地；广众为数很多的人群。指聚集很多人的公开场合。
meaning_en: (idiom) in public; in front of everyone; openly (typically preceded by 在[zai4] and followed by 之下[zhi1 xia4])

meaning_cn: 竭尽。精神、力气消耗已尽。形容非常疲劳。
meaning_en: spirit weary, strength exhausted (idiom); spent; drained; washed out

meaning_cn: 皆都。所有的人都知道。
meaning_en: known to everyone

meaning_cn: 幸高兴。指人缺乏善意，在别人遇到灾祸时感到高兴。
meaning_en: lit. to take joy in calamity and delight in disaster (idiom); fig. to rejoice in other people's misfortune; Schadenfreude

meaning_cn: 衣袖中除清风外，别无所有。比喻做官廉洁。也比喻穷得一无所有。
meaning_en: lit. both sleeves flowing in the breeze (idiom); having clean hands; uncorrupted; unsoiled by corrupt practices

meaning_cn: 回答的不是所问的内容。
meaning_en: (idiom) to sidestep the question; to answer evasively

meaning_cn: 指说话、写文章简单明了，能抓住要点。
meaning_en: brief and to the point (idiom); succinct

meaning_cn: 连一样事情也没有做成。指什么事情都做不成。形容毫无成就。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have achieved nothing; to be a total failure; to get nowhere

meaning_cn: 形对照；绌不够，不足⊥同类的事物相比较，显出不足。
meaning_en: to pale by comparison (idiom)

meaning_cn: 涛大波浪；骇使惊怕。汹涌吓人的浪涛。比喻险恶的环境或尖锐激烈的斗争。
meaning_en: perilous situation

meaning_cn: 不仁没有感觉。肢体麻痹，失去知觉。比喻对外界事物反应迟钝或漠不关心。
meaning_en: numbed; insensitive; apathetic; thick-skinned

meaning_cn: 觥古代的一种酒器；筹行酒令的筹码。酒杯和酒筹杂乱地放着。形容许多人聚会喝酒时的热闹场景。
meaning_en: wine goblets and gambling chips lie intertwined; to drink and gamble together in a large group (idiom); a big (drinking) party

meaning_cn: 不把个人的生死放在心上。
meaning_en: bravery with no thought of personal safety (idiom); risking life and limb; undaunted by perils

meaning_cn: 寿终年纪很大才死；正寝旧式住宅的正房。原指老死在家里。现比喻事物的灭亡。
meaning_en: to die of old age; to die in one's bed at a ripe old age; (fig.) (of a structure or machine etc) to come to the end of its life

meaning_cn: 比喻违反事物发展的客观规律，急于求成，反而坏事。
meaning_en: to spoil things through excessive enthusiasm (idiom)

meaning_cn: 恶邪恶；务必须。清除坏人坏事必须干净彻底。
meaning_en: to eradicate evil completely (idiom); thorough in rooting out wickedness

meaning_cn: 驰奔跑；掣闪过。形容非常迅速，象风吹电闪一样。
meaning_en: fast as lightning

meaning_cn: 妄胡乱的；菲薄小看，轻视。过分看轻自己。形容自卑。
meaning_en: to be unduly humble (idiom); to undervalue oneself

meaning_cn: 自然地发生，生长，又自然地消灭。形容自然发展，无人过问。
meaning_en: to emerge and perish on its own; to run its course (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻言语行动有条理、有步调。
meaning_en: orderly; methodical; rhythmical

meaning_cn: 只有一个人或一方面的力量，得不到外力援助。
meaning_en: isolated and without help

meaning_cn: 沆瀣指唐时的崔沆、崔瀣。比喻臭味相投的人结合在一起。
meaning_en: to act in collusion (idiom); in cahoots with; villains will look after one another

meaning_cn: 喋喋形容说话多；体停止。唠唠叨叨，说个没完没了。
meaning_en: (idiom) to chatter endlessly; to talk nonstop

meaning_cn: 念念连续不断地念叨。旧指和尚念经，现指低声自语或含糊不清地说个不停。
meaning_en: to mumble; to mutter to oneself

meaning_cn: 本想耍弄聪明，结果做了蠢事。
meaning_en: to overreach oneself; to try to be clever and end up with egg on one's face

meaning_cn: 人和钱财都无着落或都有损失。
meaning_en: (idiom) to suffer the departure of sb (talented staff or one's spouse etc) and a financial loss as well; to get burned both romantically and financially

meaning_cn: 泛指多种供游赏、休息的建筑物。
meaning_en: pavilions and kiosks (in Chinese gardens)

meaning_cn: 间缝隙。关系亲密，没有隔阂。形容十分亲密，没有任何隔阂。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have a very close relationship with each other

meaning_cn: 终身一生。关系一辈子的大事情，多指婚姻。
meaning_en: major turning point of lifelong import (esp. marriage)

meaning_cn: 坚坚固；摧摧毁。非常坚固，摧毁不了。
meaning_en: (idiom) invulnerable; indestructible; impregnable

meaning_cn: 传说梁武帝时有个和尚讲经，感动了上天，天上纷纷落下花来。形容说话有声有色，极其动听（多指夸张而不符合实际）。
meaning_en: (lit.) a deluge of heavenly flowers (idiom); (fig.) extravagant embellishments; hype

meaning_cn: 原指花木遭受风雨摧残。比喻恶势力对弱小者的迫害。也比喻严峻的考验。
meaning_en: lit. windswept and battered by rain; to undergo hardship (idiom)

meaning_cn: 异不同；乎于；寻常平常。跟平常的情况很不一样。
meaning_en: unusual; extraordinary

meaning_cn: 形容说得话很多。
meaning_en: thousands of words (idiom); having a lot of things to say; talking nonstop

meaning_cn: 原意是说，你慢走我也慢走，你快走我也快走，你跑我也跑。比喻由于缺乏主张，或为了讨好，事事模仿或追随别人。
meaning_en: to blindly follow suit (idiom); to imitate slavishly; to do what everyone else is doing

meaning_cn: 惩警戒；毖谨慎。指批判以前所犯的错误，吸取教训，使以后谨慎些，不致再犯。
meaning_en: lit. to punish those before to prevent those after (idiom); to criticize former mistakes firmly to prevent them happening again

meaning_cn: 携拉着，带领。搀着老人，领着小孩。
meaning_en: taking everyone along, young and old; to look after the elderly and the young

meaning_cn: 皑皑洁白的样子，多用来形容霜雪。洁白的积雪银光耀眼。
meaning_en: brilliant white snow cover (esp. of distant peaks)

meaning_cn: 充塞住。塞住耳朵不听。形容有意不听别人的意见。
meaning_en: to block one's ears and not listen (idiom); to turn a deaf ear

meaning_cn: 青梅青的梅子；竹马儿童以竹竿当马骑。形容小儿女天真无邪玩耍游戏的样子。现指男女幼年时亲密无间。
meaning_en: lit. green plums and hobby-horse (idiom); fig. innocent children's games; childhood sweethearts; a couple who grew up as childhood friends

meaning_cn: 对目前的情况习惯了，不愿改变。
meaning_en: to take things as they are (idiom); to leave a situation as it is; to be happy with the status quo

meaning_cn: 济济众多的样子。形容有才能的人很多。
meaning_en: a galaxy of talent (idiom); a great number of competent people

meaning_cn: 咎灾祸。灾祸或罪过是自己招来的。指自作自受。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have only oneself to blame; to bring trouble through one's own actions

meaning_cn: 比别人高出一个等级。指高过一般人。
meaning_en: a cut above others; superior

meaning_cn: 污、垢肮脏的东西。比喻隐藏或包容坏人坏事。
meaning_en: to hide dirt, to conceal corruption (idiom); to shelter evil people and accept wrongdoing; aiding and abetting wicked deeds

meaning_cn: 效仿效，跟着学。上面的人怎么做，下面的人就跟着怎么干。
meaning_en: subordinates follow the example of their superiors (idiom)

meaning_cn: 燥干。口舌都干了。形容说话太多。
meaning_en: lit. dry mouth and tongue (idiom); to talk too much

meaning_cn: 灯光酒色，红绿相映，令人目眩神迷。形容奢侈糜烂的生活。
meaning_en: lanterns red, wine green (idiom); feasting and pleasure-seeking; debauched and corrupt environment

meaning_cn: 形容很会讲话。
meaning_en: can talk really well (idiom); the gift of the gab

meaning_cn: 所向指力所到达的地方；披靡溃败。比喻力量所达到的地方，一切障碍全被扫除。
meaning_en: (idiom) to sweep everything before one; to be invincible

meaning_cn: 嗷嗷哀鸣声；待等待；哺喂食。饥饿时急于求食的样子。形容受饥饿的悲惨情景。
meaning_en: cry piteously for food

meaning_cn: 砸了锅去卖废铁。表示穷极无聊，不留后路。也比喻把所的都拿出来了。
meaning_en: to be willing to sacrifice everything one has (idiom)

meaning_cn: 旧指道德高尚者能承担重大任务。
meaning_en: with great virtue one can take charge of the world (idiom)

meaning_cn: 言语遮遮掩掩，吞吞吐吐。
meaning_en: to speak evasively (idiom); beating about the bush

meaning_cn: 神通原是佛家语，指神奇的法术。法术广大无边。形容本领高超，无所不能。
meaning_en: (idiom) to possess great magical power; to possess remarkable abilities

meaning_cn: 风里吃饭，露天睡觉。形容旅途或野外工作的辛苦。
meaning_en: lit. to eat in the open air and sleep outdoors (idiom); fig. to rough it

meaning_cn: 比喻节约使用财物，使经常不缺用。也比喻一点一滴不间断地做某件事。
meaning_en: lit. thin streams flow forever; fig. economy will get you a long way; to work steadily at something little by little

meaning_cn: 了然了解、明白。心里非常明白。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be well aware; to understand clearly

meaning_cn: 形容某人前后的言行明显不一致，象两个人一样。
meaning_en: to be a different person; not to be one's usual self

meaning_cn: 指商店倒闭或企业破产停业。
meaning_en: to close down a business for good and put the best face on it (idiom)

meaning_cn: 冒往上升。形容愤怒到极点。
meaning_en: to get really angry

meaning_cn: 胡乱；非不对。不顾法纪或舆论，毫无顾忌地做坏事。
meaning_en: to run amok (idiom); to commit outrages

meaning_cn: 大街小巷里人们的议论。指民间的舆论。
meaning_en: (idiom) town gossip; streetcorner conversations

meaning_cn: 指年龄已超过七十岁。
meaning_en: over seventy years old

meaning_cn: 筚路柴车；蓝缕破衣服。驾着简陋的车，穿着破烂的衣服去开辟山林。形容创业的艰苦。
meaning_en: the hardships of beginning an undertaking (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指没有经过上级或有关方面同意，就擅自处置。
meaning_en: (idiom) to act on one's own; to decide for oneself

meaning_cn: 比喻人人痛恨的坏人。
meaning_en: sb or sth detested by all; target of scorn; anathema; cf. 老鼠過街，人人喊打|老鼠过街，人人喊打[lao3 shu3 guo4 jie1 , ren2 ren2 han3 da3]

meaning_cn: 一在天之南，一在地之北。形容地区各不相同。也形容距离极远。
meaning_en: (idiom) far apart; (idiom) from different places; from all over; (idiom) (to talk) about this and that

meaning_cn: 指以欺骗手段捞取钱财，陷害他人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to swindle, scam and deceive

meaning_cn: 攀抓住高处的东西向上爬。高得手也攀不到。形容难以达到。也形容人高高在上，使人难接近。
meaning_en: too high to reach (idiom); eminent and unapproachable

meaning_cn: 酒已尽量，饭也吃饱。形容吃饱喝足。
meaning_en: to have eaten and drunk to one's heart's content

meaning_cn: 遏止。愤怒地难以抑制。形容十分愤怒。
meaning_en: unable to restrain one's anger (idiom); in a towering rage

meaning_cn: 头发昏，眼发花，感到一切都在旋转。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have a dizzy spell; dazzled

meaning_cn: 指傍晚日落时的景象。也比喻迟暮之年或事物走向衰落。
meaning_en: the sun sets in the west (idiom)

meaning_cn: 引用经典书籍作为论证的依据。
meaning_en: lit. to quote the classics; to quote chapter and verse (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指衣着华丽，只会吃喝玩乐，不务正业的、有钱有势人家的女弟。
meaning_en: playboy

meaning_cn: 鸩传说中的毒鸟，用它的羽毛浸的酒喝了能毒死人∪毒酒解渴。比喻用错误的办法来解决眼前的困难而不顾严重后果。
meaning_en: lit. drinking poison in the hope of quenching one's thirst (idiom); fig. a supposed remedy that only makes matters worse

meaning_cn: 滥失实的，假的。不会吹竽的人混在吹竽的队伍里充数。比喻无本领的冒充有本领，次货冒充好货。
meaning_en: lit. to play the yu 竽 mouth organ to make up numbers (idiom); fig. to make up the numbers with inferior products; to masquerade as having an ability; token member of a group

meaning_cn: 光有空名，实际上并不是那样。
meaning_en: lit. has a name but no reality (idiom); exists only in name; nominal

meaning_cn: 登成熟。指年成好，粮食丰收。
meaning_en: abundant harvest of all food crops; bumper grain harvest

meaning_cn: 若好像∶像在思考着什么。
meaning_en: (idiom) looking pensive; thoughtfully

meaning_cn: 号啕大哭声。放声大哭。
meaning_en: variant of 嚎啕大哭[hao2 tao2 da4 ku1]

meaning_cn: 坐着空谈大道理。指口头说说，不见行动。
meaning_en: to sit and pontificate; to find answers through theory and not through practice (idiom)

meaning_cn: 真正的才能和学识。
meaning_en: solid learning; real ability and learning; genuine talent

meaning_cn: 没有它并不轻些，有它也并不重些。指无关紧要。
meaning_en: insignificant

meaning_cn: 形容某些文艺作品既优美，又通俗，各种文化程度的人都能够欣赏。
meaning_en: can be enjoyed by scholars and lay-people alike (idiom)

meaning_cn: 眼泪象雨水似的直往下流。形容悲痛或害怕之极。
meaning_en: tears falling like rain (idiom)

meaning_cn: 盛怒的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) spitting anger; in a rage

meaning_cn: 下次不可以再这样做。表示只通融这一次。
meaning_en: not to be repeated; not to be taken as a precedent; just this once

meaning_cn: 贤有德有才的人。指用人只选有德有才的人。
meaning_en: to appoint people according to their merits (idiom); appointment on the basis of ability and integrity

meaning_cn: 逢遇到；源水源。到处遇到充足的水源。原指赏识广博，应付裕如◇也比喻做事得心应手，非常顺利。
meaning_en: lit. to strike water right and left (idiom); fig. to turn everything into gold; to have everything going one's way; to benefit from both sides

meaning_cn: 至极，最∶象得到极珍贵的宝物。形容对所得到的东西非常珍视喜爱。
meaning_en: as if gaining the most precious treasure

meaning_cn: 大雅《诗经》的组成部分之一，这里指雅正、文雅大方。指虽有影响但对主要方面没有妨害。
meaning_en: (of a defect etc) to be of no great matter (idiom); harmless

meaning_cn: 指在江河的急流中泥土和沙子随着水一起冲下。比喻好人和坏人混杂在一起。
meaning_en: mud and sand flow together (idiom); good and bad mingle

meaning_cn: 使苍天和大地为之感动。形容诚意感人至深。亦比喻使无情天地受感动。形容冤屈极大。
meaning_en: (idiom) deeply affecting

meaning_cn: 想说又停止不说。形容有难言的苦衷。
meaning_en: to want to say sth but then hesitate

meaning_cn: 事情同自己没有关系。
meaning_en: a matter of no concern to oneself (idiom)

meaning_cn: 一下子便扫除干净。比喻彻底清除。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make a clean sweep of; to clean out

meaning_cn: 推开高山，翻倒大海。形容力量强盛，声势浩大。
meaning_en: lit. to topple the mountains and overturn the seas (idiom); earth-shattering; fig. gigantic; of spectacular significance

meaning_cn: 九条牛身上的一根毛。比喻极大数量中极微小的数量，微不足道。
meaning_en: (lit.) one hair from nine oxen (idiom); (fig.) a drop in the ocean

meaning_cn: 比喻事物消失净尽。
meaning_en: lit. scattered ashes and dispersed smoke (idiom); fig. to be annihilated; to vanish in a puff of smoke

meaning_cn: 本指态度和霭可亲。现也指互相之间只讲和气，不讲原则。
meaning_en: (idiom) to keep on the right side of everyone (often at the expense of principle)

meaning_cn: 把赤诚的心交给人家。比喻真心待人。
meaning_en: to give one's bare heart into sb else's keeping (idiom); sb has one's absolute confidence; to trust completely; to confide in sb with entire sincerity

meaning_cn: 象是鬼神制作出来的。形容艺术技巧高超，不是人力所能达到的。
meaning_en: supernaturally fine craft (idiom); the work of the Gods; uncanny workmanship; superlative craftsmanship

meaning_cn: 垂留传后世；朽腐烂，磨灭。指光辉的事纪伟大的精神永远流传，不会磨灭。
meaning_en: eternal glory; will never be forgotten

meaning_cn: 穷完。没有止境，没有限度。
meaning_en: (idiom) endless; boundless; infinite

meaning_cn: 墨守战国时墨翟善于守城；成规现成的或久已通行的规则、方法。指思想保守，守着老规矩不肯改变。
meaning_en: hidebound by convention (idiom)

meaning_cn: 被弓箭吓怕了的鸟不容易安定。比喻经过惊吓的人碰到一点动静就非肠怕。
meaning_en: (lit.) a bird startled by the mere twang of a bow (idiom); (fig.) sb who frightens easily, due to past experiences

meaning_cn: 汹涌水势腾涌的样子。形容波浪又大又急。
meaning_en: waves surging forth; roaring sea

meaning_cn: 把所有的钱一次押上去，决一输赢。比喻在危急时用尽所有力量作最后一次冒险。
meaning_en: to stake all on one throw

meaning_cn: 毛遂自我推荐。比喻自告奋勇，自己推荐自己担任某项工作。
meaning_en: Mao Sui recommends himself (idiom); to offer one's services (in the style of Mao Sui offering his services to king of Chu 楚 of the Warring states)

meaning_cn: 干戈古代的两种武器。大规模地进行战争。比喻大张声势地行事。
meaning_en: lit. to go to war (idiom); fig. to make a big fuss over sth

meaning_cn: 浮超过。原指人的才德高过所得俸禄的等级◇指工作中人员过多或人多事少。
meaning_en: more hands than needed (idiom); too many cooks spoil the broth

meaning_cn: 古代神话传说盘古氏开辟天地，开始有人类历史◇常比喻空前的，自古以来没有过的。
meaning_en: (lit.) to split heaven and earth apart (refers to the Pangu 盤古|盘古[Pan2 gu3] creation myth) (idiom); (fig.) unprecedented; first of its kind

meaning_cn: 垂柳浓密，鲜花夺目。形容柳树成荫，繁花似锦的春天景象。也比喻在困难中遇到转机。
meaning_en: lit. the willow trees make the shade, the flowers give the light (idiom); at one's darkest hour, a glimmer of hope; light at the end of the tunnel

meaning_cn: 饥肠饥饿的肚子；辘辘车行声。肚子饿得咕咕直响。形容十分饥饿。
meaning_en: (idiom) stomach rumbling with hunger; very hungry

meaning_cn: 下手的时候留点情面。比喻处理事情不要太苛刻。
meaning_en: lit. start off leniently (idiom); please do not be too strict with me; Do not judge me too harshly.; Look favorably on my humble efforts.

meaning_cn: 过过分；犹象；不及达不到。事情做得过头，就跟做得不够一样，都是不合适的。
meaning_en: too far is as bad as not enough (idiom, from the Analects)

meaning_cn: 比喻非常微小的利润。
meaning_en: (idiom) meager profit; petty gain

meaning_cn: 原意是各人的口味不同，很难做出一种饭菜使所有的人都感到好吃。比喻做事很难让所有的人都满意。
meaning_en: it's difficult to please everyone (idiom)

meaning_cn: 晕头发昏；转向辨不清方向。头脑发晕，辨不清方向。形容糊里糊涂或惊惶失措。
meaning_en: confused and disoriented

meaning_cn: 指走过南方北方不少地方。也泛指闯荡。
meaning_en: to travel extensively

meaning_cn: 喻开导，晓喻。没法跟他讲道理。形容蛮横或固执。
meaning_en: (idiom) impervious to reason; unreasonable

meaning_cn: 通过不同的途径，到达同一个目的地。比喻采取不同的方法而得到相同的结果。
meaning_en: different routes to the same destination (idiom); fig. different means of achieve the same end

meaning_cn: 背地里小声说话。
meaning_en: (idiom) to whisper; to speak in whispers

meaning_cn: 不扬不好看。形容人容貌难看。
meaning_en: (idiom) nothing special to look at; unprepossessing

meaning_cn: 象口渴思饮那样访求贤士。形容罗致人才的迫切。
meaning_en: (idiom) to eagerly seek talented people

meaning_cn: 原指古代作战时摇着旗子，大声喊杀助威。现比喻给别人助长声势。
meaning_en: to wave flags and shout battle cries (idiom); to egg sb on; to give support to

meaning_cn: 为人处世的道理。
meaning_en: worldly wisdom; the ways of the world; to know how to get on in the world

meaning_cn: 遂通随”，顺从。原为医学病症名，指半边身体不能随意转动。有时比喻诗文部分好，部分不好，不够匀称。
meaning_en: paralysis of one side of the body; hemiplegia

meaning_cn: 宣公开说出。保守秘密，不肯宣布。
meaning_en: to withhold information; to keep sth secret

meaning_cn: 借着某件事情为题目来做文章，以表达自己真正的意见或主张。也指假借某事为由，去做其它的事。
meaning_en: to use the current topic to put over one's own ideas; to use sth as a pretext to make a fuss

meaning_cn: 早晨发布的命令，晚上就改了。比喻经常改变主张和办法，一会儿一个样。
meaning_en: to make frequent or unpredictable changes in policy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 天天命，命运；尤怨恨，归咎。指遇到挫折或出了问题，一味报怨天，责怪别人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to blame the gods and accuse others

meaning_cn: 循、蹈遵循，依照。规、矩是定方圆的标准工具，借指行为的准则。原指遵守规矩，不敢违反。现也指拘守旧准则，不敢稍做变动。
meaning_en: to follow the compass and go with the set square (idiom); to follow the rules inflexibly; to act according to convention

meaning_cn: 每家每户。指所有的人家。
meaning_en: each and every family (idiom); every household

meaning_cn: 形容全屋子的人同时大笑。
meaning_en: the whole room roaring with laughter (idiom)

meaning_cn: 宗宗教，家族。代后代。传延宗教，接续后代。旧指生了独生子可以使家世一代一代传下去。
meaning_en: to carry on one's ancestral line

meaning_cn: 完善美好，没有缺点。
meaning_en: perfect and without blemish; flawless; to leave nothing to be desired

meaning_cn: 金榜科举时代称殿试揭晓的榜；题名写上名字。指科举得中。
meaning_en: to win top marks in the imperial examinations

meaning_cn: 黯然心里不舒服、情绪低落的样子；失色因惊恐而变以脸色。本指心怀不好，脸色难看◇多比喻相形之下很有差距，远远不如。
meaning_en: to lose one's splendor; to lose luster; to be eclipsed; to be overshadowed

meaning_cn: 张铺张，夸大。假装出强大的气势。指假造声势，借以吓人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to bluff; to bluster; to make an empty show of strength

meaning_cn: 招摇张扬炫耀；市闹市，指人多的地方。指在公开场合大摇大摆显示声势，引人注意。
meaning_en: (idiom) to parade oneself ostentatiously about town

meaning_cn: 化改变，转变。原指大行其道，使天下化之◇形容做事情不小心谨慎。
meaning_en: careless; sloppy

meaning_cn: 指工作费力大，收效小。
meaning_en: (idiom) to expend twice the effort for half the result

meaning_cn: 收拾整顿、整理。指事物败坏到无法整顿或不可救药的地步。
meaning_en: (idiom) irremediable; unmanageable; out of hand; hopeless

meaning_cn: 心思灵敏，手艺巧妙（多用在女子）。
meaning_en: capable; clever; dexterous

meaning_cn: 比喻坚持不懈地改造自然和坚定不移地进行斗争。
meaning_en: the old man moves mountains (idiom); fig. where there's a will, there's a way

meaning_cn: 老百姓所受的灾难，象水那样越来越深，象火那样越来越热。比喻人民生活极端痛苦。
meaning_en: deep water and scorching fire; abyss of suffering (idiom)

meaning_cn: 一下子就扫除干净。
meaning_en: see 一掃而空|一扫而空[yi1 sao3 er2 kong1]

meaning_cn: 形容孤苦无依。
meaning_en: (idiom) having nothing to rely on; on one's own

meaning_cn: 花甲旧时用天干和地支相互配合作为纪年，六十年为一花甲，亦称一个甲子。花形容干支名号错综参差。指六十岁。
meaning_en: (idiom) 60 years old

meaning_cn: 念念头、主意；差错误。一个念头的差错（造成严重后果）。
meaning_en: momentary slip; false step; ill-considered action

meaning_cn: 抛暴露。露出头和面孔。原指妇女出现在大庭广众之中。现指公开露面。
meaning_en: to put oneself out in the public eye (said of sb for whom doing so is deemed unseemly)

meaning_cn: 原指封建官吏退堂时打鼓。现在比喻跟人共同做事中途退缩。
meaning_en: lit. to beat the return drum (idiom); fig. to give up; to turn tail

meaning_cn: 用牙咬来对付牙咬。比喻针锋相对地进行回击。
meaning_en: a tooth for a tooth (retaliation)

meaning_cn: 形容人手头很紧，一个钱也没有。
meaning_en: empty-handed (idiom); fig. not receiving anything

meaning_cn: 阿迎合，偏袒。刚强正直，不逢迎，无偏私。
meaning_en: upright and plainspoken

meaning_cn: 哑口象哑巴一样。象哑巴一样说不出话来。形容理屈词穷的样子。
meaning_en: dumbstruck and unable to reply (idiom); left speechless; at a loss for words

meaning_cn: 宾客人；至到；归回到家中。客人到这里就象回到自己家里一样。形容招待客人热情周到。
meaning_en: guests feel at home (in a hotel, guest house etc); a home away from home

meaning_cn: 在忙碌中抽出一点时间来做别的不关重要的事，或者消遣。
meaning_en: (idiom) to snatch a moment of leisure in the midst of a busy schedule

meaning_cn: 深无限，没有穷尽。启发人深入地思考。形容语言或文章有深刻的含意，耐人寻味。
meaning_en: (idiom) thought-provoking; to give one food for thought

meaning_cn: 没有什么不被包括。形容包含的东西非常多。
meaning_en: (idiom) not excluding anything; all-encompassing

meaning_cn: 裹缠。停步不前，好象脚被缠住了一样。
meaning_en: to stand still without advancing (idiom); to hesitate and hold back

meaning_cn: 原指作战要见机而行，不要做实际上无法办到的事◇泛指知道事情困难就后退。
meaning_en: (lit.) to sound out the difficulties and retreat to avoid defeat (idiom); (fig.) to back out of an awkward situation; to get out on finding out what it's really like

meaning_cn: 几句话。形容话很少。
meaning_en: in a few words (idiom); expressed succinctly

meaning_cn: 心思不在这里。指思想不集中。
meaning_en: absent-minded; preoccupied; inattentive; with one's thoughts wandering

meaning_cn: 搔抓。隔着靴子搔痒痒。比喻说话作文不中肯，不贴切，没有抓住要点。或做事没有抓住关键。
meaning_en: lit. to scratch the outside of the boot (idiom); fig. beside the point; ineffectual

meaning_cn: 昭然明显、显著的样子；揭原意为高举，现也指揭开。形容真相全部暴露，一切都明明白白。
meaning_en: abundantly clear

meaning_cn: 肺腑指内心。出于内心的真诚的话。
meaning_en: words from the bottom of one's heart

meaning_cn: 性格、志趣、境遇相同的人互相爱护、同情、支持。
meaning_en: (lit.) people of talent appreciate one another (idiom); (fig.) to feel an affinity with (sb); to feel a bond with

meaning_cn: 从容不慌不忙，很镇静；不迫不急促。不慌不忙，沉着镇定。
meaning_en: calm; unruffled

meaning_cn: 形容公正严明，不怕权势，不讲情面。
meaning_en: strictly impartial and incorruptible (idiom)

meaning_cn: 悲伤、欢乐、离散、聚会。泛指生活中经历的各种境遇和由此产生的各种心情。
meaning_en: joys and sorrows; partings and reunions; the vicissitudes of life

meaning_cn: 山野和海里出产的各种珍贵食品。泛指丰富的菜肴。
meaning_en: exotic delicacies; luxury foodstuff from distant locations

meaning_cn: 奋战尽全力地战斗。孤立无助的军队单独对敌作战。也比喻一个人或一个集体无人支援、帮助的情况下努力从事某项斗争。
meaning_en: lit. lone army putting up a brave fight (idiom); fig. (of a person or group of people) struggling hard without support

meaning_cn: 与山外、林外距离远的、人急至的山岭、森林。
meaning_en: (idiom) backwoods; wilderness

meaning_cn: 到处奔波。多指为生活所迫或为某一目的四处奔走活动。
meaning_en: to run this way and that (idiom); to rush about busily; to bustle about

meaning_cn: 文文采；质实质；彬彬形容配合适当。原形容人既文雅又朴实，后形容人文雅有礼貌。
meaning_en: refined in manner; gentle

meaning_cn: 顶礼佛教拜佛时的最敬礼，人跪下，两手伏地，以头顶着受礼人的脚；膜拜佛教徒的另一种敬礼，两手加额，跪下叩头。虔诚地跪拜。
meaning_en: to prostrate oneself in worship (idiom); (fig.) to worship; to bow down to

meaning_cn: 原是佛教用来比喻人没有一丝牵挂◇指人裸体。
meaning_en: not wearing one thread (idiom); absolutely naked; without a stitch of clothing; in one's birthday suit

meaning_cn: 应接应；合配合。外面攻打，里面接应。
meaning_en: to coordinate outside and inside offensives (idiom); (fig.) to act together

meaning_cn: 故老朋友。初次见面就象老朋友一样合得来。
meaning_en: familiarity at first sight

meaning_cn: 霆极响的雷，比喻震怒。比喻大发脾气，大声斥责。
meaning_en: to be furious; to fly into a terrible rage

meaning_cn: 形容吃东西又猛又急的样子。
meaning_en: to wolf down one's food (idiom); to devour ravenously; to gorge oneself

meaning_cn: 执固执，坚持；迷迷惑；悟觉悟。坚持错误而不觉悟。
meaning_en: to obstinately persist in going about things the wrong way (idiom)

meaning_cn: 物人物，人们。指跟别人往来接触。
meaning_en: (idiom) to interact with people

meaning_cn: 清除旧思想，改变旧面貌。比喻彻底悔改。
meaning_en: lit. to wash one's heart and renew one's face (idiom); to repent sincerely and mend one's mistaken ways; to turn over a new leaf

meaning_cn: 怜怜悯，同情。比喻因有同样的遭遇或痛苦而互相同情。
meaning_en: fellow sufferers empathize with each other (idiom); misery loves company

meaning_cn: 医治不好的病。也比喻无法挽救的祸患。
meaning_en: incurable disease

meaning_cn: 形容兴奋得意，精神焕发的样子。
meaning_en: in high spirits (idiom); glowing with health and vigor

meaning_cn: 踏入社会都靠父母提供。指生活所依赖的人。
meaning_en: the people one depends upon for one's livelihood; one's bread and butter

meaning_cn: 实实际。原指言语浮夸，超过实际才能◇也指话说得过分，超过了实际情况。
meaning_en: (idiom) to exaggerate; to overstate the facts

meaning_cn: 势气势，威力。形势就象劈竹子，头上几节破开以后，下面各节顺着刀势就分开了。比喻节节胜利，毫无阻碍。
meaning_en: like a hot knife through butter (idiom); with irresistible force

meaning_cn: 反目翻脸了。翻脸而变成仇敌。一般指夫妻不和，矛盾激化，互相对立。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fall out with sb; to become enemies

meaning_cn: 原意是如果对敌我双方的情况都能了解透彻，打起仗来就可以立于不败之地。泛指对双方情况都很了解。
meaning_en: know yourself, know your enemy (idiom, from Sunzi's "The Art of War" 孫子兵法|孙子兵法[Sun1 zi3 Bing1 fa3])

meaning_cn: 切齿咬紧牙齿，表示痛恨。形容极端仇视或痛恨。也形容把某种情绪或感觉竭力抑制住。
meaning_en: (idiom) to gnash one's teeth; to fume with rage

meaning_cn: 非肠怕，脸色都变了。
meaning_en: to turn pale with fright (idiom)

meaning_cn: 纷纷众多；扬扬飘荡的样子。形容雪花飘落的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of leaves etc) fluttering about

meaning_cn: 成千上万匹刀在奔跑腾跃。形容群众性的活动声势浩大或场面热烈。
meaning_en: lit. (like) ten thousand horses galloping (idiom); fig. going full steam ahead

meaning_cn: 赤手空手。两手空空。比喻没有任何依靠。
meaning_en: (idiom) with one's bare hands (unarmed – also figuratively: without assistance)

meaning_cn: 指极其紧要的契机或时刻。
meaning_en: the critical moment; life and death crisis

meaning_cn: 指隐藏才能，不使外露。
meaning_en: to conceal one's strengths and bide one's time (idiom); to hide one's light under a bushel

meaning_cn: 意气主观偏激的情绪；用事行事。缺乏理智，只凭一时的想法和情绪办事。
meaning_en: (idiom) to let emotions affect one's decisions

meaning_cn: 废停止。顾不得睡觉，忘记了吃饭。形容专心努力。
meaning_en: (idiom) to skip one's sleep and meals; to be completely wrapped up in one's work

meaning_cn: 亲身经历过很多次战斗。比喻况历多，经验丰富。
meaning_en: lit. veteran of a hundred battles (idiom); fig. experienced; seasoned

meaning_cn: 笔文笔。指文章传神绝妙之处。
meaning_en: the brush stroke that dots in the eyes (idiom); fig. to add the vital finishing touch; the crucial point that brings the subject to life; a few words to clinch the point

meaning_cn: 谋面见面。指平素没有见过面。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have never met; to be complete strangers

meaning_cn: 唳鹤叫声。形容惊慌失措，或自相惊忧。
meaning_en: lit. wind sighing and crane calling (idiom); fig. to panic at the slightest move; to be jittery

meaning_cn: 指单独成立家庭。也指学术上不依赖前人而另立一派。现也指离开某一集体，自己另搞一套。
meaning_en: to form one's own group or school of thought; to set up one's own business; to establish oneself

meaning_cn: 夺目耀眼。形容鲜艳耀眼。也用来形容某些艺术作品和艺术形象的极高成就。
meaning_en: dazzling; brilliant

meaning_cn: 膏肓古人把心尖脂肪叫膏”，心脏与膈膜之间叫肓”。形容病情十分严重，无法医治。比喻事情到了无法挽救的地步。
meaning_en: lit. the disease has attacked the vitals (idiom); fig. beyond cure; the situation is hopeless

meaning_cn: 满全；在乎在意。丝毫不在意。形容对事情一点也不重视。
meaning_en: not in the least concerned (idiom); reckless; couldn't give a damn about it; unperturbed; couldn't care less; harum scarum

meaning_cn: 皱着眉头，哭丧着脸。形容愁苦的神色。
meaning_en: to look anxious (idiom); to look miserable

meaning_cn: 一百个当中就挑出这一个来。形容人才出众。
meaning_en: one in a hundred; cream of the crop

meaning_cn: 有好的一面，也有坏的一面。
meaning_en: to have both advantages and disadvantages

meaning_cn: 览看；遗遗留。一眼看去，所有的景物全看见了。形容建筑物的结构没有曲折变化，或诗文内容平淡，没有回味。
meaning_en: be plainly visible

meaning_cn: 益更加。越多越好。
meaning_en: the more the better

meaning_cn: 形容人神志不清的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) dizzy

meaning_cn: 指不管条件是否许可，一心想做大事立大功。多用以形容浮夸的作风。
meaning_en: to rejoice in grandiose deeds; to strive to achieve extraordinary things

meaning_cn: 一家子被迫分离四散。
meaning_en: a family wrenched apart (idiom)

meaning_cn: 守口紧闭着嘴不讲话。闭口不谈，象瓶口塞紧了一般。形容说话谨慎，严守秘密。
meaning_en: lit. to guard one's mouth like a closed bottle (idiom); tight-lipped; reticent; not breathing a word

meaning_cn: 象坐在插着针的毡子上。形容心神不定，坐立不安。
meaning_en: lit. as if sitting on pins and needles (idiom); fig. to be in an uncomfortable situation

meaning_cn: 循循有次序的样子；善善于；诱引导。指善于引导别人进行学习。
meaning_en: to guide patiently and systematically (idiom)

meaning_cn: 把姓张的帽子戴到姓李的头上。比喻认错了对象，弄错了事实。
meaning_en: lit. to put Zhang's hat on Li's head; to attribute sth to the wrong person (idiom); to confuse one thing with another

meaning_cn: 没有声音，没有气味。比喻没有名声，不被人知道。
meaning_en: wordless and uncommunicative (idiom); without speaking; taciturn; not providing any news

meaning_cn: 患忧患，担心。担心得不到，得到了又担心失掉。形容对个人得失看得很重。
meaning_en: to worry about personal gains and losses

meaning_cn: 自以为聪明而乱作主张。指过高地估计自己，主观地办事。
meaning_en: (idiom) to think oneself clever

meaning_cn: 宠宠爱。因为得到宠爱或赏识而又高兴，又不安。
meaning_en: overwhelmed by favor from superior (humble expr.)

meaning_cn: 象嘴唇和牙齿那样互相依靠。比喻关系密切，相互依靠。
meaning_en: lit. as close as lips and teeth (idiom); closely related; interdependent

meaning_cn: 娇爱怜过甚；惯纵容，放任。从小就被溺爱、娇养惯了。
meaning_en: pampered and spoiled since childhood

meaning_cn: 奇特殊的。指事物或诗文平平常常，没有吸引人的地方。
meaning_en: ordinary and mediocre (idiom); nothing to write home about

meaning_cn: 形容色彩鲜艳，花样繁多。
meaning_en: (idiom) bright and multicolored; of rich variety; dazzling; glitzy

meaning_cn: 辞告别⊥人世永别了。指去世。
meaning_en: to die; to depart from the world forever

meaning_cn: 襟衣襟；危坐端正地坐着。整一整衣服，端正地坐着。形容严肃或拘谨的样子。
meaning_en: to sit upright and still (idiom)

meaning_cn: 尽全部，所有。人人都知道。
meaning_en: known by everyone (idiom); well known; a household name

meaning_cn: 文规定、仪式；缛繁多；节礼节。过分繁琐的仪式或礼节。也比喻其他繁琐多余的事项。
meaning_en: convoluted and overelaborate (document); unnecessarily elaborate writing; mumbo-jumbo

meaning_cn: 求找寻；疵毛病。吹开皮上的毛寻疤痕。比喻故意挑剔别人的缺点，寻找差错。
meaning_en: lit. to blow apart the hairs upon a fur to discover any defect (idiom); fig. to be fastidious; nitpick

meaning_cn: 克己约束自己；奉公以公事为重。克制自己的私心，一心为公。
meaning_en: self-restraint and devotion to public duties (idiom); selfless dedication; to serve the public interest wholeheartedly

meaning_cn: 遮蔽天空和太阳。形容事物体积庞大、数量众多或气势盛大。
meaning_en: lit. hiding the sky and covering the earth (idiom); fig. earth-shattering; omnipresent; of universal importance

meaning_cn: 佛教用语，世界的千倍叫小千世界，小千世界的千倍叫中千世界，中千世界的千倍叫大千世界◇指广大无边的人世。
meaning_en: great wide world; marvelously diverse world; (Buddhism) cosmos (abbr. for 三千大千世界[san1 qian1 da4 qian1 shi4 jie4])

meaning_cn: 原指做事违反常理，不择手段。现多指所作所为违背时代潮流或人民意愿。
meaning_en: to go against the tide (idiom); to do things all wrong; to try to turn back history; a perverse way of doing things

meaning_cn: 因循沿袭；守旧死守老的一套。死守老一套，缺乏创新的精神。
meaning_en: (idiom) to continue in the same old rut; diehard conservative attitudes

meaning_cn: 争执的双方中一方所说的话。
meaning_en: one side of the story; one-sided statement

meaning_cn: 一滴水也不外漏。形容说话、办事非常细致、周密，无懈可击。也形容钱财全部抓在手里，轻易不肯出手。
meaning_en: lit. not one drop of water can leak out; watertight; rigorous (argument)

meaning_cn: 非不是；此这个；即便是；彼那个。不是这一个，就是那一个。
meaning_en: either this or that; one or the other

meaning_cn: 空巷街道里弄里的人全部走空。指家家户户的人都从巷里出来了。多形容庆祝、欢迎等盛况。
meaning_en: the multitudes come out from everywhere, emptying every alleyway (to celebrate); the whole town turns out

meaning_en: incorporating diverse things (idiom); eclectic; all-embracing

meaning_cn: 凡响平凡的音乐。形容事物不平凡，很出色。
meaning_en: lit. not a common chord (idiom); outstanding; brilliant; out of the common run

meaning_cn: 攸所。关系到生和死。指生死存亡的关键。
meaning_en: matter of life and death

meaning_cn: 涎口水。馋得连口水都要滴下来了。形容十分贪婪的样子。
meaning_en: to drool with desire (idiom); to envy; to hunger for

meaning_cn: 瞻向前看；顾回头看。看看前面，又看看后面。形容做事之前考虑周密慎重。也形容顾虑太多，犹豫不决。
meaning_en: lit. to look forward and back (idiom); fig. to consider carefully; to weigh the pros and cons; fig. to be overcautious and indecisive

meaning_cn: 广宽，大。推展开来而且把它扩大。也指从一件事情推及其它。
meaning_en: to apply sth more broadly; by logical extension; and, by extension,

meaning_cn: 投进入；罗网捕捉鱼鸟的器具。自己投到罗网里去。比喻自己送死。
meaning_en: to walk right into the trap

meaning_cn: 高风高尚的品格；亮节坚贞的节操。形容道德和行为都很高尚。
meaning_en: of noble character and unquestionable integrity (idiom)

meaning_cn: 扶摇急剧盘旋而上的暴风。形容上升很快。比喻仕途得意。
meaning_en: to skyrocket; to get quick promotion in one's career

meaning_cn: 比喻双方各得一半，不分上下。
meaning_en: to both share the limelight; to both have an equal share of

meaning_cn: 诺许诺。许下的一个诺言有千金的价值。比喻说话算数，极有信用。
meaning_en: (lit.) a promise worth a thousand pieces of gold (idiom); (fig.) a promise that can be counted on

meaning_cn: 自己认为对的就做，不考虑别人的意见。
meaning_en: to act as one thinks fit; to have one's own way

meaning_cn: 几小桌。形容房间干净明亮。
meaning_en: lit. clear window and clean table (idiom); fig. bright and clean

meaning_cn: 开劝课；源水源。开发水源，节制水流。比喻增加收入，节省开支。
meaning_en: lit. to open a water source and reduce outflow (idiom); to increase income and save on spending; to broaden the sources of income and economize on expenditure

meaning_cn: 因伤感郁闷或悲痛而发出叹息的声音。
meaning_en: sighing voice, wailing breath (idiom); to heave deep sighs; to sigh in despair

meaning_cn: 量计量。根据收入的多少来定开支的限度。
meaning_en: to assess one's income and spend accordingly (idiom); to live within one's means; You can only spend what you earn.

meaning_cn: 指按市场行情行事。
meaning_en: (of a price) to fluctuate according to the market; to sell at the market price

meaning_cn: 为了小的利益，造成大的损失。
meaning_en: to save a little only to lose a lot (idiom)

meaning_cn: 飘落的枯叶，掉在树木根部。比喻事物有一定的归宿。多指客居他乡的人，终要回到本乡。
meaning_en: lit. a falling leaf returns to the roots (idiom); fig. all things go back to their source eventually; in old age, an expatriate returns home

meaning_cn: 一分一秒也一定要争取。形容抓紧时间。
meaning_en: seize every minute and second (idiom); not a minute to lose; every moment counts

meaning_cn: 觑看。你看我，我看你，不知道如何是好。形容人们因惊惧或无可奈何而互相望着，都不说话。
meaning_en: to look at each other in dismay (idiom)

meaning_cn: 屡多次。多次打仗多次失败。
meaning_en: to suffer defeat in every battle (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指深夜。
meaning_en: in the dead of night (idiom)

meaning_cn: 坐着等死。形容在极端困难中，不积极想办法找出路。
meaning_en: to sit and wait for death (idiom); resigned to one's fate

meaning_cn: 睹看见。虽然看见了，却象没有看见一样。指对眼前事物莫不关心。
meaning_en: to turn a blind eye to

meaning_cn: 巍然极高的样子；屹立山势直立高耸。比喻象高山一样直立地上，不可动摇。
meaning_en: to stand tall and rock-solid (idiom); towering majestically; (of a person) to stand up against sb

meaning_cn: 连乌鸦麻雀的声音都没有。形容非常静。
meaning_en: lit. crow and peacock make no sound; absolute silence (idiom); not a single voice can be heard; absolute silence

meaning_cn: 亭亭高耸直立的样子。形容女子身材细长。也形容花木等形体挺拔。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a woman) slender and elegant; (idiom) (of a plant) tall and straight

meaning_cn: 短兵刀剑等短兵器；接交战。指近距离搏斗。比喻面对面地进行激烈的斗争。
meaning_en: lit. short-weaponed soldiery fight one another (idiom); fierce hand-to-hand infantry combat; to fight at close quarters

meaning_cn: 弹琴、弈棋、写字、绘画。常以表示个人的文化素养。
meaning_en: (idiom) the four arts of the Chinese scholar (guqin, Go, calligraphy and painting); (by extension) the accomplishments of a well-educated person

meaning_cn: 兴发动；众大队人马。旧指大规模出兵。现多指动用很多人力做某件事。
meaning_en: to muster large forces; to get a great number of people involved (in carrying out some task)

meaning_cn: 形容要求很迫切，好象饿了急着要吃饭，渴了急着要喝水一样。
meaning_en: to hunger for sth (idiom); eagerly; to long for sth

meaning_cn: 形容说话声音微弱，作事精神不振。也形容体弱无力。
meaning_en: weakly and without strength (idiom); dispirited

meaning_cn: 广扩大；言路进言的道路。指尽量给下面创造发表意见的条件。
meaning_en: to encourage the free airing of views (idiom)

meaning_cn: 威风威严的气概；凛凛严肃，可敬畏的样子。形容声势或气派使人敬畏。
meaning_en: majestic; awe-inspiring presence; impressive power

meaning_cn: 死的讳称。
meaning_en: (idiom) (euphemism) after (sb's) death

meaning_cn: 四脚指四肢。形容仰面跌倒。也形容人死去。
meaning_en: four legs facing the sky (idiom); flat on one's back

meaning_cn: 见到有利可图就不顾道义。
meaning_en: (idiom) to abandon moral principles in the pursuit of profit

meaning_cn: 用手捂住肚子大笑。形容遇到极可笑之事，笑得不能抑制。
meaning_en: (idiom) to split one's sides laughing

meaning_cn: 胜禁得起；烦烦琐。烦琐得使人受不了。
meaning_en: to be pestered beyond endurance

meaning_cn: 原意是从出生到死去◇形容冒着生命危险，不顾个人安危。
meaning_en: from the cradle to the grave (idiom); to go through fire and water; brave; willing to risk life and limb

meaning_cn: 休欢乐，吉庆；戚悲哀，忧愁。忧喜、福祸彼此相关联。形容关系密切，利害相关。
meaning_en: to share the same interests (idiom); to be closely related; to be in the same boat

meaning_cn: 各自到自己的岗位上。
meaning_en: (of the people in a group) to get into position (idiom); (athletics) On your mark!

meaning_cn: 纯纯粹。道士炼丹，认为炼到炉里发出纯青色的火焰就算成功了◇用来比喻功夫达到了纯熟完美的境界。
meaning_en: (lit.) the stove fire has turned bright green (allusion to Daoist alchemy) (idiom); (fig.) (of an art, a technique etc) brought to the point of perfection

meaning_cn: 辄就。略微尝试一下就停下来。指不深入钻研。
meaning_en: (lit.) to stop after taking just a sip (idiom); (fig.) to gain only a superficial knowledge of sth and then stop

meaning_cn: 形容身体强壮有力。
meaning_en: strong and vigorous; sturdy; robust

meaning_cn: 五脏脾、肺、肾、肝、心；六腑胃、大肠、小肠、三焦、膀胱、胆。人体内脏器官的统称。也比喻事物的内部情况。
meaning_en: five viscera and six bowels (TCM)

meaning_cn: 贪赃枉法的官吏。
meaning_en: grasping officials, corrupt mandarins (idiom); abuse and corruption

meaning_cn: 比喻下决心不顾一切地干到底。
meaning_en: lit. to break the cauldrons and sink the boats (idiom); fig. to cut off one's means of retreat; to burn one's boats

meaning_cn: 逸安逸；恶讨厌、憎恨。贪图安逸，厌恶劳动。
meaning_en: to love ease and comfort and hate work (idiom)

meaning_cn: 应应该。按罪恶或错误的性质，理应得到这样的惩罚。
meaning_en: guilty and deserves to be punished (idiom); entirely appropriate chastisement; the punishment fits the crime

meaning_cn: 壮健壮。年纪轻，体力强。
meaning_en: young and vigorous (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指人在三十岁前后有所成就。
meaning_en: thirty years old and therefore independent (idiom, from Confucius)

meaning_cn: 拿着棋子，不知下哪一着才好。比喻犹豫不决，拿不定主意。
meaning_en: to hesitate over what move to make (idiom); to waver; to shilly-shally

meaning_cn: 郁郁发愁的样子；寡少。形容心里苦闷。指闷闷不乐。
meaning_en: (idiom) depressed; cheerless

meaning_cn: 形容纷乱，理不出头绪。亦指有意找麻烦，抓住一点不肯放手。
meaning_en: hopelessly muddled; impossible to unravel

meaning_cn: 原形容道士修炼养气，不吃五谷，后形容人吸烟。
meaning_en: to swallow clouds and blow out fog (idiom); to blow cigarette or opium smoke

meaning_cn: 明智的人善于保全自己。现指因怕连累自己而回避原则斗争的处世态度。
meaning_en: a wise man looks after his own hide (idiom); to put one's own safety before matters of principle

meaning_cn: 抛出砖去，引回玉来。比喻用自己不成熟的意见或作品引出别人更好的意见或好作品。
meaning_en: lit. throw out a brick and get jade thrown back (idiom); fig. to attract others' interest or suggestions by putting forward one's own modest ideas to get the ball rolling

meaning_cn: 指两年喜事一齐到来。
meaning_en: two simultaneous happy events in the family

meaning_cn: 形容显赫、得意。
meaning_en: to hit the big time

meaning_cn: 弥越，更加。经历时间越长久，越显得坚定不移。
meaning_en: to become more resolute with the passing of time (idiom)

meaning_cn: 眼睛都要望穿了。形容盼望殷切。
meaning_en: to anxiously await

meaning_cn: 比喻行动快的人先达到目的或先得到所求的东西。
meaning_en: the quick-footed climb up first (idiom); the early bird catches the worm; first come, first served

meaning_cn: 及到。原意是鞭子虽长，也不能打马肚子。比喻相隔太远，力量达不到。
meaning_en: lit. the whip cannot reach (idiom); beyond one's influence; too far to be able to help

meaning_cn: 形容花朵将要开放时的形态。也比喻将成年的少女。
meaning_en: in bud; budding

meaning_cn: 表示目的达到或困难解除后满意轻松的心情。
meaning_en: (idiom) thank goodness

meaning_cn: 形容工作刚开始就取得成功。
meaning_en: to win instant success (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容消瘦到极点。
meaning_en: (idiom) as thin as a match; emaciated

meaning_cn: 辗转翻来复去；反侧反复。翻来复去，睡不着觉。形容心里有所思念或心事重重。
meaning_en: to toss and turn restlessly (in the bed)

meaning_cn: 比喻经历多次艰苦斗争的锻炼和考验。也指对文章和作品进行多次精心的修改。
meaning_en: after hard work and numerous revisions (idiom); the vicissitudes of life

meaning_cn: 想回家的心情象射出的箭一样快。形容回家心切。
meaning_en: with one's heart set on speeding home (idiom)

meaning_cn: 痛彻底；非错误。彻底改正以前所犯的错误。
meaning_en: completely correcting one's former misdeeds (idiom); to repent past mistakes and turn over a new leaf; a reformed character

meaning_cn: 比喻陷入四面受敌、孤立无援的境地。
meaning_en: lit. on all sides, the songs of Chu (idiom); fig. surrounded by enemies, isolated and without help

meaning_cn: 分离好象和死者永别一样。指很难再见的离别或永久的离别。
meaning_en: separated in life and death; to part for ever

meaning_cn: 良好；益有帮助。使人得到教益和帮助的好老师和好朋友。
meaning_en: good teacher and helpful friend (idiom); mentor

meaning_cn: 继继承。没有后人来继承前人的事业。
meaning_en: to have no qualified successors to carry on one's undertaking

meaning_cn: 头发蓬乱，脸上很脏。旧时形容贫苦人生活生活条件很坏的样子。也泛指没有修饰。
meaning_en: messy hair and dirty face; bad appearance

meaning_cn: 瓦解制瓦时先把陶土制成圆筒形，分解为四，即成瓦，比喻事物的分裂。象土崩塌，瓦破碎一样，不可收拾。比喻彻底垮台。
meaning_en: to collapse; to fall apart

meaning_cn: 泡水泡。变成像水泡和影子那样，很快就消失。
meaning_en: (idiom) to come to nothing

meaning_cn: 杀害证人以毁灭口供。
meaning_en: (idiom) to kill sb to prevent them from revealing sth

meaning_cn: 垂头耷拉着脑袋；丧气神情沮丧。形容因失败或不顺利而情绪低落、萎蘼不振的样子。
meaning_en: hanging one's head dispiritedly (idiom); dejected; crestfallen

meaning_cn: 形容做事机警敏捷。
meaning_en: (idiom) quick to notice and react

meaning_cn: 蜃大蛤。原指海边或沙漠中，由于光线的反向和折射，空中或地面出现虚幻的楼台城郭。现多比喻虚无缥渺的事物。
meaning_en: (idiom) (lit. and fig.) mirage

meaning_cn: 好喜欢；骛追求。比喻不切实际地追求过高过远的目标。
meaning_en: to bite off more than one can chew (idiom); to aim too high

meaning_cn: 笑一笑就算了事，指不予重视。
meaning_en: to laugh away (instead of taking seriously)

meaning_cn: 气气概；壮使壮丽；山河高山和大河。形容气概豪迈，使祖国山河因而更加壮丽。
meaning_en: magnificent; inspiring

meaning_cn: 小可寻常的。指情况严重或事情重要，不能轻视。
meaning_en: extremely important; no small matter

meaning_cn: 逐追随；颜脸面，面容；开舒展开来。笑得使面容舒展开来。形容满脸笑容，十分高兴的样子。
meaning_en: smile spread across the face (idiom); beaming with pleasure; all smiles; joy written across one's face

meaning_cn: 做种种坏事。
meaning_en: to break the law and commit crimes (idiom); malefactor; evildoer; to perpetrate outrages

meaning_cn: 犹还。说的话还在耳边。比喻说的话还清楚地记得。
meaning_en: words still ringing in one's ears (idiom)

meaning_cn: 高高深；阔广阔。多指不着边际地大发议论。
meaning_en: to harangue; loud arrogant talk; to spout

meaning_cn: 昧不了解；平生平素、往常。彼此一向不了解。指与某人从来不认识。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have never met sb before; entirely unacquainted

meaning_cn: 讳避忌；忌怕，畏惧。隐瞒疾病，不愿医治。比喻怕人批评而掩饰自己的的缺点和错误。
meaning_en: hiding a sickness for fear of treatment (idiom); fig. concealing a fault to avoid criticism; to keep one's shortcomings secret; to refuse to listen to advice

meaning_cn: 知懂得。认识事情的道理较易，实行其事较难。
meaning_en: easy to grasp but difficult to put into practice (idiom); easier said than done

meaning_cn: 比喻随口乱说一气。
meaning_en: to speak without thinking (idiom); to blurt sth out

meaning_cn: 两条道路交叉的地方。比喻处在对重大事情需要决定怎样选择的境地。
meaning_en: crossroads; intersection

meaning_cn: 比喻双方力量不相上下。
meaning_en: lit. two armies have equivalent banners and drums (idiom); fig. evenly matched; roughly comparable (opponents)

meaning_cn: 假装聋哑。指故意不理睬，只当不知道。
meaning_en: to play deaf-mute

meaning_cn: 庭庭院；抗礼平等行礼。原指宾主相见，分站在庭的两边，相对行礼。现比喻平起平坐，彼此对等的关系。
meaning_en: peer competition; to function as rivals; to make claims as an equal

meaning_cn: 旧时指男女双方的社会地位和经济情况相当，结亲很适合。
meaning_en: the families are well-matched in terms of social status (idiom); (of a prospective marriage partner) an appropriate match

meaning_cn: 劈正对着，冲着；盖压。正对着头和脸盖下来。形容（打击、冲击、批评等）来势很猛。
meaning_en: lit. splitting the head and covering the face (idiom); fig. pelting (with rain etc); showering down

meaning_cn: 无法估价的宝物。指极珍贵的东西。
meaning_en: (idiom) priceless treasure

meaning_cn: 为了完成艰巨的任务，忍受暂时的屈辱。
meaning_en: to endure humiliation as part of an important mission (idiom); to suffer in silence

meaning_cn: 政事通达，人心和顺。形容国家稳定，人民安乐。
meaning_en: efficient government, people at peace (idiom); all is well with the state and the people

meaning_cn: 唾手往手上吐唾沫。动手就可以取得。比喻极容易得到。
meaning_en: easily obtained; readily available

meaning_cn: 乔装改变服装、面貌；打扮指化装。指进行伪装，隐藏身份。
meaning_en: to dress up in disguise (idiom); to pretend for the purpose of deceit

meaning_cn: 峥嵘不平凡，不寻常。形容不平凡的年月。
meaning_en: eventful years (idiom)

meaning_cn: 天网天道之网；恢恢宽广的样子。指天道如大网，坏人是逃不过这个网的，作恶必受到惩罚。
meaning_en: lit. heaven's net has wide meshes, but nothing escapes it (idiom, from Laozi 73); fig. the way of Heaven is fair, but the guilty will not escape; you can't run from the long arm of the law

meaning_cn: 听听从。什么话都听从，什么主意都采纳。形容对某人十分信任。
meaning_en: to see, hear and obey (idiom); to take advice; to take sb at his word

meaning_cn: 指不说话；不出声。
meaning_en: (idiom) wordless; silent; taciturn; without speaking

meaning_cn: 明媚美好，可爱。形容春天的景物鲜明可爱。
meaning_en: lovely spring sunshine

meaning_cn: 私心很重，只为个人利益打算。
meaning_en: everything for self and selfish profit (idiom); with no regard for others; selfish; mercenary

meaning_cn: 付交给；诸之于。扔在东流的水里冲走。比喻希望落空，成果丧失，前功尽弃，好象随着流水冲走了一样。
meaning_en: wasted effort

meaning_cn: 意心思。心思烦乱，不知怎样才好。
meaning_en: lit. heart distracted, thoughts in turmoil (idiom); distraught with anxiety

meaning_cn: 原形容梁代画家张僧繇作画的神妙◇多比喻写文章或讲话时，在关键处用几句话点明实质，使内容生动有力。
meaning_en: to paint a dragon and dot in the eyes (idiom); fig. to add the vital finishing touch; the crucial point that brings the subject to life; a few words to clinch the point

meaning_cn: 指没有根据，不切实际的瞎想。
meaning_en: (idiom) to indulge in flights of fancy; to let one's imagination run wild

meaning_cn: 指不正当的门径。也比喻坏主意。
meaning_en: dishonest practices

meaning_cn: 原比喻自讨苦吃或自取灭亡。现多比喻主动暴露自己的缺点错误，以争取大家的批评帮助。
meaning_en: to invite trouble

meaning_cn: 泽池、湖。掏干了水塘捉鱼。比喻取之不留余地，只图眼前利益，不作长远打算。也形容反动派对人民的残酷剥削。
meaning_en: lit. to drain the pond to get at the fish (idiom); fig. to kill the goose that lays the golden eggs

meaning_cn: 原指动物中弱者被强者吞食。比喻弱的被强的吞并。
meaning_en: (lit.) the weak are prey to the strong (idiom); (fig.) the law of the jungle

meaning_cn: 寸草一点儿草。形容土地贫瘠，连一点儿草都不长。亦形容灾情严重。
meaning_en: (idiom) barren; devoid of vegetation

meaning_cn: 明里暗里都在进行争斗。形容各用心思，互相排挤。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fight openly and maneuver covertly

meaning_cn: 堂堂盛大的样子；正正整齐的样子。原形容强大整齐的样子，现也形容光明正大。也形容身材威武，仪表出众。
meaning_en: displaying strength and discipline; impressive; upright and frank; square

meaning_cn: 流流俗；污肮脏。指跟坏人一起干坏事。
meaning_en: to wallow in the mire with sb (idiom); to follow the bad example of others

meaning_cn: 凶不幸；吉吉利。指估计事态的发展趋势不妙，凶害多，吉利少。
meaning_en: (lit.) everything bodes ill, no positive signs (idiom); (fig.) inauspicious; everything points to disaster

meaning_cn: 指毫无价值。
meaning_en: worthless (idiom); no use whatsoever

meaning_cn: 挨次序一字一句地。
meaning_en: literal; word for word; word by word and phrase by phrase

meaning_cn: 万象宇宙间一切景象；更变更。事物或景象改换了样子，出现了一番新气象。
meaning_en: (in the spring) nature takes on a new look (idiom)

meaning_cn: 心机计谋。挖空心思，想眷法。
meaning_en: to rack one's brains for schemes (idiom); to beat one's brains out

meaning_cn: 铩羽羽毛摧落，比喻失败或不得志。指失败或不得志而归。
meaning_en: (idiom) to return in low spirits following a defeat or failure to achieve one's ambitions

meaning_cn: 微言精当而含义深远的话；大义本指经书的要义，后指大道理。包含在精微语言里的深刻的道理。
meaning_en: subtle words with profound meaning (idiom)

meaning_cn: 色脸色。形容人得意兴奋的样子。
meaning_en: smiles of exultation; radiant with delight

meaning_cn: 虚怕。指做了坏事怕人知道，心里老是不安。
meaning_en: to feel guilty as a thief (idiom); to have sth on one's conscience

meaning_cn: 比泰山还要重。形容意义重大。
meaning_en: heavier than Mt Tai (idiom); fig. extremely serious matter

meaning_cn: 把死看得象回家一样平常。形容不怕牺牲生命。
meaning_en: to view death as a return home; to not be afraid of dying; to face death with equanimity (idiom)

meaning_cn: 怀包藏。没安好心。
meaning_en: (idiom) to harbor evil designs; to harbor malicious intentions

meaning_cn: 相传王羲之在木板上写字，木工刻时，发现字迹透入木板三分深。形容书法极有笔力。现多比喻分析问题很深刻。
meaning_en: written in a forceful hand; penetrating; profound

meaning_cn: 指因过分兴奋或得意而忘了应有的举止。
meaning_en: (idiom) to get carried away; to lose one's sense of proportion

meaning_cn: 比喻把说过多次的理论、主张重新搬出来。也比喻把搁置很久的技艺重新做起来。亦作旧调重弹”、重弹老调”。
meaning_en: to play the same old tune (idiom); unoriginal

meaning_cn: 通通。
meaning_en: erhua variant of 一股腦|一股脑[yi1 gu3 nao3]

meaning_cn: 多事事故或事变多；秋时期。事故或事变很多的时期。
meaning_en: (idiom) troubled times; eventful period

meaning_cn: 形容人身躯短小，精明强悍。也形容文章或发言简短而有力。
meaning_en: (of a person) short but plucky (idiom); (of an article) concise and forceful

meaning_cn: 平平庸庸，无所作为。
meaning_en: unaccomplished; mediocre; feckless

meaning_cn: 痴傻。原指对痴人说梦话而痴人信以为真。比喻凭借荒唐的想象胡言乱语。
meaning_en: lunatic ravings; nonsense

meaning_cn: 痛痒比喻疾苦或紧要的事。指与自身利害没有关系或无足轻重。
meaning_en: (idiom) to not affect sb; irrelevant; of no importance; insignificant

meaning_cn: 劫灾难；余生侥幸保全的生命。经历灾难以后幸存下来的生命。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be a survivor of a calamity

meaning_cn: 抑降低；扬升高；顿停顿；挫转折。指声音的高低起伏和停顿转折。
meaning_en: see 頓挫抑揚|顿挫抑扬[dun4 cuo4 yi4 yang2]

meaning_cn: 比喻接受父母疼爱的儿女，特指女儿。
meaning_en: lit. a pearl in the palm (idiom); fig. beloved person (esp. daughter)

meaning_cn: 牵拉。形容十分惦念，放心不下。
meaning_en: deeply worried (idiom); to feel anxious

meaning_cn: 登上；峰山顶；造到达；极最高点。比喻学问、技能等达到最高的境界或成就。
meaning_en: to reach great heights (in technical skills or scholastic achievements)

meaning_cn: 过一天象过一年那样长。形容日子很不好过。
meaning_en: a day drags past like a year (idiom); time hangs heavy; time crawls when one is wretched

meaning_cn: 浩广大；烟海茫茫大海。形容典籍、图书等极为丰富。
meaning_en: vast as the open sea (idiom); fig. extensive (library)

meaning_cn: 指办事公正，没有私心。现多指从集体利益出发，毫无个人打算。
meaning_en: selfless; impartial

meaning_cn: 洞中另有一个天地。形容风景奇特，引人入胜。
meaning_en: place of charm and beauty; scenery of exceptional charm; completely different world

meaning_cn: 端头绪。形容变化极多。也指变化很大。
meaning_en: changeable; changing; varied; full of changes

meaning_cn: 姬指西楚霸王项羽的宠妾虞姬。形容英雄末路的悲壮情景。现多比喻独断专行，脱离群众，最终垮台。
meaning_en: The Conqueror Bids Farewell to His Favorite Concubine (tragic opera by Mei Lanfang 梅蘭芳|梅兰芳[Mei2 Lan2 fang1]); Farewell My Concubine (1993 film by Chen Kaige)

meaning_cn: 形容吐字准确，唱腔圆熟。
meaning_en: to enunciate beautifully (in speaking or singing) (idiom)

meaning_cn: 天地转动。比喻重大的变化。也形容眩晕时的感觉或闹得极凶。
meaning_en: the sky spins, the earth goes round (idiom); giddy with one's head spinning; fig. huge changes in the world

meaning_cn: 患灾祸；未然没有这样，指尚未形成。防止事故或祸害于尚未发生之前。
meaning_en: to prevent troubles before the event (idiom); to forestall; to nip sth in the bud

meaning_cn: 九表示极多。形容经历很大危险而幸存。也形容处在生死关头，情况十分危急。
meaning_en: nine deaths and still alive (idiom); a narrow escape; new lease of life

meaning_cn: 世、俗指一般人。使一般人感到惊骇。
meaning_en: universally shocking; to offend the whole of society

meaning_cn: 药一服下病就好了。形容用药效果非趁。
meaning_en: lit. the disease is cured the moment the medicine is taken (idiom); fig. (of a medical treatment) to give instant results; (of a solution or method) highly effective

meaning_cn: 原指成年后才出家做和尚或尼姑。比喻中途改行，从事另一工作。
meaning_en: (lit.) to enter monastic life at a mature age (idiom); (fig.) to change one's career; to take up a new line of work or specialization; to enter a profession from a different background

meaning_cn: 芸芸形容众多；众生原指一切生物，后指许多人。原指世间的一切生灵◇多指大群无知无识的人。
meaning_en: every living being (Buddhism); the mass of common people

meaning_cn: 形容活泼矫健，富有生气。
meaning_en: lit. lively dragon and animated tiger (idiom); fig. vigorous and lively

meaning_cn: 堂、室古代宫室，前面是堂，后面是室。登上厅堂，进入内室。比喻学问或技能从浅到深，达到很高的水平。
meaning_en: (lit.) from the main room, enter the inner chamber (idiom); (fig.) to go to the next level; to attain a higher level

meaning_cn: 平川地势平坦的地方。能够纵马疾驰的一片广阔平地。指广阔的平原。
meaning_en: flat land one could gallop straight across (idiom); wide expanse of flat country

meaning_cn: 难灾祸。遇到巨大的灾难而没有死掉。形容幸运地脱险。
meaning_en: to just escape from calamity

meaning_cn: 本钱小，利润大。
meaning_en: small capital, huge profit (idiom); to put in a little and get a lot out

meaning_cn: 悦愉快，高兴；诚硬实。由衷地高兴，真心地服气。指真心地服气或服从。
meaning_en: to submit cheerfully; to accept willingly (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指人世间极美好的地方。
meaning_en: heaven on Earth; nickname for the city Suzhou

meaning_cn: 昂扬情绪高涨。斗争的意志旺盛。
meaning_en: having high fighting spirit

meaning_cn: 假借；济帮助。假借公家的名义，谋取私人的利益。
meaning_en: official authority used for private interests (idiom); to attain private ends by abusing public position

meaning_cn: 以后的祸害没有个完。
meaning_en: (idiom) there will be no end of trouble in the future

meaning_cn: 独身往来，不与人为伍。比喻事事不与人相同。
meaning_en: (idiom) to come and go alone; to act independently; (fig.) to keep to oneself; to be a loner

meaning_cn: 原指战国时代楚国的一种较高级的歌曲。比喻高深的不通俗的文学艺术。
meaning_en: melodies of the elite in the state of Chu 楚國|楚国[Chu3 guo2]; highbrow art and literature

meaning_cn: 一年半年。泛指一段时间。
meaning_en: about a year

meaning_cn: 交一起，同时。衣食无着，又饿又冷。形容生活极端贫困。
meaning_en: beset by hunger and cold (idiom); starving and freezing; in desperate poverty

meaning_cn: 骑在老虎背上不能下来。比喻做一件事情进行下去有困难，但情况又不允许中途停止，陷于进退两难的境地。
meaning_en: if you ride a tiger, it's hard to get off (idiom); fig. impossible to stop halfway

meaning_cn: 样模样、姿态。指故意做作，故做姿态。
meaning_en: (idiom) to put on an act; to show affectation; to indulge in histrionics

meaning_cn: 抬起眼睛，看不见一个亲人。比喻单身在外，人地生疏。
meaning_en: to look up and see no-one familiar (idiom); not having anyone to rely on; without a friend in the world

meaning_cn: 挥散。把钱财当成泥土一样挥霍。形容极端挥霍浪费。
meaning_en: lit. to squander money like dirt (idiom); fig. to spend money like water; extravagant

meaning_cn: 畏怕，惧。前也怕，后也怕。比喻做事胆子小，顾虑多。
meaning_en: afraid of the head, terrified of the tail (idiom); ever fearful and nervous; afraid of the slightest thing

meaning_cn: 没有地方可以让自己容身。形容非常羞愧。
meaning_en: (idiom) ashamed and unable to show one's face

meaning_cn: 意思是他送给我桃儿，我以李子回赠他。比喻友好往来或互相赠送东西。
meaning_en: toss a peach, get back a plum (idiom); to return a favor; to exchange gifts; Scratch my back, and I'll scratch yours.

meaning_cn: 原形原来的形状；毕完全。本来面目完全暴露。指伪装被彻底揭开。
meaning_en: original identity fully revealed (idiom); fig. to unmask and expose the whole truth

meaning_cn: 眼力过高，手法过低。指要求的标准很高（甚至不切实际），但实际上自己也做不到。
meaning_en: to have high standards but little ability; to be fastidious but incompetent (idiom)

meaning_cn: 残垣倒了的短墙。残存和坍塌了的墙壁。形容残败的景象。
meaning_en: (lit.) broken walls and crumbling remnants (idiom); (fig.) scene of devastation; ruins

meaning_cn: 盖遮掩；弥更加；彰明显。想掩盖坏事的真相，结果反而更明显地暴露出来。
meaning_en: trying to hide it makes it more conspicuous (idiom); A cover up only makes matters worse.

meaning_cn: 妄胡乱，非分的，出了常规的。妄为胡作非为。指不顾一切由着自己的性子胡作非为。亦作肆意妄行”。
meaning_en: see 恣意妄為|恣意妄为[zi4 yi4 wang4 wei2]

meaning_cn: 强词强辩；夺争。指无理强辩，明明没理硬说有理。
meaning_en: to twist words and force logic (idiom); sophistry; loud rhetoric making up for fallacious argument; shoving false arguments down people's throats

meaning_cn: 不二指不是两极端；法门佧行入道的门径。原为佛家语，意为直接入道，不可言传的法门◇比喻最好的或独一无二的方法。
meaning_en: the one and only way; the only proper course to take

meaning_cn: 损害别人，使自己得到好处。
meaning_en: harming others for one's personal benefit (idiom); personal gain to the detriment of others

meaning_cn: 重视或优待一方，轻视或怠慢另一方。比喻对两方面的待遇不同。
meaning_en: to favour one and discriminate against the other

meaning_cn: 拿邻国当做大水坑，把本国的洪水排泄到那里去。比喻只图自己一方的利益，把困难或祸害转嫁给别人。
meaning_en: to use one's neighbor as a drain; to shift one's problems onto others (idiom)

meaning_cn: 郑重审慎，严肃认真。形容说话做事时态度非常严肃认真。
meaning_en: serious about the matter

meaning_cn: 光怪光彩奇异；陆离开卷参差。形容奇形怪状，五颜六色。
meaning_en: monstrous and multicolored; grotesque and variegated

meaning_cn: 出自恶毒用心去诽谤诬陷伤害别人，中伤说坏话攻击陷害别人。
meaning_en: to slander maliciously

meaning_cn: 访问贫苦的老百姓。
meaning_en: to visit the poor and ask about their suffering (idiom)

meaning_cn: 看过就不忘记。形容记忆力非常强。
meaning_en: to have a highly retentive memory; to have sth imprinted in one's memory

meaning_cn: 喧声音大。客人的声音压倒了主人的声音。比喻外来的或次要的事物占据了原有的或主要的事物的位置。
meaning_en: lit. the voice of the guest overwhelms that of the host (idiom); fig. a minor player upstages the main attraction; minor details obscure the main point; the sauce is better than the fish

meaning_cn: 疾病多是由食物传染。比喻应该注意饮食卫生。
meaning_en: Illness enters by the mouth (idiom). Mind what you eat!; fig. A loose tongue may cause a lot of trouble.

meaning_cn: 糊里糊涂，什么也不知道。
meaning_en: (idiom) confused; ignorant; muddle-headed

meaning_cn: 原来的病又犯了。
meaning_en: old illness recurs (idiom); a relapse; fig. to repeat an old error; the same old problem

meaning_cn: 指计划得很周密，考虑得很长远。
meaning_en: lit. deep plans and distant thoughts; to plan far ahead (idiom)

meaning_cn: 花儿正盛开，月亮正圆满。比喻美好圆满。多用于棕人新婚。
meaning_en: lit. lovely flowers, round moon (idiom); fig. everything is wonderful; perfect happiness; conjugal bliss

meaning_cn: 云说。不知道说得是些么。形容说话内容混乱，无法理解。
meaning_en: to not know what sb is driving at; to be unintelligible

meaning_cn: 交头头靠着头；接耳嘴凑近耳朵。形容两个人凑近低声交谈。
meaning_en: to whisper to one another's ear

meaning_cn: 神、化指神妙的境域。极其高超的境界。形容文学艺术达到极高的成就。
meaning_en: to reach perfection (idiom); a superb artistic achievement

meaning_cn: 得意扬扬自得的样子。旧时形容考中进士后的兴奋心情◇形容职位升迁顺利。
meaning_en: flushed with success; proud of one's success (in exams, promotion etc); as pleased as punch

meaning_cn: 颐指动下巴示意，指挥别人；气使用神情气色支使人。不说话而用面部表示表情示意。形容有权势的人指挥别人的傲慢态度。
meaning_en: lit. to order people by pointing the chin (idiom); to signal orders by facial gesture; arrogant and bossy

meaning_cn: 陈陈旧，陈腐；滥浮泛不合实际。指陈腐、空泛的论调。
meaning_en: cliché; commonplace; truism; stereotype

meaning_cn: 到处奔波。多指为生活所迫或为某一目的四处奔走活动。
meaning_en: to run this way and that (idiom); to rush about busily; to bustle about; to hopscotch; also 東跑西顛|东跑西颠[dong1 pao3 xi1 dian1]

meaning_cn: 穷困贫穷、困难；潦倒失意。生活贫困，失意颓丧。
meaning_en: (idiom) to live in poverty and despair; down and out; destitute and without hope

meaning_cn: 一世一时。认为当代的人都不行。形容目空一切、狂妄自大到了极点。
meaning_en: (idiom) to consider oneself unexcelled in the world; to be insufferably arrogant

meaning_cn: 袖子长，有利于起舞。原指有所依靠，事情就容易成功◇形容有财势会耍手腕的人，善于钻营，会走门路。
meaning_en: long sleeves help one dance beautifully (idiom); money and power will help you in any occupation

meaning_cn: 表外表；里内心。表面和内心象一个东西。形容言行和思想完全一致。
meaning_en: external appearance and inner thoughts coincide (idiom); to say what one means; to think and act as one

meaning_cn: 这一年吃了下一年的粮。比喻经济困难，收入不够支出，预先支用了以后的进项。比喻指经济困难，入不敷出。
meaning_en: lit. eating away next year's food in advance; fig. to dip into the next month's check; live now, pay later

meaning_cn: 按照惯例办理的公事。现在多指刻板的形式主义的工作。
meaning_en: routine business; usual practice; mere formality

meaning_cn: 比喻追究底细。
meaning_en: to dig up roots and inquire at the base (idiom); to get to the bottom of sth

meaning_cn: 自己能从中得到乐趣。
meaning_en: to find amusement in one's own way; to enjoy oneself quietly

meaning_cn: 因担心而手上出汗。形容非常紧张的心情。
meaning_en: to break out into a cold sweat (idiom)

meaning_cn: 六神道家认为人的心、肺、肝、肾、脾、胆各有神灵主宰，称为六神。形容惊慌着急，没了主意，不知如何才好。
meaning_en: out of one's wits (idiom); distracted; stunned

meaning_cn: 躲避闪开，以免遇到某些情况。亦形容遮遮盖盖，支支吾吾，不坦率，不直爽。
meaning_en: to evade; to dodge (out of the way)

meaning_cn: 一夜分为五更，三更是午夜十二时。指深夜。
meaning_en: see 三更半夜[san1 geng1 ban4 ye4]

meaning_cn: 冷眼冷静或冷漠的眼光。指不参与其事，站在一旁看事情的发展。
meaning_en: (idiom) to observe with an indifferent attitude; to be a bystander (usually referring to someone who could get involved but chooses not to)

meaning_cn: 勃然突然。突然变脸大发脾气。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fly into a rage; to see red

meaning_cn: 先张扬自己的声势以压倒对方。也比喻做事抢先一步。
meaning_en: to gain the upper hand by a show of strength

meaning_cn: 声势力量大。
meaning_en: many men, a great force (idiom); many hands provide great strength; There is safety in numbers.

meaning_cn: 跟天和地存在的时间那样长。形容时间悠久。也形容永远不变（多指爱情）。
meaning_en: enduring while the world lasts (idiom); eternal

meaning_cn: 原指臣子先把人处决了，然后再报告帝王。现比喻未经请示就先做了某事，造成既成事实，然后再向上级报告。
meaning_en: (lit.) execute sb first, then report to the emperor (idiom); (fig.) to act first and report later; to take action without prior approval

meaning_cn: 力竭力；排排队；议议论、意见。竭力排除各种意议论，使自己的意见占上风。
meaning_en: to stand one's ground against the opinion of the masses (idiom)

meaning_cn: 穷途处境困窘。形容到了无路可走的地步。
meaning_en: lit. the path exhausted, the end of the road (idiom); an impasse; in a plight with no way out; things have reached a dead end

meaning_cn: 机机会；时时机∶的时机不可放过，失掉了不会再来。
meaning_en: No time to lose! (idiom)

meaning_cn: 由听从，随顺。听任事态自然发展变化，不做主观努力。也比喻碰机会，该怎么样就怎么样。
meaning_en: (idiom) to submit to the will of heaven; to resign oneself to fate; to trust to luck

meaning_cn: 戒警惕，预防。警惕并防止产生骄傲和急躁情绪。
meaning_en: to guard against pride and impatience (idiom); to remain modest and keep cool

meaning_cn: 得了一寸，还想再进一尺。比喻贪心不足，有了小的，又要大的。
meaning_en: lit. win an inch, want a foot (idiom); fig. not satisfied with small gains; give him an inch, and he'll want a mile

meaning_cn: 把山上的草木都当做敌兵。形容人在惊慌时疑神疑鬼。
meaning_en: lit. every tree or bush an enemy soldier (idiom); fig. to panic and treat everyone as an enemy; to feel beleaguered

meaning_cn: 指子女对父母身前的赡养和死后的殡葬。
meaning_en: to look after one's aged parents and arrange proper burial after they die

meaning_cn: 所有的人都说同样的话。
meaning_en: all of one voice; unanimous

meaning_cn: 用较长的时间慎重考虑、仔细商量。
meaning_en: (idiom) to take one's time making a decision; to consider at length

meaning_cn: 说怎么样就怎么样。形容说话算数。
meaning_en: to say one and mean just that (idiom); to keep one's word

meaning_cn: 回天比喻力量大，能移转极难挽回的时势；乏术缺少方法。比喻局势或病情严重，已无法挽救。
meaning_en: (idiom) nothing can be done to remedy the situation; beyond recovery

meaning_cn: 头发昏，眼发花。
meaning_en: to faint with blurred vision (idiom); dizzy and eyes dimmed

meaning_cn: 博丰富。指国家疆土辽阔，资源丰富。
meaning_en: vast territory with abundant resources (idiom)

meaning_cn: 终人死；远指祖先。旧指慎重地办理父母丧事，虔诚地祭祀远代祖先◇也指谨慎从事，追念前贤。
meaning_en: to pay careful attention to one's parents' funerary rites

meaning_cn: 掬双手捧取。形容笑容满面。
meaning_en: smiling wholeheartedly (idiom); beaming from ear to ear

meaning_cn: 功德功业和德行；无量无法计算。旧时指功劳恩德非常大。现多用来称赞做了好事。
meaning_en: no end of virtuous achievements (idiom); boundless beneficence

meaning_cn: 虚无空虚；缥缈隐隐约约，若有若无的样子。形容空虚渺茫。
meaning_en: illusory; imaginary; fanciful

meaning_cn: 指官员之间互相包庇。
meaning_en: officials shield one another (idiom); a cover-up

meaning_cn: 原形容身体各部位匀称、结实◇常形容说话做事稳当。也形容做事只求不出差错，缺乏积极创新精神。
meaning_en: everything steady and stable (idiom); overcautious and unimaginary

meaning_cn: 从出生到现在。
meaning_en: (idiom) since birth; for one's whole life

meaning_cn: 轻易地了结纠纷，心甘情愿地停止再闹。
meaning_en: (idiom) to let the matter rest; to just let it go; to take it lying down (usu. used in the negative)

meaning_cn: 开拓疆域，扩展领土。
meaning_en: (idiom) to expand one's territory; to conquer new lands; (fig.) to expand one's business into new markets

meaning_cn: 蝉变为成虫时要脱去一层壳。比喻用计脱身，使人不能及时发觉。
meaning_en: lit. the cicada sheds its carapace (idiom); fig. to vanish leaving an empty shell; a crafty escape plan

meaning_cn: 说大话，不感到难为情。
meaning_en: to boast shamelessly; to talk big

meaning_cn: 天真指心地单纯，没有做作和虚伪；烂漫坦率自然的样子。形容儿童思想单纯、活泼可爱，没有做作和虚伪。
meaning_en: (idiom) innocent and unaffected

meaning_cn: 山和水都到了尽头。比喻无路可走陷入绝境。
meaning_en: mountain and river exhausted (idiom); at the end of the line; nowhere to go

meaning_cn: 足够。穿的吃的都很丰富充足。形容生活富裕。
meaning_en: having ample food and clothing (idiom); well fed and clothed

meaning_cn: 人烟指住户、居民，因有炊烟的地方就有人居住。形容地方偏僻荒凉，见不到人家。
meaning_en: desolate and uninhabited (idiom)

meaning_cn: 爱爱惜；莫不。虽然心中关切同情，却没有力量帮助。
meaning_en: unable to help however much one would like to (idiom); Although we sympathize, there is no way to help you.; My hands are tied.

meaning_cn: 表示吃惊的声音。形容不合常理，难以理解的怪事。
meaning_en: (idiom) extraordinary occurrence; bizarre event

meaning_cn: 璀璨美玉发光。光辉灿烂耀人眼睛。
meaning_en: dazzling (idiom)

meaning_cn: 暴、骤急速，突然。又猛又急的大风雨。比喻声势浩大，发展急速而猛烈。
meaning_en: violent wind and rainstorm; hurricane; tempest

meaning_cn: ①反复阐说。②犹言总而言之。
meaning_en: (idiom) when all is said and done

meaning_cn: 感激的心情没有穷尽。形容非常感激。
meaning_en: can't thank sb enough (idiom)

meaning_cn: 风里夹着腥味，雨点带着鲜血。形容疯狂杀戮的凶险气氛或环境。
meaning_en: see 腥風血雨|腥风血雨[xing1 feng1 xue4 yu3]

meaning_cn: 俑古代殉葬用的木制或陶制的俑人。开始制作俑的人。比喻首先做某件坏事的人。
meaning_en: (lit.) the first person to make funerary figurines (idiom); (fig.) the originator of an evil practice

meaning_cn: 张张开；舞挥舞。形容猛兽凶恶可怕。也比喻猖狂凶恶。
meaning_en: to bare fangs and brandish claws (idiom); to make threatening gestures

meaning_cn: 丧丧失；天良良心。没有一点良心。形容恶毒到了极点。
meaning_en: devoid of conscience (idiom); utterly heartless

meaning_cn: 大家心里明白，不必再用言语解释。
meaning_en: needless to say; it goes without saying

meaning_cn: 洋西洋，指西方国家；媚谄媚。崇拜西方一切，谄媚外国人。指丧失民族自尊心，一味奉承巴结外国人。
meaning_en: to revere everything foreign and pander to overseas powers (idiom); blind worship of foreign goods and ideas

meaning_cn: 指提升了官职，同时就能获得更多的物质财富。
meaning_en: to be promoted and gain wealth (idiom)

meaning_cn: 平白凭空；故缘故。指无缘无故。
meaning_en: (idiom) for no reason whatever; inexplicably

meaning_cn: 容容纳；包包含。把各个方面全都容纳包括进来。
meaning_en: to include and monopolize many things; all-embracing

meaning_cn: 定安定。形容心情不平静。
meaning_en: to feel ill at ease

meaning_cn: 勉勉强；为做。勉强去做能力所不及或不愿去做的事。
meaning_en: to tackle a difficult job (idiom); to do sth reluctantly

meaning_cn: 不分白天黑夜拼命赶路。
