meaning_en: to travel day and night

meaning_cn: 累重叠；牍古代写字的木片。形容篇幅过多，文辞冗长。
meaning_en: (of a piece of writing) long and tedious (idiom); verbose

meaning_cn: 舍舍弃；逐追求。抛弃根本的、主要的，而去追求枝节的、次要的。比喻不抓根本环节，而只在枝节问题上下功夫。
meaning_en: to neglect the root and pursue the tip (idiom); to neglect fundamentals and concentrate on details

meaning_cn: 厌满足。贪心永远没有满足的时候。
meaning_en: avaricious and insatiable (idiom); greedy and never satisfied

meaning_cn: 浑浑深厚的样子；噩噩严肃的样子。原意是浑厚而严正。现形容糊里糊涂，愚昧无知。
meaning_en: (idiom) muddleheaded

meaning_cn: 用另一种眼光看待。指看待某个人不同一般。也指不被重视的人得到重视。
meaning_en: to treat sb favorably; to view in a new light

meaning_cn: 酩酊沉醉的样子。形容醉得很厉害。
meaning_en: (idiom) dead drunk; plastered; as drunk as a lord

meaning_cn: 沽买；钓用饵引鱼上钩，比喻骗取。用某种不正当的手段捞取名誉。
meaning_en: to angle for fame (idiom); to fish for compliments

meaning_cn: 无常变化不定。形容常常变化，一会儿是这样，一会儿又是那样，变动不定。
meaning_en: unstable; erratic; changeable; fickle

meaning_cn: 象鹤站在鸡群中一样。比喻一个人的仪表或才能在周围一群人里显得很突出。
meaning_en: a crane in a flock of chicken (idiom); way above the common; manifestly superior

meaning_cn: 想找都找不到。原指急切企求，但不能得到◇多形容迫切希望得到。
meaning_en: lit. seek but fail to get (idiom); fig. exactly what one’s been looking for

meaning_cn: 比翼翅膀挨着翅膀。齐飞成双的并飞。比喻夫妻情投意合，在事业上并肩前进。
meaning_en: to fly wing to wing (idiom); two hearts beating as one; (of a couple) inseparable

meaning_cn: 飞黄传说中神马名；腾达上升，引伸为发迹，宦途得意。形容骏马奔腾飞驰。比喻骤然得志，官职升得很快。
meaning_en: lit. the divine steed Feihuang gallops (idiom); fig. to achieve meteoric success in one's career

meaning_cn: 桅杆或杂技长竿的顶端。比喻极高的官位和功名，或学问、事业有很高的成就。
meaning_en: to be at the highest level of enlightenment (Buddhist expression)

meaning_cn: 惶恐惧。内心害怕，十分不安。
meaning_en: anxious; panicky

meaning_cn: 嘴里说出狂妄自大的话。指说话狂妄、放肆。也指胡说八道。
meaning_en: to speak conceited nonsense; to come out with arrogant claptrap

meaning_cn: 卵蛋。为了要得到鸡蛋，不惜把鸡杀了。比喻贪图眼前的好处而不顾长远利益。
meaning_en: lit. to kill the chicken to get the eggs (idiom); fig. to kill the goose that lays the golden eggs

meaning_cn: 不停的哭泣。
meaning_en: to weep endlessly; interminable wailing

meaning_cn: 形容一时特别兴盛或流行。
meaning_en: all the rage for a time; grand fashion for a limited time

meaning_cn: 指事先未经周密考虑。
meaning_en: accidentally; to act before thinking

meaning_cn: 指因极度的疼痛或悲哀，晕过去，又醒过来。多形容被打得很惨，或哭得很厉害。
meaning_en: to hover between life and death (idiom); to suffer terribly; within an inch of one's life

meaning_cn: 经经历。指经过很久的时间；长时间。
meaning_en: for years; over the years

meaning_cn: 形容认识一致，共同努力。
meaning_en: to work as one (idiom); united in a concerted effort; working hard together

meaning_cn: 闻听见；睹看见。亲耳听到，亲眼看见。
meaning_en: to witness personally

meaning_cn: 嫌弃贫穷，喜爱富有。指对人的好恶以其贫富为准。
meaning_en: to favor the rich and disdain the poor (idiom); snobbish

meaning_cn: 宁宁愿；毋不；滥过度。盐人才或挑选事物，宁可少一些，也不要不顾质量贪多凑数。
meaning_en: better to have nothing (than substandard choice) (idiom); would prefer to go without than accept shoddy option

meaning_cn: 心里挂着很多沉重的顾虑。
meaning_en: to have a lot on one's mind; to be laden with anxiety

meaning_cn: 扔在东流的水里冲走。比喻希望落空，成果丧失，前功尽弃，好象随着流水冲走了一样。
meaning_en: to commit to the waters (idiom); to lose sth irrevocably

meaning_cn: 恨到骨头里去。形容痛恨到极点。
meaning_en: to hate sb to the bone (idiom)

meaning_cn: 禁承受。形容身体娇弱，连风吹都经受不起。
meaning_en: (lit.) too weak to stand up to the wind (idiom); (fig.) extremely delicate; fragile

meaning_cn: 悔后悔；当初开头，起初◇悔不在当初采取另一种行动。
meaning_en: to regret one's past deeds (idiom)

meaning_cn: 高高贵。高贵的朋友坐满了席位。形容宾客很多。
meaning_en: surrounded by distinguished friends (idiom); in company

meaning_cn: 六甲传说为上帝造物的日子。指妇女怀孕。
meaning_en: to be pregnant (idiom)

meaning_cn: 知道满足，就总是快乐。形容安于已经得到的利益、地位。
meaning_en: satisfied with what one has (idiom)

meaning_cn: 惺忪刚苏醒的样子。形容睡觉的人刚睡醒，还没有完全清醒。
meaning_en: (idiom) sleepy-eyed; still half asleep

meaning_cn: 鼻子发青，脸部肿起。形容脸部伤势严重。
meaning_en: a bloody nose and a swollen face; badly battered

meaning_cn: 说的是一套，做的又是另外一套。
meaning_en: (idiom) to say one thing and do another

meaning_cn: 绿油油的草好象地上铺的褥子。常指可供临时休憩的草地。亦作碧草如茵”。
meaning_en: green grass like cushion (idiom); green meadow so inviting to sleep on

meaning_cn: 看见人要掉进陷井里，不伸手救他，反而推他下去，又扔下石头。比喻乘人有危难时加以陷害。
meaning_en: to throw stones at sb who has fallen down a well (idiom); to hit a person when he's down

meaning_cn: 步步表示距离很短；高升往上升。指职位不断上升。
meaning_en: to climb step by step; to rise steadily; on the up and up

meaning_cn: 行做，办；是对的。按照各自认为对的去做。比喻各搞一套。
meaning_en: each one does what he thinks is right (idiom); each goes his own way

meaning_cn: 顺着水流的方向推船。比喻顺着某个趋势或某种方便说话办事。
meaning_en: lit. to push the boat with the current; fig. to take advantage of the situation for one's own benefit

meaning_cn: 匠心工巧的心思。独创性地运用精巧的心思。
meaning_en: original and ingenious (idiom); to show great creativity

meaning_cn: 多方面想了又想。
meaning_en: to turn over in one's mind (idiom); to think through from different angles; to ponder

meaning_cn: 比喻修改文章时稍稍改动原来的文字，就使它变得很出色。
meaning_en: to touch base matter and turn it to gold (idiom); fig. to turn crude writing into a literary gem

meaning_cn: 一群龙没有领头的。比喻没有领头的，无法统一行动。
meaning_en: lit. a thunder of dragons without a head; fig. a group lacking a leader

meaning_cn: 指亲缘关系近的家畜个体间交配繁殖。可以用于领导干部在自己权利范围内任人唯亲。
meaning_en: inbreeding

meaning_cn: 迷信的人认为人的一切遭遇都是命运预先决定的，人力无法挽回。
meaning_en: decreed by fate (idiom); destined; fated

meaning_cn: 原指旧时诗文里经常描写的自然景物◇比喻堆砌词藻、内容贫乏空洞的诗文。也指爱情之事或花天酒地的荒淫生活。
meaning_en: wind, flower, snow and moon, trite poetry subject (idiom); effete language without substance; love affair; romance is in the air; dissipated life

meaning_cn: 形容失败到了不可收拾的地步。
meaning_en: lit. defeated, the ground blanketed with bodies (idiom); fig. to suffer a crushing defeat

meaning_cn: 混淆使界限不清。故意把正确的说成错误的，把错误的说成正确的。
meaning_en: to confuse right and wrong (idiom)

meaning_cn: 隐约显现出刀剑的闪光和影子。形容环境充满了凶险的气氛。
meaning_en: lit. flash of knives and swords (idiom); fig. intense conflict

meaning_cn: 非命横死。在意外的灾祸中死亡。
meaning_en: violent death (idiom); to die in a disaster; an unnatural death

meaning_cn: 滂沱雨大而多的样子。形容寸下得很大。
meaning_en: see 滂沱大雨[pang1 tuo2 da4 yu3]

meaning_cn: 不可能再增加。指程度达到了极点。
meaning_en: in the extreme (idiom); incapable of further increase

meaning_cn: 聊赖依赖。精神上无所寄托，感到什么都没意思。
meaning_en: (idiom) bored to death; bored stiff; overcome with boredom

meaning_cn: 精神疲乏，气力用尽。形容精神和身体极度疲劳。
meaning_en: spirit weary, strength exhausted (idiom); spent; drained; washed out

meaning_cn: 形容说话浮夸不切实际。
meaning_en: (idiom) to talk big; to sound off; to be full of hot air

meaning_cn: 手中掌握有很大权力。
meaning_en: to be in a position of power

meaning_cn: 线微小；生机生存的机会。还有一点儿生存的希望。
meaning_en: (idiom) a chance of survival; a fighting chance; a ray of hope

meaning_cn: 心怀坦白，言行正派。
meaning_en: just and honorable

meaning_cn: 长驱不停顿地策马快跑；直入一直往前。指长距离不停顿的快速行进。形容进军迅猛，不可阻挡。
meaning_en: to march straight in unchallenged (military) (idiom); (fig.) to push deep into the heart of sth; to flood in

meaning_cn: 怡然安适愉快的样子。形容高兴而满足的样子。
meaning_en: happy and content (idiom)

meaning_cn: 令使；智理智；昏昏乱，神智不清。因贪图私利而失去理智，把什么都忘了。
meaning_en: to lose one's head through material greed (idiom)

meaning_cn: 涎口水。口水挂下三尺长。形容极其贪婪的样子。也形容非常眼热。
meaning_en: to drool (over) (idiom); to yearn for; to covet; to crave

meaning_cn: 本不应该生枝的地方生枝。比喻在原有问题之外又岔出了新问题。多指故意设置障碍，使问题不能顺利解决。
meaning_en: (idiom) new problems arise unexpectedly

meaning_cn: 投相合。形容双方思想感情融洽，合得来。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have an affinity with each other; to find each other congenial

meaning_cn: 指心神悲沮的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) depressed; dispirited

meaning_cn: 比喻出名，显露才能。
meaning_en: to reveal one's talent (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指吉庆之事。
meaning_en: the dragon and phoenix are symbols of good fortune (idiom); auspicious; decorated with auspicious symbols such as the dragon and the phoenix

meaning_cn: 旧指富贵以后回到故乡‖有向乡里夸耀的意思。
meaning_en: lit. to come back to one's hometown in silken robes (idiom); fig. to return home after making good; Taiwan pr. [yi4 jin3 huan2 xiang1]

meaning_cn: 兵戎武器。以武力相见。指用战争解决问题。
meaning_en: to meet on the battlefield (idiom)

meaning_cn: 深而大的仇恨。
meaning_en: (idiom) bitter hatred

meaning_cn: 声名名誉；狼藉杂乱不堪。名声败坏到了极点。
meaning_en: to have a bad reputation

meaning_cn: 指缝隙严密闭合。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fit together snugly; to dovetail perfectly

meaning_cn: 执言说公道话。为了正义说公道话。指能伸张正义。
meaning_en: to speak out for justice (idiom); to take a stand on a matter of principle

meaning_cn: 依然仍旧；故过去，从前。指人没有什么长进，还是从前的老样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) back to where we were; absolutely no improvement; things haven't changed at all

meaning_cn: 血气精力；方正；刚强劲。形容年青人精力正旺盛。
meaning_en: full of sap (idiom); young and vigorous

meaning_cn: 对答回答。回答问话象流水一样快。形容口才好，反应快。
meaning_en: able to reply quickly and fluently (idiom); having a ready answer

meaning_cn: 认真学习，刻苦训练。
meaning_en: to study diligently; to train assiduously

meaning_cn: 指有彩绘装饰的十分华丽的房屋。
meaning_en: richly ornamented (building)

meaning_cn: 孺小孩。妇女、小孩全都知道。指众所周知。
meaning_en: understood by everyone (idiom); well known; a household name

meaning_cn: 沽卖。等有好价钱才卖。比喻谁给好的待遇就替谁工作。
meaning_en: to sell only for a good price (idiom); to wait for a good offer

meaning_cn: 物内容。文章或讲话有具体内容。
meaning_en: (of one's words) to have substance

meaning_cn: 义道理。词言辞。道理正当公允，严肃的措词。亦作义正辞严”、辞严义正”、辞严意正”、词严理正”、正义严辞”。
meaning_en: variant of 義正辭嚴|义正辞严[yi4 zheng4 ci2 yan2]

meaning_cn: 迷途迷失道路；返回来。迷了路知道回来。比喻发觉自己犯了错误，知道改正。
meaning_en: to get back on the right path; to mend one's ways

meaning_cn: 无常没有常态。指事物经常变化，没有规律性。
meaning_en: (idiom) changeable; fickle

meaning_cn: 耸直立，高起。高高地直立，直入云端。形容建筑物、山峰等高峻挺拔。
meaning_en: tall and erect, reaching through the clouds (idiom); used to describe tall mountain or skyscraper

meaning_cn: 一个人呼喊，马上有很多人响应。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a call) to elict an enthusiastic response; to receive extensive approval

meaning_cn: 舍古时行军计程以三十里为一舍。主动退让九十里。比喻退让和回避，避免冲突。
meaning_en: (lit.) to retreat ninety li (idiom); (fig.) to shun; to assiduously avoid

meaning_cn: 在困苦中勉强自寻欢乐。
meaning_en: to find joy in sorrows (idiom); to enjoy sth in spite of one's suffering

meaning_cn: 从听从；善好的，正确的；如流好象流水向下，形容迅速。形容能迅速地接受别人的好意见。
meaning_en: readily following good advice (idiom); willing to accept other people's views

meaning_cn: 薪柴草。睡觉睡在柴草上，吃饭睡觉都尝一尝苦胆。形容人刻苦自励，发奋图强。
meaning_en: variant of 臥薪嘗膽|卧薪尝胆[wo4 xin1 chang2 dan3]

meaning_cn: 故老友。不是亲属，也不是熟人。表示彼此没有什么关系。
meaning_en: lit. neither a relative nor a friend (idiom); fig. unrelated to one another in any way

meaning_cn: 抬起头，挺起胸膛。形容斗志高，士气旺。
meaning_en: head high, chest out (idiom); to keep up one's spirits; in fine mettle (of animal)

meaning_cn: 使、差指使∶象有鬼神在支使着一样，不自觉地做了原先没想到要做的事。
meaning_en: demons and gods at work (idiom); unexplained event crying out for a supernatural explanation; curious coincidence

meaning_cn: 不住地叫苦。形容十分痛苦。
meaning_en: to whine on for days (idiom); to endlessly grumble complaints; incessant whining

meaning_cn: 什么奇怪的事物都有。
meaning_en: nothing is too bizarre; full of extraordinary things

meaning_cn: 树种植，栽培。比喻培养人才是长期而艰巨的事。
meaning_en: (idiom) it takes many years to raise children to be upstanding citizens

meaning_cn: 戮力并力；同心齐心。齐心合力。
meaning_en: (idiom) to join forces to work towards a common goal

meaning_cn: 元勋有特大功绩的人。指为建立新的国家或朝代立大功的人。
meaning_en: founding figure (of a country or dynasty); founding father; fig. also used of company or school etc

meaning_cn: 卑低、自卑；亢高傲。指对人有恰当的分寸，既不低声下气，也不傲慢自大。
meaning_en: neither servile nor overbearing (idiom); neither obsequious nor supercilious

meaning_cn: 毫无根据的话。指背后散布的诽谤性的坏话。
meaning_en: rumors and slanders (idiom); gossip; lies and slanders

meaning_cn: 委曲曲意迁就。勉强迁就，以求保全。也指为了顾全大局而让步。
meaning_en: to accept a compromise

meaning_cn: 居心存心；叵不可；测推测。指存心险恶，不可推测。
meaning_en: harboring unfathomable motives (idiom)

meaning_cn: 士对人的尊称。指有理想有抱负的人。
meaning_en: (idiom) person committed to a noble cause or ideal

meaning_cn: 搬弄是非，使别人不团结。
meaning_en: to sow dissension (idiom); to drive a wedge between

meaning_cn: 匠心巧妙的心思。指在技巧和艺术方面具有与众不同的巧妙构思。
meaning_en: to show ingenuity; (of a design) clever; brilliantly conceived

meaning_cn: 原指说话做事有条有理，不慌不忙。现也形容说话做事慢腾腾，不不慌不忙。
meaning_en: unhurried; calm; composed; leisurely

meaning_cn: 革改变，革除；故旧的；鼎树立。旧指朝政变革或改朝换代。现泛指除去旧的，建立新的。
meaning_en: to discard the old and introduce the new (idiom); to innovate

meaning_cn: 罪恶大到了极点。
meaning_en: guilty of terrible crimes (idiom); reprehensible

meaning_cn: 所有的想法和打算都破灭了。形容极端灰心失望的心情。
meaning_en: every hope turns to dust (idiom); completely disheartened

meaning_cn: 装点装饰；门面指外观。比喻只把外表装饰得很漂亮。
meaning_en: lit. to decorate the front of one's store (idiom); fig. to embellish (one's CV, etc); to keep up appearances; to put up a front

meaning_cn: 享享受；成成果。自己不出力而享受别人取得的成果。
meaning_en: to reap where one has not sown (idiom)

meaning_cn: 平平稳；步行走；青云高空。指人一下子升到很高的地位上去。
meaning_en: to rapidly go up in the world; meteoric rise (of a career, social position etc)

meaning_cn: 诚实在，的确；惶害怕；恐畏惧。非常小心谨慎以至达到害怕不安的程度。
meaning_en: in fear and trepidation (idiom); in reverence before your majesty (court formula of humility)

meaning_cn: 达官大官。指地位高的大官和出身侯门身价显赫的人。
meaning_en: (idiom) high officials and noble lords; the powerful and influential

meaning_cn: 不同一般的，奇奇怪怪的形状。
meaning_en: fantastic oddities of every description (idiom); grotesquely shaped

meaning_cn: 形容黑暗没有灯光。
meaning_en: pitch dark

meaning_cn: 形容关系十分亲密。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be on very good terms with each other; to hit it off with sb; to be passionately in love with each other; to carry on intimately with; (of trading, conflict etc) to be in full swing

meaning_cn: 本指秋收后结算账目。比喻待到事后再对反对自己的一方行清算处理。
meaning_en: lit. to settle accounts after autumn (idiom); fig. to settle scores at an opportune time

meaning_cn: 狼狈窘迫的样子。困顿、窘迫得不能忍受。形容非常窘迫的样子。
meaning_en: battered and exhausted; stuck in a dilemma

meaning_cn: 身披星星，头戴月亮。形容连夜奔波或早出晚归，十分辛苦。
meaning_en: to travel or work through night and day; to toil away for long hours

meaning_cn: 街坊邻居。指住处邻近的人。亦作街坊四邻”。
meaning_en: neighbors; the whole neighborhood

meaning_cn: 聊依赖，凭借。指老百姓无以为生，活不下去。
meaning_en: (idiom) the people have no way to make a living (from Records of the Grand Historian 史記|史记[Shi3 ji4])

meaning_cn: 只恨相见得太晚。形容一见如故，意气极其相投。
meaning_en: to regret not having met earlier (idiom); It is nice to meet you finally.; It feels like we have known each other all along.

meaning_cn: 做贼的人喊捉贼。比喻坏人为了自己逃脱，故意制造混乱，转移目标，把别人说成是坏人。
meaning_en: lit. a thief crying "Stop the thief!" (idiom); fig. to accuse sb of a theft and try to sneak away oneself; to cover up one's misdeeds by shifting the blame onto others

meaning_cn: 原形容马跑得很快◇比喻进展极快。
meaning_en: lit. one day, a thousand miles (idiom); rapid progress

meaning_cn: 促靠近；促膝膝碰膝，坐得很近。形容亲密地谈心里话。
meaning_en: (idiom) to sit side-by-side and have a heart-to-heart talk

meaning_cn: 形容沉湎在酒色之中。花，指妓女。
meaning_en: to spend one's time in drinking and pleasure (idiom); to indulge in sensual pleasures; life of debauchery

meaning_cn: 寡少；敌抵挡；众多。人少的抵挡不住人多的。
meaning_en: the few are no match for the many; heavily outnumbered; facing impossible odds (idiom)

meaning_cn: 儆警告。处死一个人，借以警戒许多人。
meaning_en: lit. kill one to warn a hundred (idiom); to punish an individual as an example to others; pour encourager les autres

meaning_cn: 水边的楼台先得到月光。比喻能优先得到利益或便利的某种地位或关系。
meaning_en: lit. a pavilion near the water (idiom); fig. using one's proximity to the powerful to obtain favor

meaning_cn: 比喻言语、行动有条理或合规矩。有时也比喻做事死板，不懂得灵活掌握。
meaning_en: lit. one strong beat and one weak beats in a measure of music (two beats in the bar) (idiom); fig. follow a prescribed pattern to the letter; scrupulous attention to detail

meaning_cn: 不把国家法律放在眼里。形容胡作非为，无法无天。
meaning_en: with no regard for law or discipline (idiom); flouting the law and disregarding all rules; in complete disorder

meaning_cn: 原指轻浮地议论妇女的容貌。现也比喻任意挑剔。
meaning_en: lit. to assess the head and discuss the feet (idiom); minute criticism of a woman's appearance; fig. to find fault in minor details; to remark upon a person's appearance; nitpicking; overcritical; judgmental

meaning_cn: 整整顿，收拾。比喻失败之后，整顿力量，准备再干。
meaning_en: lit. to reorganize flags and drums (idiom); to regroup after a setback; to prepare for new initiatives; to attempt a comeback

meaning_cn: 东西还是原来的东西，可是人已不是原来的人了。多用于表达事过境迁。因而怀念故人。
meaning_en: (idiom) the place is unchanged, but the faces are different

meaning_cn: 奋笔提起笔来。指精神昂扬地挥笔快速书写。
meaning_en: to write at a tremendous speed

meaning_cn: 全身的皮肤没有一块好的。形容遍体都是伤。也比喻理由全部被驳倒，或被批评、责骂得很厉害。
meaning_en: lit. cuts and bruises all over (idiom); fig. totally refuted

meaning_cn: 厥其，他的；词文辞，言辞。原指铺张词藻或畅所欲言。现用来指大发议论。
meaning_en: to prattle on self-importantly (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容百花齐放，色彩艳丽。也比喻事物丰富多彩。
meaning_en: thousands of purples and reds (idiom); a blaze of color; fig. a profusion of flourishing trades

meaning_cn: 弹丸弹弓所用的铁丸或泥丸。弹丸那么大的地方。形容地方非常狭小。
meaning_en: (idiom) tiny speck of land; small area

meaning_cn: 驰奔驰。心神奔向所向往的事物。形容一心向往。
meaning_en: one's thoughts fly to a longed-for place or person; to long for; infatuated; fascinated

meaning_cn: 体贴细心体谅别人的心情和处境，给予关心和照顾；入微达到细微的程度。形容对人照顾或关怀非常细心、周到。
meaning_en: to show every possible consideration (idiom); meticulous care

meaning_cn: 说坏话的和说好话的各占一半。表示对人的评价没有一致的意见。
meaning_en: (idiom) to receive both praise and criticism; to get mixed reviews

meaning_cn: 形容用各种理由或方式请求或劝说。
meaning_en: (idiom) to try one's very best to persuade sb; to reason with sb in every way possible

meaning_cn: 把账一笔抹掉。比喻把一切全部取消。
meaning_en: to write off at one stroke

meaning_cn: 劫强取；济救济。夺取富人的财产，救济穷人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to rob the rich to help the poor

meaning_cn: 察详审。观察别人的说话或脸色。多指揣摸别人的心意。
meaning_en: to weigh up sb's words and observe their facial expression (idiom); to discern what sb thinks from his body language

meaning_cn: 软外皮中塞得圆鼓鼓的；藏物凸起的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a pocket, pouch etc) full and bulging

meaning_cn: 不生长草木庄稼的荒地。形容荒凉、贫瘠。
meaning_en: (idiom) barren land; desert

meaning_cn: 就顺着。指事情已经做错了，索性顺着错误继续做下去。
meaning_en: lit. if it's wrong, it's wrong (idiom); to make the best after a mistake; to accept an error and adapt to it; to muddle through

meaning_cn: 形容万分思念。
meaning_en: (idiom) to miss very much; to yearn for

meaning_cn: 原指演员擅长的剧目。泛指最擅长的本领。
meaning_en: the role an actor plays best (idiom); (fig.) one's specialty; one's forte

meaning_cn: 自知自己了解自己；明看清事物的能力。指了解自己的情况，对自己有正确的估计。
meaning_en: (idiom) self-knowledge

meaning_cn: 斟、酌反复考虑。指写文章或说话时慎重细致，一字一句地推敲琢磨。
meaning_en: weighing every word

meaning_cn: 嬉游戏。比喻不论什么题材和形式，都能任意发挥，写出好文章来。
meaning_en: lit. laughs, jeers, anger and invective (idiom); fig. all kinds of emotions; to mock and scold; (of writing) freely roving; following the author's fancy

meaning_cn: 原指射箭技术高超，一箭射中两只雕◇比喻做一件事达到两个目的。
meaning_en: lit. one arrow, two golden eagles (idiom); to kill two birds with one stone

meaning_cn: 群雄旧指许多有军事势力的人。逐鹿比喻争夺帝王之位。形容各派势力争夺最高统治地位。
meaning_en: great heroes pursue deer in the central plains (idiom); fig. many vie for supremacy

meaning_cn: 急得不能等待。形容心怀急切或形势紧迫。
meaning_en: unable to wait

meaning_cn: 高声歌唱，勇猛前进。形容在前进的道路上，充满乐观精神。
meaning_en: to advance singing loudly (idiom); triumphant progress

meaning_cn: 辞推托；劳苦劳累辛苦。不逃避劳累辛苦。形容人不怕吃苦，毅力强。
meaning_en: to spare no effort

meaning_cn: 指相提并论。
meaning_en: lit. to speak of two things on the same day (idiom); to mention things on equal terms (often with negatives: you can't mention X at the same time as Y)

meaning_cn: 唯一留存下来的大果子。比喻由于时间的推移，留存下来仅存的人或事物。
meaning_en: only remaining of the great (idiom); one of the few greats extant

meaning_cn: 饱充分。沧桑沧海变桑田的简缩。泛指世事的变化。经历过多次的世事变化，生活经历极为丰富。
meaning_en: having lived through many changes

meaning_cn: 背背诵。把书或文章倒过来背，背得像流水一样流畅。形容背得非常熟练，记得非常牢。
meaning_en: to know by heart (so well that you can recite it backwards)

meaning_cn: 原指宫室建筑结构的交错和精巧◇比喻用尽心机，明争暗斗。
meaning_en: to fight and scheme against each other (idiom); (in palace construction) elaborate and refined

meaning_cn: ①泛指烹调佐料。比喻另外添加的原来没有的内容。②指琐碎庸俗。
meaning_en: (lit.) oil, salt, soy sauce and vinegar (idiom); (fig.) life's daily necessities

meaning_cn: 包承担全部任务，负责完成。将打天下的整个任务承担下来。常指人逞强争胜。
meaning_en: to run everything (idiom); to monopolize the whole business; not allow anyone else to have a look in

meaning_cn: 夺门破门，奋力冲开门。猛然奋力冲开门出去。形容迫不及待。
meaning_en: to rush out through a door (idiom)

meaning_cn: 倾心爱慕。初次见面就十分爱幕。
meaning_en: love at first sight

meaning_cn: 着接触；边际边界，边缘。挨不着边儿。多指说话空泛，不接触实际。
meaning_en: not to the point; wide of the mark; neither here nor there; irrelevant

meaning_cn: 指出人意料。
meaning_en: beyond expectation (idiom); unexpected

meaning_cn: 炯炯明亮的样子。形容人的眼睛发亮，很有精神。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of eyes) bright and full of spirit; shining with vitality and presence

meaning_cn: 留着位置等待。
meaning_en: to reserve a seat; to leave a position vacant

meaning_cn: 养指生活。指生活在有人伺候、条件优裕的环境中。
meaning_en: to live like a prince (idiom)

meaning_cn: 白白付出劳动而没有成效。
meaning_en: to work to no avail (idiom)

meaning_cn: 丧胆吓破了胆。听到风声，就吓得丧失的勇气。形容对某种力量非常恐惧。
meaning_en: hear the wind and lose gall (idiom); terror-stricken at the news

meaning_cn: 耀显扬。炫耀武力，显示威风。
meaning_en: to show off one's military strength (idiom); to strut around; to bluff; to bluster

meaning_cn: 利用职权，非法取得财物，过着奢侈糜烂的生活。
meaning_en: (idiom) corruption

meaning_cn: 故故意；弄玩弄；玄虚用来掩盖真相，使人迷惑的欺骗手段。故意玩弄花招，迷惑人，欺骗人。
meaning_en: deliberately mystifying; to make sth unnecessarily complicated

meaning_cn: 指同时占有或具有几种事物。
meaning_en: to have both (at the same time)

meaning_cn: 比喻玩弄手法，串通做弊。
meaning_en: to raise and lower one's hand (idiom); to signal as conspiratorial hint; fig. conspiring to defraud

meaning_cn: 见一面的缘分。
meaning_en: (idiom) one-time encounter (e.g. 有一面之緣|有一面之缘[you3 yi1 mian4 zhi1 yuan2] "to have met once before")

meaning_cn: 镜里的花，水里的月。原指诗中灵活而不可捉摸的意境，后比喻虚幻的景象。
meaning_en: lit. flowers in a mirror and the moon reflected in the lake (idiom); fig. an unrealistic rosy view; viewing things through rose-tinted spectacles; also written 水月鏡花|水月镜花

meaning_cn: 指事情要靠人去做的。在一定的条件下，事情能否做成要看人的主观努力如何。
meaning_en: the matter depends on the individual (idiom); it is a matter for your own effort; With effort, one can achieve anything.

meaning_cn: 形容事情紧急到了极点（多用于公文、电报等）。
meaning_en: most urgent; posthaste; express

meaning_cn: 聪明智力发达，天资高。伶俐灵活、乖巧。形容小孩头脑机灵，活泼且乖巧。
meaning_en: (idiom) bright; clever; quick-witted

meaning_cn: 聚细沙成宝塔。原指儿童堆塔游戏◇比喻积少成多。
meaning_en: (lit.) many sand grains accumulate to form a tower (idiom); (fig.) many little things add up to sth great

meaning_cn: 深得无法测量。比喻对事物的情况捉摸不透。
meaning_en: deep and unmeasurable (idiom); unfathomable depths; incomprehensible; enigmatic and impossible to predict

meaning_cn: 怒放盛开。心里高兴得象花儿盛开一样。形容极其高兴。
meaning_en: to burst with joy (idiom); to be over the moon; to be elated

meaning_cn: 尸位空占职位，不尽职守；素餐白吃饭。空占着职位而不做事，白吃饭。
meaning_en: to hold a sinecure (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容人多手杂，动作纷乱。
meaning_en: (idiom) with everyone lending a hand (eagerly but somewhat chaotically)

meaning_cn: 比喻叙述事情或转述别人的话，为了夸大，添上原来没有的内容。
meaning_en: (lit.) to add oil and vinegar (idiom); (fig.) to embellish; to exaggerate (a story, a narration etc)

meaning_cn: 原指古代军队中先行开路和打头阵的将领。现比喻进行某项工作的先遣人员。
meaning_en: pioneer; trailblazer

meaning_cn: 璧平圆形中间有孔的玉。珍珠联串在一起，美玉结合在一块。比喻杰出的人才或美好的事物结合在一起。
meaning_en: string of pearl and jade (idiom); ideal combination; perfect pair

meaning_cn: 只坐着吃，山也要空。指光是消费而不从事生产，即使有堆积如山的财富，也要耗尽。
meaning_en: lit. just sitting and eating, one can deplete even a mountain of wealth (idiom); fig. to spend one's money without generating any income

meaning_cn: 若好象；悬河激流倾泻。讲起话来滔滔不绝，象瀑布不停地奔流倾泻。形容能说会辨，说起来没个完。
meaning_en: mouth like a torrent (idiom); eloquent; glib; voluble; have the gift of the gab

meaning_cn: 哄吵闹。形容聚在一起的人一下子吵吵嚷嚷地走散了。
meaning_en: see 一哄而散[yi1 hong1 er2 san4]

meaning_cn: 鱼骨头卡在喉咙里。比喻心里有话没有说出来，非常难受。
meaning_en: lit. as if having a fish bone stuck in one's throat (idiom); fig. very upset and needing to express one's displeasure

meaning_cn: 奇奇兵，奇计；制制服。出奇兵战胜敌人。比喻用对方意料不到的方法取得胜利。
meaning_en: to win by a surprise move

meaning_cn: 大义正义；凛然严肃、或敬畏的样子。由于胸怀正义而神态庄严，令人敬畏。
meaning_en: devotion to righteousness that inspires reverence (idiom)

meaning_cn: 一个先唱，一个随声应和。原形容两人感情相通。现也比喻二人互相配合，互相呼应。
meaning_en: to echo one another (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指对恶劣的环境或无礼的待遇采取顺从和忍受的态度。
meaning_en: to resign oneself to adversity (idiom); to grin and bear it; to submit meekly to insults, maltreatment, humiliation etc

meaning_cn: 小巧小而灵巧；玲珑精巧细致。形容东西小而精致。
meaning_en: (idiom) dainty; delicate; exquisite

meaning_cn: 暴暴烈，急躁。急怒叫跳，象打雷一样猛烈。形容又急又怒，大发脾气的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) to stamp with fury; to fly into a rage

meaning_cn: 曲调高深，能跟着唱的人就少。旧指知音难得。现比喻言论或作品不通俗，能了解的人很少。
meaning_en: difficult songs find few singers (idiom); highbrow

meaning_cn: 辙车轮轧过的痕迹。琴换弦，车改道。比喻改变原来的方向、计划、办法等。
meaning_en: change of string, move out of rut (idiom); dramatic change of direction; to dance to a different tune

meaning_cn: 把本来没有某种意义的事物硬说成有某种意义。也指把不相关联的事物牵拉在一起，混为一谈。
meaning_en: to make an irrelevant comparison or interpretation (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容心里充满着热烈诚挚的感情。
meaning_en: full of enthusiasm

meaning_cn: 嚣张猖狂的样子。形容人威势逼人，猖狂放肆。
meaning_en: see 囂張氣焰|嚣张气焰[xiao1 zhang1 qi4 yan4]

meaning_cn: 知认识；觉觉悟。指认识事理较一般人为早的人。
meaning_en: having foresight; a person of foresight

meaning_cn: 旧小说中形容有武艺的人身体轻捷，能够跳上房檐，越过墙壁。
meaning_en: to leap onto roofs and vault over walls (usually associated with martial arts)

meaning_cn: 象翻一下手掌那样容易。比喻事情非常容易做。
meaning_en: easy as a hand's turn (idiom); very easy; no effort at all

meaning_cn: 笑一笑，就把它放在一边了。表示不当回事。
meaning_en: to dismiss with a laugh; to make light of

meaning_cn: 指鸟展开翅膀远远飞走了。亦比喻充分发挥才能，施展抱负。
meaning_en: to spread one's wings and soar (idiom); to develop one's abilities freely

meaning_cn: 瞻往前或向上看。看着我马头的方向，决定进退。比喻追随某人行动。
meaning_en: to follow blindly (idiom); to take as one's only guide

meaning_cn: 连续而不中断。
meaning_en: (idiom) continuous; unending

meaning_cn: 惨淡苦费心思；经营筹划。费尽心思辛辛苦苦地经营筹划◇指在困难的的境况中艰苦地从事某种事业。
meaning_en: to manage by painstaking effort (idiom)

meaning_cn: 人人都知道。
meaning_en: something that everybody knows

meaning_cn: 五、十计数单位。五个十个地将数目点清。比喻叙述从头到尾，源源本本，没有遗漏。也形容查点数目。
meaning_en: lit. count by fives and tens (idiom); to narrate systematically and in full detail

meaning_cn: 比喻人所共知的野心。
meaning_en: understood by everyone (idiom); well known; a household name

meaning_cn: 形容过分地斟酌字句。多指死扣字眼而不注意精神实质。
meaning_en: to bite words and chew characters (idiom); punctilious about minutiae of wording

meaning_cn: 受到眼前景物的触动，引起联想，产生某种感情。
meaning_en: scene which recalls past memories (idiom); evocative of the past; reminiscent; to arouse deep feelings

meaning_cn: 抱着残缺陈旧的东西不放。形容思想保守，不求改进。
meaning_en: to cherish the outmoded and preserve the outworn (idiom); conservative; stickler for tradition

meaning_cn: 桀凶暴；骜马不驯良，比喻傲慢。性情强暴不驯顺。
meaning_en: arrogant and obstinate (idiom); unyielding

meaning_cn: 佛教称世界从生成到毁灭的一个过程为一劫，万劫就是万世的意思。指永远不能恢复。
meaning_en: consigned to eternal damnation; with no hope of reprieve

meaning_cn: 身体粉碎而死。比喻为了某种目的或遭到什么危险而丧失生命。
meaning_en: (lit.) torn body and crushed bones (idiom); (fig.) to die horribly; to sacrifice one's life

meaning_cn: 升上天空，钻入地下。形容神通广大。也比喻为实现某种目的而四处奔走。
meaning_en: lit. to go up to heaven or down to Hades (idiom); fig. to go to great lengths; to search heaven and earth

meaning_cn: 原来表示发现真实情况。原来是这样。
meaning_en: (idiom) so that's how it is; I see

meaning_cn: 磨阻碍，困难∶事情在实现、成功前，常常会遇到许多波折。
meaning_en: the road to happiness is strewn with setbacks (idiom)

meaning_cn: 锱、铢都是古代很小的重量单位。形容非常小气，很少的钱也一定要计较。也比喻气量狭小，很小的事也要计较。
meaning_en: to haggle over every cent (idiom)

meaning_cn: 伤、害损害；天天道；理伦理。形容做事凶恶残忍，丧尽天良。
meaning_en: to offend Heaven and reason (idiom); bloody atrocities that cry to heaven; outrageous acts

meaning_cn: 惹引起；非事端。招惹是非，引起争端。
meaning_en: to stir up trouble

meaning_cn: 比喻费力研究不值得研究或无法解决的问题。也指思想方法狭窄。
meaning_en: lit. to penetrate into a bull's horn (idiom); fig. to waste time on an insoluble or insignificant problem; to bash one's head against a brick wall; a wild goose chase; a blind alley; to split hairs

meaning_cn: 背违背；信信用；弃扔掉；义道义。违背诺言，不讲道义。
meaning_en: breaking faith and abandoning right (idiom); to betray; treachery; perfidy

meaning_cn: 白头头发白；偕共同。夫妻相亲相爱，一直到老。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a married couple) to live together until old age; to remain lifelong companions

meaning_cn: 光着膀子上阵。比喻亲身上场，不加掩饰地进行活动。
meaning_en: lit. to go into battle bare-breasted (idiom); fig. to go all out; to come out in the open

meaning_cn: 配成一对，多指夫妻或情侣。
meaning_en: to form pairs; to be in couples

meaning_cn: 大义正义，正道；亲亲属。为了维护正义，对犯罪的亲属不循私情，使受到应得的惩罚。
meaning_en: to place righteousness before family (idiom); ready to punish one's own family if justice demands it

meaning_cn: 因获得大量财物而富裕起来。
meaning_en: to become rich; enrichment

meaning_cn: 寄依附。依附于他人篱笆下。比喻依附别人生活。
meaning_en: to lodge under another person's roof (idiom); to live relying on sb else's charity

meaning_cn: 指旅途中没出任何事故。也用作对出门人的祝福语。
meaning_en: to have a pleasant journey; Bon voyage!

meaning_cn: 水不断下滴，可以闹穿石头。比喻只要有恒心，不断努力，事情一定成功。
meaning_en: dripping water penetrates the stone (idiom); constant perseverance yields success; You can achieve your aim if you try hard without giving up.; Persistent effort overcomes any difficulty.

meaning_cn: 指话语、文章、或已表露的现象之中，很有令人难以捉摸的意思或别的情况。
meaning_en: some deeper meaning in this; more to it than meets the eye; there's sth behind all this

meaning_cn: 已停止。死了以后才罢手。形容为完成一种责任而奋斗终身。
meaning_en: until death puts an end (idiom); one's whole life; unto one's dying day

meaning_cn: 求、责要求；全、备完备，完美。对人对事物要求十全十美，毫无缺点。
meaning_en: to demand perfection (idiom)

meaning_cn: 连寸步也不让给别人。形容丝毫不肯让步、妥协。
meaning_en: (idiom) not to yield an inch

meaning_cn: 原指夜间潜入某处前，先投以石子，看看有无反应，借以探测情况◇用以比喻进行试探。
meaning_en: lit. to toss a stone to find out what's ahead (idiom); fig. to test the waters

meaning_cn: 茂繁茂。根扎得深，叶子就茂盛。比喻基础牢固，就会兴旺发展。
meaning_en: deep roots and vigorous foliage (idiom); (fig.) well established and growing strongly

meaning_cn: 完全丧失人所具有的理性。形容极端残忍，象野兽一样。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be devoid of all humanity; inhuman; bestial

meaning_cn: 贯贯穿，进入。响亮得象雷声传进耳朵里。形容人的名声大。
meaning_en: lit. like thunder piercing the ear; a well-known reputation (idiom)

meaning_cn: 舍弃自己的利益去帮助别人。
meaning_en: to abandon self for others (idiom, from Analects); to sacrifice one's own interest for other people; altruism

meaning_cn: 壤地。荒远偏僻的地方。
meaning_en: a remote and desolate place

meaning_cn: 天下的人或全国的人共同庆祝。
meaning_en: everybody celebrating together; universal celebration; universal rejoicing

meaning_cn: 指还过得去。亦形容做事不认真，不仔细。
meaning_en: careless; casual; vague; not so bad; so-so; tolerable; fair

meaning_cn: 比喻说话、写文章不从正面直接点明，而是从侧面曲折地加以讽刺或抨击。
meaning_en: to make insinuations; to take an indirect approach (in making inquiries) (idiom)

meaning_cn: 明·指眼力。事先看清问题的能力。指对事物发展的预见性。
meaning_en: foresight

meaning_cn: 《西游记》故事猪八戒以钉耙为武器，常用回身倒打一耙的绝技战胜对手。自己做错了，不仅拒绝别人的指摘，反而指摘对方。
meaning_en: lit. to strike with a muckrake (idiom), cf Pigsy 豬八戒|猪八戒 in Journey to the West 西遊記|西游记; fig. to counterattack; to make bogus accusations (against one's victim)

meaning_cn: 指随便谈论，漫无边际。
meaning_en: to talk endlessly; to talk about everything under the sun

meaning_cn: 无缘无故找岔子，存心制造麻烦。
meaning_en: to make trouble out of nothing

meaning_cn: 上游河的上流，比喻先进的地位。努力奋斗，争取先进再先进。
meaning_en: to strive for mastery (idiom); aiming for the best result; to have high ambitions

meaning_cn: 内心痛苦得象刀割一样。
meaning_en: to feel a pain like a knife being twisted in one's heart (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻说话做事不干脆利落。
meaning_en: (idiom) muddy and wet; (idiom) (of speech, writing etc) slovenly; sloppy; (of actions) indecisive

meaning_cn: 离背离，不遵守。原指违反封建统治阶级所尊奉的经典和教条。现泛指背离占主导地位的理论或学说。
meaning_en: to rebel against orthodoxy; to depart from established practices

meaning_cn: 自己遭受暗算或受损吃亏，不敢声张或无法申诉，只好自认吃亏。
meaning_en: to be forced to suffer in silence; unable to speak of one's bitter suffering

meaning_cn: 比一般人衣着式样特异的服装（多含贬义）。
meaning_en: bizarre dress

meaning_cn: 科指古典戏曲中的表情和动作；诨诙谐逗趣的话。戏曲、曲艺演员在表演中穿插进去的引人发笑的动作或语言。
meaning_en: to include impromptu comic material in opera performance (idiom); to jest; buffoonery

meaning_cn: 利用对方所用的计策，反过来对付对方。
meaning_en: to beat sb at their own game (idiom)

meaning_cn: 事实明显或理由充足，没有什么可以怀疑的。
meaning_en: cannot be doubted (idiom)

meaning_cn: 勉强人家去做他不能做或不愿做的事情。
meaning_en: to force someone to do something

meaning_cn: 一个钱也不要。比喻不计报酬。
meaning_en: to give for free

meaning_cn: 引招引。把狼招引到室内。比喻把坏人或敌人引入内部。
meaning_en: (lit.) to show the wolf into the house (idiom); (fig.) to introduce a potential source of trouble

meaning_cn: 心肠凶狠，手段毒辣。
meaning_en: (idiom) vicious; merciless

meaning_cn: 若好象；即接近∶象接近，又好象不接近。①形容对人保持一定距离。②形容事物含混不清。
meaning_en: lit. seeming neither close nor distant (idiom); fig. to keep one's distance; (of a relationship) lukewarm; vague

meaning_cn: 彼那，对方；此这，我方。不分这个和那个。形容关系密切，交情深厚。
meaning_en: to make no distinction between what's one's own and what's another's (idiom); to share everything; to be on very intimate terms

meaning_cn: 形容转战南北，经历了许多战斗。
meaning_en: war on all sides (idiom); fighting from all four quarters

meaning_cn: 拘拘泥。不为小事所约束。多指不注意生活小事。
meaning_en: to not bother about trifles (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指死了心，不作别的打算◇常形容打定了主意，决不改变。
meaning_en: to be hell-bent on; dead set on sth; unswerving

meaning_cn: 战场上使用的武器弹药。多比喻实战。
meaning_en: (idiom) with real guns and live ammunition; (fig.) for real (involving genuine action rather than rehearsal, simulation or theory); (coll.) to have actual sex; to go all the way

meaning_cn: 脉脉默默地用眼神或行动表达情意。形容饱含温和的感情，很想表露出来的样子。
meaning_en: full of tender feelings (idiom); tender-hearted

meaning_cn: 损害公家的利益而使私人获利。
meaning_en: to damage the public interest for personal profit (idiom); personal profit at public expense; venal and selfish behavior

meaning_cn: 贻笑让人笑话；大方原指懂得大道的人，后泛指见识广博或有专长的人。指让内行人笑话。
meaning_en: to make a fool of oneself; to make oneself a laughing stock

meaning_cn: 指生活悠闲自在。
meaning_en: see 悠哉悠哉[you1 zai1 you1 zai1]

meaning_cn: 天生天然生成。丽质美丽的姿容。形容女子妩媚艳丽。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be naturally beautiful; to be born beautiful

meaning_cn: 丈夫的好妻子，孩子的好母亲。
meaning_en: a good wife and loving mother

meaning_cn: 形容做事无所畏惧。
meaning_en: (idiom) to stop at nothing; to dare to do anything

meaning_cn: 粗粗糙、简单；淡饭指饭菜简单。形容饮食简单，生活简朴。
meaning_en: plain tea and simple food; (fig.) bread and water

meaning_cn: 由于寒冷而四肢不能舒展的样子。也形容做事胆小，顾虑多，不敢放手。
meaning_en: bound hand and foot (idiom); constrained

meaning_cn: 死去了又活过来，形容生命不息。
meaning_en: (idiom) to come back to life (after death)

meaning_cn: 用糖衣裹着的炮弹；比喻用腐蚀、拉拢、诱惑等手段去牟取自己的利益。
meaning_en: sugar-coated bullets, term used by Mao (originally in 1949) to refer to corrupting bourgeois influences

meaning_cn: 栋栋宇，屋子。书运输时牛累得出汗，存放时可堆至屋顶。形容藏书非常多。
meaning_en: lit. enough books to make a pack-ox sweat or to fill a house to the rafters (idiom); fig. many books

meaning_cn: 望洋仰视的样子。仰望海神而兴叹。原指在伟大事物面前感叹自己的渺小。现多比喻做事时因力不胜任或没有条件而感到无可奈何。
meaning_en: (lit.) to gaze at the ocean and lament one's inadequacy (idiom); (fig.) to feel powerless and incompetent (to perform a task)

meaning_cn: 形容放轻脚步走的样子。也形容偷偷摸摸、鬼鬼祟祟的样子。
meaning_en: to walk quietly on tiptoe (idiom)

meaning_cn: 礼仪礼节和仪式；邦国家。指讲究礼节和仪式的国家。
meaning_en: (idiom) a land of ceremony and propriety

meaning_cn: 熟悉门径，了解情况，很有经验。
meaning_en: familiar

meaning_cn: 国家灭亡，种族灭绝。指一个国家被彻底毁灭。
meaning_en: country destroyed, its people annihilated (idiom); total destruction

meaning_cn: 醍醐酥酪上凝聚的油。用纯酥油浇到头上。佛教指灌输智慧，使人彻底觉悟。比喻听了高明的意见使人受到很大启发。也形容清凉舒适。
meaning_en: lit. to anoint your head with the purest cream (idiom); fig. to enlighten people with perfect wisdom; flawless Buddhist teaching

meaning_cn: 指对坏人坏事如同对仇敌一样憎恨。
meaning_en: (idiom) to hate evil as one hates an enemy

meaning_cn: 盛气骄横的气焰；凌欺凌。以骄横的气势压人。形容傲慢自大，气势逼人。
meaning_en: overbearing; arrogant bully

meaning_cn: 指灾难深重。
meaning_en: to be plagued with misfortunes; precarious

meaning_cn: 形容心里慌乱不安。
meaning_en: at sixes and sevens; perturbed state of mind; in a mess

meaning_cn: 投用东西去掷；忌怕，有所顾虑。想用东西打老鼠，又怕打坏了近旁的器物。比喻做事有顾忌，不敢放手干。
meaning_en: lit. to refrain from shooting at the rat for fear of breaking the vases (idiom); to not act against an evil so as to prevent harm to innocents

meaning_cn: 分本分。规矩老实，守本分，不做违法的事。
meaning_en: to be content with one's lot (idiom); to know one's place

meaning_cn: 泛指所有的人。
meaning_en: men, women, young and old; all kinds of people; people of all ages

meaning_cn: 最好的地方。指首都。
meaning_en: (idiom) the finest place in the nation (often used in reference to the capital city)

meaning_cn: 人民的怨声就象开水在翻滚一样。形容人民对腐败黑暗的反动统治怨恨到了极点。
meaning_en: seething discontent (idiom); popular grievances boil over

meaning_cn: 健步脚步快而有力。步伐矫健，跑得飞快。
meaning_en: running as fast as flying

meaning_cn: 形容夫妻互相尊敬，象对待宾客一样。
meaning_en: to treat each other as an honored guest (idiom); mutual respect between husband and wife

meaning_cn: 损伤美好的景致。比喻败坏兴致。
meaning_en: see 大殺風景|大杀风景[da4 sha1 feng1 jing3]

meaning_cn: 妙美妙。形容好得难以用文字、语言表达。
meaning_en: too wonderful for words

meaning_cn: 胸臆胸腔，内心，引申为心意。直率地抒发自己的思想感情。
meaning_en: to speak one's mind

meaning_cn: 城里到处刮风下雨。原形容重阳节前的雨景◇比喻某一事件传播很广，到处议论纷纷。
meaning_en: lit. wind and rain sweeping through the town (idiom); fig. a big scandal; an uproar; the talk of the town

meaning_cn: 比喻帮助坏人干坏事。
meaning_en: lit. helping tyrant Zhou 商紂王|商纣王[Shang1 Zhou4 wang2] in his oppression (idiom); fig. to take the side of the evildoer; giving succor to the enemy

meaning_cn: 苟苟且。不敢随便地同意。指对人对事抱慎重态度。
meaning_en: to beg to differ (idiom)

meaning_cn: 昂仰，高抬。抬起头迈开大步向前。形容精神抖擞，意气风发。
meaning_en: striding forward with head high (idiom); to walk with spirited and vigorous step; to strut

meaning_cn: 聪听觉灵敏；明眼力敏锐。听得清楚，看得明白。形容头脑清楚，眼光敏锐。
meaning_en: sharp ears and keen eyes (idiom); keen and alert; perceptive

meaning_cn: 番次。一次又一次。形容次数之多。
meaning_en: lit. twice then three times (idiom); fig. repeatedly; over and over again

meaning_cn: 维相当于是”；谷比喻困境。无论是进还是退，都是处在困境之中。形容进退两难。
meaning_en: no room to advance or to retreat (idiom); without any way out of a dilemma; trapped; in an impossible situation

meaning_cn: 树叶从树根生发出来，凋落后最终还是回到树根。比喻事物总有一定的归宿。多指作客他乡的人最终要回到本乡。
meaning_en: a falling leaf returns to the roots (idiom); everything has its ancestral home; In old age, an expatriate longs to return home.

meaning_cn: 文、饰掩饰；过、非错误。用漂亮的言词掩饰自己的过失和错误。
meaning_en: (idiom) to cover up one's faults; to whitewash

meaning_cn: 夫妻永远和好之意。
meaning_en: may you live a long and happy life together (wedding greeting)

meaning_cn: 假借↑狸假借老虎的威势。比喻依仗别人的势力欺压人。
meaning_en: lit. the fox exploits the tiger's might (idiom); fig. to use powerful connections to intimidate people

meaning_cn: 得得利。失失利。成功与失败，得到的与丢掉的。
meaning_en: lit. success and failure, the gains and losses (idiom); fig. to weigh up various factors

meaning_cn: 形容妇女妆饰打扮得十分艳丽。
meaning_en: to apply makeup conspicuously (idiom); dressed to the nines and wearing makeup

meaning_cn: 为了劫夺财物，害人性命。
meaning_en: to plot and kill sb for his property (idiom); to murder for money

meaning_cn: 邪不正当、不正派；归回到。从邪路上回到正路上来，不再做坏事。
meaning_en: to mend one's ways (idiom); to turn over a new leaf

meaning_cn: 了了结，解决。把一件主要的事情了结以后，其余有关的事情也跟着了结。
meaning_en: (idiom) once the main problem is solved, all troubles are solved; death ends all one's troubles

meaning_cn: 勇清代指战争期间临时招募的士兵。原指没有统帅的逃散士兵。现有指没有组织的集体队伍里独自行动的人。
meaning_en: lit. straggling and disbanded soldiers (idiom); fig. disorganized uncoordinated action

meaning_cn: 恣意任意，随意；妄为胡作非为。随心所欲，胡作非为。
meaning_en: to behave unscrupulously

meaning_cn: 彪小老虎，比喻躯干壮大；汉男子。身材高大、结实的男子。
meaning_en: (idiom) burly chap; husky fellow

meaning_cn: 包包容。形容胆子极大。
meaning_en: reckless; extremely daring

meaning_cn: 指各在天底下的一个地方。形容相隔极远，见面困难。
meaning_en: (of relatives or friends) to live far apart from each other

meaning_cn: 栉梳头发；沐洗头发。风梳发，雨洗头。形容人经常在外面不顾风雨地辛苦奔波。
meaning_en: lit. to comb one's hair in the wind and wash it in the rain (idiom); fig. to work in the open regardless of the weather

meaning_cn: 现多形容敌人在行动前频繁活动。
meaning_en: (lit.) to sharpen one's sword (idiom); (fig.) to prepare to attack; to be getting ready for battle

meaning_cn: 持抓住不放。各人都坚持自己的意见。
meaning_en: each sticks to his own opinion (idiom); chacun son gout

meaning_cn: 形容东西非常混杂，或事情非常杂乱。
meaning_en: an assortment; a bit of everything; lots of different (skills)

meaning_cn: 一只手把天遮住。形容依仗权势，玩弄手段，蒙蔽群众。
meaning_en: lit. to hide the sky with one hand; to hide the truth from the masses

meaning_cn: 形容事情曲折复杂，不是一句话能说清楚的（用在不好的事）。
meaning_en: hard to explain in a few words (idiom); complicated and not easy to express succinctly

meaning_cn: 子孙后裔；世世代代的意思。
meaning_en: (idiom) one's posterity

meaning_cn: 从大坛子里捉王八。比喻想要捕捉的对象已在掌握之中。形容手到擒来，轻易而有把握。
meaning_en: (lit.) to catch a turtle in a jar (idiom); (fig.) to go after easy prey

meaning_cn: 原形容颜色和香气不同于一般花卉的牡丹花◇也形容女子的美丽。
meaning_en: national grace, divine fragrance (idiom); an outstanding beauty

meaning_cn: 形容强大无比，可以战胜一切。也比喻办任何事情都能成功。
meaning_en: (idiom) all-conquering; invincible

meaning_cn: 拨开乌云见到太阳。比喻冲破黑暗见到光明。也比喻疑团消除，心里顿时明白。
meaning_en: lit. to dispel the clouds and see the sun (idiom); fig. to restore justice

meaning_cn: 从前没有过，今后也不会再有。夸张性地形容独一无二。
meaning_en: unprecedented and never to be duplicated; the first and the last; unmatched; unique

meaning_cn: 焕发光彩四射的样子。形容精神振作，情绪饱满。
meaning_en: in high spirits (idiom); glowing with health and vigor

meaning_cn: 临靠近；渊深水坑。如同处于深渊边缘一般。比喻存有戒心，行事极为谨慎。
meaning_en: (lit.) as if on the brink of a deep abyss (idiom); (fig.) extremely cautious

meaning_cn: 延缓对方进攻的计策。指拖延时间，然后再想办法。
meaning_en: delaying tactics; stalling; measures to stave off an attack; stratagem to win a respite

meaning_cn: 一拍桌子猛地站起来。形容非常愤慨。
meaning_en: (idiom) to slam the table and rise to one's feet in indignation

meaning_cn: 画蛇时给蛇添上脚。比喻做了多余的事，非但无益，反而不合适。也比喻虚构事实，无中生有。
meaning_en: lit. draw legs on a snake (idiom); fig. to ruin the effect by adding sth superfluous; to overdo it

meaning_cn: 朝早晨；暮晚上。早晚都想念。形容非常想念或经常想着某一件事。
meaning_en: to yearn for sth day and night (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指凶恶的神◇用来形容非常凶恶的人。
meaning_en: (idiom) fiends; devils; monsters

meaning_cn: 旧的朝代为新的朝代所代替。
meaning_en: to transition to a new dynasty or regime

meaning_cn: 蛮粗野。不讲道理，纠缠不放。
meaning_en: (idiom) to pester endlessly

meaning_cn: 象暂时聚合的一群乌鸦。比喻临时杂凑的、毫无组织纪律的一群人。
meaning_en: (idiom) rabble; disorderly band

meaning_cn: 没有哪件坏事不干的。指干尽了坏事。
meaning_en: not to shrink from any crime (idiom); to commit any imaginable misdeed

meaning_cn: 空头有名无实的。指不能兑现，即取不到钱的支票。比喻不准备实现的诺言。
meaning_en: bounced check; bad check; (idiom) empty promise

meaning_cn: 出出现；没消失。象神鬼那样出没无常。形容出没无常，不可捉摸◇泛指行动变化迅速。
meaning_en: (lit.) to appear and disappear unpredictably like a spirit or a ghost (idiom); (fig.) elusive

meaning_cn: 争嬜，争夺；风风韵，多指女子。指因男女关系而妒忌、争吵。
meaning_en: to rival sb for the affection of a man or woman; to be jealous of a rival in a love affair

meaning_cn: 以此事为光荣。
meaning_en: to regard it as an honor (idiom)

meaning_cn: 处处平安无事。指大治之世。
meaning_en: the whole world at peace (idiom); peace and prosperity

meaning_cn: 寿命很长，能活到一百岁。常用作祝福长寿之词。
meaning_en: (idiom) to live to be a hundred years old (often used as a blessing or wish for longevity)

meaning_cn: 恩恩惠；负违背；义情谊，恩谊。忘记别人对自己的好处，反而做出对不起别人的事。
meaning_en: to forget favors and violate justice (idiom); ingratitude to a friend; to kick a benefactor in the teeth

meaning_cn: 凭个人的爱憎或一时的感情冲动处理事情。
meaning_en: to act impetuously (idiom); on an impulse

meaning_cn: 容光脸上的光彩；焕发光彩四射的样子。形容身体好，精神饱满。
meaning_en: face glowing (idiom); looking radiant; all smiles

meaning_cn: 穷竭尽；黩随便，任意。随意使用武力，不断发动侵略战争。形容极其好战。
meaning_en: to engage in wars of aggression at will (idiom); militaristic; bellicose

meaning_cn: 旅途平安（多用于祝人）。
meaning_en: to have a pleasant journey (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指自己做了坏事，自己受到损害或惩罚。
meaning_en: to eat one's own fruit (idiom); fig. suffering the consequences of one's own action; to reap what one has sown

meaning_cn: 推抵拒，推托；就靠拢，迎上去。一面推辞，一面靠拢上去。形容装腔作势假意推辞的样子。
meaning_en: half willing and half unwilling (idiom); to yield after making a show of resistance

meaning_cn: 茅塞喻人思路闭塞或不懂事；顿立刻。原来心里好象有茅草堵塞着，现在忽然被打开了。形容思想忽然开窍，立刻明白了某个道理。
meaning_en: murky darkness suddenly opens (idiom); a sudden flash of insight and all is clear

meaning_cn: 蛊惑迷惑。指用欺骗引诱等手段迷惑人，搞乱人的思想。
meaning_en: to stir up public sentiment by false statements (idiom); to resort to demagogy

meaning_cn: 头脑发胀，脚下无力。形容身体不适。也比喻基础不牢固。
meaning_en: top-heavy; fig. unbalance in organization or political structure

meaning_cn: 念思念；兹此，这个。泛指念念不忘某一件事情。
meaning_en: see 念念不忘[nian4 nian4 bu4 wang4]

meaning_cn: 趾高走路时脚抬得很高；气扬意气扬扬。走路时脚抬得很高，神气十足。形容骄傲自满，得意忘形的样子。
meaning_en: high and mighty (idiom); arrogant

meaning_cn: 复又，再。刚得到又失去了。
meaning_en: to lose what one has just obtained (idiom)

meaning_cn: 随顺从；遇遭遇。指能顺应环境，在任何境遇中都能满足。
meaning_en: at home wherever one is (idiom); ready to adapt; flexible; to accept circumstances with good will

meaning_cn: 形身体；只单独。只有自己的身体和自己的影子。形容孤独，没有同伴。
meaning_en: (idiom) lonely soul; solitary

meaning_cn: 比喻坏人、坏事虽已清除，但不良的影响还在起作用。
meaning_en: lit. the soul of a deceased has not yet dispersed (idiom); fig. the influence still lingers on; the spirit (of some doctrine) is still alive

meaning_cn: 纲鱼网上的总绳；举提起。把大绳子一提起来，一个个网眼就都张开。比喻抓住事物的关键，带动其他环节。也比喻文章条理分明。
meaning_en: if you lift the headrope the meshes spread open (idiom); take care of the big things and the little things will take care of themselves; (of a piece of writing) well-structured and ordered

meaning_cn: 形容气氛不活泼。也形容人精神消沉，不振作。
meaning_en: dead atmosphere; lifeless; spiritless

meaning_cn: 滂沱大雨的样子。形容雨下得很大。
meaning_en: torrents of rain (idiom)

meaning_cn: 投机意见相合。形容话说不到一起。
meaning_en: (idiom) not on the same wavelength; unable to have a congenial conversation; to not see eye to eye

meaning_cn: 九鼎古代国家的宝器，相传为夏禹所铸。一句话抵得上九鼎重。比喻说话力量大，能起很大作用。
meaning_en: one word worth nine sacred tripods (idiom); words of enormous weight

meaning_cn: 作战中弹药用完了，粮食也断绝了。指无法继续作战的危险处境。
meaning_en: out of ammunition and no food left (idiom); in desperate straits

meaning_cn: 从戎从军，参军。扔掉笔去参军。指文人从军。
meaning_en: to lay down the pen and take up the sword (idiom); to join the military (esp. of educated person)

meaning_cn: 星斗变动位置。指季节或时间的变化。
meaning_en: lit. the Big Dipper 北斗星[Bei3 dou3 xing1] has turned and the stars have moved; time flies; also written 星移斗轉|星移斗转[xing1 yi2 Dou3 zhuan3]

meaning_cn: 豪迈的情感，远大的志向。
meaning_en: lofty ideals; noble aspirations

meaning_cn: 形容人动作琐细，言语罗唆。也形容人感情脆弱。
meaning_en: effeminate; old-womanish; garrulous; fainthearted; overly careful; overly sensitive; maudlin

meaning_cn: 强弩所发的矢，飞行已达末程。比喻强大的力量已经衰弱，起不了什么作用。
meaning_en: (lit.) an arrow at the end of its flight (idiom); (fig.) spent force

meaning_cn: 尽用尽；能才能。各人尽自己的能力去做。
meaning_en: each does his utmost (idiom); from each according to his means

meaning_cn: 惑，迷惑；解理解。感到非常迷惑，不能理解。
meaning_en: to be at a loss (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指罪恶极大，不可饶恕。
meaning_en: wicked beyond redemption (idiom); heinous

meaning_cn: 洋洋得意的样子。形容称心如意、沾沾自喜的样子。
meaning_en: joyfully satisfied; to be immensely proud of oneself; proudly; an air of complacency

meaning_cn: 好象懂，又好象不懂。
meaning_en: to not really understand; to half-understand

meaning_cn: 见人钱财，动起歹念。
meaning_en: seeing riches provokes evil designs

meaning_cn: 表表面；里本质。从表面现象看到本质。
meaning_en: to proceed from the outside to the inside; to see the essence merely by looking at the superficial appearance

meaning_cn: 声声张。指造成要攻打东边的声势，实际上却攻打西边。是使对方产生错觉以出奇制胜的一种战术。
meaning_en: to threaten the east and strike to the west (idiom); to create a diversion

meaning_cn: 捶敲打；顿跺。敲胸口，跺双脚。形容非常懊丧，或非常悲痛。
meaning_en: (idiom) to beat one's chest and stamp one's feet (in sorrow, anguish etc)

meaning_cn: 闭关封闭关口；锁封锁。闭关自守，不与外国往来。
meaning_en: to close the passes and seal off the country; to close a country to exclude foreign contact

meaning_cn: 歌、颂颂扬。颂扬功绩和德行。
meaning_en: to sing sb's praises (mostly derogatory)

meaning_cn: 魄迷信者指依附人形体而存在的精神。形容使人感动或令人震惊。
meaning_en: (idiom) breathtaking; deeply affecting

meaning_cn: 关心得无微不至。
meaning_en: the utmost care (idiom); to look after sb in every possible way

meaning_cn: 指避开敌人的主力，找敌人的弱点进攻。又指谈问题回避要害。
meaning_en: (idiom) stay clear of the enemy's main force and strike at his weak points

meaning_cn: 像游鱼那样连贯着出现。
meaning_en: to file out; to walk out in a line

meaning_cn: 旧时恳求人原谅或饶恕的话。意思是您一抬手我就过去了。
meaning_en: to be generous (idiom); to be magnanimous; Give me a break!

meaning_cn: 尽心地思索和想象。
meaning_en: (idiom) to think deeply; to rack one's brains

meaning_cn: 心心指所有的心思；念念指所有的念头。心里老是想着。指想做某件事或得到某种东西。
meaning_en: (idiom) to constantly think about; to be preoccupied with; to set one's heart on

meaning_cn: 缕线；析剖析。有条有理地细细分析。
meaning_en: to analyze thoroughly, point by point (idiom)

meaning_cn: 不跟社会上的人发生争执。这是一种消极的回避矛盾的处世态度。
meaning_en: (idiom) to stand aloof from worldly affairs

meaning_cn: 招展飘动，摇动。形容旗子等随风飘扬。
meaning_en: to flutter in the wind (idiom)

meaning_cn: 闲与正事无关；碎指说话唠叨。唠叨些与正事无关的话。
meaning_en: idle gossip; irrelevant nonsense; slanderous rumor

meaning_cn: 诺诺答应的声音。形容自己没有主意，一味附和，恭顺听从的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be a yes-man

meaning_cn: 纲鱼网的总绳；挈提起。抓住网的总绳，提住衣的领子。比喻抓住要领，简明扼要。
meaning_en: to concentrate on the main points (idiom); to bring out the essentials

meaning_cn: 三再三，表示多次。指经过反复考虑，然后再去做。
meaning_en: think three times then go (idiom); don't act before you've thought it through carefully

meaning_cn: 调动兵力，派遣将领。泛指调动安排人力。
meaning_en: to move an army and send a general (idiom); to deploy an army; to send a team on a task

meaning_cn: 非常吉祥、顺利。旧时用于占卜和祝福。
meaning_en: great luck, great profit (idiom); everything is thriving

meaning_cn: 谆谆教诲不倦的样子；告诫规劝。恳切耐心地劝告。
meaning_en: to repeatedly advise sb earnestly (idiom); to admonish

meaning_cn: 长生永生。原为道教的话，后也用作对年长者的祝愿语。
meaning_en: (idiom) to live forever and never grow old

meaning_cn: 形容力量非常强大，没有什么坚固的东西不能摧毁。
meaning_en: no stronghold one cannot overcome (idiom); to conquer every obstacle; nothing one can't do; to carry everything before one

meaning_cn: 眉头舒展，眼含笑意。形容高兴愉快的样子。
meaning_en: brows raised in delight, eyes laughing (idiom); beaming with joy; all smiles

meaning_cn: 火树火红的树，指树上挂满灯彩；银花银白色的花，指灯光雪亮。形容张灯结彩或大放焰火的灿烂夜景。
meaning_en: display of fireworks and lanterns

meaning_cn: 一手指一个人；包办总揽一切，独自办理。指一人独揽，不让别人插手。
meaning_en: to take care of a matter all by oneself; to run the whole show

meaning_cn: 金属造的城，滚水形成的护城河。形容工事无比坚固。
meaning_en: (lit.) secure as a city protected by a wall of metal and a moat of boiling water (idiom); (fig.) well fortified; invulnerable to attack

meaning_cn: 古代帝王的自称◇指脱离群众，孤立无助的人。
meaning_en: one who is cut off from others (idiom); one who has chosen to follow a solitary path; (can also be an indirect way of referring to an unmarried person)

meaning_cn: 没有老师的传授就能通晓。
meaning_en: self-taught; to learn without a teacher (idiom)

meaning_cn: 顾拜访；茅庐草屋。原为汉末刘备访聘诸葛亮的故事。比喻真心诚意，一再邀请。
meaning_en: lit. to make three visits to the thatched cottage (idiom) (allusion to an episode in Romance of the Three Kingdoms 三國演義|三国演义[San1 guo2 Yan3 yi4] in which Liu Bei 劉備|刘备[Liu2 Bei4] recruits Zhuge Liang 諸葛亮|诸葛亮[Zhu1 ge3 Liang4] to his cause by visiting him three times); fig. to make earnest and repeated requests of sb

meaning_cn: 便便肥胖的样子。形容肥胖的样子。
meaning_en: big-bellied (idiom); paunchy

meaning_cn: 升平太平。边歌边舞，庆祝太平。有粉饰太平的意思。
meaning_en: (lit.) to celebrate peace with songs and dance (idiom); (fig.) to make a show of happiness and prosperity

meaning_cn: 两立双方并立。指敌对的双方不能同时存在。比喻矛盾不可调和。
meaning_en: the two cannot exist together (idiom); irreconcilable differences; incompatible standpoints

meaning_cn: 养保养；精精神；蓄积蓄；锐锐气。保养精神，蓄集力量。
meaning_en: to preserve and nurture one's spirit (idiom); honing one's strength for the big push

meaning_cn: 指对人或对事物顷注了很深的感情，向往而不能克制。
meaning_en: deeply attached; devoted

meaning_cn: 甘甜，比喻幸福。艰难的日子过完，美好的日子来到了。
meaning_en: bitterness finishes, sweetness begins (idiom); the hard times are over, the good times just beginning

meaning_cn: 优柔犹豫不决；寡少。指做事犹豫，缺乏决断。
meaning_en: indecisive; irresolute

meaning_cn: 绞尽脑汁，苦思苦想。
meaning_en: see 苦思冥想[ku3 si1 ming2 xiang3]

meaning_cn: 形容说话不流利。也比喻凑合，勉强。
meaning_en: stammeringly

meaning_cn: 指无法无天的强暴行为。
meaning_en: to kill and burn (idiom); murder and arson

meaning_cn: 营谋求；舞玩弄；弊指坏事。因图谋私利而玩弄欺骗手段做犯法的事。
meaning_en: see 徇私舞弊[xun4 si1 wu3 bi4]

meaning_cn: 边幅布帛的边缘，比喻人的衣着、仪表。原形容随随便便，不拘小节◇形容不注意衣着或容貌的整洁。
meaning_en: not care about one's appearance (idiom); slovenly in dress and manner

meaning_cn: 以手牵牵拉拉。借指拉扯私欲关系。
meaning_en: to tug at; to pull at sb aggressively; to take sb's hand or arm in a too familiar way; (derog.) to hobnob; to consort

meaning_cn: 枯燥单调。形容单调，没有趣味。
meaning_en: tedious; dreary

meaning_cn: 指着鹿，说是马。比喻故意颠倒黑白，混淆是非。
meaning_en: making a deer out to be a horse (idiom); deliberate misrepresentation

meaning_cn: 指一个人的是非功过到死后才能做出结论。同盖棺论定”。
meaning_en: don't pass judgment on a person's life until the lid is on the coffin (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指朋友或亲人在长久分别之后再次见面。
meaning_en: to meet again after a long period of separation

meaning_cn: 悔悔改；过错误；自新使自己重新做人。悔恨以前的过失，决心重新作人。
meaning_en: to repent and start afresh (idiom); to turn over a new leaf

meaning_cn: 泛泛平常，不深入。一般地浮泛地谈谈。
meaning_en: to speak in general terms

meaning_cn: 投机利用时机钻空子。利用时机，以囤积居奇、买空卖空、掺杂作假、操纵物价等手段牟取暴利。
meaning_en: to engage in speculation and profiteering

meaning_cn: 赴走往；汤热水；蹈踩。沸水敢蹚，烈火敢踏。比喻不避艰险，奋勇向前。
meaning_en: lit. to jump into scalding water and plunge into raging fire (idiom); fig. to brave any danger; to go to any lengths (for a noble cause)

meaning_cn: 奇怪的不合情理的言论。
meaning_en: strange tales and absurd arguments (idiom); unreasonable remarks

meaning_cn: 腰缠指随身携带的财物；贯旧时用绳索穿钱，每一千文为一贯。比喻钱财极多。
meaning_en: lit. ten thousand strings of cash in money belt (idiom); carrying lots of money; extremely wealthy; loaded

meaning_cn: 择挑拣。不管什么都吃。比喻需要急迫，顾不得选择。
meaning_en: when hungry, you can't pick what you eat (idiom); beggars can't be choosers; When matters are urgent, don't spend time choosing alternatives.

meaning_cn: 教和学两方面互相影响和促进，都得到提高。
meaning_en: when you teach someone, both teacher and student will benefit

meaning_cn: 把大的材料当成小的材料用。比喻使用不当，浪费人才。
meaning_en: (idiom) to use a talented person in a role far beneath their ability; a waste of talent

meaning_cn: 许多星星衬托着月亮。比喻众人拥护着一个他们所尊敬爱戴的人。
meaning_en: lit. all the stars cup themselves around the moon (idiom, from Analects); fig. to view sb as core figure; to group around a revered leader; to revolve around sb

meaning_cn: 本根本；溯探求。追究根本，探索源头，比喻追寻根源。
meaning_en: to trace sth back to its origin

meaning_cn: 形容情况非常确实。
meaning_en: absolutely true (idiom); manifold; true from many points of view

meaning_cn: 用短柄刀直接刺入。原比喻认定目标，勇猛精进◇比喻说话直接了当，不绕弯子。
meaning_en: (idiom) to get straight to the point

meaning_cn: 支撑住。快乐到不能撑持的地步。形容欣喜到极点。
meaning_en: overjoyed (idiom); as pleased as punch

meaning_cn: 指待人和善能招财进宝。
meaning_en: (idiom) amiability makes you rich

meaning_cn: 蒂花或瓜果跟枝茎相连的部分。瓜熟了，瓜蒂自然脱落。指时机一旦成熟，事情自然成功。
meaning_en: when the melon is ripe, it falls (idiom); problems sort themselves out in the fullness of time

meaning_cn: 的靶心；矢箭。没有目标乱射箭。比喻说话做事没有明确目的，或不切合实际。
meaning_en: to shoot without aim (idiom); fig. to speak without thinking; firing blindly; to shoot in the air; a shot in the dark

meaning_cn: 全部计算在内。
meaning_en: taking everything into account (idiom); when all is said and done

meaning_cn: 只要低下头来捡取，到处都是。形容多而易得。
meaning_en: lit. so numerous that one could just bend down and pick them up (idiom); fig. extremely common; easily available

meaning_cn: 陈旧不合理的规章制度或习惯。
meaning_en: (idiom) outmoded conventions; old-fashioned ways

meaning_cn: 惨狠毒，残暴。残酷狠毒到极点，如野兽一样。
meaning_en: inhuman (idiom); brutal and unfeeling

meaning_cn: 水面的光和掠过的影子，一晃就消逝。比喻观察不细致，学习不深入，印象不深刻。
meaning_en: flickering light and passing shadows (idiom); blurred scenery; cursory; superficial

meaning_cn: 潭深水坑。一池子死水。比喻停滞不前的沉闷局面。
meaning_en: a pool of stagnant water; stagnant or listless condition

meaning_cn: 零碎的，少量的。形容零散而不完整。
meaning_en: odd; piecemeal; fragmentary

meaning_cn: 得意称心如意；门生亲授业的弟子或科举中试者对座师的自称◇泛指学生。最满意的弟子或学生。
meaning_en: favorite pupil

meaning_cn: 形容态度十分恭敬。
meaning_en: reverent and respectful; extremely deferential

meaning_cn: 极顶点；反向反面转化。事物发展到极点，会向相反方向转化。
meaning_en: when things reach an extreme, they can only move in the opposite direction (idiom)

meaning_cn: 荣华草木开花，比喻兴盛或显达。形容有钱有势。
meaning_en: glory, splendor, wealth and rank (idiom); high position and great wealth

meaning_cn: 这也怀疑，那也怀疑。形容非常多疑。
meaning_en: to suspect everyone; overly suspicious

meaning_cn: 宁愿死也不屈服。
meaning_en: rather die than submit (idiom)

meaning_cn: 颠跌；扑敲。无论怎样摔打都破不了。比喻理论学说完全正确，不会被驳倒推翻。
meaning_en: solid; unbreakable; (fig.) irrefutable; incontrovertible; indisputable

meaning_cn: 宗宗族；祖祖先。指子孙做了官出了名，使祖先和家族都荣耀。
meaning_en: to bring honor to one's ancestors

meaning_cn: 精心细致地雕刻。形容创作艺术品时的苦心刻画。也比喻认真细致地加工。
meaning_en: (lit.) fine sculpting (idiom); (fig.) to work (at sth) with extreme care and precision

meaning_cn: 成竹现成完整的竹子。画竹前竹的全貌已在胸中。比喻在做事之前已经拿定主义。
meaning_en: see 胸有成竹[xiong1 you3 cheng2 zhu2]

meaning_cn: 耿耿忠诚的样子。形容非常忠诚。
meaning_en: loyal and devoted (idiom); faithful and true

meaning_cn: 既有钱财，又有势力。
meaning_en: rich and powerful (idiom)

meaning_cn: 双方对立，彼此相持，不肯让步。
meaning_en: at a stalemate; deadlocked; in unrelenting mutual opposition

meaning_cn: 由衰老恢复青春。形容老年人充满了活力。
meaning_en: to recover one's youthful vigor; to feel rejuvenated (idiom)

meaning_cn: 反唇回嘴、顶嘴。受到指责不服气，反过来讥讽对方。
meaning_en: (idiom) to answer back sarcastically; to retort

meaning_cn: 哀鸿哀鸣的鸿雁。比喻啼饥号寒的灾民。比喻在天灾人祸中到处都是流离失所、呻吟呼号的饥民。
meaning_en: lit. plaintive whine of geese (idiom); fig. land swarming with disaster victims; starving people fill the land

meaning_cn: 意思是设伏兵于十面以围歼敌军。
meaning_en: Ambush from Ten Sides (pipa solo piece); House of Flying Daggers (2004 movie by Zhang Yimou 張藝謀|张艺谋[Zhang1 Yi4 mou2])

meaning_cn: 飞扬放纵；跋扈蛮横。原指意态狂豪，不爱约束。现多形容骄横放肆，目中无人。
meaning_en: bossy and domineering; throwing one's weight about

meaning_cn: 争争夺；强优胜；好喜爱。争为强者，事事处处都喜欢超过和压倒别人。
meaning_en: competitive; ambitious and aggressive; to desire to beat others

meaning_cn: 咎责怪。原指已经做完或做过的事，就不必再责怪了。现指对以往的过错不再责备。
meaning_en: to forget and not bear recriminations (idiom); to let bygones be bygones; There is no point in crying over spilt milk.

meaning_cn: 形容以零零碎碎、断断续续的方式进行或处理。
meaning_en: to do things in bits and pieces (idiom); piecemeal work

meaning_cn: 一天能收进一斗黄金。形容发大财。
meaning_en: (idiom) to rake in money; to make money hand over fist

meaning_cn: 指共过患难的人或彼此处于同样困境的人。
meaning_en: (idiom) companions in hardship; fellow sufferers

meaning_cn: 尔你；虞、诈欺骗。表示彼此互相欺骗。
meaning_en: lit. you hoodwink me and I cheat you (idiom); fig. each tries to outwit the other; deceit and treachery

meaning_cn: 喜欢新的，厌弃旧的。多指爱情不专一。
meaning_en: lit. to like the new, and hate the old (idiom); fig. enamored with new people (e.g. new girlfriend), bored with the old

meaning_cn: 暇空闲。光顾自己还来不及。指没有力量再照顾别人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have one's hands full managing one's own affairs; too busy to spare time for anything extra

meaning_cn: 变坏事为好事。
meaning_en: to have some good come out of a bad situation (idiom); a blessing in disguise

meaning_cn: 这件事性质重要，关系重大。
meaning_en: this is no small thing (idiom); to have a serious matter at hand

meaning_cn: 筹筹码，古代用以计数的工具，多用竹子制成。比较起来，稍微好一些。
meaning_en: slightly better; a cut above

meaning_cn: 形容名气很大。
meaning_en: famous; celebrated

meaning_cn: 当应该；益更加；壮雄壮。年纪虽老而志气更旺盛，干劲更足。
meaning_en: old but vigorous (idiom); hale and hearty despite the years

meaning_cn: 胜尽。列举也列举不完。形容数量很多。
meaning_en: too numerous to list (idiom); innumerable

meaning_cn: 指财物等身体以外的东西，表示无足轻重的意思。
meaning_en: mere worldly possessions

meaning_cn: 量估量。按照自己力量的大小去做，不要勉强。
meaning_en: to weigh one's abilities and act accordingly; to act according to one's means; to cut one's coat according to one's cloth

meaning_cn: 伶仃孤独，没有依靠。孤单困苦，没有依靠。
meaning_en: solitary and impoverished (idiom)

meaning_cn: 性情直爽，有话就说。
meaning_en: frank and outspoken (idiom); straight speaking; to say what one thinks

meaning_cn: 象血和肉一样相互联系着。比喻关系十分密切，不可分离。
meaning_en: one's own flesh and blood (idiom); closely related

meaning_cn: 叛背叛；离离开。众人反对，亲人背离。形容完全孤立。
meaning_en: lit. people rebelling and friends deserting (idiom); fig. to find oneself utterly isolated

meaning_cn: 杀鸡给猴子看。比喻用惩罚一个人的办法来警告别的人。
meaning_en: (lit.) to kill the chicken to warn the monkey (idiom); (fig.) to punish an individual as an example to others

meaning_cn: 驱除干净，彻底消灭。比喻残忍狠毒，不留余地。
meaning_en: to kill to the last one (idiom); to exterminate; to eradicate; ruthless

meaning_cn: 全世界找不到第二个。
meaning_en: unrivaled (idiom); world number one; unique; unequaled

meaning_cn: 粟谷子，即小米。大海里的一粒谷子。比喻非常渺小。
meaning_en: (lit.) one grain floating on the ocean (idiom); (fig.) a drop in the ocean

meaning_cn: 形容得意时神气十足的姿态。
meaning_en: immensely pleased with oneself (idiom); proud; complacent

meaning_cn: 名字落在榜末孙山的后面。指考试或盐没有录取。
meaning_en: lit. to fall behind Sun Shan 孫山|孙山[Sun1 Shan1] (who came last in the imperial examination) (idiom); fig. to fail an exam; to fall behind (in a competition)

meaning_cn: 根据外貌来判别一个的的品质才能。
meaning_en: to judge sb by appearances (idiom)

meaning_cn: 抹角挨墙角绕过。沿着弯弯曲曲的路走。比喻说话绕弯，不直截了当。
meaning_en: lit. going round the curves and skirting the corners (idiom); fig. to speak in a roundabout way; to equivocate; to beat about the bush

meaning_cn: 表面与内在不一样。
meaning_en: outside appearance and inner reality differ (idiom); not what it seems; saying one thing but meaning sth different

meaning_cn: 高兴到极点时，发生使人悲伤的事。
meaning_en: extreme joy turns to sorrow (idiom); Don't celebrate too soon, things could still go wrong!

meaning_cn: 形容婴儿咿咿呀呀地学大人说话的神情。
meaning_en: see 咿呀學語|咿呀学语[yi1 ya1 xue2 yu3]

meaning_cn: 际边缘处。形容范围极为广阔。
meaning_en: (idiom) boundless; limitless

meaning_cn: 手足比喻兄弟。交情很深，如同兄弟一样。
meaning_en: as close as one's hands and feet (idiom); loving one another as brothers; deep friendship; closely attached to one another

meaning_cn: 为了公事而不考虑私事，为了集体利益而不考虑个人得失。
meaning_en: for the common good and forgetting personal interests (idiom); to behave altruistically; selfless

meaning_cn: 一夜分为五更，三更是午夜十二时。指深夜。
meaning_en: (idiom) in the depth of the night; very late at night

meaning_cn: 时间长，日子久。
meaning_en: after a long time (idiom)

meaning_cn: 行尸可以走动的尸体；走肉会走动而没有灵魂的躯壳。比喻不动脑筋，不起作用，糊里糊涂过日子的人。
meaning_en: walking corpse (idiom); zombie; person who lives only on the material level

meaning_cn: 指挑挑拣拣，嫌这嫌那。
meaning_en: to be picky; to be choosy

meaning_cn: 心中不服，感到气愤。同愤愤不平”。
meaning_en: variant of 憤憤不平|愤愤不平[fen4 fen4 bu4 ping2]

meaning_cn: 象龙在飞腾，虎在跳跃。形容跑跳时动作矫健有力。也比喻奋起行动，有所作为。
meaning_en: lit. dragon soaring and tiger leaping (idiom); fig. prosperous and bustling; vigorous and active

meaning_cn: 指把少有的货物囤积起来，等待高价出售。也比喻拿某种专长或独占的东西作为资本，等待时机，以捞取名利地位。
meaning_en: rare commodity worth hoarding; object for profiteering

meaning_cn: 说话不算数，没有信用。
meaning_en: (idiom) untrustworthy; not true to one's word

meaning_cn: 在地上画一个圈当做监狱。比喻只许在指定的范围内活动。
meaning_en: lit. to be confined within a circle drawn on the ground (idiom); fig. to confine oneself to a restricted range of activities

meaning_cn: 龙马古代传说中形状象龙的骏马。比喻人精神旺盛。
meaning_en: old but still full of vitality (idiom)

meaning_cn: 荒诞荒唐离奇；不经不合常理。形容言论荒谬，不合情理。
meaning_en: absurd; preposterous; ridiculous

meaning_cn: 党集团；营谋求。坏人集结在一起，谋求私利，专干坏事。
meaning_en: (idiom) to form a clique for self-serving purposes

meaning_cn: 形容子孙后代人很多。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be a flourishing family with many descendants

meaning_cn: 生下来没有遇到好时候。旧时指命运不好。
meaning_en: born at the wrong time (idiom); unlucky (esp. to complain about one's fate); born under an unlucky star; ahead of his time

meaning_cn: 比喻对事物只凭片面的了解或局部的经验，就乱加猜测，想做出全面的判断。
meaning_en: blind people touch an elephant (idiom, from Nirvana sutra 大般涅槃經|大般涅盘经[da4 ban1 Nie4 pan2 jing1]); fig. unable to see the big picture; to mistake the part for the whole; unable to see the wood for the trees

meaning_cn: 寥寥稀少，很少。形容很少，数得出来。
meaning_en: (idiom) very few

meaning_cn: 腹指前面；背指后面。前后受到敌人的夹攻。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be attacked from the front and rear

meaning_cn: 凌欺凌。依仗强大，欺侮弱小。
meaning_en: see 恃強欺弱|恃强欺弱[shi4 qiang2 qi1 ruo4]

meaning_cn: 为做，引伸为谋求。剥削者为了发财致富，心狠手毒，没有一点儿仁慈的心肠。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be wealthy and heartless

meaning_cn: 形形态。形容高兴得失去了常态。
meaning_en: so pleased as to lose one's sense of measure; beside oneself with joy

meaning_cn: 形容做事马虎粗心，不是丢了这个，就是忘了那个。
meaning_en: forgetful; empty-headed

meaning_cn: 旧指世家望族中有才德的女子。也泛指有钱有势人家的女儿。
meaning_en: girl from a wealthy family; unmarried daughter of a noble house

meaning_cn: 颜脸面。指人脸皮厚，不知羞耻。
meaning_en: shameless

meaning_cn: 指意外的灾祸或事故。特指人的死亡。
meaning_en: unexpected misfortune; unexpected accident; sudden death

meaning_cn: 除草时要连根除掉，使草不能再长。比喻除去祸根，以免后患。
meaning_en: to cut weeds and eliminate the roots (idiom); to destroy root and branch; to eliminate completely

meaning_cn: 万道河，千重山。形容路途艰难遥远。
meaning_en: ten thousand crags and torrents (idiom); the trials and tribulations of a long journey; a long and difficult road

meaning_cn: 从眼前飘过的云烟。原比喻身外之物，不必重视◇比喻很快就消失的事物。
meaning_en: (idiom) passing mist and clouds (metaphor for sth fleeting)

meaning_cn: 坚坚定；贞有节操；屈屈服、低头。意志坚定，决不屈服。
meaning_en: faithful and unchanging (idiom); steadfast

meaning_cn: 挥霍摇手称挥，反手称攉，意即动作敏捷，引伸为用钱没有节制；无度没有限度。指滥用金钱，没有节制。
meaning_en: (idiom) to squander recklessly; to spend extravagantly

meaning_cn: 草菅野草。把人命看作野草。比喻反动统治者随意谑杀人民。
meaning_en: to have disregard for human life (idiom)

meaning_cn: 从竹管的小孔里看豹，只看到豹身上的一块斑纹。比喻只看到事物的一部分，指所见不全面或略有所得。
meaning_en: lit. to see a leopard through a narrow tube (idiom); fig. to miss the big picture

meaning_cn: 舍舍弃；生生命；取求取；义正义。舍弃生命以正义。指为正义而牺牲生命。
meaning_en: to give up life for righteousness (idiom, from Mencius); to choose honor over life; would rather sacrifice one's life than one's principles

meaning_cn: 发愤决心努力；图谋求。决心奋斗，努力谋求强盛。
meaning_en: to be strongly determined to succeed (idiom)

meaning_cn: 苟暂且，勉强；延延续；残喘临死前的喘息。勉强延续临死前的喘息。比喻暂时勉强维持生存。
meaning_en: (idiom) to struggle on whilst at death's door

meaning_cn: 颜面容；悦愉快；色脸色。脸色和霭喜悦。形容和善可亲。
meaning_en: amiable manner; pleasant countenance

meaning_cn: 索然没有意味、没有兴趣的样子。形容事物枯燥无味（多指文章）。
meaning_en: dull; insipid

meaning_cn: 比喻面子丧失干净。
meaning_en: lit. for one's face to reach rock bottom; to be thoroughly discredited (idiom)

meaning_cn: 隔着河看人家着火。比喻对别人的危难不去求助，在一旁看热闹。
meaning_en: to watch the fires burning across the river; to delay entering the fray until all others have been exhausted by fighting amongst themselves (idiom)

meaning_cn: 前进和后退都失去了依据。形容无处容身。也指进退两难。
meaning_en: no room to advance or to retreat (idiom); at a loss; in a hopeless situation

meaning_cn: 背离开；井古制八家为井，引伸为乡里，家宅。离开家乡到外地。
meaning_en: to leave one's homeplace (to find work, flee disaster etc)

meaning_cn: 故故人，老友。有亲戚朋友的关系。
meaning_en: (idiom) to have some sort of connection (personal or familial etc)

meaning_cn: 指区分不出两者的差别。
meaning_en: (idiom) without the slightest difference

meaning_cn: 挑、拣选择；肥肥肉；瘦瘦肉。比喻挑挑拣拣，光要对自己有利的。
meaning_en: (idiom) to cherry-pick; to pick the best parts for oneself; to be choosy

meaning_cn: 风里夹着腥味，雨点带着鲜血。形容疯狂杀戮的凶险气氛或环境。
meaning_en: (lit.) foul wind and bloody rain (idiom); (fig.) reign of terror; carnage

meaning_cn: 人马被打得仰翻在地。形容被打得惨败。也比喻乱得一塌糊涂，不可收拾。
meaning_en: to suffer a crushing defeat (idiom); in a pitiful state; in a complete mess; to roll (with laughter)

meaning_cn: 脂胭脂。搽胭脂抹粉。指妇女打扮。也比喻为遮掩丑恶的本质而粉饰打扮。
meaning_en: (idiom) to put on makeup; (idiom) to prettify

meaning_cn: 指说话、做事很讲道理。
meaning_en: (idiom) fair and reasonable; sensible; standing to reason

meaning_cn: 乐乐意；为做。有什么不乐于去做的呢？表示愿意去做。
meaning_en: (idiom) what is there against it? (rhetorical question indicating an eagerness or willingness to do sth)

meaning_cn: 形容不重天伦，不通人情，对亲属都不顾。有时也指对谁都不讲情面。
meaning_en: not recognizing one's family (idiom); self-centered and not making any allowances for the needs of one's relatives

meaning_cn: 孤芳独秀一时的香花。把自己比做仅有的香花而自我欣赏。比喻自命清高。
meaning_en: lone flower admiring itself (idiom); narcissism; self-love

meaning_cn: 水的冷暖，只有饮者自己知道。佛教禅宗用以比喻自己证悟的境界。也比喻学习心得深浅，只有自己知道。
meaning_en: see 如人飲水，冷暖自知|如人饮水，冷暖自知[ru2 ren2 yin3 shui3 , leng3 nuan3 zi4 zhi1]

meaning_cn: 原指音乐的余音。比喻言外之意，即在话里间接透露，而不是明说出来的意思。
meaning_en: overtone (music); (fig.) connotation; implied meaning

meaning_cn: 敌匹敌。私人拥有的财富可与国家的资财相匹敌。形容极为富有。
meaning_en: having wealth equivalent to that of an entire nation (idiom); extremely wealthy

meaning_cn: 确凿的凭据。
meaning_en: reliable evidence (idiom); conclusive proof; definitive evidence

meaning_cn: 学学问；术技能。原指没有学问因而没有办法。现指没有学问，没有本领。
meaning_en: without learning or skills (idiom); ignorant and incompetent

meaning_cn: 浪子二流子。不务正业的人改邪归正。
meaning_en: the return of a prodigal son (idiom)

meaning_cn: 阿谀用言语恭维别人；奉承恭维，讨好。曲从拍马，迎合别人，竭力向人讨好。
meaning_en: flattering and fawning (idiom); sweet-talking

meaning_cn: 绝处死路。形容在最危险的时候得到生路。
meaning_en: (idiom) to find a way to survive when everything seems hopeless

meaning_cn: 舌头灵巧，象簧片一样能发出动听的乐音。形容花言巧语，能说会道。
meaning_en: lit. to have a tongue like the reed of a wind instrument (idiom); fig. to have a glib tongue

meaning_cn: 不值得批驳。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of an argument) not even worthy of a rebuttal

meaning_cn: 泛指没有劳动力而又没有亲属供养的人。
meaning_en: (lit.) widowers, widows, orphans and the childless (idiom); (fig.) people with no one left to rely on

meaning_cn: 手脚动作很轻，使没有响声。
meaning_en: (idiom) (to move or do sth) softly; quietly; gently

meaning_cn: 引拉长；吭嗓子，喉咙。放开嗓子大声歌唱。
meaning_en: to sing at the top of one's voice (idiom)

meaning_cn: 层峦山连着山；迭障许多高险的象屏障一样的山。形容山峰多而险峻。
meaning_en: range upon range of mountains (idiom)

meaning_cn: 晚节指晚年的节操。已经到了晚年却未能保住自己的节操。也指事情快成功的时候却失败了。
meaning_en: (idiom) to tarnish one's reputation in later life; to lose prestige at a later stage

meaning_cn: 找各种借口推托。
meaning_en: to use all sorts of excuses

meaning_cn: 眉、目眉毛和眼睛，泛指容貌。形容人容貌清秀不俗气。
meaning_en: pretty; with delicate features

meaning_cn: 比喻人出了名或有了钱财就容易惹人注意，引起麻烦。
meaning_en: lit. a tall tree attracts the wind (idiom); fig. a famous or rich person attracts criticism

meaning_cn: 奉奉行；公公务。奉公行事，遵守法令。形容办事守规矩。
meaning_en: to carry out official duties and observe the law

meaning_cn: 比喻方法本来不恰当，却侥幸得到满意的结果。也比喻原意本不在此，却凑巧和别人的想法符合。
meaning_en: to succeed by a lucky stroke

meaning_cn: 真实的情意。
meaning_en: (idiom) sincere feelings; genuine emotions

meaning_cn: 不是鱼死，就是网破。指拼个你死我活。
meaning_en: lit. either the fish dies or the net splits; a life and death struggle (idiom)

meaning_cn: 已停止。指无法控制自己，使激动的情绪平静下来。
meaning_en: unable to control oneself; to be beside oneself

meaning_cn: 形容射箭或打枪准确，每次都命中目标。也比喻做事有充分把握。
meaning_en: (lit.) one hundred shots, one hundred hits (idiom); (fig.) to shoot with unfailing accuracy; to hit the mark every time

meaning_cn: 猴、马十二生肖之一。泛指未来的岁月。
meaning_en: long time off; time that will never come

meaning_cn: 一二形容为数不多。略微知道一点。
meaning_en: (idiom) to know just a little; to have a rough idea

meaning_cn: 临到打仗时逃跑了。也比喻到了紧要关头退缩逃避。
meaning_en: see 臨陣退縮|临阵退缩[lin2 zhen4 tui4 suo1]

meaning_cn: 形表现；色脸色。内心的喜悦表现在脸上。形容抑制不住内心的喜悦。
meaning_en: face light up with delight (idiom); to beam with joy

meaning_cn: 梗阻塞，妨碍。在事情进行中，设置障碍，故意为难。
meaning_en: (idiom) to deliberately create obstacles; to obstruct from behind the scenes; to throw a wrench in the works

meaning_cn: 玩世以消极、玩弄的态度对待生活；不恭不严肃。因对现实不满而采取的一种不严肃、不认真的生活态度。
meaning_en: to trifle without respect (idiom); to despise worldly conventions; frivolous

meaning_cn: 蚕吐丝作茧，把自己裹在里面。比喻做了某件事，结果使自己受困。也比喻自己给自己找麻烦。
meaning_en: to spin a cocoon around oneself (idiom); enmeshed in a trap of one's own devising; hoist by his own petard

meaning_cn: 指无聊的人随意议论妇女的容貌体态。现亦比喻在小节上一味挑剔。同品头题足”。
meaning_en: lit. to assess the head and discuss the feet (idiom); minute criticism of a woman's appearance; fig. to find fault in minor details; nitpicking; overcritical

meaning_cn: 指社会风气一天不如一天。
meaning_en: public morals are degenerating with each passing day (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容人或动物消瘦露骨。
meaning_en: skinny; emaciated (idiom)

meaning_cn: 其中的乐趣没有穷尽。指朝廷某一工作，感到乐在其中。
meaning_en: boundless joy

meaning_cn: 明察看清；秋毫秋天鸟兽身上新长的细毛。原形容人目光敏锐，任何细小的事物都能看得很清楚◇多形容人能洞察事理。
meaning_en: lit. seeing clearly the downy feathers of autumn (idiom, from Mencius); fig. perceptive of even the finest detail

meaning_cn: 象游鱼一样一个跟着一个地接连着走。形容一个接一个地依次序进入。
meaning_en: to walk in in a line

meaning_cn: 扭转败局，变为胜利。
meaning_en: to turn defeat into victory (idiom); to turn the tide

meaning_cn: 形容人来人往，非常热闹拥挤。
meaning_en: a place buzzing with activity (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容人反复无常或惯于耍手段。
meaning_en: to produce clouds with one turn of the hand and rain with another (idiom); fig. to shift one's ground; tricky and inconstant; to make love

meaning_cn: 指象野兽远远跑掉，象鸟儿远远飞走。比喻人跑到很远的地方去。多指摆脱困境去寻找出路。
meaning_en: (idiom) to go far away; to flee to a distant place

meaning_cn: 留下无穷的祸患。
meaning_en: to have disastrous consequences

meaning_cn: 魂、魄旧指人身中离开形体能存在的精神为魂，依附形体而显现的精神为魄。形容惊慌忧虑、心神不定、行动失常的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) dazed; beside oneself

meaning_cn: 有面子；头面人物。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a person) to be highly respected; to enjoy prestige

meaning_cn: 虚谦虚；谷山谷。胸怀象山谷一样深广。形容十分谦虚，能容纳别人的意见。
meaning_en: receptive as an echoing canyon (idiom); modest and open-minded

meaning_cn: 两手、两膝和头一起着地。是佛教一种最恭敬的行礼仪式。比喻佩服到了极点。
meaning_en: to prostrate oneself in admiration (idiom); to adulate sb

meaning_cn: 虚假；委蛇随便应顺。指对人虚情假意，敷衍应酬。
meaning_en: (idiom) to feign civility

meaning_cn: 画个饼来解除饥饿。比喻用空想来安慰自己。
meaning_en: lit. to allay one's hunger using a picture of a cake; to feed on illusions (idiom)

meaning_cn: 黑色与白色对比鲜明。比喻事非界限很清楚。也形容字迹、画面清楚。
meaning_en: lit. black and white clearly contrasted (idiom); fig. unambiguous; black-and-white; in sharp contrast; to distinguish clearly right from wrong

meaning_cn: 争夺权力和利益。
meaning_en: scramble for power and profit (idiom); power struggle

meaning_cn: 空有名望。指有名无实。
meaning_en: with an undeserved reputation (idiom); unwarranted fame; nowhere near as good as he's made out to be

meaning_cn: 水光与天色相浑。形容水天相接的辽阔景象。
meaning_en: water and sky merge in one color (idiom)

meaning_cn: 万古千秋万代。千秋万代都象松柏一样永远苍翠。比喻崇高的精神或深厚的友谊永远不会消失。
meaning_en: (idiom) enduring through the ages; ever-flourishing

meaning_cn: 白驹白色骏马，比喻太阳；隙缝隙。象凶马在细小的缝隙前跑过一样。形容时间过得极快。
meaning_en: a white steed flits past a crack (idiom); How time flies!

meaning_cn: 果充实，饱。指吃不饱肚子。形容生活贫困。
meaning_en: lit. food not filling the stomach (idiom); fig. poverty-stricken

meaning_cn: 比喻有极大的可能性。
meaning_en: most likely; mostly (in 8 or 9 cases out of 10); vast majority

meaning_cn: 憎恨。爱和恨的立场和态度十分鲜明。
meaning_en: to make a clear difference between what one likes and what one hates; to have well-defined likes and dislikes

meaning_cn: 比喻俱为所欲，难于取舍之物。
meaning_en: lit. the fish and the bear's paw, you can't have both at the same time (idiom, from Mencius); fig. you must choose one or the other; you can't always get everything you want; you can't have your cake and eat it

meaning_cn: 熟练了，就能找到窍门。
meaning_en: with familiarity you learn the trick (idiom); practice makes perfect

meaning_cn: 刚一打开旗帜进入战斗，就取得了胜利。比喻事情刚一开始，就取得好成绩。
meaning_en: lit. to win a victory on raising the flag (idiom); fig. to start on sth and have immediate success; success in a single move

meaning_cn: 毕露完全显露。锐气和才华全都显露出来。多指人好表现自己。
meaning_en: to show off one's ability

meaning_cn: 原形容雨势大，后形容力量或声势非常壮大。
meaning_en: lit. overturning seas and rivers (idiom); fig. overwhelming; earth-shattering; in a spectacular mess

meaning_cn: 客人反过来成为主人。比喻变被动为主动。
meaning_en: lit. the guest acts as host (idiom); fig. to turn from passive to active behavior

meaning_cn: 原指战国时代楚国民间流行的一种歌曲。比喻通俗的文学艺术。
meaning_en: folk songs of the state of Chu 楚國|楚国[Chu3 guo2]; popular art forms (contrasted with 陽春白雪|阳春白雪[yang2 chun1 bai2 xue3], highbrow art forms)

meaning_cn: 色种类。各种类别，各种式样。
meaning_en: (idiom) diverse; various; all kinds of

meaning_cn: 生灵百姓；涂泥沼；炭炭火。人民陷在泥塘和火坑里。形容人民处于极端困苦的境地。
meaning_en: people are in a terrible situation (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指偷窃的行为。也指不正经的勾当。
meaning_en: to imitate the dog and steal chicken (idiom); to pilfer; to dally with women; to have affairs

meaning_cn: 眼睛被一片树叶挡住，指看不到事物的全貌。
meaning_en: lit. eyes obscured by a single leaf (idiom); fig. not seeing the wider picture; can't see the wood for the trees

meaning_cn: 孑单独。孤孤单单一个人。
meaning_en: to be all alone in the world

meaning_cn: 颦皱眉。指忧和喜的表情。
meaning_en: every frown and every smile

meaning_cn: 度考虑。放在考虑之外。指不把个人的生死利害等放在心上。
meaning_en: to give no thought to; to have no regard for; to disregard

meaning_cn: 白搞清楚。没有得到辩白或洗刷的冤屈。
meaning_en: unrighted wrong; unredressed injustice

meaning_cn: 原指人呼吸时，吐出浊气，吸进新鲜空气。现多用来比喻扬弃旧的、不好的，吸收新的，好的。
meaning_en: lit. to breathe out stale air and breathe in fresh (idiom, from Zhuangzi 莊子|庄子[Zhuang1 zi3]); fig. to get rid of the old and bring in the new

meaning_cn: 道家指侍奉仙人的童男童女◇泛指天真无邪的男孩女孩。
meaning_en: lit. golden boys and jade maidens (idiom); attendants of the Daoist immortals; fig. lovely young children; a golden couple; (of a couple who are in the public eye) a lovely young couple

meaning_cn: 招招收；贤有德有才的人；纳接受；士指读书人。招收贤士，接纳书生。指网罗人才。
meaning_en: invite the talented and call the valorous (idiom); to recruit talent

meaning_cn: 丧丧失；辱使受到耻辱。丧失主权，使国家蒙受耻辱。
meaning_en: to forfeit sovereignty and humiliate the country (idiom); to surrender territory under humiliating terms

meaning_cn: 由从；衷内心。话不是打心眼里说出来的，即说的不是真心话。指心口不一致。
meaning_en: to say sth without meaning it (idiom); to speak tongue in cheek; saying one thing but meaning sth different

meaning_cn: 涕眼泪。一下子停止了哭泣，露出笑容。形容转悲为喜。
meaning_en: to turn tears into laughter (idiom); to turn grief into happiness

meaning_cn: 道貌正经严肃的容貌；岸然高傲的样子。指神态严肃，一本正经的样子。
meaning_en: sanctimonious; dignified

meaning_cn: 替百姓除祸害。
meaning_en: (idiom) to rid the people of a scourge

meaning_cn: 逸放荡。原指骄横、奢侈、荒淫、放荡四种恶习◇形容生活放纵奢侈，荒淫无度。
meaning_en: extravagant and dissipated; decadent

meaning_cn: 忠忠诚；贞有操守；渝改变。忠诚坚定，永不改变。
meaning_en: unswerving in one's loyalty (idiom); faithful and constant

meaning_cn: 心怀恻隐而不忍下手。
meaning_en: (idiom) softhearted; merciful

meaning_cn: 天下闻名。形容名声极大。
meaning_en: (idiom) famous throughout the land; renowned far and wide

meaning_cn: 具体各部分已大体具备；微微小。指事物的各个组成部分大体都有了，不过形状和规模比较小些。
meaning_en: miniature; scaled-down; forming a microcosm

meaning_cn: 悲天哀叹时世；悯人怜惜众人。指哀叹时世的艰难，怜惜人们的痛苦。
meaning_en: to bemoan the state of the universe and pity the fate of mankind

meaning_cn: 顽固地坚持自己的意见，不肯改变。
meaning_en: to persist in one's views

meaning_cn: 一刀斩为两段。比喻坚决断绝关系。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make a clean break with; to have nothing more to do with

meaning_cn: 原比喻不知政权会落在谁的手里。现在也泛指在竞赛中不知谁会取得最后的胜利。
meaning_en: lit. at whose hand will the deer die (idiom); fig. who will emerge victorious

meaning_cn: 药治疗。病已重到无法用药医治的程度。比喻已经到了无法挽救的地步。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of an illness) incurable; (of a person, behavior etc) incorrigible; beyond any possibility of correction

meaning_cn: 江河的水一天天地向下流。比喻情况一天天地坏下去。
meaning_en: rivers pour away by the day (idiom); going from bad to worse; deteriorating day by day

meaning_cn: 过高地看待自己。形容狂妄自大，不把别人放眼里。
meaning_en: ridiculous self-importance (idiom); arrogance

meaning_cn: 囫囵整个儿。把枣整个咽下去，不加咀嚼，不辨滋味。比喻对事物不加分析思考。
meaning_en: to swallow in one gulp (idiom); (fig.) to accept without thinking; to lap up

meaning_cn: 又想这样又想那样，犹豫不定。常指不安心，不专一。
meaning_en: in two minds about sth (idiom); half-hearted; shilly-shallying

meaning_cn: 招展迎风摆动的样子。形容打扮得十分艳丽。
meaning_en: lit. lovely scene of blossoming plants swaying in the breeze (idiom); fig. gorgeously dressed (woman)

meaning_cn: 饱充分；经经历；风霜比喻艰难困苦。形容经历过长期的艰难困苦的生活和斗争。
meaning_en: weather-beaten; having experienced the hardships of life

meaning_cn: 随附和。原指封建社会认为妻子必须服从丈夫，后比喻夫妻和好相处。
meaning_en: fig. the man sings and the woman follows; fig. marital harmony

meaning_cn: 揠拔。把苗拔起，以助其生长。比喻违反事物发展的客观规律，急于求成，反而把事情弄糟。
meaning_en: see 拔苗助長|拔苗助长[ba2 miao2 zhu4 zhang3]

meaning_cn: 布满山岭田野。形容数量多或范围广。
meaning_en: covering the whole land; over hills and dales

meaning_cn: 饴麦芽糖‖着糖逗小孙子玩。形容晚年生活的乐趣。
meaning_en: lit. to play with one's grandchildren while eating candy (idiom); fig. to enjoy a happy and leisurely old age

meaning_cn: 偏面地听了一方面的话就信以为真。多指处理事情的态度不公正。
meaning_en: selective listening; to hear what one wants to hear

meaning_cn: 泛指人的喜、怒、哀、乐和嗜欲等。
meaning_en: (idiom) various emotions and desires

meaning_cn: 用柔软的去克制刚强的。
meaning_en: to use softness to conquer strength (idiom)

meaning_cn: 关起门来不外出，指杜绝与外界交往。
meaning_en: (idiom) to stay shut up at home; to not go out

meaning_cn: 戈古代的一种兵器；旦早晨。意思是立志杀敌，枕着武器睡觉等天亮。形容时刻准备作战，。
meaning_en: lit. to wait for dawn, one's head resting on a spear (idiom); fig. fully prepared and biding one's time before the battle

meaning_cn: 破除旧的，建立新的。
meaning_en: to get rid of the old to bring in the new (idiom); to innovate

meaning_cn: 头脑昏晕，眼睛发花。
meaning_en: to faint with blurred vision (idiom); dizzy and eyes dimmed

meaning_cn: 罄尽，完；竹古时用来写字的竹简。形容罪行多得写不完。
