meaning_en: (lit.) too numerous to record on bamboo slips (idiom); (fig.) (of crimes or misdeeds) innumerable; beyond counting

meaning_cn: 吓得连魂魄都离开人体飞散了。形容惊恐万分，极端害怕。
meaning_en: lit. the soul flies away and scatters (idiom); fig. to be frightened stiff; spooked out of one's mind; terror-stricken

meaning_cn: 比喻夫妻失散或离婚后重新团聚。
meaning_en: (lit.) the two halves of the broken mirror are rejoined (idiom); (fig.) long-separated lovers are reunited; a broken relationship is restored

meaning_cn: 昏暗得看不到天上的日光。形容在反动势力统治下社会的黑暗。
meaning_en: all black, no daylight (idiom); a world without justice

meaning_cn: 形容被杀的人极多。
meaning_en: rivers of blood (idiom); bloodbath

meaning_cn: 信任凭，听任；雌黄即鸡冠石，黄色矿物，用作颜料。古人用黄纸写字，写错了，用雌黄涂抹后改写。比喻不顾事实，随口乱说。
meaning_en: to speak off the cuff; to casually opine

meaning_cn: 愤憎恶，痛恨；嫉仇恨，痛恨；世、俗当时的社会状况。有正义感的人对黑暗的现实社会和不合理的习俗表示愤恨、憎恶。
meaning_en: to be cynical; to be embittered

meaning_cn: 情风情；俏俏皮、风趣。指男女调情。
meaning_en: to banter flirtatiously (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容春色正浓，情趣盎然。
meaning_en: lit. the red apricot tree leans over the garden wall (idiom); fig. a wife having an illicit lover

meaning_cn: 街坊邻居。指住处邻近的人。同街坊邻里”。
meaning_en: neighbors; the whole neighborhood

meaning_cn: 敌军已来到自己的城墙下面。比喻情势十分危急。
meaning_en: soldiers at the city walls (idiom); fig. at a critical juncture

meaning_cn: 内心痛苦得象刀割一样。
meaning_en: to feel as if having one's heart cut out (idiom); to be torn with grief

meaning_cn: 形容人的容貌一副善良的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) kind-looking; benevolent-looking

meaning_cn: 指隐藏着未被发现的人才，也指隐藏不露的人才。
meaning_en: lit. hidden dragon, crouching tiger (idiom); fig. talented individuals in hiding; concealed talent

meaning_cn: 风烛被风吹的蜡烛，容易熄灭；残年残余的岁月，指在世不太久。比喻人到了接近死亡的晚年。
meaning_en: one's late days; to have one foot in the grave

meaning_cn: 三个脑袋，六条胳臂。原为佛家语，指佛的法相◇比喻神奇的本领。
meaning_en: (lit.) (having) three heads and six arms (idiom); (fig.) superhuman abilities; exceptional capability

meaning_cn: 鬼怪迷惑住心窍。指对问题认识不清。
meaning_en: to be obsessed; to be possessed

meaning_cn: 挥挥笔；酒洒墨。形容画画、写字、作文，运笔能随心所欲。
meaning_en: (idiom) to do (sth) with great aplomb

meaning_cn: 文文才；武武艺。能文能武，文才和武艺都很出众。
meaning_en: well versed in letters and military technology (idiom); fine scholar and soldier; master of pen and sword

meaning_cn: 狼和狈一同出外伤害牲畜，狼用前腿，狈用后腿，既跑得快，又能爬高。比喻互相勾结干坏事。
meaning_en: villains collude together (idiom); to work hand in glove with sb (to nefarious ends)

meaning_cn: 公事按公事的原则办，不讲私人情面。
meaning_en: to do things in a strictly businesslike manner (idiom)

meaning_cn: 义道理；辞言辞。理由正当充足，措词严正有力。
meaning_en: (idiom) to speak forcibly out of a sense of righteousness

meaning_cn: 科旧指法律条文；律规章，法则。原形容法令条文的尽善尽美。现比喻必须遵守、不能变更的信条。
meaning_en: golden rule; key principle

meaning_cn: 貌外表；神内心。表面上关系很密切，实际上是两条心。
meaning_en: the appearance of unity, but divided at heart (idiom); seeming harmony belies underlying disagreement

meaning_cn: 狗急了也能跳过墙去。比喻坏人在走投无路时豁出去，不顾一切地捣乱。
meaning_en: a cornered dog will jump over the wall (idiom); to be driven to desperate action

meaning_cn: 用喝酒来浇灭郁积在心中的气愤或愁闷。
meaning_en: (idiom) to drown one's sorrows

meaning_cn: 尊地位高；卑低下。在封建社会里男子地位高，女子地位卑下。这是重男轻女的不平等封建礼教。
meaning_en: to regard men as superior to women (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容颜色过分鲜艳繁杂。也比喻浮华而不实在。
meaning_en: gaudy; flashy (but without substance)

meaning_cn: 拿腔拿调，故意做作想引人注意或吓唬人。
meaning_en: posturing; pretentious; affected

meaning_cn: 呻吟病痛时的低哼。没病瞎哼哼。比喻没有值得忧伤的事情而叹息感慨。也比喻文艺作品没有真实感情，装腔作势。
meaning_en: (idiom) to moan and groan despite not being sick; to feign illness; to complain without cause; (of writing) to indulge in confected sentimentality

meaning_cn: 回忆过去的苦难，回想今天的幸福生活。
meaning_en: to view one's past as miserable and one's present as happy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 荒、乱指社会秩序不安定。形容战争期间社会混乱不安的景象。
meaning_en: (idiom) war-torn; ravaged by war; in a state of utter chaos

meaning_cn: 原意是指希奇少见的花草。也比喻美妙的文章作品等。
meaning_en: (idiom) rare or exotic flowers and plants

meaning_cn: 入合乎∠乎常情和道理。
meaning_en: sensible and reasonable (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻人的刚正不阿，坚强不屈的骨气。
meaning_en: see 鐵骨錚錚|铁骨铮铮[tie3 gu3 zheng1 zheng1]

meaning_cn: 事情要抓紧时机快做，不宜拖延。
meaning_en: the matter should not be delayed; there's no time to lose

meaning_cn: 残伤害。自己人互相杀害。
meaning_en: to massacre one another (idiom); internecine strife

meaning_cn: 舍放下。形容感情很好，不愿分离。亦作难分难舍。”。
meaning_en: loath to part (idiom); emotionally close and unwilling to separate

meaning_cn: 回春使春天重返，比喻将快死的人救活。指医生医术高明。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a doctor) to effect a miracle cure

meaning_cn: 奇异常。极大的耻辱。
meaning_en: (idiom) a great humiliation; a huge embarrassment

meaning_cn: 测估测。变化很多，不能预料。
meaning_en: unpredictable; changeable

meaning_cn: 指隐藏着未被发现的人才，也指隐藏不露的人才。
meaning_en: lit. hidden dragon, crouching tiger (idiom); fig. talented individuals in hiding; concealed talent

meaning_cn: 周游全都走到，游遍。原指孔丘带着他的学生周游当时的许多国家，希望得到重用，以便推行儒家的政治主张◇指走遍各地。
meaning_en: to travel around many countries (idiom); peregrinations; refers to the travels of Confucius

meaning_cn: 祸、殃损害。使国家受害，百姓遭殃。
meaning_en: to damage the country and cause suffering to the people (idiom)

meaning_cn: 稳有把握；操掌握；胜券能够制胜的计谋。指有把握取得胜利。
meaning_en: grasp it and victory is assured; to have success within one's grasp (idiom)

meaning_cn: 毕完全。凶恶的面目完全暴露了出来。
meaning_en: show one's ferocious appearance (idiom); the atrocious features revealed; with fangs bared

meaning_cn: 攻治。中医用语，指用含有毒性的药物治疗毒疮等恶性病。比喻利用不良事物本身的矛盾来反对不良事物，或利用恶人来对付恶人。
meaning_en: to cure ills with poison (TCM); to fight evil with evil; set a thief to catch a thief; to fight fire with fire

meaning_cn: 有开头也有收尾。指做事能坚持到底。
meaning_en: where there's a start, there's a finish (idiom); to finish once one starts sth; to carry things through; I started, so I'll finish.

meaning_cn: 比喻因不受重视而担任清闲的职务。也比喻长期等候工作或长久地等待接见。
meaning_en: to hold an inconsequential job; to receive a cold reception; to be kept waiting for an assignment or audience; to be out in the cold; to be sidelined; to warm the bench; to cool one's heels

meaning_cn: 风和雪同时袭来。
meaning_en: (idiom) stormy with wind and snow; blizzard-like (conditions)

meaning_cn: 切切合；中恰好对上；弊害处。指发表的言论正好击中当时社会的弊病。
meaning_en: to hit home on the evils of the day (idiom); fig. to hit a current political target; to hit the nub of the matter

meaning_cn: 身体前后晃动。形容大笑或困倦得直不起腰的样子。
meaning_en: to sway to and fro; to rock back and forth

meaning_cn: 珠、宝指首饰；光、气形容闪耀着光彩。旧时形容妇女服饰华贵富丽，闪耀着珍宝的光色。
meaning_en: bedecked with glittering jewels (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容地形险要，利于作战的地方。比喻可以施展自己才能的地方或机会。
meaning_en: ample scope for abilities; favorable position for the use of one's skills (idiom)

meaning_cn: 躬亲亲自。不论什么事一定要亲自去做，亲自过问。形容办事认真，毫不懈怠。
meaning_en: to attend to everything personally

meaning_cn: 戈闪耀着金光，马配备了铁甲。比喻战争。也形容战士持枪驰马的雄姿。
meaning_en: very powerful army

meaning_cn: 迷信指有被杀的灾祸，
meaning_en: (idiom) mortal danger; fatal disaster

meaning_cn: 邦国家。国家多灾多难，在一定条件下可以激励人民奋发图强，战胜困难，使国家强盛起来。
meaning_en: much hardships may awaken a nation (idiom); calamity that prompts renewal

meaning_cn: 善容易。经常发愁和伤感。形容人思想空虚，感情脆弱。
meaning_en: (idiom) emotionally sensitive and prone to melancholy

meaning_cn: 逆叛逆；道指封建道德；不道违反封建道德。旧时统治阶级对破坏封建秩序的人所加的重大罪名。
meaning_en: disgraceful (of behavior that is unfilial, rebellious or otherwise in grave breach of the norms of society)

meaning_cn: 形容天色昏暗。也比喻社会黑暗混乱。
meaning_en: lit. dark sky and black earth (idiom); fig. pitch dark; to black out; disorderly; troubled times

meaning_cn: 灰心心如熄灭了的死灰；丧失去。形容因失败或不顺利而失去信心，意志消沉。
meaning_en: downhearted; downcast; in despair

meaning_cn: 讨招惹。自己找苦吃。
meaning_en: (idiom) to ask for trouble; to make a rod for one's own back

meaning_cn: 期时间。以后何时相会还没有一定的日期。
meaning_en: (idiom) may never meet again; unlikely to meet again

meaning_cn: 鬻卖。形容政治腐败，统治阶级靠出卖官职来搜刮财富。
meaning_en: (idiom) to grant government positions or official titles in exchange for bribes

meaning_cn: 瞑目闭眼。死了也不闭眼。原指人死的时候心里还有放不下的事。现常用来形容极不甘心。
meaning_en: lit. not close one's eyes after dying (idiom); fig. to die with an unresolved grievance

meaning_cn: 恍仿佛；世三十年为一世。仿佛隔了一个时代。指一种因人事或景物变化很大而引起的感触。
meaning_en: like a thing of the previous generation; as if it were a lifetime ago

meaning_cn: 窦孔穴；情窦情意的发生或男女爱情萌动。指刚刚懂得爱情（多指少女）。
meaning_en: first awakening of love (usually of a girl) (idiom)

meaning_cn: 噤闭口不作声。象深秋的蝉那样一声不吭。比喻因害怕有所顾虑而不敢说话。
meaning_en: to keep quiet out of fear (idiom)

meaning_cn: 辽远广阔，看不到边际。
meaning_en: to stretch as far as the eye can see (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容夫妻或相爱的男女十分亲昵。
meaning_en: to bill and coo (idiom); to whisper sweet nothings to one another; to be very much in love

meaning_cn: 指尽情说出要说的话而感到畅快。
meaning_en: to get sth off one's chest

meaning_cn: 嘴里说得很好，心里想的却是另一套。指心口不一致。
meaning_en: duplicity; hypocrisy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指不偏不倚，折中调和的处世态度。
meaning_en: doctrine of the mean; moderation in all things

meaning_cn: 苍青色。翠青绿色。指四季常青的松柏。比喻具有高贵品质、坚定节操的人。
meaning_en: evergreen pine and cypress (idiom); steadfast nobility

meaning_cn: 至最；名有名声的。最正确的道理，最精辟的言论。
meaning_en: wise saying; words of wisdom

meaning_cn: 过超过；望希望。结果比原来希望的还好，因而感到特别高兴。
meaning_en: overjoyed at unexpected good news (idiom)

meaning_cn: 草草形容草率、马虎；了办完，结束。草率地把事情结束了。
meaning_en: to rush through the work; to get through a thing carelessly

meaning_cn: 自己做了蠢事坏事，自己倒霉。
meaning_en: (idiom) to reap what one has sown; to stew in one's own juice

meaning_cn: 依、顺顺从。什么都依从。形容一切都顺从别人。
meaning_en: docile and obedient; all obedience

meaning_cn: 没有经过认真准备和严密组织，一下子行动起来。
meaning_en: (of a group of people) to rush into action

meaning_cn: 无拘无束，安闲自得。
meaning_en: free and at leisure (idiom); unfettered; outside the reach of the law (of criminal); at large

meaning_cn: 比喻不懂事物已发展变化而仍静止地看问题。
meaning_en: lit. a notch on the side of a boat to locate a sword dropped overboard (idiom); fig. an action made pointless by changed circumstances

meaning_cn: 非非原为佛家语，表示虚幻的境界。想到非常玄妙虚幻的地方去了。形容完全脱离现实地胡思乱想。
meaning_en: to indulge in fantasy (idiom); to let one's imagination run wild

meaning_cn: 卓尔特出的样子；不群与众不同。指才德超出寻常，与众不同。
meaning_en: standing above the common crowd (idiom); outstanding; excellent and unrivaled

meaning_cn: 泛指有才貌的男女。
meaning_en: lit. gifted scholar, beautiful lady (idiom); fig. pair of ideal lovers

meaning_cn: 藕已折断，但还有许多丝连接着未断开。比喻没有彻底断绝关系。多指男女之间情思难断。
meaning_en: lit. lotus roots may break, but the fiber remains joined (idiom); lovers part, but still long for one another

meaning_cn: 不以为意，神情如常。形容在紧急情况下沉着镇定，不慌不乱。
meaning_en: cool and collected (idiom); showing no sign of nerves; perfectly composed

meaning_cn: 过过失；则就。听到别人批评自己的缺点或错误，表示欢迎和高兴。指虚心接受意见。
meaning_en: to accept criticism gladly (humble expr.); to be happy when one's errors are pointed out

meaning_cn: 形容步子跨得大，走得快。
meaning_en: at a stride; taking large steps (while walking)

meaning_cn: 掉摇动。尾巴太大，掉转不灵。旧时比喻部下的势力很大，无法指挥调度。现比喻机构庞大，指挥不灵。
meaning_en: large tail obstructs action (idiom); bottom heavy; fig. rendered ineffective by subordinates

meaning_cn: 泰然安然，不以为意的样子；处处理，对待。形容毫不在意，沉着镇定。
meaning_en: to handle the situation calmly (idiom); unruffled; to treat the situation lightly

meaning_cn: 自己保不住自己。
meaning_en: powerless to defend oneself (idiom); helpless

meaning_cn: 指识大体，顾大局。
meaning_en: to have a high notion of one's duty; to be highly principled

meaning_cn: 得病后就再也起不了床。比喻得病后病情一天天恶化，终至死亡。
meaning_en: to fall gravely ill, never to recover (idiom)

meaning_cn: 故旧；故步旧时行步之法，引伸为旧法；封限制在一定的范围内。比喻守着老一套，不求进步。
meaning_en: stuck in the old ways (idiom); refusing to acknowledge new ideas; stagnating and conservative

meaning_cn: 没有踪迹可以寻求。多指处事为文不着痕迹。
meaning_en: (idiom) to leave no trace; to have no detectable clues or signs

meaning_cn: 勇猛，善于战斗。
meaning_en: to be brave and good at fighting (idiom)

meaning_cn: 能善于。形容能说会道，有辩才。
meaning_en: glib of tongue (idiom); eloquent

meaning_cn: 佛教用语。原指皈依佛法的男女◇泛指信仰佛教的男男女女。
meaning_en: lay practitioners of Buddhism

meaning_cn: 出超出；右上，古代以右为尊。没有能超过他的。
meaning_en: (idiom) matchless; without equal; there is nothing better

meaning_cn: 拂袖甩袖子，表示生气。形容生了气，一甩袖子就走了。
meaning_en: to storm off in a huff (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指故意示警，使人震动。同敲山振虎”。
meaning_en: a deliberate show of strength as a warning

meaning_cn: 各人都坚持自己的意见。
meaning_en: each sticks to his own view (idiom); a dialogue of the deaf

meaning_cn: 骥良马，千里马；枥马槽，养马的地方。比喻有志向的人虽然年老，仍有雄心壮志。
meaning_en: lit. an old steed in the stable still aspires to gallop 1000 miles (idiom); fig. aged person with great aspirations

meaning_cn: 襟怀胸怀；坦白正直无私。形容心地纯洁，光明正大。
meaning_en: open and candid (idiom); not hiding anything; ingenuous; openhearted; unselfish; magnanimous; broad-minded

meaning_cn: 战战恐惧的样子；兢兢小心谨慎的样子。形容非肠怕而微微发抖的样子。也形容小心谨慎的样子。
meaning_en: trembling with fear; with fear and trepidation

meaning_cn: 童未成年的孩子；叟年老的男人；欺蒙骗。既不欺骗小孩也不欺骗老人。指买卖公平。
meaning_en: cheating neither old nor young (idiom); treating youngsters and old folk equally scrupulously; Our house offers sincere treatment to all and fair trade to old and young alike.

meaning_cn: 垂将近。临死前的挣扎，妄想延长生命。比喻行将灭亡之时的孤注一掷。
meaning_en: deathbed struggle; final struggle (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比翼翅膀挨着翅膀。双飞成双的并飞。比喻夫妻情投意合，在事业上并肩前进。
meaning_en: lit. a pair of birds flying close together (idiom); fig. two hearts beating as one; name of a sweet and sour chicken wing dish

meaning_cn: 玲珑精巧细致，指人灵活、敏捷。本指窗户明亮轩敞◇用来形容人处世圆滑，待人接物面面俱到。
meaning_en: be smooth and slick (in establishing social relations)

meaning_cn: 弗不。自己惭愧不如别人。
meaning_en: ashamed of being inferior (idiom); to feel inferior to others

meaning_cn: 丢脸，出丑。
meaning_en: to make an exhibition of oneself; to be a disgrace

meaning_cn: 相互勾结，一个鼻孔出气。
meaning_en: to act in collusion (idiom)

meaning_cn: 居心存心；良善。存心不善。指内心存在着恶意或阴谋。
meaning_en: to harbor evil intentions (idiom)

meaning_cn: 周密的筹划，深远的打算。形容人办事精明老练。
meaning_en: rigorous schemes and deep foresight (idiom); astute and circumspect

meaning_cn: 绘画，画树木粗枝大叶，不用工笔。比喻工作粗糙，不认真细致。
meaning_en: thick stems and broad leaves (idiom); boorish; rough and ready; sloppy

meaning_cn: 根据不同时期的具体情况，采取适当的措施。
meaning_en: (idiom) to use methods appropriate to the current situation

meaning_cn: 把散乱的事物合在一起。
meaning_en: to merge together (idiom); to unify disparate elements into one whole

meaning_cn: 说话靠得住，有信用。
meaning_en: to speak and keep one's promise (idiom); as good as one's word

meaning_cn: 聊略微。比没有要好一点。
meaning_en: better than nothing (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容关怀体贴备至。
meaning_en: (idiom) to show concern about sb's well-being

meaning_cn: 机灵聪明，办事能力强。
meaning_en: able and efficient

meaning_cn: 是对；非错。把错的说成对的，对的说成错的。把是非弄颠倒了。
meaning_en: (idiom) to distort right and wrong; to deliberately mislead

meaning_cn: 指新的一年的开始。并常以下句万象更新”合成春联。
meaning_en: a new year begins (idiom)

meaning_cn: 失笑忍不住地笑起来。禁不住笑出声来。
meaning_en: to laugh involuntarily; Taiwan pr. [e4 ran2 shi1 xiao4]

meaning_cn: 古人认为礼定贵贱尊卑，义为行动准绳，廉为廉洁方正，耻为有知耻之心。指封建社会的道德标准和行为规范。
meaning_en: (idiom) propriety, justice, integrity and a sense of shame (i.e. the four social bonds, 四維|四维[si4 wei2])

meaning_cn: 龙钟行动不灵便的样子。形容年老体衰，行动不灵便。
meaning_en: (idiom) doddering; senile

meaning_cn: 形容非常广阔，一眼望不到边。也指谈话或写文章没有中心，离题很远。
meaning_en: extremely vast; boundless; limitless; digressing; discursive; going off on tangents; straying far off topic

meaning_cn: 比喻利用别人的矛盾而从中获利。
meaning_en: benefit from others' dispute (idiom)

meaning_cn: 涕眼泪；零落。因感激而流泪。形容极度感激。
meaning_en: to shed tears of gratitude (idiom); moved to tears

meaning_cn: 泯泯灭。年岁虽大但仍有天真之心。形容成年人还有着孩子的天真。
meaning_en: (idiom) still a child at heart; to retain a playful spirit

meaning_cn: 戴尊奉，推崇。感激别人的恩惠和好处。
meaning_en: deeply grateful

meaning_cn: 因胜利而头脑发热，不能总冷静思考和谨慎行事。
meaning_en: lit. to be muddled in the brain (idiom); fig. excited and unable to act rationally; to go to one's head

meaning_cn: 比喻虚诞、离奇的议论。
meaning_en: fantasy story

meaning_cn: 估量不透。捉摸猜测，预料。
meaning_en: (idiom) unpredictable; elusive; hard to pin down

meaning_cn: 形容人精力充沛，风度不凡。
meaning_en: to have an imposing or impressive appearance; impressive appearance; straight and impressive looking

meaning_cn: 高深的程度无法揣测。形容使人难以理解。
meaning_en: profound mystery

meaning_cn: 行走时身体故意左右扭动亿。形容举止言谈不爽快，不大方或故做姿态和。
meaning_en: affecting shyness or embarrassment; coy; mincing (walk, manner of speech); mannered

meaning_cn: 看到钱财，眼睛就睁大了。形容人贪财。
meaning_en: to open one's eyes wide at the sight of profit (idiom); thinking of nothing but personal gain; money-grubbing

meaning_cn: 左右手都能射箭。比喻两只手轮流做同一动作或同时做几项工作。
meaning_en: lit. to shoot from both sides (idiom); fig. to display ambidexterity; to slap with one hand and then the other, in quick succession; to use both feet equally (football)

meaning_cn: 原形容大风大雨◇也比喻处境险恶或声势猛烈。
meaning_en: strong wind and heavy rain (idiom)

meaning_cn: 脸色发黄，身体瘦削。形容人营养不良或有病的样子。
meaning_en: (lit.) face yellow and body emaciated (idiom); (fig.) malnourished and sickly in appearance

meaning_cn: 莫不能；辩辩白。即使有一百张嘴也辩白不清。形容不管怎样辩白也说不清楚。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of sb unfairly accused) to have all one's protestations fall on deaf ears; to be unable to convince sb of one's innocence

meaning_cn: 发动军队，声讨对方罪过。也指大闹意见，集合一伙人去上门责问。
meaning_en: to send punitive forces against; (fig.) to criticize violently

meaning_cn: 水不停地滴，石头也能被滴穿。比喻只要有恒心，不断努力，事情就一定能成功。
meaning_en: dripping water penetrates the stone (idiom); constant perseverance yields success; You can achieve your aim if you try hard without giving up.; Persistent effort overcomes any difficulty.

meaning_cn: 拿仇恨回报所受的恩惠。指忘恩负义。
meaning_en: to bite the hand that feeds one (idiom)

meaning_cn: 弥天满天。形容天大的谎话。
meaning_en: a pack of lies (idiom)

meaning_cn: 人世间的活地狱。比喻黑暗的社会。
meaning_en: hell on earth (idiom); suffering the torments of Buddhist hell while still alive; fig. having an uncomfortable time

meaning_cn: 原形容山势的蜿蜒雄壮，后也形容书法笔势有力，灵活舒展。
meaning_en: flamboyant or bold cursive calligraphy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 传说汉朝淮南王刘安修炼成仙后，把剩下的药撒在院子里，鸡和狗吃了，也都升天了◇比喻一个人做了官，和他有关的人也跟着得势。
meaning_en: (lit.) (when a person attains enlightenment and immortality), even his chickens and dogs will ascend to heaven with him (idiom); (fig.) (when somebody attains a position of power and influence), their relatives and friends also benefit; (2nd half of the saying 一人得道，雞犬升天|一人得道，鸡犬升天[yi1 ren2 de2 dao4 , ji1 quan3 sheng1 tian1])

meaning_cn: 故态老脾气，老样子；复又；萌发生。指旧的习气或毛病等又出现了。
meaning_en: to revert to old ways

meaning_cn: 擒捉。原指作战一下子就能把敌人捉拿过来，后比喻做事有把握，不费力就做好了。
meaning_en: stretch a hand and grab it (idiom); very easy

meaning_cn: 怀怀藏；才才能。胸怀才学但生不逢时，难以施展；多指屈居微贱而不得志。
meaning_en: to have talent but no opportunity (idiom); to be an unrecognized talent

meaning_cn: 古指古代的社会风尚。旧时指人心奸诈、刻薄，没有古人淳厚。
meaning_en: (idiom) moral standards are much lower now than in former times

meaning_cn: 触类接触某一方面的事物；旁通相互贯通。掌握了某一事物的知识或规律，进而推知同类事物的知识或规律。
meaning_en: to comprehend (new things) by analogy

meaning_cn: 形容歌声优美，给人留下难忘的印象。
meaning_en: reverberates around the rafters (idiom); fig. sonorous and resounding (esp. of singing voice)

meaning_cn: 数数着说；典指历来的制度、事迹。谈论历来的制度、事迹时，把自己祖先的职守都忘了。比喻忘本。也比喻对于本国历史的无知。
meaning_en: to recount history but omit one's ancestors (idiom); to forget one's roots

meaning_cn: 师军队；名名义，引伸为理由。出兵必有正当的理由◇比喻做某事有充足的理由。
meaning_en: lit. to have sufficient reason to send troops (idiom); to do something with good reason; to have just cause

meaning_cn: 象从瓜蔓上掉下来的瓜那样熟。形容读书或背书流利纯熟。
meaning_en: lit. ripe as a melon that rolls from its vine (idiom); fig. to know fluently; to know sth inside out; to know sth by heart

meaning_cn: ①分别治理。②利用手段使国家、民族或宗教等产生分裂，然后对其进行控制和统治。
meaning_en: (idiom) to divide and rule

meaning_cn: 不失时机，寻欢作乐。
meaning_en: to enjoy the present (idiom); to live happily with no thought for the future; make merry while you can; carpe diem

meaning_cn: 虚假。装着对人热情，不是真心实意。
meaning_en: false friendship; hypocritical show of affection

meaning_cn: 指没有生机和活力。死又死不了，活着又受罪。
meaning_en: (idiom) half-dead; barely alive; (idiom) listless

meaning_cn: 指男女相爱时立下的誓言，爱情要象山和海一样永恒不变。
meaning_en: to pledge undying love (idiom); oath of eternal love; to swear by all the Gods

meaning_cn: 臭得使人受不了。比喻人名声极坏。
meaning_en: (idiom) to stink to high heaven; (fig.) (idiom) disgraceful; disgusting

meaning_cn: 肝肠一寸寸断开。比喻伤心到极点。
meaning_en: lit. liver and guts cut to pieces (idiom); fig. grief-stricken

meaning_cn: 擂打鼓。自己吹喇叭，自己打鼓。比喻自我吹嘘。
meaning_en: to blow one's own trumpet (idiom)

meaning_cn: 声说话的声音；色脸上的表情。心里的打算不在说话和脸色上显露出来。
meaning_en: not show one's feeling or intentions

meaning_cn: 转眼一眨眼。一眨眼的时间。形容极短的时间。
meaning_en: (idiom) in the wink of an eye; in a flash

meaning_cn: 打与某些动词结合成为一个词，表示进行的意思；冷宫古代皇帝把失宠的后妃软禁于冷僻宫内。比喻人不被重视或把事情搁置一边。
meaning_en: (idiom) to snub; to consign to the trash heap of history

meaning_cn: 象胶和漆那样黏结。形容感情炽烈，难舍难分。多指夫妻恩爱。
meaning_en: stuck together as by glue (of lovers); joined at the hip

meaning_cn: 旧指宗教或学术上的各种流派。也指社会上各行各业的人。
meaning_en: the Three Religions (Daoism, Confucianism, Buddhism) and Nine Schools (Confucians, Daoists, Yin-Yang, Legalists, Logicians, Mohists, Political Strategists, Eclectics, Agriculturists); fig. people from all trades (often derog.)

meaning_cn: 龇露齿。张着嘴巴，露出牙齿。形容凶狠或疼痛难忍的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make a pained or menacing facial expression; to grimace; to snarl

meaning_cn: 旖旎柔和美丽。柔和而美丽的韵致风采或自然风景。
meaning_en: see 風光旖旎|风光旖旎[feng1 guang1 yi3 ni3]

meaning_cn: 异不同。原指夫妇生活在一起，但感情不和。比喻同做一件事而心里各有各的打算。
meaning_en: lit. to share the same bed with different dreams (idiom); ostensible partners with different agendas; strange bedfellows; marital dissension

meaning_cn: 涣散散漫，松懈。思想不统一。形容人心不齐。
meaning_en: (of a nation, government etc) demoralized; disunited

meaning_cn: 把鸡吓得飞起来，把狗吓得到处乱跳。形容惊慌得乱成一团。
meaning_en: lit. chickens flying and dogs jumping (idiom); fig. in chaos; in disarray

meaning_cn: 认识凝，不明事理。也形容思想处于凝不清的状态。
meaning_en: variant of 糊裡糊塗|糊里糊涂[hu2 li5 hu2 tu2]

meaning_cn: 色脸色。原指被老虎咬过的人才真正知道虎的厉害◇比喻一提到自己害怕的事就情绪紧张起来。
meaning_en: (lit.) to turn pale at the mention of a tiger (idiom); (fig.) to be terrified at the thought (of it)

meaning_cn: 世态人情世故；炎热，亲热；凉冷淡。指一些人在别人得势时百般奉承，别人失势时就十分冷淡。
meaning_en: the hypocrisy of the world (idiom)

meaning_cn: 德恩惠。怨仇恨。不记别人的仇，反而给他好处。
meaning_en: to return good for evil (idiom); to requite evil with good

meaning_cn: 乔迁鸟儿飞离深谷，迁到高大的树木上去∝人迁居或贺人官职升迁之辞。
meaning_en: congratulations on house-moving or promotion (idiom); Best wishes for your new home!

meaning_cn: 注灌入。形容寸下得很大，雨水象往下灌似的。
meaning_en: pouring with rain; rain bucketing down

meaning_cn: 庞然高大的样子。指高大笨重的东西。现也用来形容表面上很强大但实际上很虚弱的事物。
meaning_en: (idiom) huge object; colossus

meaning_cn: 比喻容易引起嫌疑的场合。
meaning_en: abbr. for 瓜田不納履，李下不整冠|瓜田不纳履，李下不整冠[gua1 tian2 bu4 na4 lu:3 , li3 xia4 bu4 zheng3 guan1]

meaning_cn: 把剑柄交给别人。比喻将权力交给别人或让人抓住缺点、失误，使自己被动。
meaning_en: to hand someone the swordhilt (idiom); to give someone a hold on oneself

meaning_cn: 论按照。按功劳的大小给于奖赏。
meaning_en: (idiom) to assess merit and confer rewards

meaning_cn: 起开头；承承接上文加以申述；转转折；合结束。泛指文章的做法。也比喻固定呆板的形式。
meaning_en: (idiom) four-part structure of a composition: introduction, elucidation, pivot (shift in perspective), synthesis; (fig.) coherent structural progression in writing, narrative, or any unfolding process

meaning_cn: 小家子旧指出身低微的人。形容人的言谈举止及做事不大方。
meaning_en: petty; small-minded

meaning_cn: 效仿效；颦皱眉头。比喻胡乱模仿，效果极坏。
meaning_en: lit. Dong Shi imitates Xi Shi's frown (idiom); fig. to mimick sb's idiosyncrasies but make a fool of oneself

meaning_cn: 乘人家危难的时候去威胁损害。
meaning_en: to take advantage of sb's precarious position

meaning_cn: 指不正派，也指不象样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) dubious; shady; neither one thing nor the other; neither fish nor fowl; nondescript

meaning_cn: 妖怪和魔鬼。比喻各种桅人民利益的邪恶势力。
meaning_en: (idiom) all kinds of evil spirits or malevolent beings

meaning_cn: 适适应；履鞋。因为鞋小脚大，就把脚削去一块来凑和鞋的大小。比喻不合理的牵就凑合或不顾具体条件，生搬硬套。
meaning_en: to cut the feet to fit the shoes (idiom); to force sth to fit (as to a Procrustean bed); impractical or inelegant solution

meaning_cn: 保持一致，行动起来像一个人。形容关系极为亲密。
meaning_en: to band together; to gang up; to stick together

meaning_cn: 指名利地位。
meaning_en: position and wealth (idiom); rank, fame and fortune

meaning_cn: 良好；辰时日；吉吉利。美好的时辰，吉利的日子◇常用以称宜于成亲的日子。
meaning_en: fine time, lucky day (idiom); fig. good opportunity

meaning_cn: 经历许多次战役，都没有遭到危险。形容善于用兵。
meaning_en: to come unscathed through a hundred battles (idiom, from Sunzi's "The Art of War" 孫子兵法|孙子兵法[Sun1 zi3 Bing1 fa3]); to win every fight

meaning_cn: 堪可，能；入耳听。指说的话使人听不进去（多指脏话）。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of speech, music etc) vulgar; offensive to the ear

meaning_cn: 附庸依傍，追随；风雅泛指诗歌。指缺乏文化修养的人为了装点门面而结交文人，参加有关文化活动。
meaning_en: (of an uneducated person) to mingle with the cognoscenti; to pose as a culture lover; to be a culture snob; having pretensions to culture

meaning_cn: 勃勃旺盛的样子。形容人或社会富有朝气，充满活力。
meaning_en: (idiom) vibrant; full of vitality

meaning_cn: 寄托或隐含的意思很深（多指语言文字或艺术作品）。
meaning_en: the implied message is deep (idiom); having deep implications

meaning_cn: 逸安闲；致情趣。指悠闲的心情和安逸的兴致。
meaning_en: leisurely and carefree mood

meaning_cn: 形容事物不清晰或关系不亲密。
meaning_en: indistinct; faintly discernible

meaning_cn: 一句话包含两个意思。
meaning_en: to make a pun; to have a double meaning; double entendre

meaning_cn: 禽鸟；兽野兽。飞翔的禽鸟，奔跑的野兽。泛指鸟类和兽类。
meaning_en: (idiom) birds and animals

meaning_cn: 牛郎织女为神话人物，从牵牛星、织女星的星名衍化而来。比喻分居两地的夫妻。也泛指一对恋人。
meaning_en: Cowherd and Weaving maid (characters in folk story); separated lovers; Altair and Vega (stars)

meaning_cn: 黄莺在歌唱，小燕子在飞舞。形容春天鸟儿喧闹活跃的景象。现常比喻革命和建设蓬勃兴旺的景象。
meaning_en: the warbler sings and the swallow dances; prosperity abounds (idiom)

meaning_cn: 腋腋下，指狐狸腋下的皮毛；裘皮衣↑狸腋下的皮虽很小，但聚集起来就能制一件皮袍。比喻积少成多。
meaning_en: many hairs make a fur coat (idiom); many small contributions add up to sth big; many a mickle makes a muckle

meaning_cn: 没有完全成熟或未烹煮至可食用的程度。比喻不熟悉；不熟练。
meaning_en: underripe; half-cooked; (fig.) not mastered (of a technique); clumsy; halting

meaning_cn: 每战必胜。形容所向无敌。
meaning_en: to emerge victorious in every battle; to be ever-victorious

meaning_cn: 指由于一心爱财而心中糊涂。
meaning_en: mad about money (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻经历了种种艰难困苦。
meaning_en: (lit.) wind, frost, rain and snow (idiom); (fig.) all kinds of trials and hardships

meaning_cn: 头发长而散乱。形容仪容不整。
meaning_en: with dishevelled hair (idiom); with one's hair down

meaning_cn: 倾倒出；巢巢穴。比喻敌人出动全部兵力进行侵扰。
meaning_en: the whole nest came out (idiom); to turn out in full strength

meaning_cn: 尽最大努力忍受痛苦或克服困难。
meaning_en: (idiom) to grit one's teeth tightly; (idiom) (fig.) to endure pain or suffering; to bite the bullet

meaning_cn: 眼里没有别人。形容骄傲自大，看不起人。
meaning_en: to consider everyone else beneath one (idiom); so arrogant that no-one else matters; condescending; to go about with one's nose in the air

meaning_cn: 汗珠象下雨似的往下掉。形容出汗很多。
meaning_en: sweating like rain (idiom); to perspire profusely; sweating like a pig

meaning_cn: 捆住手脚。形容胆子小，顾虑多。
meaning_en: (idiom) restricted; constrained; inhibited

meaning_cn: 对奇异的事情拍着桌子惊叹。
meaning_en: to slap the table in amazement (idiom); wonderful!; amazing!

meaning_cn: 追究根底。一般指追问一件事的原由。
meaning_en: to get to the heart of the matter

meaning_cn: 脸色不变。形容从容镇静的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) not bat an eyelid

meaning_cn: 形容象泰山一样稳固，不可动摇。
meaning_en: steady as Mt Tai; as safe as houses

meaning_cn: 搬弄挑拔。把别人的话传来传去，有意挑拔，或在背后乱加议论，引起纠纷。
meaning_en: to incite a quarrel (idiom); to sow discord between people; to tell tales; to make mischief

meaning_cn: 指情况出于不得已。
meaning_en: compelled by the circumstances (to do sth); (have) no other choice (but do sth); (used as a pun in romance) can't help but fall in love

meaning_cn: 风风度；绰约女子姿态柔美。形容女子风韵姿态柔美动人。
meaning_en: (idiom) graceful; lovely

meaning_cn: 黔今贵州省一带；技技能；穷尽。比喻有限的一点本领也已经用完了。
meaning_en: to exhaust one's limited abilities (idiom)

meaning_cn: 用各种手段使对方过不去。
meaning_en: (idiom) to put up innumerable obstacles; to create all kinds of difficulties

meaning_cn: 药治疗。病已重到无法用药医治的程度。比喻已经到了无法挽救的地步。
meaning_en: see 無可救藥|无可救药[wu2 ke3 jiu4 yao4]

meaning_cn: 偷取炉中烤熟的栗子。比喻受人利用，冒险出力却一无所得。
meaning_en: lit. to pull chestnuts out of the fire (idiom); fig. to be sb's cat's-paw

meaning_cn: 奉信奉；圭测日影器；臬射箭的靶子；圭臬比喻事物的准则。比喻把某些言论或事当成自己的准则。
meaning_en: to take as a guiding principle (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指生财有个大原则，后指搞钱很有办法。
meaning_en: lit. there are principles behind making money (idiom); fig. to have a knack for good business; knowing how to accumulate wealth; good at feathering one's own nest

meaning_cn: 不破除旧的，就不能建立新的。
meaning_en: without destruction there can be no construction

meaning_cn: 迷信的人认为可以办事的吉利日子。
meaning_en: (idiom) auspicious day (for a wedding, ceremony etc)

meaning_cn: 制造谣言，挑起事端。
meaning_en: to start rumours and create trouble

meaning_cn: 比喻一个学术流派、技艺的开创者。
meaning_en: founder

meaning_cn: 绽裂开。皮肉都裂开了。形容伤势严重。多指受残酷拷打。
meaning_en: flesh lacerated from corporal punishment (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容嬉笑不严肃的样子。
meaning_en: all smiles; smiling mischievously or ingratiatingly

meaning_cn: 大器比喻大才。指能担当重任的人物要经过长期的锻炼，所以成就较晚。也用做对长期不得志的人的安慰话。
meaning_en: lit. it takes a long time to make a big pot (idiom); fig. a great talent matures slowly; in the fullness of time a major figure will develop into a pillar of the state; Rome wasn't built in a day

meaning_cn: 诲教导。教导人特别耐心，从不厌倦。
meaning_en: instructing with tireless zeal (idiom, from Analects)

meaning_cn: 登上。一步跨上青天。比喻一下子就达到很高的境界或程度。有时也用来比喻人突然得志，爬上高位。
meaning_en: reaching heaven in a single bound (idiom); (esp. with negative: don't expect) instant success

meaning_cn: 安安然，坦然；之代词，指人或物；素平常。安然相处，和往常一样，不觉得有什么不合适。
meaning_en: bear hardship with equanimity; regard wrongdoing with equanimity

meaning_cn: 比喻著作有价值，流传广。
meaning_en: lit. paper has become expensive in Luoyang (because everyone is making a copy of a popular story) (idiom); fig. (of a product) to sell like hotcakes

meaning_cn: 前先前。从来没有听说过。
meaning_en: (idiom) unheard-of; unprecedented

meaning_cn: 夜郎汉代西南地区的一个小国。比喻人无知而又狂妄自大。
meaning_en: lit. Yelang thinks highly of itself (idiom); fig. foolish conceit

meaning_cn: 伶、俐聪明，灵活。形容人机灵，很会说话。
meaning_en: clever and eloquent (idiom); fluent; having the gift of the gab

meaning_cn: 一根汗毛也不肯拔。原指杨朱的极端为我主义◇形容为人非常吝啬自私。
meaning_en: (lit.) unwilling to spare a single hair (idiom); (fig.) extremely stingy

meaning_cn: 表示真心佩服，自认不如。
meaning_en: to step down gracefully (humble expression); to concede defeat; to play second fiddle

meaning_cn: 冷意含讥讽。带讥讽意味的冷冰冰的话。
meaning_en: sarcastic comments (idiom); to make sarcastic comments

meaning_cn: 本指游乐休息的环境◇多指谈情说爱的处所。
meaning_en: (idiom) romantic surroundings

meaning_cn: 早晨不能知道晚上会变成什么样子或发生什么情况。形容形势危急，难以预料。
meaning_en: at dawn, not sure of lasting to evening (idiom); precarious state; imminent crisis; living from hand to mouth

meaning_cn: 挂钩取，这里指说到，提到；漏遗漏。形容说得不全，遗漏很多。
meaning_en: to mention some but omit many others (idiom); to leave out much more than one includes

meaning_cn: 人定指人谋。指人力能够战胜自然。
meaning_en: man can conquer nature (idiom); human wisdom can prevail over nature

meaning_cn: 合配合∶象是上天给予安排，很完美地配合到一起。祝人婚姻美满的话。
meaning_en: a match made in heaven (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指盛产鱼和稻米的富饶地方。
meaning_en: (lit.) land of fish and rice; (fig.) fertile region; land of milk and honey

meaning_cn: 指过恣意享乐的生活。
meaning_en: (lit.) to eat, drink, play and be merry (idiom); (fig.) to abandon oneself to a life of pleasure

meaning_cn: 奸坏事；科法律条文。为非作歹，触犯法令。
meaning_en: to flout the law

meaning_cn: 流流传；芳香，指好名声；百世时间久远∶的名声永远流传下去。
meaning_en: (of one's name, reputation etc) to be immortalized (idiom); to leave a mark for generations to come

meaning_cn: 矫使弯的变成直的；揉使直的变成弯的。比喻故意做作，不自然。
meaning_en: pretension; affectation; putting on artificial airs

meaning_cn: 丈夫死了不再嫁人，这时旧时束缚妇女的封建礼教。
meaning_en: faithful unto death (i.e. Confucian ban on widow remarrying)

meaning_cn: 舛不顺，不幸。命运充满不顺。指一生坎坷，屡受挫折。
meaning_en: to meet with many difficulties in one's life (idiom)

meaning_cn: 玩玩赏；丧丧失；志志气。指迷恋于所玩赏的事物而消磨了积极进取的志气。
meaning_en: lit. trifling destroys the will (idiom); infatuation with fine details prevents one making progress; excessive attention to trivia saps the will

meaning_cn: 传说一种叫蜮的动物，在水中含沙喷射人的影子，使人生病。比喻暗中攻击或陷害人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to attack sb by innuendo; to make insinuations

meaning_cn: 很快乐，不思念蜀国。比喻在新环境中得到乐趣，不再想回到原来环境中去。
meaning_en: indulge in pleasure and forget home and duty (idiom)

meaning_cn: 这里起来，那里下去。形容接连不断。
meaning_en: to rise and fall in succession (idiom); repeating continuously

meaning_cn: 载装载，引伸为阐明；道道理，泛指思想。指文章是为了说明道理的。
meaning_en: words of truth; moral expressed in words; written article explaining a moral

meaning_cn: 所作所为把自己引上绝路。
meaning_en: to court disaster (idiom); to dig one's own grave

meaning_cn: 指修养身心，以期保健延年的方法。
meaning_en: the way of maintaining good health

meaning_cn: 指以名利地位引诱别人来帮助自己达到不正当的目的。
meaning_en: to offer official positions and material benefits in order to buy people's allegiance

meaning_cn: 叶公春秋时楚国贵族，名子高，封于叶（古邑名，今河南叶县）。比喻口头上说爱好某事物，实际上并不真爱好。
meaning_en: lit. Lord Ye's passion for dragons (idiom); fig. to pretend to be fond of sth while actually fearing it; ostensible fondness of sth one really fears

meaning_cn: 辄即；咎过失，罪责。动不动就受到指摘或责难。
meaning_en: faulted at every turn (idiom); can't get anything right

meaning_cn: 四海天下。名声传扬到天下。形容名声很大。
meaning_en: to become known far and wide (idiom); famous

meaning_cn: 九霄高空。在九重天的外面。比喻无限远的地方或远得无影无踪。
meaning_en: beyond the topmost clouds (idiom); unimaginably far away

meaning_cn: 欺骗世人，窃取名誉。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fool the world and usurp a good name

meaning_cn: 声歌舞；色女色；犬养狗；马骑马。形容剥削阶级荒淫无耻的生活方式。
meaning_en: (lit.) music, women, dogs and horses (traditional aristocratic amusements, with dogs and horses referring to activities such as hunting and riding) (idiom); (fig.) wine, women and song; dissolute pleasures; a life of sensual indulgence

meaning_cn: 连最普通的丁”字也不认识。形容一个字也不认得。
meaning_en: lit. the eye cannot recognize the letter T (idiom); totally illiterate

meaning_cn: 犹言好不容易。
meaning_en: extremely difficult

meaning_cn: 纵南北方向；横东西方向；驰骋纵马疾驰。不受阻挡地往来奔驰。形容英勇战斗，所向无敌。也比喻写作上才思奔放，意到笔随。
meaning_en: to criss-cross; to run unhindered across the whole country

meaning_cn: 执行法律象山一样不可动摇。
meaning_en: to maintain the law as firm as a mountain (idiom); to enforce the law strictly

meaning_cn: 湛湛蓝天，没有一丝云彩。形容天气晴朗。
meaning_en: cloudless

meaning_cn: 故意装糊涂蒙骗人。
meaning_en: to play dumb; to slack off (idiom)

meaning_cn: 劳伯劳。伯劳、燕子各飞东西。比喻夫妻、情侣别离。
meaning_en: the shrike and the swallow fly in different directions (idiom); (usually of a couple) to part from each other

meaning_cn: 怨怨恨，悔恨；艾割草，比喻改正错误。原意是悔恨自己的错误，自己改正。现在只指悔恨自己的错误。
meaning_en: to be full of remorse; to repent and redress one's errors

meaning_cn: 粉饰涂饰表面。把社会黑暗混乱的状况掩饰成太平的景象。
meaning_en: to pretend that everything is going well

meaning_cn: 不因袭陈旧的格式。
meaning_en: to conform to no conventional pattern; unconventional; offbeat

meaning_cn: 原为弃妇诉说原夫再娶与新欢作乐，后反其意，用作庆贺新婚之辞。形容新婚时的欢乐。
meaning_en: (idiom) to experience the joy of being newly married

meaning_cn: 用敲锣等发出信号撤兵回营。比喻战斗暂时结束。
meaning_en: to beat the gong to recall troops (idiom); to order a retreat

meaning_cn: 蔚茂盛；大观盛大的景象。发展成为盛大壮观的景象。形容事物美好繁多，给人一种盛大的印象。
meaning_en: to afford a magnificent sight (idiom); enchanting

meaning_cn: 仓皇匆忙，慌张。慌慌张张地外出逃跑。
meaning_en: to run off in a great panic (idiom)

meaning_cn: 不管多远之处，没有不到的。
meaning_en: to extend all over the globe (idiom); far-reaching

meaning_cn: 单凭口说，不足为据。
meaning_en: (idiom) you can't rely on a verbal agreement; just because sb says sth, doesn't mean it's true

meaning_cn: 白头头发白。夫妻相亲相爱，一直到老。
meaning_en: see 白頭偕老|白头偕老[bai2 tou2 xie2 lao3]

meaning_cn: 自己甘心思想行为向坏的方向发展。
meaning_en: to abandon oneself (idiom); to let oneself go

meaning_cn: 一会儿高兴，一会儿生气。形容态度多变。
meaning_en: temperamental; moody

meaning_cn: 形秽形态丑陋，引伸为缺点。因为自己不如别人而感到渐愧。
meaning_en: (idiom) to feel inferior; to feel inadequate

meaning_cn: 原指仁爱而有节操，能为正义牺牲生命的人。现在泛指爱国而为革命事业出力的人。
meaning_en: gentleman aspiring to benevolence (idiom); people with lofty ideals

meaning_cn: 指愤怒得头发直竖，顶着帽子。形容极端愤怒。
meaning_en: lit. hair stands up in anger and tips off one's hat (idiom); fig. seething in anger; raise one's hackles

meaning_cn: 古时一种耕种方法，把地上的草烧成灰做肥料，就地挖坑下种。
meaning_en: slash and burn (agriculture)

meaning_cn: 青史古代在竹简上记事，因称史书。把姓名事迹记载在历史书籍上。形容功业巨大，永垂不朽。
meaning_en: lit. reputation will go down in history (idiom); fig. achievements will earn eternal glory

meaning_cn: 浮萍随水漂泊，聚散不定。比喻向来不认识的人偶然相遇。
meaning_en: strangers coming together by chance (idiom)

meaning_cn: 两边肋骨插上刀，表示不怕死。比喻承担极大的牺牲。
meaning_en: (lit.) to take knives in both sides (idiom); (fig.) to go to any lengths for a friend; to sacrifice oneself out of loyalty

meaning_cn: 没有儿子，也没有孙子。指没有后代。
meaning_en: to die without progeny; (offensive) may you die childless; may you be the last of your family line

meaning_cn: 至极，最；尽全部用出。竭尽仁义之道。指人的善意和帮助已经做到了最大限度。
meaning_en: extreme benevolence, utmost duty (idiom); meticulous virtue and attention to duty

meaning_cn: 不足不值得；挂齿放在嘴上讲。表示不值得一提。
meaning_en: not worth mentioning (idiom)

meaning_cn: 舞、弄故意玩弄；文、墨文笔。故意玩弄文笔。原指曲引法律条文作弊◇常指玩弄文字技巧。
meaning_en: (idiom) to display one's facility with words; to show off one's literary skills; (original meaning) to pervert the law by playing with legal phraseology (墨[mo4] was a reference to 繩墨|绳墨[sheng2 mo4])

meaning_cn: 指对谋事非常疑惑，很不理解。同大惑不解”。
meaning_en: to feel puzzled

meaning_cn: 谲诡怪异，变化∶象云彩和水波那样，形态不可捉摸。原形容房屋构造就象云彩、波浪一样千姿百态◇多形容事物变幻莫测。
meaning_en: (idiom) ever-changing; unpredictable

meaning_cn: 难灾祸；临来到。大祸落到头上。
meaning_en: to be facing imminent calamity (idiom); disaster is looming

meaning_cn: 擒捉；纵放。故意先放开他，使他放松戒备，充分暴露，然后再把他捉住。
meaning_en: In order to capture, one must let loose.; to loosen the reins only to grasp them better

meaning_cn: 锦衣鲜艳华美的衣服；玉食珍美的食品。精美的衣食。形容豪华奢侈的生活。
meaning_en: brocade garments, jade meals (idiom); a life of luxury; extravagance

meaning_cn: 指体形高大的马。也比喻人的体形高大。
meaning_en: (idiom) tall, imposing horse; (of a person) tall and well-built

meaning_cn: 瑕玉上面的斑点，比喻缺点；掩遮盖；瑜美玉的光泽，比喻优点。比喻缺点掩盖不了优点，缺点是次要的，优点是主要的。
meaning_en: lit. a blemish does not obscure jade's luster; the pros outweigh the cons (idiom)

meaning_cn: 风雅而有情趣的事。旧指文人诗歌吟咏及琴棋书画等活动。也指男女私情。
meaning_en: poetic and passionate (idiom); romance; love affair

meaning_cn: 羁约束。放纵任性，不加检点，不受约束。
meaning_en: wanton and unrestrained (idiom); dissolute

meaning_cn: 迎头迎面，当头；痛狠狠地。迎上去给敌人以狠狠的打击。
meaning_en: to deliver a frontal assault; to meet head-on (idiom)

meaning_cn: 迷信者认为，人死后可将灵魂附于他人尸体而复活。比喻已经消灭或没落的事物又以另一种形式出现。
meaning_en: lit. reincarnated in sb else's body (idiom); fig. a discarded or discredited idea returns in another guise

meaning_cn: 荏苒时间一点一点的流逝。指时间渐渐地过去了。
meaning_en: (idiom) How time flies!

meaning_cn: 原指事物到了尽头就要发生变化。现指在穷困艰难的时候，就要想办法改变现状。
meaning_en: (idiom) when you hit bottom, you have to come up with a new approach

meaning_cn: 生让人活；杀处死；予给予；夺剥夺。形容反动统治者掌握生死、赏罚大权。
meaning_en: (lit.) to spare or to kill, to give or take away (idiom); (fig.) control over the fate of others

meaning_cn: 卖卖弄。仗着岁数大，摆老资格。
meaning_en: (idiom) to flaunt one's seniority; to rely on one's age or length of experience to control or belittle others

meaning_cn: 故意装成疯疯癫癫，傻里傻气。
meaning_en: (idiom) to play the fool; to feign madness; to act dumb

meaning_cn: 形容用眉眼传情。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make eyes; to exchange flirting glances with sb

meaning_cn: 楚楚鲜明、整洁的样子。衣帽穿戴得很整齐，很漂亮。
meaning_en: immaculately dressed; well-groomed; dapper

meaning_cn: 火烧到眉毛。比喻事到眼前，非常急迫。
meaning_en: lit. the fire burns one's eyebrows (idiom); fig. desperate situation; extreme emergency

meaning_cn: 本来是假装的，结果却弄成了真的。
meaning_en: pretense that turns into reality (idiom); to play at make-believe, but accidentally make it true

meaning_cn: 痴心沉迷于某人或某事的心思；妄想荒诞的打算。一心想着不可能实现的事。也指愚蠢荒唐的想法。
meaning_en: to be carried away by one's wishful thinking (idiom); to labor under a delusion; wishful thinking

meaning_cn: 整个园子里一片春天的景色。比喻欣欣向荣的景象。
meaning_en: everything in the garden is lovely

meaning_cn: 犹言渔人之利。
meaning_en: (idiom) the advantage gained by a third party when two sides are in conflict

meaning_cn: 兵武器；刃刀剑等的锋利部分。兵器上没有沾上血。形容未经战斗就轻易取得了胜利。
meaning_en: lit. no blood on the men's swords (idiom); fig. an effortless victory

meaning_cn: 伤、败败坏。指败坏社会风俗。多用来遣责道德败坏的行为。
meaning_en: offending public morals (idiom)

meaning_cn: 泛指一些吃喝玩乐、不务正业的朋友。
meaning_en: a pack of rogues (idiom); a gang of scoundrels

meaning_cn: 牢骚抑郁不平之感。一肚子的不满情绪。形容心情极为抑郁，很不得意。
meaning_en: lit. belly full of complaints (idiom); discontent; always moaning and complaining

meaning_cn: 宁安宁。形容骚扰得厉害，连鸡狗都不得安宁。
meaning_en: lit. not even the chickens and dogs are left undisturbed (idiom); fig. great commotion; pandemonium

meaning_cn: 旧小说里描写足智多谋的人把对付敌方的计策写在纸条上，放在锦囊里，以便当事人在紧急时拆阅。比喻有准备的巧妙办法。
meaning_en: brocade sack of miracle plans (idiom); bag of tricks; fiendishly cunning masterplan (written out by strategic genius of fiction, and given to the local commander in a brocade bag)

meaning_cn: 年纪还不大就衰老了。多指由于精神或体力负担过重而导致过早衰老。
meaning_en: to age prematurely

meaning_cn: 古时传说狐狸能够变成人形来迷惑人，但它的尾巴却始终变不了，成为妖的标志。比喻坏人的本来面目或迷惑人的罪证。
meaning_en: lit. fox's tail (idiom); visible sign of evil intentions; to reveal one's evil nature; evidence that reveals the villain

meaning_cn: 扔一颗石子打到两只鸟。比喻做一件事情得到两样好处。
meaning_en: to kill two birds with one stone (idiom)

meaning_cn: 用言语或行动为自己掩盖或辩解被人嘲笑的事。
meaning_en: to refer to one's foibles or failings with self-deprecating humor

meaning_cn: 指没有东西吃。
meaning_en: (lit.) to drink the northwest wind (idiom); (fig.) to go hungry; to have nothing to eat

meaning_cn: 搔用手指梳。形容装腔作势卖弄风情。
meaning_en: (idiom) to strike a coquettish pose

meaning_cn: 指大怒。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fly into a rage; to lose one's temper

meaning_cn: 对证核实。当事人已死，无法核对事实。
meaning_en: the dead cannot testify (idiom); dead men tell no tales

meaning_cn: 伥伥鬼，古时传说被老虎吃掉的人，死后变成伥鬼，专门引诱人来给老虎吃。替老虎做伥鬼。比喻充当恶人的帮凶。
meaning_en: (idiom) to act as accomplice to a villain; to assist in wrongdoing

meaning_cn: 一千年，一万代。指世世代代，时间久长。
meaning_en: throughout the ages

meaning_cn: 人的真诚的意志所到。
meaning_en: no difficulty is insurmountable if one is sincere (idiom)

meaning_cn: 旧指时机来了，命运也有了转机。指境况好转。
meaning_en: the time comes, fortune turns (idiom); to have a lucky break; things change for the better

meaning_cn: 比喻刚开始显示出力量或才能。
meaning_en: first sign of budding talent; to display one's ability for the first time

meaning_cn: 形容留下的血架多。
meaning_en: bloodstained

meaning_cn: 脂、膏脂肪。比喻人民用血汗换来的财富。多用于指反动统治阶级压榨人民来养肥自己的场合。
meaning_en: lit. the fat and wealth of the people (idiom); the nation's hard-won wealth (esp. as an object of unscrupulous exploitation); the people's blood, sweat and tears

meaning_cn: 过去，两个戏班子为了抢生意，有时候会硐一时间演同样的戏，称为唱对台戏。比喻采取与对方相对的行动，来反对或搞垮对方。
meaning_en: to put on a rival show (idiom); to set oneself up against sb; to get into confrontation

meaning_cn: 寻求欢快，设法取乐。形容追求享乐。
meaning_en: pleasure seeking (idiom); life of dissipation

meaning_cn: 形形原指生出这种形体；色色原指生出这种颜色。指各式各样，种类很多。
meaning_en: all kinds of; all sorts of; every (different) kind of

meaning_cn: 永远没有安宁的翌日，指社会不安。
meaning_en: (in such circumstances) there will be no peace; one can never breathe easy

meaning_cn: 树树立；传传记。原指把某人生平事迹刻在石碑上或写成传记，使他的名声世代流传下去。现比喻树立个人威信，抬高个人声望。
meaning_en: lit. to erect a stele and write a biography (idiom); to monumentalize; to glorify; to sing the praises of

meaning_cn: 哪有这个道理。指别人的言行或某一事物极其荒谬。
meaning_en: how can this be so? (idiom); preposterous; ridiculous; absurd

meaning_cn: 暴暴徒；良善良的人。铲除强暴，安抚善良的人民。
meaning_en: to root out the strong and give people peace (idiom); to rob the rich and give to the poor

meaning_cn: 鸣表示，以为。自以为了不起，表示很得意。
meaning_en: to think highly of oneself

meaning_cn: 百所有的，不论什么；禁忌忌讳。什么都不忌讳。
meaning_en: all taboos are off (idiom); anything goes; nothing is taboo

meaning_cn: 宽宽容。以宽宏大度的态度来对待别人。
meaning_en: to be lenient with others (idiom)

meaning_cn: 象喝醉酒和做梦那样，昏昏沉沉，糊里糊涂地过日子。
meaning_en: as if drunk or entranced (idiom); leading a befuddled existence; in a drunken stupor

meaning_cn: 风流有才学而不拘礼法；倜傥卓异，洒脱不拘。形容人有才华而言行不受世俗礼节的拘束。
meaning_en: (idiom) suave; debonair; dashing

meaning_cn: 看风向转发动舵柄。比喻看势头或看别人的眼色行事。
meaning_en: lit. see the wind and set the helm (idiom); fig. to act pragmatically; to be flexible and take advantage of the situation

meaning_cn: 比喻社会黑暗，见不到一点光明。
meaning_en: all black, no daylight (idiom); a world without justice

meaning_cn: 振作起精神。
meaning_en: to gather one's spirits; to pull oneself together

meaning_cn: 三、四表示杂乱。形容说话做事错杂紊乱。
meaning_en: confused; disorderly; incoherent

meaning_cn: 论定下结论。盖上棺材盖，才能下结论。人死后对其一生作出评价。
meaning_en: don't pass judgment on a person's life until the lid is on the coffin (idiom)

meaning_cn: 醉得瘫成一团，扶都扶不住。形容大醉的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be dead drunk; to be plastered

meaning_cn: 指情急时说话不能正确用词表达或指说话随便。
meaning_en: to speak incoherently; to ramble; to talk irresponsibly

meaning_cn: 形容文思跌荡，放得开，收得拢。
meaning_en: (idiom) epic in scope; wide-ranging

meaning_cn: 逆耳不顺耳。正直的劝告听起来不顺耳，但有利于改正缺点错误。
meaning_en: loyal advice jars on the ears (idiom)

meaning_cn: 临到，快要；阵阵地、战场；枪指梭镖、长矛一类的武器。到了快要上阵打仗的时候才磨刀擦枪。比喻事到临头才匆忙准备。
meaning_en: (lit.) to sharpen one's spear only before going into battle (idiom); (fig.) to make preparations only at the last moment

meaning_cn: 形容山势险峻。同悬崖峭壁”。
meaning_en: see 懸崖峭壁|悬崖峭壁[xuan2 ya2 qiao4 bi4]

meaning_cn: 旧小说中多指打抱不平。
meaning_en: see 路見不平，拔刀相助|路见不平，拔刀相助[lu4 jian4 bu4 ping2 , ba2 dao1 xiang1 zhu4]

meaning_cn: 陋浅陋；寡少。形容学识浅陋，见闻不广。
meaning_en: ignorant and inexperienced; ill-informed and narrow-minded

meaning_cn: 比喻经过长期锻炼，变得非常坚强。
meaning_en: to be tempered into a steel

meaning_cn: 挠搔。抓抓耳朵，搔搔肋帮子。形容心里焦急而无法可想的样子。
meaning_en: to tweak one's ears and scratch one's cheeks (as an expression of anxiety, delight, frustration etc) (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指双方争吵、斗争、比赛等相持不下，难以分开。有时也形容双方关系十分亲密，分不开。
meaning_en: hard to untie, hard to separate (idiom); inextricably involved; locked in battle

meaning_cn: 温温习；故旧的。温习旧的知识，得到新的理解和体会。也指回忆过去，能更好地认识现在。
meaning_en: to review the old and know the new (idiom, from the Analects); to recall the past to understand the future

meaning_cn: 珠玑珠子。每个字都像珍珠一样。比喻说话、文章的词句十分优美。
meaning_en: (idiom) every word is a gem

meaning_cn: 一再表示感恩和谢意。
meaning_en: (idiom) to thank profusely; to express deep gratitude

meaning_cn: 形容明媚的春天景象。也形容颜色鲜艳纷繁。
meaning_en: red flowers and green willow; all the colors of spring

meaning_cn: 鞭辟鞭策，激励；里最里层。形容作学问切实。也形容分析透彻，切中要害。
meaning_en: penetrated; trenchant; incisive

meaning_cn: 疾憎恨；恶指坏人坏事。憎恨坏人坏事就象憎恨仇人一样。
meaning_en: variant of 嫉惡如仇|嫉恶如仇[ji2 e4 ru2 chou2]

meaning_cn: 指长辈去世，子孙身披麻布服，头上戴白，表示哀悼。
meaning_en: to wear mourning clothes; to be in mourning; also written 披麻帶孝|披麻带孝

meaning_cn: 等闲寻常，一般。无足轻重的寻常人。
meaning_en: (in the negative) (not) to be trifled with

meaning_cn: 风行象刮风一样流行。形容事物在一个时期内非常盛行。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be popular for a while; to be all the rage for a time

meaning_cn: 珍异难得的宝物。
meaning_en: rare treasure (idiom)

meaning_cn: 欲欲望；壑深谷。形容欲望象深谷一样，很难填满。指贪心重，没法满足。
meaning_en: (idiom) insatiably greedy

meaning_cn: 窟洞穴。狡猾的兔子准备好几个藏身的窝。比喻隐蔽的地方或方法多。
meaning_en: lit. a crafty rabbit has three burrows; a sly individual has more than one plan to fall back on (idiom)

meaning_cn: 树木已经做成了船。比喻事情已成定局，无法改变。
meaning_en: lit. the timber has been turned into a boat already (idiom); fig. what is done cannot be undone

meaning_cn: 招引进财气、财宝。
meaning_en: ushering in wealth and prosperity (idiom and traditional greeting, esp. at New Year); We wish you wealth and success!

meaning_cn: 假假真真，以假乱真。指军事上讲究策略，善于迷惑对方。也指文艺作品中虚写、实写并用，表现方法耐人思索回味。
meaning_en: hard to tell if it's real or sham

meaning_cn: 给别人的损害非常之大。
meaning_en: (idiom) (usu. of behaviors, systems or trends etc) to cause people tremendous harm

meaning_cn: 足充实，足够；智聪明、智慧；谋计谋。富有智慧，善于谋划。形容人善于料事和用计。
meaning_en: resourceful; full of stratagems

meaning_cn: 指大白天。也比喻明显的事情或高洁的品德。
meaning_en: (idiom) in broad daylight; in the middle of the day; KMT emblem, a white sun on a blue background

meaning_cn: 指把能参加战斗的人民全都武装起来，随时准备歼灭入侵之敌。
meaning_en: to bring the entire nation to arms (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻被迫起来反抗。现也比喻被迫采取某种行动。
meaning_en: driven to join the Liangshan Mountain rebels; to drive to revolt; to force sb to desperate action

meaning_cn: 纨裤细绢裤。衣着华美的年轻人。旧时指官僚、地主等有钱有势人家成天吃喝玩乐、不务正业的子弟。
meaning_en: (idiom) hedonistic son of rich parents

meaning_cn: 分不出第一第二。
meaning_en: lit. unable to distinguish eldest brother from second brother (idiom); they are all equally excellent; nothing to choose between them

meaning_cn: 自扰自找麻烦。指本来没事，自己找麻烦。
meaning_en: lit. silly people get their panties in a bunch (idiom); fig. to get upset over nothing; to make problems for oneself

meaning_cn: 旧时指小户人家美丽的年轻女子。
meaning_en: pretty daughter in a humble family

meaning_cn: 旧指洋人较多的地方。多形容旧时的上海。
meaning_en: the Shanghai of old, with its foreign settlements; (fig.) a bustling, cosmopolitan city

meaning_cn: 赤比喻真纯。形容十分忠诚。
meaning_en: lit. red-bellied devotion (idiom); wholehearted loyalty; to serve sb with body and soul

meaning_cn: 官运官场中的运气；亨通顺利。指仕途顺利，步步高升。
meaning_en: (of a political career) everything is going smoothly (idiom)

meaning_cn: 经纶整理丝缕，引伸为人的才学、本领。形容人极有才干和智谋。
meaning_en: full of political wisdom (idiom); politically astute; with encyclopedic experience of state policy

meaning_cn: 知了解，知道；任任用，使用。善于认识人的品德和才能，最合理地使用。
meaning_en: (idiom) expert at appointing people according to their abilities; to put the right people in the right places

meaning_cn: 卑躬低头弯腰；屈膝下跪。形容没有骨气，低声下气地讨好奉承。
meaning_en: to bow and bend the knee (idiom); fawning; bending and scraping to curry favor

meaning_cn: 空空洞洞，没有什么内容。多指言谈、文章极其空泛。
meaning_en: empty cave, nothing there (idiom); devoid of substance; nothing new to show

meaning_cn: 绵绵连续不断的样子。形容多，连续不断。
meaning_en: continuous; endless

meaning_cn: 支支持；绌屈曲，引伸为不足。原指弯弓射箭的姿势，左手支持，右手屈曲。指力量不足，应付了这方面，那方面又出了问题。
meaning_en: to be in straitened circumstances

meaning_cn: 瓮一种陶制的盛器。比喻用某人整治别人的办法来整治他自己。
meaning_en: lit. please Sir, get into the boiling pot (idiom); fig. to give sb a taste of his own medicine

meaning_cn: 垂接近，快要。事情在将要成功的时候遭到了失败。
meaning_en: to fail within sight of success (idiom); last-minute failure; to fall at the last hurdle; snatching defeat from the jaws of victory

meaning_cn: 弊害处，坏处。兴办对国家人民有益利的事业，除去各种弊端。
meaning_en: to promote what is useful and get rid of what is harmful (idiom)

meaning_cn: 自己过了河，便把桥拆掉。比喻达到目的后，就把帮助过自己的人一脚踢开。
meaning_en: (lit.) to destroy the bridge after crossing the river (idiom); (fig.) to abandon one's benefactor upon achieving one's goal

meaning_cn: 饱含温情，默默地用眼神表达自己的感情。常用以形容少女面对意中人稍带娇羞但又无限关切的表情。
meaning_en: full of tender feelings (idiom); tender-hearted

meaning_cn: 怅然形容不如意、不痛快。象失去什么似的烦恼不快。
meaning_en: (idiom) to feel a profound sense of loss; to feel disconsolate

meaning_cn: 玲珑精巧细致；剔透孔穴明晰。形容器物精致通明，结构细巧。也比喻人精明灵活。
meaning_en: exquisitely made; very clever

meaning_cn: 神魂精神，神志。精神恍惚，颠三倒四，失去常态。
meaning_en: lit. spirit and soul upside down (idiom); infatuated and head over heels in love; fascinated; captivated

meaning_cn: 指符合道义者则能得到多数人的帮助。
meaning_en: a just cause enjoys abundant support (idiom); those upholding justice will find help all around

meaning_cn: 甘甜；饴麦芽糖浆。感到象糖那样甜。指为了从事某种工作，甘愿承受艰难、痛苦。
meaning_en: lit. as sweet as syrup (idiom, from Book of Songs); to endure hardship gladly; a glutton for punishment

meaning_cn: 双方互相看着，发出会心的微笑。形容二者情合意洽的情态。
meaning_en: (idiom) to look at each other and smile

meaning_cn: 臭味气味；相投互相投合。彼此的思想作风、兴趣等相同，很合得来（常指坏的）。
meaning_en: to share vile habits; partners in notoriety; birds of a feather

meaning_cn: 狂妄极端的自高自大。指极其放肆，自高自大，自中无人。
meaning_en: arrogant and conceited

meaning_cn: 指苦心钻研，到了别人所达不到的地步。也指为寻求解决问题的办法而煞费苦心。
meaning_en: to make painstaking efforts (idiom); after much trouble; to work hard at sth

meaning_cn: 泛指平庸的人。
meaning_en: common people; ordinary folk

meaning_cn: 比喻说话做事漏洞非常多。
meaning_en: (of an argument, theory etc) full of flaws (idiom)

meaning_cn: 灾祸从口里产生出来。指说话不谨慎容易惹祸。
meaning_en: Trouble issues from the mouth (idiom). A loose tongue may cause a lot of trouble.

meaning_cn: 探头或上体向前伸出。伸着头向左右张望。形容鬼鬼祟祟的探望。
meaning_en: to stick one's head out and look around (idiom)

meaning_cn: 凭弱小的力量战胜力量强大的。
meaning_en: using the weak to defeat the strong (idiom); to win from a position of weakness

meaning_cn: 揽采摘。到天的最高处去摘月。常形容壮志豪情。
meaning_en: (idiom) to reach for the stars

meaning_cn: 悱恻悲苦的样子。旧时形容内心痛苦难以排解。也指文章感情婉转凄凉。
meaning_en: (of a person) sad beyond words (idiom); (of music, literature etc) poignant; very sentimental

meaning_cn: 衣食不足。指贫穷。亦作缺食无衣”。
meaning_en: short of food and clothing; destitute

meaning_cn: 飞蛾扑到火上，比喻自取灭亡。
meaning_en: the moth flies into the flame; fatal attraction

meaning_cn: 指整个天下；遍天下。
meaning_en: (idiom) all under heaven; in the whole world; throughout the world

meaning_cn: 比喻很有把握。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be a cinch; in the bag; (idiom) (of a person) confident of success

meaning_cn: 象山一样高耸，如水一般长流。原比喻人的风范或声誉象高山一样永远存在◇比喻恩德深厚。
meaning_en: high as the mountain and long as the river (idiom); fig. noble and far-reaching

meaning_cn: 表示又爱又恨的意思。小说戏曲中多用作对情人或儿女的亲热称呼。
meaning_en: quarrelsome but loving couple

meaning_cn: 好象在哭泣，又象在诉说。形容声音悲切。
meaning_en: (lit.) as if weeping and complaining (idiom); (fig.) (of music, singing etc) mournful

meaning_cn: 做了坏事满不再乎，一点儿也不感到羞耻。
meaning_en: to have no sense of shame

meaning_cn: 形容很少的数量。
meaning_en: (idiom) the tiniest bit

meaning_cn: 春风指笑容。比喻人喜悦舒畅的表情。形容和蔼愉快的面容。
meaning_en: (idiom) radiant with happiness; beaming

meaning_cn: 马前马后。指追随左右。
meaning_en: to follow everywhere; to always be there for sb at their beck and call

meaning_cn: 留着毒疮不去医治，就会成为后患。比喻纵容包庇坏人坏事，结果会遭受祸害。
meaning_en: lit. to foster an ulcer and bequeath a calamity (idiom); tolerating budding evil can only lead to disaster; to cherish a viper in one's bosom

meaning_cn: 当底。虽然大，却无底。原指大得无边际◇多用作表示大得不切合实际、不合用。
meaning_en: grandiose but impractical (idiom); large but of no real use

meaning_cn: 吁叹息。长一声、短一声不住地叹气。形容发愁的神情。
meaning_en: long moan and short gasp (idiom); continually moaning and groaning in pain

meaning_cn: 浪迹到处流浪。到处流浪，足迹遍天下。
meaning_en: to roam far and wide (idiom); to travel the world

meaning_cn: 振挥动。挥动手臂呼喊（多用在号召）。
meaning_en: (idiom) to issue a call for action; to raise one's hand and issue a rousing call

meaning_cn: 户门。夜里睡觉不用闩上门。形容社会治安情况良好。
meaning_en: lit. doors not locked at night (idiom); fig. stable society

meaning_cn: 比喻为了追逐名利，不择手段，象苍蝇一样飞来飞去，象狗一样的不识羞耻。
meaning_en: (lit.) to swarm like flies around rotten food and drag out an ignoble existence like a dog (idiom); (fig.) to lead an undignified life; to resort to any means for personal gain

meaning_cn: 峭壁陡直的石壁。形容山势险峻。
meaning_en: (idiom) sheer cliffs and precipitous rock faces

meaning_cn: 屈屈服。坚韧、刚毅，毫不屈服。
meaning_en: staunch and unyielding (idiom); steadfast

meaning_cn: 犹言洋洋得意。形容得意时神气十足的姿态。
meaning_en: immensely pleased with oneself (idiom); proud; complacent

meaning_cn: 态度粗暴，不讲道理。
meaning_en: rude and unreasonable

meaning_cn: 睹看；思思念。看见死去或离别的人留下的东西就想起了这个人。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fondly remember a person on seeing sth one associates with them

meaning_cn: 黄花菊花。原指重阳节过后逐渐萎谢的菊花◇多比喻过时的事物或消息。
meaning_en: lit. chrysanthemums after the Double Ninth Festival (idiom); fig. outdated; thing of the past; dead letter

meaning_cn: 指另找一份职业，意即辞去原职。
meaning_en: to get a better job somewhere else (idiom); to seek alternative employment

meaning_cn: 迂回回旋，环绕。弯弯曲曲，绕来绕去。常比喻事物发展的曲折性。
meaning_en: meandering and circuitous (idiom); complicated developments that never get anywhere; going around in circles

meaning_cn: 看见某种严重情况，心里感到震惊。
meaning_en: lit. shocks the eye, astonishes the heart (idiom); shocking; horrible to see; a ghastly sight; also written 觸目驚心|触目惊心

meaning_cn: 形容情况或条件有很大的好转。
meaning_en: bird shotgun replaced by cannon (idiom); equipment improved enormously

meaning_cn: 杀气凶恶的气势；腾腾气势旺盛的样子。形容充满了要杀人的凶狠气势。
meaning_en: ferocious; murderous-looking

meaning_cn: 夙早；兴起来；寐睡。早起晚睡。形容勤奋。
meaning_en: to rise early and sleep late (idiom); to work hard; to study diligently; to burn the candle at both ends

meaning_cn: 逢遭遇；凶不幸；吉吉利、吉祥。遇到凶险转化为吉祥、顺利。这是带有迷信的说法。
meaning_en: misfortune turns to blessing (idiom); to turn an inauspicious start to good account

meaning_cn: 原意是只有君王才能独揽权威，行赏行罚◇泛指凭借职位，滥用权力。
meaning_en: tyrannical abuse (idiom); riding roughshod over people

meaning_cn: 以用；易改变，更换；暴残暴。用残暴势力代替残暴势力。指统治者换了，暴虐的统治没有改变。
meaning_en: to replace one tyranny by another; to use violence against violence

meaning_cn: 一会儿说东，一会儿说西。指说话条理斋乱，没有中心。
meaning_en: to talk about this and that (idiom); to ramble incoherently

meaning_cn: 师军队；名名义，引伸为理由。出兵没有正当理由。也引申为做某事没有正当理由。
meaning_en: lit. to go to war without just cause (idiom); to act without justification

meaning_cn: 成成就。成全别人的好事。
meaning_en: (idiom) beauty of helping others succeed; act of helping sb fulfill their wish

meaning_cn: 下棋时走错一步，整个棋就输掉。比喻因受某一局部的影响而使全局归于失败。
meaning_en: see 一著不慎，滿盤皆輸|一着不慎，满盘皆输[yi1 zhao1 bu4 shen4 , man3 pan2 jie1 shu1]

meaning_cn: 和声音相应。自己没有主见，别人怎么说，就跟着怎么说。
meaning_en: to parrot other people's words (idiom); to chime in with others

meaning_cn: 秀色美女姿容或自然美景；餐吃。原形容妇女美貌◇也形容景物秀丽。
meaning_en: a feast for the eyes (idiom); (of women) gorgeous; graceful; (of scenery) beautiful

meaning_cn: 礼礼貌；兵武力。先按通常的礼节同对方交涉，如果行不能，再用武力或其他强硬手段解决。
meaning_en: (idiom) try persuasion before resorting to force

meaning_cn: 犹万箭攒心。形容万分伤痛。
meaning_en: (lit.) to have one's heart pierced by thousands of arrows (idiom); (fig.) overcome with sorrow; (fig.) to lambaste; to rip sb to shreds

meaning_cn: 旧指在争夺政权斗争中，成功了的就是合法的，称帝称王；失败了的就是非法的，被称为寇贼‖有成功者权势在手，无人敢责难，失败者却有口难辩的意思。
meaning_en: see 成則為王，敗則為寇|成则为王，败则为寇[cheng2 ze2 wei2 wang2 , bai4 ze2 wei2 kou4]

meaning_cn: 欺负人太过分了，令人不能容忍。
meaning_en: (idiom) to bully intolerably

meaning_cn: 姑息为求苟安，无原则地宽容；养助长；奸坏人坏事。无原则地宽容，只会助长坏人作恶。
meaning_en: to tolerate is to nurture an evildoer (idiom); spare the rod and spoil the child

meaning_cn: 不仅是当面告诉他，而且是提着他的耳朵向他讲。形容长辈教导热心恳切。
meaning_en: to give sincere advice (idiom); to exhort earnestly

meaning_cn: 指从事征战的生活、经历。
meaning_en: army life (idiom); the experience of war

meaning_cn: 一个巴掌拍不响。比喻力量孤单，难以成事。
meaning_en: It's hard to clap with only one hand.; It takes two to tango; It's difficult to achieve anything without support.

meaning_cn: 贫穷和疾病一起压在身上。
meaning_en: poverty compounded by ill health (idiom)

meaning_cn: 诡欺诈，奸滑。指暗地里策划坏的害人的坏主意。
meaning_en: crafty plots and machinations (idiom)

meaning_cn: 代上天主持公道。封建社会里农民起义多以此作为动员、组织群众的口号。
meaning_en: (idiom) to enforce justice on behalf of Heaven

meaning_cn: 二致两样。丝毫没有什么两样。指完全一样。
meaning_en: (idiom) without the slightest difference

meaning_cn: 原指玩弄手法欺骗人◇用来比喻常常变卦，反复无常。
meaning_en: lit. say three in the morning but four in the evening (idiom); to change sth that is already settled upon; indecisive; to blow hot and cold

meaning_cn: 暴损害，糟蹋；殄灭绝；天物指自然生物。原指残害灭绝天生万物◇指任意糟蹋东西，不知爱惜。
meaning_en: to waste natural resources recklessly; not to know how to use things sparingly

meaning_cn: 拱手双手合抱在胸前，以示敬意。恭顺地让给别人。形容怯弱可欺或甘心为奴仆、附庸。
meaning_en: (idiom) to surrender sth without resistance

meaning_cn: 巴、蜀指四川一带。四川一带的山山水水。
meaning_en: mountains and rivers of Sichuan (idiom)

meaning_cn: 象冰那样清澈透明，象玉那样洁白无瑕。比喻人的操行清白（多用于女子）。
meaning_en: clear as ice and clean as jade (idiom); spotless; irreproachable; incorruptible

meaning_cn: 天下指中国或世界。全国或全世界的局势动荡不安。
meaning_en: the whole country in rebellion

meaning_cn: 盟盟约；誓誓言。指男女相爱时立下的誓言，表示爱情要象山和海一样永恒不变。
meaning_en: to pledge undying love (idiom); oath of eternal love; to swear by all the Gods

meaning_cn: 说出话来就成文章。形容文思敏捷，口才好。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of one's speech) eloquent; articulate

meaning_cn: ①犹言差不多。②犹言零零碎碎，各式各样。
meaning_en: almost; nearing completion; bits and piece; of all kinds

meaning_cn: 自命自认为；凡平凡。自以为不平凡，比别人高明。
meaning_en: to think too much of oneself; self-important; arrogant

meaning_cn: 蔽遮。衣服破烂，连身子都遮盖不住。形容生活贫苦。
meaning_en: lit. clothes not covering the body (idiom); fig. poverty-stricken

meaning_cn: 紧闭着嘴，什么也不说。
meaning_en: to keep silent (idiom)

meaning_cn: 疾急速。徐缓慢。不急不慢。指处事能掌握适度的节律，不太快或不太慢。
meaning_en: neither too fast nor too slow (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指独腿站立的一种武术姿势◇也指用一足站立。
meaning_en: golden rooster stands on one leg (tai chi posture); standing on one leg

meaning_cn: 客死死在异乡或国外。死在离家乡很遥远的地方。
meaning_en: see 客死異鄉|客死异乡[ke4 si3 yi4 xiang1]

meaning_cn: 象天塌下、地裂开那样。比喻重大的事变。
meaning_en: heaven falls and earth rends (idiom); rocked by a major disaster; fig. violent revolution; major social upheaval

meaning_cn: 形容仪容不整，作风散漫，态度不严肃或不认真。
meaning_en: sloppy

meaning_cn: 善好的。报报应。做好事必有好的报答。常与恶有恶报”连用。
meaning_en: virtue has its rewards (idiom); one good turn deserves another

meaning_cn: 愎任性；刚愎强硬回执；自用自以为是。十分固执自信，不考虑别人的意见。
meaning_en: obstinate and self-opinionated (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指戏曲的南北腔调。现形容说话口音不纯，搀杂着方言。
meaning_en: a regional accent

meaning_cn: 为干，做。喜欢自己亲手去做。
meaning_en: to do one's best; to shape up; to fend for oneself; you're on your own

meaning_cn: 心肠硬得象铁和石头一样。形容心肠很硬，不为感情所动。
meaning_en: to have a heart of stone; hard-hearted; unfeeling

meaning_cn: 说话带刺，待人冷酷。
meaning_en: sharp and unkind (words)

meaning_cn: 原形容暮春景色衰败◇常用来比喻被打得大败。
meaning_en: to be in a sorry state; to be utterly defeated

meaning_cn: 胜能承受。喜欢得控制不了自己。形容非常高兴。
meaning_en: unable to contain one's joy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 文文字，指字面；义意义。不了解某一词句的确切涵义，光从字面上去牵强附会，做出不确切的解释。
meaning_en: lit. view a text and interpret (idiom); to interpret word by word without understanding the meaning; a far-fetched interpretation

meaning_cn: 指应该和有关的人一起商量或一起做的事，却独自办理，不让旁人参与。
meaning_en: to do everything oneself (idiom); not to allow others in on the act

meaning_cn: 逢遇到；场演戏的场地。原指旧时走江湖的艺人遇到适合的场合就表演◇指遇到机会，偶尔凑凑热闹。
meaning_en: lit. find a stage, put on a comedy (idiom); to join in the fun; to play along according to local conditions

meaning_cn: 当事人被碰到的问题搞糊涂了，旁边观看的人却看得很清楚。
meaning_en: an outsider can see things more clearly or objectively than those involved (idiom)

meaning_cn: 憎厌恶。面貌神情卑陋，使人看了厌恶。
meaning_en: repulsive countenance; disgusting appearance

meaning_cn: 依依恋。象小鸟那样依傍着人。形容少女或小孩娇小可爱的样子。
meaning_en: lit. like a little bird relying on people (idiom); fig. cute and helpless-looking

meaning_cn: 缄封闭。封住嘴巴，不开口说话。
meaning_en: see 閉口不言|闭口不言[bi4 kou3 bu4 yan2]

meaning_cn: 畏惧退缩，不敢前进。
meaning_en: to shrink back in fear (idiom); too cowardly to advance

meaning_cn: 从一片树叶的凋落，知道秋天的到来。比喻通过个别的细微的迹象，可以看到整个形势的发展趋向与结果。
meaning_en: lit. the falling of one leaf heralds the coming of autumn (idiom); fig. a small sign can indicate a great trend; a straw in the wind

meaning_cn: 井底的蛙只能看到井口那么大的一块天。比喻见识狭窄的人。
meaning_en: (lit.) a frog at the bottom of a well (idiom); (fig.) a person of limited outlook and experience

meaning_cn: 比喻玩弄手段蒙骗人。
meaning_en: (lit.) to pretend to be in contact with supernatural beings (idiom); (fig.) to create a false sense of mystery; to play tricks to deceive or scare others; to engage in hocus-pocus

meaning_cn: 同类的东西聚在一起。指坏人彼此臭味相投，勾结在一起。
meaning_en: similar things come together (idiom); like draws like; Birds of a feather flock together.

meaning_cn: 鸡飞走了，蛋打破了。比喻两头落空，一无所得。
meaning_en: the chicken has flown the coop and the eggs are broken; a dead loss (idiom)

meaning_cn: 陋简陋；就将就。原意是因循原来的的简陋，不求改进◇指就着原来简陋的条件办事。
meaning_en: crude but simple methods (idiom); use whatever methods you can; to do things simply and thriftily; It's not pretty but it works.

meaning_cn: 舍住宅，比喻人的躯壳。灵魂离开了躯壳。指人之将死。也形容精神恍惚。
meaning_en: to be preoccupied (idiom); to be inattentive; to be frightened out of one's mind

meaning_cn: 媒妁说合婚姻的人。媒人的介绍。
meaning_en: (idiom) matchmaker's services (in establishing an arranged marriage)

meaning_cn: 功德佛教用语，指诵经、布施等。多指诵经等佛事结束。比喻举办事情圆满结束。
meaning_en: virtuous achievements come to their successful conclusion (idiom)

meaning_cn: 良美好；辰时辰。美好的时光和景物。
meaning_en: fine time, beautiful scenery (idiom); everything lovely

meaning_cn: 用瞪眼回击瞪眼。比喻用对方使用的手段来回击对方。
meaning_en: an eye for an eye (idiom); fig. to use the enemy's methods against him; to give sb a taste of his own medicine

meaning_cn: 传说老子过函谷关之前，关尹喜见有紫气从东而来，知道将有圣人过关。果然老子骑着青牛而来。旧时比喻吉祥的征兆。
meaning_en: (idiom) auspicious omen heralding good fortune

meaning_cn: 形容度量大，能容人。
meaning_en: magnanimous (idiom); generous

meaning_cn: 风华风采才华；绝代冠绝当世。意思是风采才华为当世第一。
meaning_en: magnificent style unmatched in his generation (idiom); peerless talent

meaning_cn: 将映在酒杯里的弓影误认为蛇。比喻因疑神疑鬼而引起恐惧。
meaning_en: lit. to see a bow reflected in a cup as a snake (idiom); fig. unnecessary suspicions; overly fearful

meaning_cn: 形容神态失常，失去自制。
meaning_en: see 如癡如醉|如痴如醉[ru2 chi1 ru2 zui4]

meaning_cn: 指屡次，多次。
meaning_en: repeatedly (idiom)

meaning_cn: 在一旁助威增加他人的愤怒或助长事态的发展。
meaning_en: to add oil to the fire (idiom); fig. to aggravate a situation; to enrage people and make matters worse

meaning_cn: 什么都不放在眼里。形容极端骄傲自大。
meaning_en: the eye can see nothing worthwhile all around (idiom); arrogant; condescending; supercilious

meaning_cn: 比喻说话和行动的真实意图别有所指。同项庄舞剑，意在沛公”
meaning_en: lit. Xiang Zhuang performs the sword dance, but his mind is set on Liu Bang 劉邦|刘邦[Liu2 Bang1] (idiom, refers to plot to kill Liu Bang during the Hongmen feast 鴻門宴|鸿门宴[Hong2 men2 yan4] in 206 BC); fig. an elaborate deception hiding malicious intent

meaning_cn: 泥塑的牛掉到海里。比喻一去不再回来。
meaning_en: lit. a clay ox enters the sea (idiom); fig. to disappear with no hope of returning

meaning_cn: 心比天高，气性骄傲。态度傲慢，自以为高人一等。
meaning_en: proud and arrogant

meaning_cn: 嘴唇没有了，牙齿就会感到寒冷。比喻利害密要相关。
meaning_en: lit. without the lips, the teeth feel the cold (idiom); fig. intimately interdependent

meaning_cn: 比喻美丽的女子死亡。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a beautiful woman) to die; to pass away

meaning_cn: 使国家富足，兵力强大。
meaning_en: lit. rich country, strong army (idiom); slogan of legalist philosophers in pre-Han times; Make the country wealthy and the military powerful, slogan of modernizers in Qing China and Meiji Japan (Japanese pronunciation: Fukoku kyōhei)

meaning_cn: 因为爱一个人而连带爱他屋上的乌鸦。比喻爱一个人而连带地关心到与他有关的人或物。
meaning_en: lit. love the house and its crow (idiom); involvement with sb and everyone connected; Love me, love my dog.

meaning_cn: 甚很，极。只求知道个大概，不求彻底了解。常指学习或研究不认真、不深入。
meaning_en: lit. not requiring a detailed understanding (idiom); only looking for an overview; not bothered with the details; superficial; content with shallow understanding

meaning_cn: 屈冤枉；招招供。指无罪的人冤枉受刑，被迫招认有罪。
meaning_en: to obtain confessions under torture

meaning_cn: 门户派别；见成见。因派别不同而产生的成见。
meaning_en: sectarian bias; parochialism

meaning_cn: 泛指有名的高山和源远流长的大河。
meaning_en: famous mountains and great rivers

meaning_cn: 掘挖。自己的所作所为就象在替自己挖掘坟墓一样。比喻自寻死路。
meaning_en: to dig one's own grave

meaning_cn: 志向实现，心满意足。
meaning_en: fully content with one's achievements (idiom); complacent

meaning_cn: 一半真情，一半假意。不是完全真实的。
meaning_en: (idiom) half true and half false

meaning_cn: 地位低，说话不受人重视。
meaning_en: (idiom) what lowly people think counts for little

meaning_cn: 形容极少。
meaning_en: just the tiniest bit; a hint of

meaning_cn: 时务当前的形势和潮流。指不认识当前重要的事态和时代的潮流。现也指待人接物不知趣。
meaning_en: to show no understanding of the times (idiom); cannot adapt to current circumstances; not amenable to reason

meaning_cn: 心腹比喻要害。比喻隐藏在内部的严重祸害。也泛指最大的隐患。
meaning_en: lit. calamity within one's bosom (idiom); major trouble hidden within

meaning_cn: 才学相貌都好。
meaning_en: talented and good-looking (idiom)

meaning_cn: 穷极；奢奢侈；欲享乐的观念。奢侈和贪欲到了极点。
meaning_en: to indulge in a life of luxury (idiom); extreme extravagance

meaning_cn: 比喻看待人或事物所抱的成见。
meaning_en: (idiom) biased perspective; prejudice

meaning_cn: 少年轻；更经历。年纪轻，没有经历过什么事情。指经验不多。
meaning_en: (idiom) young and inexperienced; wet behind the ears

meaning_cn: 干枯竭。形容外表强壮，内里空虚。
meaning_en: strong in appearance but weak in reality (idiom)

meaning_cn: 首头；异不同；处地方。指被杀头。
meaning_en: to be decapitated (idiom)

meaning_cn: 冷得象冰霜一样。比喻待人接物毫无感情，象冰霜一样冷。也比喻态度严正，不可接近。
meaning_en: as cold as ice and frost (idiom, usually of woman); icy manner; frigid

meaning_cn: 原指不正派的宗教派别。借指不正派的学术派别。现泛指不正派的东西。
meaning_en: dissenting religious sect (idiom); heretical school of opinion; dissident group

meaning_cn: 旧指小贩和差役。泛指旧社会里地位低下者。
meaning_en: lit. peddlers and carriers; common people; lower class

meaning_cn: 指学业上是没有尽头的，应奋进不息。
meaning_en: no end to learning (idiom); There's always something new to study.; You live and learn.

meaning_cn: 口齿说话、言谈；伶俐聪明，灵活。谈吐麻利，应付自如。形容口才好。
meaning_en: eloquent and fluent speaker (idiom); grandiloquence; the gift of the gab

meaning_cn: 坐在井底看天。比喻眼界小，见识少。
meaning_en: lit. to view the sky from the bottom of a well (idiom); ignorant and narrow-minded

meaning_cn: 喜事从天上掉下来。比喻突然遇到意想不到的喜事。
meaning_en: joy from heaven (idiom); overjoyed at unexpected good news; unlooked-for happy event

meaning_cn: 同室一家，指自己人；操拿起；戈古代的兵器。自家人动刀枪。指兄弟争吵。泛指内部斗争。
meaning_en: wielding the halberd within the household (idiom); internecine strife

meaning_cn: 话里含有别的意思。
meaning_en: one's words carry an implicit meaning

meaning_cn: 聊姑且。姑且用来安慰自己。
meaning_en: to find some consolation (idiom); to find relief in

meaning_cn: 求追究，寻求；诸之于”的合成词。反过来追究自己。指从自己方面找原因。
meaning_en: to seek the cause in oneself rather than sb else

meaning_cn: 完完整。完完整整，没有欠缺。
meaning_en: in perfect condition; without any defect

meaning_cn: 设法使老虎离开原来的山冈。比喻用计使对方离开原来的地方，以便乘机行事。
meaning_en: to lure the tiger from its domain in the mountains (idiom); to lure an enemy away from his territory

meaning_cn: 形容发生爆炸等灾祸时，死伤者血肉四溅的惨状。
meaning_en: (idiom) flesh and blood flying in all directions; carnage

meaning_cn: 开卷打开书本，指读书；益好处。读书总有好处。
meaning_en: lit. opening a book is profitable (idiom); the benefits of education

meaning_cn: 解脱下；甲古代将士打仗时穿的战服。脱下军装，回家种地。指战士退伍还乡。
meaning_en: to remove armor and return to the farm; to return to civilian life

meaning_cn: 覆倒。倒在地上的水难以收回。比喻事情已成定局，无法挽回。
meaning_en: spilt water is difficult to retrieve (idiom); it's no use crying over spilt milk; what's done is done and can't be reversed; the damage is done; once divorced, there's no reuniting

meaning_cn: 指把零碎的东西拼凑起来。引申为胡乱凑合。
meaning_en: assembled at random; a motley collection

meaning_cn: 喝醉酒寻衅生事者。
meaning_en: drunken fighting; to get drunk and quarrel

meaning_cn: 拈捏；惹招惹；草、花比喻好。比喻到处留情，多指男女间的挑逗引诱。
meaning_en: lit. to pick the flowers and trample the grass (idiom); fig. to womanize; to frequent brothels; to sow one's wild oats

meaning_cn: 接受这一方面的好处，却为那一方面卖力。也指将自己方面的情况告诉对方。
meaning_en: (idiom) to work against the interests of sb one derives support from; to double-cross one's employer; to bite the hand that feeds

meaning_cn: 皇帝的亲戚。指极有权势的人。
meaning_en: the emperor relatives (idiom); person with powerful connections

meaning_cn: 俯低头，弯腰；即就。只要低下头来捡取，到处都是。形容多而易得。
meaning_en: see 俯拾皆是[fu3 shi2 jie1 shi4]

meaning_cn: 量估量。自己不估量自己的能力。指过高地估计自己的实力。
meaning_en: (idiom) to overestimate one's capabilities

meaning_cn: 年老辞职，回到家乡。
meaning_en: (idiom) to retire from official service due to old age and return to one's hometown

meaning_cn: 词言词；意意思。指词句不能确切地表达出意思和感情。
meaning_en: words do not convey the meaning; poorly expressed; senseless; inarticulate

meaning_cn: 闻听。听了跟没听到一样。形容不关心，不在意。
meaning_en: to hear but not react (idiom); to turn a deaf ear; to ignore deliberately

meaning_cn: 豆蒮多年生草本植物，比喻处女。指女子十三四岁时。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a girl) 13 or 14 years old; early teens; adolescence

meaning_cn: 因果原因和结果。佛教迷信，认为今生种什么因，来生结什么果，善有善报，恶有恶报。
meaning_en: (Buddhism) retribution; karma

meaning_cn: 淋漓心情舒畅。形容非常痛快。
meaning_en: joyous; hearty; spirited; (of commentary) trenchant; incisive

meaning_cn: 特独特；立立身。形容人的志行高洁，不同流俗。
meaning_en: to be unconventional; independence of action

meaning_cn: 指同床并头而眠。多指夫妻生活。
meaning_en: to share the bed; (fig.) to be married

meaning_cn: 拥拥挤。一下子全都拥了进去，挤了进去。
meaning_en: to swarm in (of people etc) (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容受峻削压迫的苦，有很大的仇恨。
meaning_en: (idiom) great bitterness and deep hatred; deeply ingrained long-standing resentment

meaning_cn: 遗失物。路上没有人把别人丢失的东西捡走。形容社会风气好。
meaning_en: lit. no one picks up lost articles in the street (idiom); fig. honesty prevails throughout society

meaning_cn: 从眼前飘过的云烟。原比喻身外之物，不必重视◇比喻很快就消失的事物。
meaning_en: see 過眼雲煙|过眼云烟[guo4 yan3 yun2 yan1]

meaning_cn: 手足比喻兄弟。比喻兄弟的感情。
meaning_en: brotherly affection

meaning_cn: 家业衰败，境况没有从前富裕。
meaning_en: to come down in the world (idiom); to suffer a reversal of fortune

meaning_cn: 授给予，付予；机宜机密之事。当面指示处理事务的方针、办法等。
meaning_en: (idiom) to brief sb in person on the line of action to pursue; to advise face-to-face on how to deal with the present situation

meaning_cn: 物竞生物的生存竞争；天择自然选择。生物相互竞争，能适应者生存下来。原指生物进货的一般规律，后也用于人类社会的发展。
meaning_en: natural selection

meaning_cn: 囊口袋；探囊向袋里摸取。伸手到口袋里拿东西。比喻能够轻而易举地办成某件事情。
meaning_en: to feel in one's pocket and take sth (idiom); as easy as pie; in the bag

meaning_cn: 心里不畅快，但脸上勉强装出喜笑的样子。
meaning_en: to pretend to look happy; to force oneself to smile

meaning_cn: 旧时指品行端正的人。现多作讽刺的用法，指假装正经的人。
meaning_en: upright gentleman; man of honor

meaning_cn: 形容说话轻而柔和。
meaning_en: to speak softly

meaning_cn: 丝毫不往心里去。
meaning_en: to not mind (at all, a bit); to not care in the slightest

meaning_cn: 否、泰《周易》中的两个卦名。否卦不顺利；泰卦顺利；极尽头。逆境达到极点，就会向顺境转化。指坏运到了头好运就来了。
meaning_en: extreme sorrow turns to joy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 尸体到处横着。形容死者极多。
meaning_en: (idiom) corpses are strewn across the field (typically after a battle)

meaning_cn: 楚楚植物丛生的样子，也形容痛苦的神情。本指幼松纤弱可爱，后形容女子娇弱的样子。
meaning_en: (idiom) pitiable; sweet, innocent and vulnerable

meaning_cn: 做事不得当，反使自己难堪窘迫。
meaning_en: to invite a snub; to court a rebuff

meaning_cn: 回天比喻力量大，能移转极难挽回的时势；无力没有力量。比喻局势或病情严重，已无法挽救。
meaning_en: see 無力回天|无力回天[wu2 li4 hui2 tian1]

meaning_cn: 克能够。既能勤劳，又能节俭。
meaning_en: (idiom) industrious and frugal

meaning_cn: 来日未来的日子；方正。将来的日子还长着呢。表示事有可为或将来还有机会。
meaning_en: the future is long (idiom); there will be ample time for that later; We'll cross that bridge when we get there

meaning_cn: 象骨头和肉一样互相连接着。比喻关系非常密切，不可分离。
meaning_en: lit. interrelated as bones and flesh (idiom); inseparably related; closely intertwined

meaning_cn: 伯仲兄弟排行的次第，伯是老大，仲是老二；间中间。比喻差不多，难分优劣。
meaning_en: almost on a par

meaning_cn: 做坏事的人会得到不好的报应。指因办坏事而自食其果。
meaning_en: evil has its retribution (idiom); to suffer the consequences of one's bad deeds; sow the wind and reap the whirlwind (Hosea 8:7)

meaning_cn: 形容光辉灿烂，照耀到远方。
meaning_en: (idiom) boundless radiance; splendor

meaning_cn: 呆傻，发愣的样子。呆得象木头鸡一样。形容因恐惧或惊异而发愣的样子。
meaning_en: lit. dumb as a wooden chicken (idiom); fig. dumbstruck

meaning_cn: 学识广博，有多方面的才能。
meaning_en: (idiom) erudite and multitalented; versatile and able

meaning_cn: 用眼睛、眉毛示意。
meaning_en: to make eyes; to wink

meaning_cn: 利用机会顺便给人的好处。也指不费力的人情。
meaning_en: to do sb a favor at little cost

meaning_cn: 枝节比喻细小或旁出的事情。比喻在解决问题过程中意外地发生了一些麻烦事。
meaning_en: to deliberately complicate an issue (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容又愚笨又没有知识。
meaning_en: stupid and ignorant (idiom)

meaning_cn: 象锦绣那样的前程。形容前途十分美好。
meaning_en: bright future; bright prospects

meaning_cn: 名名声；扬传播。坏名声传得很远。
meaning_en: stinking reputation; notorious far and wide

meaning_cn: 看具体情况灵活办事。
meaning_en: see the opportunity and act (idiom); to act according to circumstances; to play it by ear; to use one's discretion

meaning_cn: 原指人年纪虽轻，却很老练。现在也指年轻人缺乏朝气。
meaning_en: accomplished though young; lacking youthful vigor

meaning_cn: 形容人高大粗壮，身材魁梧。
meaning_en: burly; strapping; big and strong

meaning_cn: 关闭关口，不和外人来往。比喻因循保守，不愿接触外界事物。
meaning_en: close the country to international intercourse

meaning_cn: 仗凭借，依靠。依仗某种权势欺压人。
meaning_en: to take advantage of one's position to bully people (idiom); to kick people around

meaning_cn: 比喻另择新主，另找依靠。
meaning_en: to improve one's family's social status by moving up in the world; to switch one's allegiance to a new patron

meaning_cn: 玩玩弄；焚烧。玩火的必定会烧了自己。比喻干冒险或害人的勾当，最后受害的还是自己。
meaning_en: to play with fire and get burnt (idiom); fig. to play with evil and suffer the consequences; to get one's fingers burnt

meaning_cn: 用应有的礼节接待。
meaning_en: to treat sb with due respect (idiom)

meaning_cn: 跟老虎商量要它的皮。比喻跟恶人商量要他放弃自己的利益，绝对办不到。
meaning_en: (lit.) to negotiate with a tiger for its pelt (idiom); (fig.) to ask sb to act contrary to their own interests

meaning_cn: 道主张，思想。安于贫穷，以坚持自己的信念为乐。旧时士大夫所主张的为人处世之道。
meaning_en: to be content with poverty and strive for virtue (idiom)

meaning_cn: 说话罗嗦，一说起来没个完。
meaning_en: to chatter; to babble

meaning_cn: 交交情，朋友。在一起经历过艰难困苦的朋友。
meaning_en: a friend in times of tribulations (idiom); a friend in need is a friend indeed

meaning_cn: 把破损的罐子摔破。比喻有了缺点、错误不改正，反而有意向更坏的方向发展。
meaning_en: (lit.) to smash a pot just because it has a crack (idiom); (fig.) to give up altogether after a setback; to throw one's hands up in frustration and let it all go to hell

meaning_cn: 牛头的鬼，蛇身的神。原形容虚幻怪诞◇比喻社会上形形色色的坏人。
meaning_en: evil monsters; (fig.) bad characters; (political) bad elements

meaning_cn: 拿蛋去碰石头。比喻不估计自己的力量，自取灭亡。
meaning_en: lit. to strike a stone with egg (idiom); to attempt the impossible; to invite disaster by overreaching oneself

meaning_cn: 兵力强盛，战马健壮。形容军队实力强，富有战斗力。
meaning_en: lit. strong soldiers and sturdy horses (idiom); fig. a well-trained and powerful army

meaning_cn: 东晋王朝在江南建立后，北方士族纷纷来到江南，当时有人说过江名士多于鲫”。比喻某种时兴的事物非常多。
meaning_en: (idiom) vast multitude of people

meaning_cn: 形容牲畜肥壮结实。
meaning_en: (of a livestock animal) plump and strong; well-fed

meaning_cn: 比喻为人方正。也形容脸色严峻。
meaning_en: (of a shape) sharp and clearcut; (of a person) definite in his opinion

meaning_cn: 指太阳刚落山时，由于光线反射而发生的天空中短时发亮的现象。比喻人死前精神突然兴奋。也比喻事物灭亡前夕的表面兴旺。
meaning_en: final radiance of setting sun; fig. dying flash (of lucidity or activity, prior to demise)

meaning_cn: 单凭嘴说而没有什么作为凭据。只要用实物来证明。
meaning_en: mere verbal statement cannot be taken as proof (idiom)

meaning_cn: 横行指行动蛮横；无忌无所顾忌。指倚仗暴力，毫无顾忌地干坏事。
meaning_en: (idiom) to run rampant; to act with impunity

meaning_cn: 贤者之间的交情，平淡如水，不尚虚华。
meaning_en: friendship between gentlemen, insipid as water (idiom, from Zhuangzi 莊子|庄子[Zhuang1 zi3])

meaning_cn: 什么事情都知道，没有不懂得的。
meaning_en: omniscient

meaning_cn: 出于人们的意料之外，都没想到的。
meaning_en: turned out other than expected (idiom); unexpected

meaning_cn: 是命令就服从，不敢有半点违抗。
meaning_en: to follow obediently

meaning_cn: 采精神。形容精神不振，提不起劲头。
meaning_en: listless; dispirited; washed out; also written 沒精打彩|没精打彩[mei2 jing1 da3 cai3]

meaning_cn: 坐镇指挥千里之外的战局。形容将帅雄才大略，指挥若定。
meaning_en: to be able to plan victory from a thousand miles away (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指闯荡江湖靠卖假药、算命等骗人谋生的人或招摇撞骗的人。
meaning_en: swindler; itinerant con-man

meaning_cn: 不说话，闷声不响。
meaning_en: to not say a word (idiom); to keep silent

meaning_cn: 形容态度卑贱低下也指工作性质卑贱低下。
meaning_en: servile

meaning_cn: 指在某一方面的学问或技术有独到的见解或独特的做法，能自成体系。
meaning_en: to have a style of one's own

meaning_cn: 应付对付，处置。自如按自己的心愿做事。处理事情从容不迫，很有办法。
meaning_en: to handle matters with ease (idiom); to hold one's own

meaning_cn: 当抵挡。形容来势十分迅猛，不能抵挡。
meaning_en: impossible to resist (idiom); an irresistible force

meaning_cn: 道道义；寡少。做事违反正义的人，一定得不到别人的支持和帮助。
meaning_en: an unjust cause finds little support (idiom, from Mencius); cf 得道多助[de2 dao4 duo1 zhu4] a just cause attracts much support

meaning_cn: 指封建礼教的规章制度遭到极大的破坏。
meaning_en: rites and music are in ruins (idiom); fig. society in total disarray; cf. 禮樂|礼乐[li3 yue4]

meaning_cn: 睡不好觉，吃不好饭。十分忧虑担心的样子。
meaning_en: see 寢食難安|寝食难安[qin3 shi2 nan2 an1]

meaning_cn: 布安排，开展。清除旧的，建立新的。以新的代替旧的。
meaning_en: to get rid of the old to bring in the new (idiom); to innovate

meaning_cn: 惜、怜爱怜；玉、香比喻女子。比喻男子对所爱女子的照顾体贴。
meaning_en: to have tender, protective feelings for the fairer sex (idiom)

meaning_cn: 三个人谎报城市里有老虎，听的人就信以为真。比喻说的人多了，就能使人们把谣言当事实。
meaning_en: three men talking makes a tiger (idiom); repeated rumor becomes a fact

meaning_cn: 振振理直气壮的样子。形容自以为理由充分，说个没完。
meaning_en: variant of 振振有詞|振振有词[zhen4 zhen4 you3 ci2]

meaning_cn: 鹬蚌相争，渔翁得利”的省语。比喻双方相持不下，而使第三者从中得利。
meaning_en: abbr. for 鷸蚌相爭，漁翁得利|鹬蚌相争，渔翁得利[yu4 bang4 xiang1 zheng1 , yu2 weng1 de2 li4]

meaning_cn: 比喻暗中改变事物的真相，以达到蒙混欺骗的目的。
meaning_en: to engage in fraudulent activities (idiom); skulduggery; to hoodwink people; to cheat sb audaciously

meaning_cn: 戴加在头上或用头顶着。不愿和仇敌在一个天底下并存。形容仇恨极深。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of enemies) cannot live under the same sky; absolutely irreconcilable

meaning_cn: 言语是思想的反映，从一个人的话里可以知道他的思想感情。
meaning_en: one's words reflect one's thinking (idiom)

meaning_cn: 封建时代官吏出门时，前面开路的人敲锣喝令行人让路。比喻为某种事物的出现，制造声势，开辟道路。
meaning_en: to beat the gong to clear the way; (fig.) to pave the way for sth

meaning_cn: 非常杰出的才智和谋略。
meaning_en: great skill and strategy

meaning_cn: 指不洁净，肮脏。也指因忌讳而感觉不洁净。也可形容语文不文明。
meaning_en: unclean; filthy; foul-mouthed

meaning_cn: 暮傍晚。佛教规矩，寺里晚上打鼓，晚上敲钟。比喻可以使人警觉醒悟的话。
meaning_en: lit. morning bell, evening drum, symbolizing monastic practice (idiom); fig. encouragement to study or progress

meaning_cn: 时时机。时机错过就不会再来了。指行事不要放过时机。
meaning_en: Time that has passed will never come back. (idiom)

meaning_cn: 倾倾覆；城国。原指因女色而亡国◇多形容妇女容貌极美。
meaning_en: lit. capable of causing the downfall of a city or state (idiom); fig. (of a woman) devastatingly beautiful; also written 傾城傾國|倾城倾国[qing1 cheng2 qing1 guo2]

meaning_cn: 像花和玉那样美好。形容女子姿容出众。
meaning_en: delicate as a flower, refined as a precious jade (idiom); (of a woman) exquisite

meaning_cn: 羽毛比喻人的声望。比喻为珍惜自己的名声，行事十分谨慎。
meaning_en: (idiom) to cherish one's reputation
