meaning_cn: 在一百步远以外射中杨柳的叶子。形容箭法或枪法十分高明。
meaning_en: to shoot with great precision (idiom)

meaning_cn: 踌躇迟疑不决的样子。犹豫不决，不敢前进。
meaning_en: to hesitate to move forward; to hesitate; to hold back

meaning_cn: 卜占卜，打卦，古人用火灼龟甲，看灼开的裂纹推测未来的吉凶祸富。没有占卜便能事先知道。形容有预见。
meaning_en: (idiom) to foresee the future (without divination); to know beforehand through uncanny insight

meaning_cn: 百多次；解理解。百般思索也无法理解。
meaning_en: to remain puzzled after pondering over sth a hundred times (idiom); to remain perplexed despite much thought

meaning_cn: 咫古代长度单位，周制八寸，合今市尺六寸二分二厘；咫尺比喻距离很近。比喻距离虽近，但很难相见，象是远在天边一样。
meaning_en: so close, yet worlds apart (idiom)

meaning_cn: 四方天下。有远大的抱负和理想。
meaning_en: to aspire to travel far and make one's mark (idiom)

meaning_cn: 垂帘太后或皇后临朝听政，殿上用帘子遮隔。听治理。指太后临朝管理国家政事。
meaning_en: lit. to govern from behind the curtain; to rule in place of the emperor (idiom)

meaning_cn: 逸安闲；劳疲劳。指在战争中做好充分准备，养精蓄锐，等疲乏的敌人来犯时给以迎头痛击。
meaning_en: to wait at one's ease for the exhausted enemy; to nurture one's strength and bide one's time (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容走得非常快，好象脚尖都未着地。同脚不点地”。
meaning_en: feet not touching the ground (idiom); to run like the wind

meaning_cn: 安置家庭，创立基业或事业。也指长期在一个地方劳动和生活。
meaning_en: stable household, established profession (idiom); settled and comfortably off

meaning_cn: 后生年轻人，后辈；畏敬畏。年轻人是可敬畏的。形容青年人能超过前辈。
meaning_en: the young will be redoubtable in the years to come (idiom); the younger generations will surpass us in time

meaning_cn: 旧指做事残忍，灭绝人性，为天理所不容。
meaning_en: Heaven cannot tolerate this (idiom); intolerable behavior

meaning_cn: 指睡眠尚未清醒。
meaning_en: half-awake; half-asleep

meaning_cn: 籁从孔穴中发出的声音；万籁自然界中万物发出的各种声响；寂静。形容周围环境非常安静，一点儿声响都没有。
meaning_en: (idiom) dead silent

meaning_cn: 白费劲，没有一点用处。
meaning_en: futile endeavor (idiom)

meaning_cn: 邯郸战国时赵国的都城；学步学习走路。比喻模仿人不到家，反把原来自己会的东西忘了。
meaning_en: to copy the way they walk in Handan (idiom); slavishly copying others, one risks becoming a caricature

meaning_cn: 彻明白；悟领会。形容彻底醒悟。
meaning_en: to achieve supreme enlightenment or nirvana (Buddhism)

meaning_cn: 原指帝王占有全国◇指什么地方都可以当作自己的家。指志在四方，不留恋家乡或个人小天地。
meaning_en: to regard the four corners of the world all as home (idiom); to feel at home anywhere; to roam about unconstrained; to consider the entire country, or world, to be one's own

meaning_cn: 居功自恃有功。自以为有功劳而骄傲自大。
meaning_en: satisfied with one's accomplishment and arrogant as a result (idiom); resting on one's laurels and despising others

meaning_cn: 昔往昔，过去。现在不如过去。多用于表示对世事的不满情绪。
meaning_en: things are not as good as they used to be

meaning_cn: 指着桑树骂槐树。比喻表面上骂这个人，实际上是骂那个人。
meaning_en: lit. to point at the mulberry tree and curse the locust tree; fig. to scold sb indirectly; to make oblique accusations (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻纵容敌人，留下后患，自己反手其害。
meaning_en: lit. to nurture a tiger invites calamity; fig. to indulge one's enemy is asking for trouble (idiom)

meaning_cn: 正传正题或本题。指话头转回到正题上来。旧小说中常用的套语。
meaning_en: to return to the topic (idiom); to get back to the main point

meaning_cn: 格推究；致求得。穷究事物原理，从而获得知识。
meaning_en: to study the underlying principle to acquire knowledge (idiom); pursuing knowledge to the end

meaning_cn: 时机和命运不佳。
meaning_en: fate is unfavorable (idiom); the omens are not good

meaning_cn: 指水和火是不讲情面的，如疏忽大意，容易造成灾祸。
meaning_en: fire and flood have no mercy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原意是梅子酸，人想吃梅子就会流涎，因而止渴◇比喻愿望无法实现，用空想安慰自己。
meaning_en: lit. to quench one's thirst by thinking of plums (idiom); fig. to console oneself with illusions

meaning_cn: 曲折而极窄的路（多指山路）。
meaning_en: road as twisty as sheep's intestine (idiom); narrow and winding road; fig. complicated and tricky job

meaning_cn: 自找的烦闷苦恼。意思是，本来不该有烦闷苦恼。
meaning_en: to bring trouble on oneself (idiom)

meaning_cn: 蜕化虫类脱皮变化。比喻人堕落变坏。
meaning_en: (idiom) to degenerate (morally); to become depraved

meaning_cn: 劳疲劳，辛苦；师、众军队；动出动，动员。原指出动大批军队。现指动用很多人力。
meaning_en: (idiom) to go to a great deal of trouble; to mobilize considerable manpower and resources (often unnecessarily)

meaning_cn: 秀秀丽；慧联盟。外表秀丽，内心聪明。
meaning_en: good-looking and intelligent (idiom)

meaning_cn: 量估量。自己不估量自己的能力。指过高地估计自己的力量。
meaning_en: to overestimate one's capabilities (idiom)

meaning_cn: 表示事情很复杂，不是几句话就能说清楚（多指不大愉快的事）。
meaning_en: start explaining and it's a long story (idiom); complicated and not easy to express succinctly

meaning_cn: 敢有胆量。敢于放手行事，敢于承担责任。
meaning_en: variant of 敢做敢當|敢做敢当[gan3 zuo4 gan3 dang1]

meaning_cn: 穷山荒山；恶水经常引起灾害的河流湖泊等。形容自然条件非常差。
meaning_en: lit. barren hills and wild rivers (idiom); fig. inhospitable natural environment

meaning_cn: 形容斗争或竞赛很激烈。
meaning_en: lit. the dragon wars, the tiger battles (idiom); fierce battle between giants

meaning_cn: ①不顾一切地斗争。②用尽全部精力。
meaning_en: one's utmost; (to fight or work) desperately hard; to put up a life or death struggle; at all costs

meaning_cn: 折挫折。比喻意志坚强，无论受到多少次挫折，毫不动摇退缩。
meaning_en: see 百折不撓|百折不挠[bai3 zhe2 bu4 nao2]

meaning_cn: 五车指五车书。形容读书多，学识丰富。
meaning_en: of great erudition and scholarship (idiom)

meaning_cn: 俗庸俗；耐忍受得住。庸俗得使人受不了。
meaning_en: intolerably vulgar

meaning_cn: 民生人民的生计；凋敝衰败，艰苦。社会穷困，经济衰败，人民生活极端困苦。
meaning_en: the people's livelihood is reduced to destitution (idiom); a time of famine and impoverishment

meaning_cn: 敌抵挡。力量所指向的地方，谁也抵挡不住。形容力量强大，无往不胜。
meaning_en: to be invincible; unrivalled

meaning_cn: 弹冠掸去帽子上的灰尘，准备做官。指官场中一人当了官或升了官，同伙就互相庆贺将有官可做。
meaning_en: lit. to flick dust off sb's cap (idiom); to celebrate an official appointment; to congratulate and celebrate (promotion, graduation etc)

meaning_cn: 成整；累积聚。一年又一年，一月又一月。形容时间长久。
meaning_en: year in, year out (idiom)

meaning_cn: 壁垒古代军营四周的围墙；森严整齐，严肃。原指军事戒备严密。现也用来比喻彼此界限划得很分明。
meaning_en: closely guarded; strongly fortified; sharply divided

meaning_cn: 清清净；寡少欲欲望，需求。保持心地清净，减少欲念。
meaning_en: (idiom) uninterested in self-indulgence; abstemious; ascetic

meaning_cn: 比喻由于偶然的因素而造成了差错。
meaning_en: see 陰差陽錯|阴差阳错[yin1 cha1 yang2 cuo4]

meaning_cn: 形容目光短浅，没有远见。
meaning_en: short-sighted

meaning_cn: ①指强迫良家妇女卖淫。②比喻被迫做某件坏事。
meaning_en: to force an honest girl into prostitution (idiom); to debauch

meaning_cn: 指延长寿命，增加岁数。同延年益寿”。
meaning_en: see 延年益壽|延年益寿[yan2 nian2 yi4 shou4]

meaning_cn: 抽干池水捉鱼。比喻只图眼前利益，不作长远打算。
meaning_en: see 竭澤而漁|竭泽而渔[jie2 ze2 er2 yu2]

meaning_cn: 处处理，对待；泰然安然，不以为意的样子。若无其事的样子。形容自理事情沉着镇定。也指对待问题毫不在意。
meaning_en: see 泰然處之|泰然处之[tai4 ran2 chu3 zhi1]

meaning_cn: 先用绳索套住脖子，又绕到背后反剪两臂的绑入方式。
meaning_en: to bind a person's upper body, with arms tied behind the back and rope looped around the neck; to truss up

meaning_cn: 缝纫用的针线等物。比喻细微的事物。
meaning_en: needle and thread; sewing implements; needlework; (fig.) unimportant thing

meaning_cn: 绵丝棉。棉絮里面藏着针。形容柔中有刚。也比喻外貌和善，内心刻毒。
meaning_en: lit. a needle concealed in silk floss (idiom); fig. ruthless character behind a gentle appearance; a wolf in sheep's clothing; an iron fist in a velvet glove

meaning_cn: 比喻不敢超越一定的范围和界限。同不敢越雷池一步”。
meaning_en: not overstepping the prescribed limits; to remain within bounds

meaning_cn: 比喻善于钻营，手腕不寻常。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be highly influential and well-connected; to have the ability to get things done through one's connections and influence

meaning_cn: 绝断；缕细线。多形容局面危急或声音、气息等低沉微弱、时断时续。
meaning_en: hanging by a thread; very precarious; almost extinct; (of sound) linger on faintly

meaning_cn: 一个铜钱都不值。比喻毫无价值。
meaning_en: (idiom) not worth a penny; utterly worthless

meaning_cn: 心里着慌，乱了主意。
meaning_en: confused; rattled; flustered

meaning_cn: 贪舍不得。贪恋生存，畏惧死亡。指对敌作战畏缩不前。
meaning_en: greedy for life, afraid of death (idiom); craven and cowardly; clinging abjectly to life; only interested in saving one's neck

meaning_cn: 遭受的痛苦和灾难既深又重。
meaning_en: deep grief; extensive sorrow

meaning_cn: 狼烟古代边防报警时烧狼粪腾起的烟。四处都是报警的烟火，指边疆不平静。
meaning_en: fire beacons on all sides (idiom); enveloped in the flames of war

meaning_cn: 比喻虚假的恭敬或过分的客气。
meaning_en: to nod one's head and bow (idiom); bowing and scraping; unctuous fawning

meaning_cn: 鉴审察或引为教训；往过去；来未来。根据以往的情形便知道以后怎样发生变化。
meaning_en: to observe the past to foresee the future (idiom, taken loosely from Book of Songs); studying ancient wisdom gives insight into what is to come

meaning_cn: 见闻少的人遇到不常见的事物就觉得奇怪◇常用来嘲笑见识浅陋的人。
meaning_en: (lit.) a person who has seen little of the world will be astonished by certain things (idiom); (fig.) to be taken aback by sth because of one's lack of sophistication; naive; unworldly

meaning_cn: 接受这一方面的好处，却为那一方面卖力。也指将自己方面的情况告诉对方。
meaning_en: variant of 吃裡扒外|吃里扒外[chi1 li3 pa2 wai4]

meaning_cn: 自己不懂却装作很精通的样子。
meaning_en: to pretend to understand when you don't

meaning_cn: 比喻照着样子模仿。
meaning_en: lit. drawing a tiger using a cat as a model (idiom); fig. to follow a model and get things more or less right but without capturing the spirit of the subject; uninspired imitation

meaning_cn: 永远记住，不遗忘。
meaning_en: never to be forgotten

meaning_cn: 光阴时间。时间如箭，迅速流逝。形容时间过得极快。
meaning_en: time flies like an arrow (idiom); How time flies!

meaning_cn: 指申诉冤屈。
meaning_en: to complain bitterly

meaning_cn: 把自己看得很高（多指身分，学识等）。
meaning_en: to think highly of oneself (idiom); giving oneself airs; arrogant and self-important

meaning_cn: 正确与错误非常分明。
meaning_en: to distinguish right from wrong (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指从宗教迷信的束缚中解脱出来。现也指解放思想，扫除自卑感，树立敢想、敢说、敢干的新风格。
meaning_en: to eliminate superstition (idiom)

meaning_cn: 从追随，引伸为学习。指选择好的学，按照好的做。
meaning_en: to choose the right course and follow it (idiom)

meaning_cn: 看得准，动作敏捷。
meaning_en: sharp-sighted and deft

meaning_cn: 酒酣酒喝得很痛快。形容喝酒喝得正高兴的时候。
meaning_en: tipsy and merry (idiom)

meaning_cn: 遗臭死后留下的恶名。死后恶名一直流传，永远被人唾骂。
meaning_en: to have one's name go down in history as a byword for infamy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 兆预兆。不吉利的预兆。
meaning_en: (idiom) bad omen

meaning_cn: 指白天刮风下雨，天色暗得象黑夜一样。形容政治黑暗，社会不安。
meaning_en: lit. wind and rain darken the sky (idiom); fig. the situation looks grim

meaning_cn: 原形容鱼悠然自在的样子。现用来形容人摇头晃脑、轻浮得意的样子。
meaning_en: to nod one's head and wag one's tail (idiom); to be well pleased with oneself; to have a lighthearted air

meaning_cn: 泼妇泼辣凶悍的妇女。象泼妇在街上当众谩骂。多指大肆攻击、谩骂别人。
meaning_en: shouting abuse in the street like a fishwife

meaning_cn: 胜尽。数也数不过来。形容数量极多。
meaning_en: countless; innumerable

meaning_cn: 局促拘束。形容举止拘束，心中不安。
meaning_en: ill at ease; uncomfortable

meaning_cn: 趋奔走；炎热，比喻权势。奉承和依附有权有势的人。
meaning_en: to curry favor (idiom); playing up to those in power; social climbing

meaning_cn: 旧时迷信说法，谓狗血淋在妖人头上，就可使其妖法失灵◇形容骂得很凶，使被骂者如淋了狗血的妖人一样，无言以对，无计可施。
meaning_en: lit. to pour dog's blood on (idiom); fig. torrent of abuse

meaning_cn: 形容瞒着别人做事，不敢让别人知道。
meaning_en: (idiom) surreptitious; sneaky

meaning_cn: 指同样的事不宜连作三次。
meaning_en: (idiom) a thing should not be attempted more than three times; don't repeat the same mistake again and again; (idiom) bad things don't happen more than three times

meaning_cn: 形容层次、脉络清楚。
meaning_en: (idiom) clear and orderly; neat and tidy

meaning_cn: 恨遗憾；交加一起出现。形容非常懊悔。
meaning_en: to feel remorse and shame (idiom)

meaning_cn: 牛刀宰牛的刀；小试稍微用一下，初显身手。比喻有大本领的人，先在小事情上略展才能。也比喻有能力的人刚开始工作就表现出才。
meaning_en: see 小試牛刀|小试牛刀[xiao3 shi4 niu2 dao1]

meaning_cn: 洞透彻。形容观察事物非常清楚，好象看火一样。
meaning_en: lit. to see sth as clearly as one sees a blazing fire (idiom); fig. to grasp the situation thoroughly

meaning_cn: 雌雄比喻胜负、高下。决一胜负，比个高下。
meaning_en: to have a showdown; to fight for mastery; to compete for a championship

meaning_cn: 用于意想、预料之外。
meaning_en: beyond expectation (idiom); unexpected

meaning_cn: 机灵聪明，办事能力强。
meaning_en: intelligent and capable (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容心境平静，毫无杂念。
meaning_en: to be at peace with oneself

meaning_cn: 某些才智出众的人，看来好象愚笨，不露锋芒。
meaning_en: (idiom) great intelligence may appear to be stupidity

meaning_cn: 泛指旧时鼓吹的道德规范。
meaning_en: compassion, duty, propriety and integrity (idiom); all the traditional virtues; mainly used sarcastically, to mean hypocritical

meaning_cn: 洋洋盛大、众多的样子；洒洒明白、流畅的样子。形容文章或谈话丰富明快，连续不断。
meaning_en: voluminous; flowing (of speeches, articles etc) (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指四方、到处、各地、普天下或方向；亦指到处飘泊，行踪不定。
meaning_en: east west south north

meaning_cn: 用木棒打散一双鸳鸯。比喻拆散恩爱的夫妻或情侣。
meaning_en: (idiom) to cruelly separate lovers (esp. by family or societal pressure); to forcibly break up a couple against their will

meaning_cn: 猜猜疑。男女小时候在一起玩耍，没有猜疑。
meaning_en: innocent playmates

meaning_cn: 仇敌相逢在窄路上。指仇人或不愿意见面的人偏偏相遇。
meaning_en: lit. for enemies, the road is narrow (idiom); fig. rivals inevitably cross paths

meaning_cn: 泛指邻居。
meaning_en: see 左鄰右舍|左邻右舍[zuo3 lin2 you4 she4]

meaning_cn: 指光说不做。也指卖弄口才（含贬义）。
meaning_en: to talk glibly; to talk big; to be all talk

meaning_cn: 缘木爬树。爬到树上去找鱼。比喻方向或办法不对头，不可能达到目的。
meaning_en: lit. climb a tree to catch a fish (idiom); fig. to attempt the impossible

meaning_cn: 释放下；卷指书籍。书本不离手。形容勤奋好学。
meaning_en: lit. always with a book in hand (idiom); fig. (of a student or scholar) diligent and hardworking

meaning_cn: 格打；格杀打死；勿论不论罪。指把拒捕、行凶或违反禁令的人当场打死而不以杀人论罪。
meaning_en: (idiom) to kill on sight (without fear of prosecution)

meaning_cn: 莫逆没有抵触，感情融洽；交交往，友谊。指非常要好的朋友。
meaning_en: intimate friendship; bosom buddies

meaning_cn: 形容人到老年还依然威猛，不减当年。
meaning_en: treasure knife does not age (idiom); old but still vigorous

meaning_cn: 除此之外没有多余的东西。同别无长物”。
meaning_en: nothing else

meaning_cn: 自身性命遭杀害的大祸。
meaning_en: (idiom) getting killed

meaning_cn: 苟且得过且过；偷生苟且地活着。得过且过，勉强活着。
meaning_en: to drift and live without purpose (idiom); to drag out an ignoble existence

meaning_cn: 寥稀疏。稀少得好象早晨的星星。指为数极少。
meaning_en: rare as morning stars (idiom); few and far between; sparse

meaning_cn: 所到之处，没有不顺利的。指处处行得通，办得好。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be successful in every endeavor

meaning_cn: 庸平庸。指平凡无奇。
meaning_en: ordinary; mediocre

meaning_cn: 心意好象猴子跳、马奔跑一样控制不住。形容心里东想西想，安静不下来。
meaning_en: lit. heart like a frisky monkey, mind like a cantering horse (idiom); fig. capricious (derog.); to have ants in one's pants; hyperactive; adventurous and uncontrollable

meaning_cn: 高一声低一声地乱叫乱喊。
meaning_en: to shout and quarrel; to make a big fuss

meaning_cn: 比喻悍妒的妻子对丈夫大吵大闹。
meaning_en: lit. the lioness from Hedong roars (idiom); fig. refers to a shrewish wife or a henpecked husband

meaning_cn: 形容态度傲慢，目中无人的样子。
meaning_en: boldly; ostentatiously; poised; self-assured; Taiwan pr. [da4 mo2 da4 yang4]

meaning_cn: 指不追求名利才能使志趣高洁。
meaning_en: living a simple life as one's ideal (idiom)

meaning_cn: 贯贯穿。正义的精神直上高空，穿过彩虹。形容精神极其崇高，气概极其豪壮。
meaning_en: spirit reaches to the rainbow; full of noble aspiration and daring

meaning_cn: 许多星星聚集、环绕着月亮。比喻众人拥戴一人或众物围绕一物。同众星攒月”。
meaning_en: see 眾星捧月|众星捧月[zhong4 xing1 peng3 yue4]

meaning_cn: 嫁转移。把自己的祸事推给别人。
meaning_en: to pass the misfortune on to sb else (idiom); to blame others; to pass the buck

meaning_cn: 讥笑听话的人不懂对方说得是什么。用以讥笑说话的人不看对象。
meaning_en: lit. to play the lute to a cow (idiom); fig. offering a treat to an unappreciative audience; to cast pearls before swine; caviar to the general; to preach to deaf ears; to talk over sb's head

meaning_cn: 指双方争吵、斗争、比赛等相持不下，难以分开。有时也形容双方关系十分亲密，分不开。
meaning_en: to become caught up in an irresolvable situation (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指经历的时间极久。
meaning_en: see 天荒地老[tian1 huang1 di4 lao3]

meaning_cn: 走跑。形容缝纫技术非常熟练。
meaning_en: flying needle and running seam (idiom); skillful needlework

meaning_cn: 黄粱小米。比喻虚幻不能实现的梦想。
meaning_en: see 黃粱夢|黄粱梦[huang2 liang2 meng4]

meaning_cn: 国家覆灭、家庭毁灭。
meaning_en: the country ruined and the people starving (idiom)

meaning_cn: 累土可以堆成山，比喻积少成多。
meaning_en: lit. piling up dirt eventually creates a mountain (idiom); fig. success is the cumulation of lots of small actions

meaning_cn: 塞边界险要之处；翁老头。比喻一时虽然受到损失，也许反而因此能得到好处。也指坏事在一定条件下可变为好事。
meaning_en: lit. the old man lost his horse, but it all turned out for the best (idiom); fig. a blessing in disguise; it's an ill wind that blows nobody any good

meaning_cn: 惊恐害怕；万状各种样子，表示程度极深。形容害怕到了极点。
meaning_en: convulsed with fear (idiom)

meaning_cn: 勤奋能够弥补不足。
meaning_en: (idiom) hard work can make up for lack of natural talent

meaning_cn: 俱全，都；焚烧。美玉和石头一样烧坏。比喻好坏不分，同归于尽。
meaning_en: to burn both jade and common stone; to destroy indiscriminately (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指来客很多。
meaning_en: guests filled the hall (idiom); a house full of distinguished visitors

meaning_cn: 伐讨伐，攻击。指结帮分派，偏向同伙，打击不同意见的人。
meaning_en: to be narrowly partisan; to unite with those of the same views but alienate those with different views

meaning_cn: 象吃蜡一样，没有一点儿味。形容语言或文章枯燥无味。
meaning_en: lit. tastes as if one is chewing wax (idiom); fig. tasteless; insipid

meaning_cn: 老气老年人的气派；横充满。形容老练而自负的神态。现形容自高自大，摆老资格。也形容缺乏朝气。
meaning_en: old and decrepit; proud of one's age and experience (idiom)

meaning_cn: 文弱文雅而体弱。举目文雅，身体柔弱的读书人。
meaning_en: (idiom) frail scholar

meaning_cn: 形容炮火非常猛烈。
meaning_en: cannon firing for days on end (idiom); enveloped in the flames of war

meaning_cn: 淑善，美。指女子嫁了一个品质不好的丈夫。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be in a relationship with or marry a bad person; (idiom) to associate with a bad person

meaning_cn: 受承受，担待；过过失，过错。替别人承担过错的责任。
meaning_en: to take the blame for sb else; to be made a scapegoat

meaning_cn: 比喻虽然年龄已大或脱离本行已久，但功夫技术并没减退。
meaning_en: lit. a good sword always remains sharp (idiom); fig. (of one's skills etc) to be as good as ever; the old man still has it

meaning_cn: 困在瓮中的甲鱼。比喻已在掌握之中，逃跑不了的东西。
meaning_en: lit. like a turtle in a jar; to be trapped (idiom)

meaning_cn: 铺铺陈；叙叙述。说话或写文章不加修饰，没有起伏，重点不突出。
meaning_en: (idiom) (neutral) to narrate in a plain, unaffected manner; (mildly critical) to recount events in a flat, colorless style

meaning_cn: 鹦鹉学人说话。比喻人家怎么说，他也跟着怎么说。
meaning_en: to parrot; to repeat uncritically what sb says

meaning_cn: 原指轻浮地议论妇女的容貌。现也比喻任意挑剔。
meaning_en: to make idle remarks about a woman's appearance (idiom)

meaning_cn: 金玉黄金和美玉。比喻可贵而有价值的劝告。
meaning_en: gems of wisdom (idiom); priceless advice

meaning_cn: 孔孔子；孟孟子。指儒家学说。
meaning_en: the teaching of Confucius and Mencius

meaning_cn: 刻苦很能吃苦；耐禁得起、受得住。工作勤奋，经得住繁重的劳累。
meaning_en: to bear hardships and work hard (idiom); assiduous and long-suffering; hard-working and capable of overcoming adversity

meaning_cn: 寿命象终南山那样长久。用于祝人长寿。
meaning_en: Live as long as the Zhongnan Mountains! (idiom); Long may you live!

meaning_cn: 青云指青天；直上直线上升。指迅速升到很高的地位。
meaning_en: rising straight up in a clear sky (idiom); rapid promotion to a high post; meteoric career

meaning_cn: 大白天做梦。比喻根本不能实现的梦想。
meaning_en: to daydream; to indulge in wishful thinking

meaning_cn: 服信服。心里嘴上都信服。指真心信服。
meaning_en: see 心服口服[xin1 fu2 kou3 fu2]

meaning_cn: 梁房梁。躲在梁上的君子。窃贼的代称。现在有时也指脱离实际、脱离群众的人。
meaning_en: lit. the gentleman on the roof beam; fig. a thief

meaning_cn: 招招供。旧指没有用刑就招供。比喻做了坏事或有坏的意图自我暴露出来。
meaning_en: to confess without being pressed; to make a confession without duress

meaning_cn: 造制作；设安排。指事物自然形成，合乎理想，不必再加人工。
meaning_en: lit. made by Heaven and arranged by Earth(idiom); ideal; perfect; (of a match) made in heaven; to be made for one another

meaning_cn: 雪洗刷掉。报冤仇，除仇恨。
meaning_en: to take revenge and wipe out a grudge (idiom)

meaning_cn: 锐锐气；当抵挡。形容勇往直前的气势，不可抵挡。
meaning_en: unstoppable; hard to hold back

meaning_cn: 交共。悲伤和喜悦的心情交织在一起。
meaning_en: mixed feelings of grief and joy

meaning_cn: 重新来到曾经居住过或游览过的地方。
meaning_en: (idiom) to return to a place after a long time away

meaning_cn: 佛教指阿弥陀佛居住的地方◇泛指幸福安乐的地方。
meaning_en: paradise (mainly Buddhist); Elysium; (Budd.) Sukhavati

meaning_cn: 旦夕早晚之间，形容极短的时间。生命垂危，很快会死去。
meaning_en: to be at death's door (idiom)

meaning_cn: 神速特别迅速。用兵贵在行动特别迅速。
meaning_en: lit. speed is a crucial asset in war (idiom); fig. swift and resolute (in doing sth)

meaning_cn: 行动笨拙的鸟要先飞。比喻能力差的人怕落后，做事比别人先动手。
meaning_en: lit. the clumsy bird flies early (idiom); fig. to work hard to compensate for one's limited abilities

meaning_cn: 逢相遇。下棋遇到对手。比喻争斗的双方本领不相上下。
meaning_en: to be evenly matched; to meet one's match

meaning_cn: 形容闹得很凶。
meaning_en: terribly; awfully; desperately

meaning_cn: 态度傲慢，对人不讲礼节。
meaning_en: (idiom) arrogant; disrespectful

meaning_cn: 听起来不舒服的话（多指尖锐、中肯的劝告或批评）。
meaning_en: speech that grates on the ear (idiom); bitter truths; home truths (that one does not want to hear)

meaning_cn: 壁立峭壁陡立。形容岩石高耸。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a cliff, mountain etc) steep; lofty; imposing

meaning_cn: 郎旧指女子对丈夫或情人的称呼。男的有才气，女的有美貌。形容男女双方很相配。
meaning_en: talented man and beautiful woman; ideal couple

meaning_cn: 形容中年妇女仍然保留着优美的风姿。
meaning_en: (of an aging woman) still attractive

meaning_cn: 单刀一把刀，指一个人。原指蜀将关羽只带一口刀和少数随从赴东吴宴会◇泛指一个人冒险赴约。有赞扬赴会者的智略和胆识之意。
meaning_en: lit. to go among enemies with only one's sword (idiom); fig. to go alone into enemy lines

meaning_cn: 表外。出乎人们意料之外。
meaning_en: to exceed all expectations; to come as a surprise

meaning_cn: 诛惩罚。指不问罪行，只根据其用心以认定罪状。也指揭穿动机的评论。
meaning_en: a devastating criticism; to expose hidden motives

meaning_cn: 流年旧时算命看相的人称一年中所行之运”；利吉利。指人长年里处于不吉利的状态。谓时运不佳。
meaning_en: the year's horoscope augurs ill (idiom); an unlucky year

meaning_cn: 形容贪恋淫欲胆量很大。
meaning_en: outrageously bold in one's lust; debauched (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容特别有精神。
meaning_en: lit. vitality a hundredfold (idiom); refreshed; one's vigor thoroughly restored

meaning_cn: 从古到今无所不谈，无不评论。
meaning_en: to talk of the past and discuss the present (idiom); to chat freely; to discuss everything

meaning_cn: 呜呼叹词，古代祭文末多有此词，后即以此为死亡的代称。指人死亡。
meaning_en: to die (idiom); to breathe one's last; to give up the ghost

meaning_cn: 逐追赶；鹿指所要围捕的对象，常比喻帝位、政权。指群雄并起，争夺天下。
meaning_en: lit. hunting deer in the Central Plain (idiom); fig. to attempt to seize the throne

meaning_cn: 林林众多的样子；总总众多而杂乱的样子。形容众多。
meaning_en: in great abundance; numerous

meaning_cn: 病久了对医理就熟悉了。比喻对某方面的事见识多了就能成为这方面的行家。
meaning_en: (proverb) a long illness makes the patient into a doctor

meaning_cn: 继承前代的，启发后代的。
meaning_en: see 承前啟後|承前启后[cheng2 qian2 qi3 hou4]

meaning_cn: 凄风寒冷的风；苦雨久下成灾的雨。形容天气恶劣◇用来比喻境遇悲惨凄凉。
meaning_en: lit. bleak wind and icy rain (idiom); fig. hardships; miserable circumstances

meaning_cn: 芙蓉荷花。刚开放的荷花。比喻诗文清新不俗。也形容天然艳丽的女子。
meaning_en: as a lotus flower breaking the surface (idiom); surpassingly beautiful (of young lady's face or old gentleman's calligraphy)

meaning_cn: 将用。用功劳来补偿过错。
meaning_en: to make up for one's faults by doing good deeds (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容年纪很大。
meaning_en: in one's seventies (age); very old (of people)

meaning_cn: 形容书法生动而有气势。
meaning_en: (lit.) the brush flows with the fluidity of a dragon or snake (idiom); (fig.) (of brushwork, esp for calligraphy) lively; vigorous

meaning_cn: 篇幅很长，内容很多。
meaning_en: (of a text) very lengthy (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指对情况了解不清楚，心里没有底。
meaning_en: to have no idea; to be unsure

meaning_cn: 心怀民心，存心；叵不可。指存心险恶，不可推测。
meaning_en: see 居心叵測|居心叵测[ju1 xin1 po3 ce4]

meaning_cn: 指雄鹰振翅飞翔于辽阔的天空。亦比喻有雄心壮志的人在广阔的领域中施展自己的才能。
meaning_en: the eagle soars in the sky (citation from Mao Zedong)

meaning_cn: 人和钱财都无着落或都有损失。同人财两空”。
meaning_en: see 人財兩空|人财两空[ren2 cai2 liang3 kong1]

meaning_cn: 只见过一面的交情。比喻交情很浅。
meaning_en: to have met once; casual acquaintance

meaning_cn: 形容以零零碎碎、断断续续的办法做事。
meaning_en: to do things in bits and pieces (idiom); piecemeal work

meaning_cn: 不主动及时行动而失去好机会。
meaning_en: to sit and waste a good opportunity (idiom); to lose the chance

meaning_cn: 谏直言规劝。听从规劝像流水一样自然。形容乐于接受别人的批评意见。
meaning_en: to follow admonition as natural flow (idiom); to accept criticism or correction (even from one's inferiors)

meaning_cn: 销熔武器以制造务农器具。
meaning_en: (idiom) to beat swords into plowshares; to turn from war to peace

meaning_cn: 形容厚着脸皮，胡搅蛮缠。
meaning_en: brazen faced (idiom); shameless

meaning_cn: 胼、胝老茧。手脚上磨出老茧。形容经常地辛勤劳动。
meaning_en: lit. with calluses on hands and feet (idiom); fig. to work one's fingers to the bone

meaning_cn: 旧时比喻美女的眼睛象秋天明净的水波一样。指暗中眉目传情。
meaning_en: to cast flirtatious glances at sb (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻对子女的慈爱。
meaning_en: lit. the cow licking its calf fondly (idiom); fig. to show deep affection towards one's children

meaning_cn: 形容没有拖累，非常放心。
meaning_en: (idiom) unburdened by obligations or attachments; carefree

meaning_cn: 形容十分真挚诚恳。
meaning_en: earnestly and sincerely (idiom); with all sincerity

meaning_cn: 坚守节操，决不改变。
meaning_en: unyielding integrity (idiom); unwavering

meaning_cn: 决不推辞（多用在冒险犯难）。
meaning_en: not to refuse to (idiom); not to hesitate to

meaning_cn: 一心为利，别的什么都不顾。
meaning_en: variant of 唯利是圖|唯利是图[wei2 li4 shi4 tu2]

meaning_cn: ①正经的，严肃认真的。②犹名副其实。
meaning_en: very serious; solemn

meaning_cn: 好药往往味苦难吃。比喻衷心的劝告，尖锐的批评，听起来觉得不舒服，但对改正缺点错误很有好处。
meaning_en: good medicine tastes bitter (idiom); fig. frank criticism is hard to swallow

meaning_cn: 睁圆了眼睛瞪视着。形容正要大发脾气的神情。
meaning_en: (idiom) to glare at

meaning_cn: 图谋取。为了劫夺财物，害人性命。
meaning_en: see 謀財害命|谋财害命[mou2 cai2 hai4 ming4]

meaning_cn: 庄严地说出表示决心的话或对某事提出保证。
meaning_en: to vow

meaning_cn: 峦连绵的山。山峰一个连着一个，连绵不断。
meaning_en: range upon range of mountains (idiom)

meaning_cn: 越抢劫ˇ人性命，抢人东西。指盗匪的行为。
meaning_en: to kill sb for his property (idiom); to murder for money

meaning_cn: 运用智谋，凭借他人的人力或财力来达到自己的目的。
meaning_en: lit. using straw boats to borrow arrows (idiom, from 三國演義|三国演义[San1 guo2 Yan3 yi4]); fig. to use others' manpower and resources for one's own ends

meaning_cn: 通通晓；博广博，知道得多。对古代的事知道得很多，并且通晓现代的事情。形容知识丰富。
meaning_en: conversant with things past and present; erudite and informed

meaning_cn: 心神不宁的样子。指因心虛或忧虑而不能安心。
meaning_en: (idiom) anxious; uneasy; filled with trepidation

meaning_cn: 旧指看透人生，把生死哀乐都不放在心上的消极的生活态度。现也指受挫折后消极回避、无所作为的生活态度。
meaning_en: (idiom) to see through the illusions of the material world (often a precursor to becoming a Buddhist monk or nun); to become disillusioned with human society

meaning_cn: 象沾着雨点的梨花一样。原形容杨贵妃哭泣时的姿态◇用以形容女子的娇美。
meaning_en: lit. like raindrops on a pear blossom (idiom); fig. tear-stained face of a beauty

meaning_cn: 男女亲昵欢爱之词。
meaning_en: passionate love (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指奔走四方，在外谋生。
meaning_en: to travel around the country

meaning_cn: 形容路途艰辛。
meaning_en: to climb mountains and wade rivers (idiom); fig. to make a long and difficult journey

meaning_cn: 名占有。一个钱都没有。形容非常贫困。
meaning_en: to be penniless

meaning_cn: 苛苛刻、繁重；杂繁杂。指反动统治下苛刻繁重的捐税。
meaning_en: exorbitant taxation (idiom)

meaning_cn: 心里乱得象一团乱麻。形容心里非常烦乱。
meaning_en: one's thoughts in a whirl (idiom); confused; disconcerted; upset

meaning_cn: 喷薄涌起，上升的样子；欲将要。形容水涌起或太阳初升时涌上地平线的样子。
meaning_en: to be on the verge of eruption (idiom); (of the sun) to emerge in all its brilliance

meaning_cn: 比喻积少成多。
meaning_en: see 聚沙成塔[ju4 sha1 cheng2 ta3]

meaning_cn: 眼睛不偷看旁边。比喻为人行止端方。也形容只朝一个方向看。
meaning_en: not to glance sideways (idiom); to gaze fixedly; to be fully concentrated; to preserve a correct attitude

meaning_cn: 极言小心谨慎，考虑周密。亦作心细于发”。
meaning_en: (idiom) meticulous; very careful or attentive

meaning_cn: 形容十分杂乱。
meaning_en: everything in disorder (idiom); in a hideous mess; obscene; dirty; filthy

meaning_cn: 足赤成色十足的金子。比喻人也不能十全十美。
meaning_en: not all gold is sufficiently red (idiom); no-one is perfect

meaning_cn: 钟凝聚，集中；毓养育。凝聚了天地间的灵气，孕育着优秀的人物。指山川秀美，人才辈出。
meaning_en: (of a place) endowed with a natural beauty that nurtures people of talent (idiom)

meaning_cn: 八两即半斤。一个半斤，一个八两。比喻彼此一样，不相上下。
meaning_en: not much to choose between the two; tweedledum and tweedledee

meaning_cn: 土豪乡里的豪强，即仗势欺人的地主。劣绅地方上的恶霸或退职官僚中的恶劣者。旧社会有钱有势、横行乡里的人。
meaning_en: local bosses, shady gentry (idiom); dominant local mafia

meaning_cn: 跳梁腾跃跳动；小丑对人的卑称。比喻猖狂捣乱而成不了大气候的坏人。
meaning_en: (idiom) clownish troublemaker; contemptible buffoon

meaning_cn: 略大致；斑斑点或斑纹。比喻大致看到一些情况，但不够全面。
meaning_en: lit. to glimpse just one spot (of the leopard) (idiom); fig. to get an inkling of the whole picture

meaning_cn: 形容一片黑暗，没有一点光明。也形容对事情一无所知。
meaning_en: pitch-dark; (fig.) completely in the dark; totally ignorant of; (fig.) grim; beyond salvation

meaning_cn: 毛举动轻率。做事粗心，不细致。
meaning_en: carelessly and haphazardly; to paw; to grope; to get fresh

meaning_cn: 惹引；身本身。引火烧自己。比喻自找麻烦或自找苦吃。
meaning_en: stir up the fire and you get burnt (idiom); to get one's fingers burnt; fig. to suffer on account of one's own meddling

meaning_cn: 喜欢当别人的教师。形容不谦虚，自以为是，爱摆老资格。
meaning_en: to like to lecture others (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻器量狭小，只考虑小事，不照顾大局。
meaning_en: lit. small belly, chicken's gut (idiom); narrow-minded; petty

meaning_cn: 乐于向学问或地位比自己低的人学习，而不觉得不好意思。
meaning_en: not feel ashamed to ask and learn from one's subordinates

meaning_cn: 境境况；迁改变。事情已经过去，情况也变了。
meaning_en: The issue is in the past, and the situation has changed (idiom).; It is water under the bridge.

meaning_cn: 太阳快要落山。比喻人到老年将死或事物接近衰亡。
meaning_en: the sun sets over western hills (idiom); the day approaches its end; fig. time of decline; the end of an era; Sic transit gloria mundi

meaning_cn: 佛家语，认为大众营营扰扰，如溺海中，佛以慈悲为怀，施宏大法力，尽力救济他们以便登上彼岸。
meaning_en: (Buddhism) to deliver all living creatures from suffering (idiom)

meaning_cn: 洗干净耳朵恭恭敬敬听别人讲话。请人讲话时的客气话。指专心地听。
meaning_en: to listen with respectful attention; (a polite request to sb to speak); we are all ears

meaning_cn: 样子完全改变，有了崭新的面貌。
meaning_en: complete change (idiom); facelift; We're in a wholly new situation.

meaning_cn: 指文章的风格同作者的性格特点相似。
meaning_en: the writing style mirrors the writer (idiom)

meaning_cn: 顾看；怜怜惜。回头看看自己的影子，怜惜起自己来。形容孤独失意的样子，也指自我欣赏。
meaning_en: lit. looking at one's shadow and feeling sorry for oneself (idiom); fig. alone and dejected

meaning_cn: 对着酒应该放声高唱。原意是人生时间有限，应该有所作为◇也用来指及时行乐。
meaning_en: lit. sing to accompany wine (idiom); fig. life is short, make merry while you can

meaning_cn: 节节制；变事变。抑制哀伤，顺应变故。用来慰唁死者家属的话。
meaning_en: (idiom) restrain one's grief and accept what has happened (expression of condolence)

meaning_cn: 正义之气直上高空。形容为正义而斗争的精神极其崇高。
meaning_en: supremely honorable and righteous

meaning_cn: 三皇伏羲、神农、黄帝；五帝少昊、颛顼、帝喾、尧、舜。原为传说中我国远古的部落酋长◇借指远古时代。
meaning_en: three sovereigns 三皇[san1 huang2] and five emperors 五帝[wu3 di4] of myth and legend; the earliest system of Chinese historiography

meaning_cn: 闲无拘束。飘浮的云，野生的鹤。旧指生活闲散、脱离世事的人。
meaning_en: (idiom) free spirit; person who leads a carefree, unfettered life

meaning_cn: 把手洗干净休息了。
meaning_en: to totally stop doing something; to reform one's ways

meaning_cn: 中医用狗皮膏药消肿止痛。比喻骗人的货色。
meaning_en: dogskin plaster, used in TCM for treating contusions, rheumatism etc; quack medicine; sham goods

meaning_cn: 指颜色浓艳。
meaning_en: bright-colored; garish

meaning_cn: 在小处精打细算，斤斤计较。
meaning_en: lit. to count on a narrow abacus (idiom); petty and scheming selfishly; concerned with petty interests; selfish and uncaring of the interests of others; bean counter

meaning_cn: 分别时赠送的一些勉励的话。
meaning_en: words of advice on parting

meaning_cn: 指有名无实。
meaning_en: with an undeserved reputation (idiom); unwarranted fame; nowhere near as good as he's made out to be

meaning_cn: 保持原样，不加变动。
meaning_en: see 原封不動|原封不动[yuan2 feng1 bu4 dong4]

meaning_cn: 天府天生的仓库；国地区。原指土地肥沃、物产丰富的地区◇专指四川。
meaning_en: (idiom) land of plenty (usu. used in reference to Sichuan)

meaning_cn: 形容态度怪癖，冷言冷语，不可捉摸。
meaning_en: eccentric; peculiar; mystifying

meaning_cn: 指孝顺父母，尊敬兄长，忠于君主，取信于朋友的封建社会的应具备的道德标准。
meaning_en: Confucian moral injunctions of fidelity; piety to one's parents, respect to one's older brother, loyalty to one's monarch, faith to one's male friends

meaning_cn: 指求名利的最近便是门路。也比喻达到目的的便捷途径。
meaning_en: lit. the Mount Zhongnan shortcut (idiom); fig. shortcut to a high-flying career; easy route to success (an allusion to the Tang Dynasty story of 盧藏用|卢藏用[Lu2 Cang4 yong4], who lived like a hermit on Mt. Zhongnan in order to gain a reputation for wisdom, which he then used to gain a position in the Imperial Court)

meaning_cn: 形容极大。同硕大无朋”。
meaning_en: (idiom) very big; huge

meaning_cn: 马革马皮。用马皮把尸体裹起来。指英勇牺牲在战场。
meaning_en: to be buried in a horse hide (idiom); to give one's life on the battlefield

meaning_cn: 远远望见对方的气势很盛，就吓得逃跑了。形容十分怯敌。
meaning_en: to flee at the mere sight of (idiom)

meaning_cn: 悄然寂静无声的样子。静悄悄的，听不到一点声音。
meaning_en: absolutely quiet

meaning_cn: 君主时代功臣的妻得到封赠，子孙世袭官爵。旧时指为官的荣耀。
meaning_en: (idiom) to bestow a title on the wife of a deserving official and make his son heir to his titles

meaning_cn: 僵枯死。李树代替桃树而死。原比喻兄弟互相爱护互相帮助◇转用来比喻互相顶替或代人受过。
meaning_en: lit. the plum tree withers in place of the peach tree; to substitute one thing for another; to carry the can for sb

meaning_cn: 原指佛教徒修行时，排除物欲，保持心地洁净。现泛指丝毫不受坏习惯，坏风气的影响。也用来形容非常清洁、干净。
meaning_en: see 一塵不染|一尘不染[yi1 chen2 bu4 ran3]

meaning_cn: 堂高大的厅堂。金玉财宝满堂。形容财富极多。也形容学识丰富。
meaning_en: lit. gold and jade fill the hall (idiom); fig. abundant wealth; abundance of knowledge

meaning_cn: 时间长，日子久。
meaning_en: see 天長地久|天长地久[tian1 chang2 di4 jiu3]

meaning_cn: 指历代祖先。
meaning_en: (idiom) one's ancestors through the generations

meaning_cn: 雕雕刻；虫指鸟虫书，古代汉字的一种字体。比喻小技或微不足道的技能。
meaning_en: insignificant talent; skill of no high order; minor accomplishment

meaning_cn: 叩磕头。最敬重的礼节。
meaning_en: to kneel three times and kowtow nine times (formal etiquette on meeting the emperor)

meaning_cn: 自以为了不起而显示出来的得意和傲慢的样子。
meaning_en: arrogant appearance; smug appearance; to act condescending; to put on airs

meaning_cn: 古代神怪小说里海龙王手下的兵将。比喻敌人的爪牙或不中用的大小娄罗。
meaning_en: shrimp soldiers and crab generals (in mythology or popular fiction, the army of the Dragon King of the Eastern Sea); useless troops (idiom)

meaning_cn: 神通原为佛家语，指无所不能的力量◇指特别高超的本领。形容充分显示出高明的本领。
meaning_en: to display one's remarkable skill or prowess; to give full play to one's brilliant abilities

meaning_cn: 躬自身；问检查。回过头来检查自己的言行得失。
meaning_en: introspection; to ask oneself

meaning_cn: 不考虑整个局面或形势。
meaning_en: to give no consideration to the bigger picture (usually implying selfishness)

meaning_cn: 话里含有别的意思。
meaning_en: one's words carry an implicit meaning

meaning_cn: 坚壁坚固壁垒；清野清除郊野。对付强敌入入侵的一种方法。使敌人既攻不下据点，又抢不到物资。
meaning_en: to fortify defenses and raze the fields (idiom); to leave nothing for the invader; scorched earth policy

meaning_cn: 再三再四地嘱咐。表示对嘱咐的事情极重视。
meaning_en: repeatedly urging; imploring over and over again

meaning_cn: 精卫古代神话中的鸟名。精卫衔来木石，决心填平大海。旧时比喻仇恨极深，立志报复◇比喻意志坚决，不畏艰难。
meaning_en: lit. mythical bird Jingwei tries to fill the ocean with stones (idiom); futile ambition; task of Sisyphus; determination in the face of impossible odds

meaning_cn: 人言别人的评论，指流言蜚语；畏怕。指在背后的议论或诬蔑的话很可怕。
meaning_en: gossip is a fearful thing (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容说话絮叨，琐谈不休。
meaning_en: (idiom) talking endlessly; long-winded

meaning_cn: 鬓鬓发；厮互相；磨擦。耳与鬓发互相摩擦。形容相处亲密。
meaning_en: lit. to play together ear to ear and temple to temple (idiom); fig. (of a boy and a girl) to play together often during childhood

meaning_cn: 比喻形势非常危险，如同堆起来的蛋，随时都有塌下打碎的可能。
meaning_en: precarious as pile of eggs (idiom); ready to fall and break at any moment; in a dangerous state

meaning_cn: 正合自己的心意。
meaning_en: exactly what one wants

meaning_cn: 形容大声哭叫，声音凄厉。
meaning_en: (idiom) to wail and scream loudly

meaning_cn: 形容菜肴水太多，粗糙没有味道。
meaning_en: meager fare; (fig.) insipid; colorless

meaning_cn: 巧言花言巧语；令色讨好的表情。形容花言巧语，虚伪讨好。
meaning_en: to be glib in one's speech and wear an ingratiating expression (idiom)

meaning_cn: 负背着；荆荆条。背着荆条向对方请罪。表示向人认错赔罪。
meaning_en: lit. to bring a bramble and ask for punishment (idiom); fig. to offer sb a humble apology

meaning_cn: 靡靡柔弱，萎靡不振。使人萎靡不振的音乐。指颓废的、低级趣味的乐曲。
meaning_en: (idiom) decadent music

meaning_cn: 原指战国时齐军用围攻魏国的方法，迫使魏国撤回攻赵部队而使赵国得救◇指袭击敌人后方的据点以迫使进攻之敌撤退的战术。
meaning_en: lit. to besiege 魏[Wei4] and rescue 趙|赵[Zhao4] (idiom); fig. to relieve a besieged ally by attacking the home base of the besiegers

meaning_cn: 看书时同时可以看十行。形容看书非常快。
meaning_en: ten lines at a glance (idiom); to read very rapidly

meaning_cn: 指为建立新的国家或朝代立下汗马功劳的人。
meaning_en: outstanding founding minister (title given to reward loyal general or vassal of new dynasty or state)

meaning_cn: 披披露；沥往下滴。比喻真心相见，倾吐心里话。也形容非常忠诚。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be completely honest and sincere; to show wholehearted loyalty

meaning_cn: 震震动；动摇动。震动了天地。形容声音或声势极大。
meaning_en: to shake heaven and earth (idiom)

meaning_cn: 假借公事报私人的仇恨。
meaning_en: to use public office to avenge private wrongs

meaning_cn: 父指父母；子子女。父母对子女慈爱，子女对父母孝顺。
meaning_en: benevolent father, filial son (idiom); natural love between parents and children

meaning_cn: 引拉弓；发射箭。拉开弓却不把箭射出去。比喻善于启发引导。也比喻做好准备暂不行动，以待时机。
meaning_en: to pull the bow without shooting (idiom from Mencius); ready and waiting for action; to go through the motions; to practice; a trial run

meaning_cn: 奉信奉；神明神。崇拜得象迷信者敬神那样。形容对某些人或事物的盲目尊重。
meaning_en: to honor sb as a God (idiom); to revere; to worship; to deify; to make a holy cow of sth; to put sb on a pedestal

meaning_cn: 结舌舌头不能转动。张着嘴说不出话来。形容理屈词穷，或因紧张害怕而发愣。
meaning_en: agape and tongue-tied (idiom); at a loss for words; gaping and speechless

meaning_cn: 指事情遭受挫折后，再从头做起。
meaning_en: to start over from scratch (idiom)

meaning_cn: 畏途可怕的道路。看成可怕的、危险的道路。也比喻看成困难的、可怕的事情。
meaning_en: to view as dangerous (idiom); afraid to do sth

meaning_cn: 徒弟和再传的徒弟。比喻一脉相传的人（含贬意）。
meaning_en: (idiom) disciples; followers

meaning_cn: 首鼠鼠性多疑，出洞时一进一退，不能自决；两端拿不定主意。在两者之间犹豫不决右动摇不定。
meaning_en: (idiom) to hesitate; to remain undecided

meaning_cn: 保持节操，象玉一样洁白无瑕。也泛指爱护自己的身体。
meaning_en: to keep oneself pure; to preserve one's integrity; to remain chaste

meaning_cn: 形容房屋倒塌残破的景象。
meaning_en: see 斷壁殘垣|断壁残垣[duan4 bi4 can2 yuan2]

meaning_cn: 形容不平凡的年月。
meaning_en: eventful years; momentous times

meaning_cn: 能弯曲也能伸直。指人在失意时能忍耐，在得志时能大干一番。
meaning_en: can bow and submit, or can stand tall (idiom, from Book of Changes); ready to give and take; flexible

meaning_cn: 喑哑。所有的马都沉寂无声。旧时形容人民不敢讲话。现也比喻沉闷的政治局面。
meaning_en: thousands of horses, all mute (idiom); no-one dares to speak out; an atmosphere of political oppression

meaning_cn: 逢遇到。枯干的树遇到了春天，又恢复了活力。比喻垂危的病人或事物重新获得生机。
meaning_en: lit. the spring comes upon a withered tree (idiom); fig. to get a new lease on life; to be revived; (of a difficult situation) to suddenly improve

meaning_cn: 佛家语，禅宗认为人皆有佛性，弃恶从善，即可成佛。此为劝善之语。
meaning_en: to become a Buddha on the spot (idiom); instant rehabilitation; to repent and be absolved of one's crimes

meaning_cn: 游移犹豫。犹豫不决，拿不定主意。
meaning_en: to oscillate without pause (idiom); to fluctuate; (of thoughts) to wander; to waver

meaning_cn: 象狼和虎一样凶狠。比喻非常凶暴残忍。
meaning_en: lit. like wolves and tigers; ruthless

meaning_cn: 要说的话很多，一时不能说清，只用扼要的几句话表明主要意思。
meaning_en: (idiom) to make a long story short; to keep it brief

meaning_cn: 指穿着各种漂亮服装的青年男女。
meaning_en: young people decked out in gorgeous clothes (idiom)

meaning_cn: 铄熔化。形容舆论力量大，连金属都能熔化。比喻众口一词可以混淆是非。
meaning_en: lit. public opinion is powerful enough to melt metal (idiom); fig. public clamor can obscure the actual truth; mass spreading of rumors can confuse right and wrong

meaning_cn: 积习长期形成的旧习惯。长期形成的旧习惯很难更改。
meaning_en: old habits are hard to change (idiom)

meaning_cn: 擎托起。一根柱托住天。比喻人能担当天下重任。
meaning_en: lit. to support the sky as a single pillar (idiom); fig. to take a crucial responsibility upon one's shoulders

meaning_cn: 话说多了一定有失误。
meaning_en: if you say too much, you're bound to slip up at some point (idiom)

meaning_cn: 湮埋没；无闻没有知道。名声被埋没，没人知道。
meaning_en: to pass into oblivion

meaning_cn: 当阻挡。螳螂举起前肢企图阻挡车子前进。比喻做力量做不到的事情，必然失败。
meaning_en: (lit.) a mantis trying to stop a chariot (idiom); (fig.) to overrate oneself and attempt sth impossible

meaning_cn: 猎打猎。看到打猎心里就高举。比喻看见别人在做的事正是自己过去所喜好的，不由得心动，也想试一试。
meaning_en: lit. seeing others go hunting, one is excited by memories of the thrill of the hunt (idiom); fig. seeing others do what one loves to do, one is inspired to try it again

meaning_cn: 剐割肉离骨。一刀一刀将罪犯身上的肉割下处死。形容罪恶重大，死也不能抵罪。
meaning_en: (idiom) to hack (sb) to pieces (punishment in former times)

meaning_cn: 福气象东海那样大。旧时祝颂语。
meaning_en: may your happiness be as immense as the East Sea (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原意是指善于打仗的就有取胜的把握，不会落到挫败的境地◇泛指办事有成功的充分把握。
meaning_en: (idiom) invincible position

meaning_cn: 老成阅历多而练达世事；持重做事谨慎。办事老练稳重，不轻举妄动。
meaning_en: old and wise; experienced and knowledgeable

meaning_cn: 乱冲乱撞，蛮横无理。同横冲直撞”。
meaning_en: see 橫衝直撞|横冲直撞[heng2 chong1 zhi2 zhuang4]

meaning_cn: 以原因。不明白为什么是这样。指不知道原因。
meaning_en: (idiom) to not know the reason; (idiom) to not know what to do

meaning_cn: 放在一边不再想起。
meaning_en: to banish from one's thoughts; to ignore; to take no notice

meaning_cn: 通通晓。一个主要的弄通了，其他的自然也都会弄通。
meaning_en: grasp this fundamental point and all the rest will follow (idiom)

meaning_cn: 旧时人们常用的小名。引申为任何轻贱的，不值得重视的人或著作。
meaning_en: (idiom) (coll.) any Tom, Dick or Harry; just about anyone (used dismissively)

meaning_cn: 听到鸡叫就起来舞剑◇比喻有志报国的人及时奋起。
meaning_en: to start practicing at the first crow of the cock (idiom); to be diligent in one's studies

meaning_cn: 敝破的，坏的；珍爱惜。把自己家里的破扫帚当成宝贝。比喻东西虽然不好，自己却很珍惜。
meaning_en: to value the broom as one's own (idiom); to attach value to sth because it is one's own; a sentimental attachment

meaning_cn: 色神色，样子；厉凶猛；荏软弱。外表强更，内心虚弱。
meaning_en: lit. show strength while weak inside (idiom); appearing fierce while cowardly at heart; a sheep in wolf's clothing

meaning_cn: 燎烧。被火烧烤。比喻心里非常着急或身上热得难受。
meaning_en: restless with anxiety; to feel unbearably painful or hot

meaning_cn: 指拥有大量钱财的商人。同富商大贾”。
meaning_en: (idiom) tycoon; magnate

meaning_cn: 不加约束，任它自由发展。
meaning_en: laissez-faire

meaning_cn: 临到；境境界，地方。亲自到了那个地方。
meaning_en: to travel to a place personally (idiom)

meaning_cn: 曲意违背自己的意愿去曲从别人；逢迎迎合。想方设法奉承讨好别人。
meaning_en: to bow down to everything sb says or does; to act submissively in order to ingratiate oneself

meaning_cn: 把简单的设备或技术同现代化的设备或技术结合起来。
meaning_en: combining native and foreign methods (idiom); sophisticated and many-sided

meaning_cn: 案古时有脚的托盘。送饭时把托盘举得跟眉毛一样高◇形容夫妻互相尊敬。
meaning_en: lit. to lift the tray to eyebrow level (idiom); mutual respect in a marriage

meaning_cn: 泛指封建社会中位尊、禄厚、权重、势大的贵族。
meaning_en: (lit.) kings, nobles, generals and ministers (idiom); (fig.) people of the highest rank and status; the ruling elite

meaning_cn: 盔、甲头盔和铠甲。跑得连盔甲都丢了。形容打败仗后逃跑的狼狈相。
meaning_en: (idiom) to throw away one's helmet and armor while fleeing from defeat

meaning_cn: 威武权势，武力；屈屈服。强暴的压力不能使之屈服。表示坚贞顽强。
meaning_en: not to submit to force

meaning_cn: 反目翻眼相看，不和睦。指夫妻不和、吵架。
meaning_en: man and wife fall out (idiom, from Book of Changes); marital strife

meaning_cn: 形容罪恶极大。
meaning_en: heinous crime

meaning_cn: 离开黑暗，投向光明。比喻在政治上脱离反动阵营，投向进步方面。
meaning_en: to renounce the dark and seek the light; to give up one's wrong way of life and turn to a better one

meaning_cn: 没有不干的事情。指什么坏事都干。
meaning_en: not stopping at anything; all manner of evil

meaning_cn: 狼子狼崽子。狼崽子虽幼，却有凶恶的本性。比喻凶暴的人居心狠毒，习性难改。
meaning_en: ambition of wild wolves (idiom); rapacious designs

meaning_cn: 茹吃。用来描绘原始人不会用火，连毛带血地生吃禽兽的生活。
meaning_en: devour raw meat and fowl (of savages)

meaning_cn: 六十岁时听别人言语便可判断是非真假。指60岁的代称。
meaning_en: (idiom) 60 years old

meaning_cn: 高兴得象麻雀一样跳跃。形容非常欢乐。
meaning_en: cheering excitedly (idiom); jubilant

meaning_cn: 比喻绞尽脑汁，苦思苦想。
meaning_en: to search one's guts and belly (idiom); to racks one's brains for a solution

meaning_cn: 用笑一笑来回答。比喻不计较，不当一回事。
meaning_en: (idiom) to dismiss sth with a laugh; to laugh it off

meaning_cn: 形容旅途辛苦。
meaning_en: to live an exhausting journey

meaning_cn: 按照自己的意思，想怎样便怎样。
meaning_en: whatever you like; to do as one pleases

meaning_cn: 分分离；舍放下。形容感情很好，不愿分开。亦作难舍难分。”。
meaning_en: loath to part (idiom); emotionally close and unwilling to separate

meaning_cn: 指非经正式途径传播的消息。往往传闻失实，并不可靠。
meaning_en: hearsay; gossip

meaning_cn: 原为古代传说中的鬼怪。指各种各样的坏人。
meaning_en: (idiom) all kinds of malevolent or mischievous spirits

meaning_cn: 霸占一个地方（多指坏人）。
meaning_en: to exercise sole hegemony (idiom); to dominate a whole area (market, resources etc); to hold as one's personal fiefdom

meaning_cn: 隐忍勉强忍耐，把事情藏在心里。把事情藏在心里不说。
meaning_en: to keep one's emotions inside oneself; to restrain one's emotions

meaning_cn: 四大古印度称地、水、火风为四大”。佛教用语。指世界上一切都是空虚的。是一种消极思想。
meaning_en: lit. the four elements are vanity (idiom); this world is an illusion

meaning_cn: 椟木匣；珠珍珠。买下木匣，退还了珍珠。比喻没有眼力，取舍不当。
meaning_en: to buy a wooden box and return the pearls inside; to show poor judgment (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容事物零碎细小，不成系统。
meaning_en: in pieces

meaning_cn: 比喻杰出的写作才能。
meaning_en: beautiful or talented writing

meaning_cn: 增损一字，赏予千金。称赞文辞精妙，不可更改。
meaning_en: one word worth a thousand in gold (idiom); (in praise of a piece of writing or calligraphy) each character is perfect; each word is highly valued

meaning_cn: 象形体和它的影子那样分不开。形容彼此关系亲密，经常在一起。
meaning_en: (lit.) body and shadow follow each other (idiom); (fig.) inseparable

meaning_cn: 移改变。本质难于改变。
meaning_en: It is hard to change one's essential nature (idiom). You can't change who you are.; Can the leopard change his spots? (Jeremiah 13:23)

meaning_cn: 挥挥笔；就成功。一动笔就写成了。形容写字、写文章、画画快。
meaning_en: to finish (a letter, a painting) at a stroke

meaning_cn: 闭上眼睛不看，堵住耳朵不听。形容对外界事物不闻不问。
meaning_en: to shut one's eyes and stop one's ears; out of touch with reality; to bury one's head in the sand

meaning_cn: 垂将，快要；暮晚，老年。快要到老年。
meaning_en: old age

meaning_cn: 拾捡取；牙慧指别人说过的话。比喻拾取别人的一言半语当作自己的话。
meaning_en: to pick up what others say (idiom); to pass off other people's opinions as one's own; to parrot

meaning_cn: 三纲指君为臣纲，父为子纲，夫为妻纲；五常指仁、义、礼、智、信。封建礼教提倡的人与人之间的道德规范。
meaning_en: three principles and five virtues (idiom); the three rules (ruler guides subject, father guides son and husband guides wife) and five constant virtues of Confucianism (benevolence 仁, righteousness 義|义, propriety 禮|礼, wisdom 智 and fidelity 信)

meaning_cn: 奔投向，奔往；前程前途。各走各的路。比喻各人按不同的志向，寻找自己的前途。
meaning_en: each goes his own way (idiom); each person has his own life to lead

meaning_cn: 黄粱小米。比喻虚幻不能实现的梦想。
meaning_en: dream of golden millet; fig. illusions of wealth and power; pipe dream

meaning_cn: 娇原指汉武帝刘彻的表妹陈阿娇『武帝幼小时喜爱阿娇，并说要让她住在金屋里。指以华丽的房屋让所爱的妻妾居住。也指取妾。
meaning_en: a golden house to keep one's mistress (idiom); a magnificent house built for a beloved woman

meaning_cn: 不值得忧虑担心。
meaning_en: to give no cause for anxiety; nothing to worry about

meaning_cn: 急急于。热心公益，见义勇为。
meaning_en: public-spirited

meaning_cn: 新仇加旧恨。形容仇恨深。
meaning_en: (idiom) old and new grudges; accumulated grievances

meaning_cn: 贪得无厌，永不满足。
meaning_en: avaricious and insatiable (idiom); greedy and never satisfied

meaning_cn: 焚烧；坑把人活埋；儒指书生。焚毁典籍，坑杀书生。
meaning_en: to burn the Confucian classics and bury alive the Confucian scholars (acts supposedly committed by the first emperor 秦始皇[Qin2 Shi3 huang2])

meaning_cn: 形容说话油滑，耍嘴皮子。
meaning_en: glib; oily-mouthed and smooth talking

meaning_cn: 无所不知，无所不能。
meaning_en: (idiom) omniscient and omnipotent

meaning_cn: 及达到。凭自己的力量不能做到。
meaning_en: beyond one's power (to do sth)

meaning_cn: 如花似月的容貌。形容女子美貌。
meaning_en: lit. countenance of a flower, face like the moon (idiom); fig. (of a woman) beautiful

meaning_cn: 坎坷道路坑坑洼洼。道路坑坑洼洼不平坦。形容前进道路上有许多困难民，不是一帆风顺的。
meaning_en: potholed and bumpy road (idiom); fig. full of disappointment and dashed hopes

meaning_cn: 贯穿钱的绳子；盈满。罪恶之多，犹如穿线一般已穿满一根绳子。形容罪大恶极，到受惩罚的时候了。
meaning_en: lit. strung through and filled with evil (idiom); filled with extreme evil; replete with vice; guilty of monstrous crimes

meaning_cn: 敛搜刮。指向人民强行征收苛捐杂税，进行残酷剥削。
meaning_en: to tax by force and extort levies (idiom); to screw taxes out of the people by force

meaning_cn: 旧时比喻女子老了被轻视，就象因年代久远而失去光泽的珍珠一样不值钱。
meaning_en: (of a woman) old and faded

meaning_cn: 言句首助词，无义。指彼此重新和好。
meaning_en: to become reconciled; to bury the hatchet

meaning_cn: 置放≤冷淡地把它搁在一边。指对人或事态度冷淡，放在一边不理。
meaning_en: to set to one side and ignore (idiom); quite indifferent; cold and uncaring

meaning_cn: 误耽误。指因无才或不负责任而耽误人家后辈学生。
meaning_en: (of a lazy or incompetent teacher) to hamper students' progress; (of media) to propagate errors; to lead people astray

meaning_cn: 旧时称赞某些统治者爱护百姓，就象爱护自己的子女一样。
meaning_en: (idiom) to love the common people as one's own children (praise for a virtuous ruler)

meaning_cn: 被围困的野兽还要作最后挣扎。比喻在绝境中还要挣扎抵抗。
meaning_en: a cornered beast will still fight (idiom); to fight like an animal at bay

meaning_cn: 经经过。一定要经过的道路。亦作必由之路”。
meaning_en: (idiom) the road one must follow; the only way

meaning_cn: 立身做人；处世在社会上活动，与人交往。指人在社会上待人接物的种种活动。
meaning_en: (idiom) the way one conducts oneself in society

meaning_cn: 烁光亮的样子。震动古代，显耀当世。形容事业或功绩非常伟大。
meaning_en: (lit.) to astonish the ancients and dazzle contemporaries (idiom); (fig.) to be earthshaking

meaning_cn: 争夺名位和利益。
meaning_en: to fight for fame, grab profit (idiom); scrambling for fame and wealth; only interested in personal gain

meaning_cn: 放浪放荡；形骸人的形体。指行动不受世俗礼节的束缚。
meaning_en: to abandon all restraint (idiom)

meaning_cn: 孔甚，很。形容人很有力气。
meaning_en: courageous and strong (idiom); Herculean (physique etc)

meaning_cn: 卷帙书籍或书籍的篇章。形容书籍很多或一部书的部头很大。
meaning_en: a huge amount (of books and papers)

meaning_cn: 准备好了，以备急用，眼下暂存不用。
meaning_en: have sth ready just in case; keep sth for possible future use

meaning_cn: 皂黑色。青、红、黑、白四色。比喻事情的是非或原因。
meaning_en: the rights and wrongs of a matter (idiom)

meaning_cn: 原指诗文的构思有独到的地方◇泛指想出的办法与众不同。
meaning_en: to display originality (idiom); to do things differently

meaning_cn: 形容路程很遥远。
meaning_en: (adverbial phrase used with verbs such as 歸|归[gui1] or 赴[fu4] etc) traveling a great distance

meaning_cn: 由这一等逐级往下。指跟某一事物比较起来更差。
meaning_en: going from there to lower grades (idiom)

meaning_cn: 形容一场大梦，或比喻一场空欢喜。
meaning_en: lit. a dream of Nanke; fig. dreams of grandeur

meaning_cn: 在江河湖海抢劫行凶的强盗。
meaning_en: (idiom) infamous pirate; (by extension) notorious bandit or robber

meaning_cn: 山光明媚，水色秀丽。形容风景优美。
meaning_en: lit. verdant hills and limpid water (idiom); fig. enchanting scenery

meaning_cn: 脸上露出为难的神色。
meaning_en: to show signs of reluctance or embarrassment

meaning_cn: 一片渺茫，没有人家。
meaning_en: remote and uninhabited (idiom); deserted; God-forsaken

meaning_cn: 天和地，一极在上，一极在下。比喻差别极大。
meaning_en: see 天壤之別|天壤之别[tian1 rang3 zhi1 bie2]

meaning_cn: 过过失。关起门来反省。
meaning_en: shut oneself up and ponder over one's mistakes

meaning_cn: 用眼色传递情意。多用于男女之间。
meaning_en: to make sheep eyes at; to cast amorous glances at

meaning_cn: 当面对。面对着强敌。形容形势严峻。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be faced with a formidable enemy

meaning_cn: 指交情甚浅，见了面只不过点点头而已。
meaning_en: nodding acquaintance

meaning_cn: 插上翅膀也难飞走。比喻陷入困境，怎么也逃不了。
meaning_en: lit. even given wings, you couldn't fly (idiom); fig. impossible to escape

meaning_cn: 正法执行死刑。在犯罪的当地执行死刑。
meaning_en: to execute on the spot (idiom); summary execution; to carry out the law on the spot

meaning_cn: 与人无争，只求相安无事的人。
meaning_en: Mr Goody-goody; yes-man (sb who agrees with anything)

meaning_cn: 有开始没有结尾。指做事不做到底。
meaning_en: to start but not finish (idiom); to fail to carry things through; lack of sticking power; short attention span

meaning_cn: 把狗血喷在头上。形容言辞刻毒，大肆辱骂。也形容骂得痛快淋漓。
meaning_en: torrent of abuse (idiom)

meaning_cn: 坐着躺着都不安宁。常形容心绪烦乱。
meaning_en: to be restless

meaning_cn: 指种种不同的味道。常用以比喻生活上的种种遭遇和复杂感受。
meaning_en: see 酸甜苦辣[suan1 tian2 ku3 la4]

meaning_cn: 哀悲哀；伤伤害。忧愁而不悲伤，形容感情有节制；另形容诗歌、音乐优美雅致，感情适度。比喻做事没有过头也无不及。
meaning_en: deeply felt but not mawkish (idiom)

meaning_cn: 伉俪夫妻，配偶。夫妻之间的感情深厚。
meaning_en: married couple very much in love; deep conjugal love

meaning_cn: 三生佛家指前生、今生、来生；幸幸运。三世都很幸运。比喻非常幸运。
meaning_en: the blessing of three lifetimes (idiom); (courteous language) it's my good fortune...

meaning_cn: 美好新奇的事物太多，眼睛来不及看。
meaning_en: lit. the eye cannot take it all in (idiom); fig. too many good things to see; a feast for the eyes

meaning_cn: 归根到底。
meaning_en: nine divide by nine is one (abacus rule); when all is said and done

meaning_cn: 流动的水不会发臭，经常转动的门轴不会被虫蛀。比喻经常运动的东西不容易受侵蚀。也比喻人经常运动可以强身。
meaning_en: lit. a door hinge never becomes worm-eaten; constant activity prevents decay (idiom)

meaning_cn: 睚眦发怒时瞪眼睛，借指极小的仇恨。象瞪一下眼睛那样极小的怨仇也要报复。比喻心胸极狭窄。
meaning_en: lit. to seek revenge over a dirty look (idiom); fig. small-minded; vindictive

meaning_cn: 原指人心胸开阔，外貌就安详◇用来指心情愉快，无所牵挂，因而人也发胖。
meaning_en: big-hearted and serene (idiom); contented and easygoing

meaning_cn: 鸣发出声音，指有所抒发或表示。指受到委曲和压迫就要发出不满和反抗的呼声。
meaning_en: where there is injustice, there will be an outcry; man will cry out against injustice

meaning_cn: 指仇人，仇敌。
meaning_en: enemy (idiom); opponent; arch-enemy

meaning_cn: 土乡土；重看得重，不轻易。安于本乡本土，不愿轻易迁移。
meaning_en: to hate to leave a place where one has lived long; to be attached to one's native land and unwilling to leave it

meaning_cn: 白纸上写下了黑字。比喻有确凿的文字凭据，不容抵赖或悔改。
meaning_en: (written) in black and white

meaning_cn: 简单爽快。
meaning_en: (of speech or actions) direct and efficient; without fooling around

meaning_cn: 比喻居心不良，当面一套，背后一套。
meaning_en: two-faced, three knives (idiom); double-cross; double dealing and back stabbing

meaning_cn: 丘土山；貉一种形似狐狸的野兽。一个土山里的貉。比喻彼此同是丑类，没有什么差别。
meaning_en: jackals of the same tribe (idiom); fig. They are all just as bad as each other.

meaning_cn: 缓慢；济救助。缓慢的行动适应不了紧急的需要。
meaning_en: lit. slow no aid to urgent (idiom); slow measures will not address a critical situation; too slow to meet a pressing need

meaning_cn: 鱼肉指受宰割者◇比喻用暴力欺凌，任意残害无辜的人们。
meaning_en: to prey on the people

meaning_cn: 辜罪。形容罪大恶极，即使处死刑也抵偿不了他的罪恶。
meaning_en: (idiom) to be so evil that even death would be insufficient punishment

meaning_cn: 期时间。以后有见面的时候（用在分别时安慰对方）。
meaning_en: I'm sure we'll meet again some day. (idiom); Hope to see you again.

meaning_cn: 阋争斗。兄弟之间的纠纷，也比喻内部争斗。
meaning_en: internecine strife (idiom); fighting among oneself

meaning_cn: 在鲁班门前舞弄斧子。比喻在行家面前卖弄本领，不自量力。
meaning_en: to display one's slight skill before an expert (idiom)

meaning_cn: 虚空；表表面，外貌。空有好看的外表，实际上不行。指有名无实。
meaning_en: looks impressive but is worthless (idiom); not as good as it looks; a reputation with no substance

meaning_cn: 意气志趣性格；投合得来。指志趣和性格相同的人，彼此投合。
meaning_en: congenial

meaning_cn: 鼾声熟睡时发出的鼻息声。形容睡得很深，鼾声很大。
meaning_en: thunderous snoring

meaning_cn: 心里没有远大志向。
meaning_en: to have no aspirations (idiom); unambitious

meaning_cn: 比喻自己不出面，借别人的手去害人。
meaning_en: to lend sb a knife to kill sb; to get sb else to do one's dirty work; to attack using the strength of another (idiom)

meaning_cn: 圆圆通；方方正。比喻人表面随和，内心严正。
meaning_en: lit. outside-flexible, inside-firm (idiom); fig. velvet glove

meaning_cn: 形容女子姿态美好。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of a woman) bewitching; charming

meaning_cn: 形容一片黑暗，没有一点光明。也形容对事情一无所知。
meaning_en: pitch-black; (fig.) to be completely in the dark

meaning_cn: 指为了应付某种情况而暂时采取的办法。同权宜之计”。
meaning_en: stratagem of convenience (idiom); stop-gap measure; makeshift plan; interim step

meaning_cn: 谋求安吉，避开灾难。
meaning_en: to seek luck and avoid calamity (idiom)

meaning_cn: 芒刺细刺。象有芒和刺扎在背上一样。形容内心惶恐，坐立不安。
meaning_en: feeling brambles and thorns in one's back (idiom); uneasy and nervous; to be on pins and needles

meaning_cn: 绝顶极端。形容异常聪明。
meaning_en: highly intelligent; brilliant

meaning_cn: 原指用手指一点使铁变成金的法术。比喻修改文章时稍稍改动原来的文字，就使它变得很出色。
meaning_en: to touch base matter and turn it to gold (idiom); fig. to turn crude writing into a literary gem

meaning_cn: 指很短的时间。
meaning_en: (idiom) a short time; a little while

meaning_cn: 有开头，有结尾。指做事能坚持到底。
meaning_en: where there's a start, there's a finish (idiom); to finish once one starts sth; to carry things through; I started, so I'll finish.

meaning_cn: 比喻不务正业的妇女。
meaning_en: women with disreputable or illegal professions (idiom)

meaning_cn: 指文章或言论空空洞洞，没有实际内容。
meaning_en: (of a writing etc) to have no substance (idiom); to carry no weight

meaning_cn: 鸣叫；盗偷东西。指微不足道的本领。也指偷偷摸摸的行为。
meaning_en: crowing like a cock and stealing like a dog (idiom); bag of tricks; useful talents

meaning_cn: 斑驳色彩杂乱；陆离参差不一。形容色彩纷杂。
meaning_en: variegated

meaning_cn: 宾客朋友坐满了席位。形容宾友聚会。
meaning_en: guests filled all the seats (idiom); a house full of distinguished visitors

meaning_cn: 迁变动。看见另一个事物就想改变原来的主意。指意志不坚定，喜爱不专一。
meaning_en: to change at once on seeing sth different (idiom); loving fads and novelty; never satisfied with what one has

meaning_cn: 形容说话装模作样，拿腔拿调。也形容生病时的呻吟声。
meaning_en: whining; groaning; muttering

meaning_cn: 绝伦超过同类。没有比这更荒唐更不合情理的了。
meaning_en: absolutely ridiculous (idiom); preposterous; the height of folly

meaning_cn: 扫除重重障碍，克服各种困难。
meaning_en: to overcome all obstacles; to overcome countless difficulties

meaning_cn: 诡计狡诈的计谋；端项目，点。形容坏主意很多。
meaning_en: deceitful in many ways (idiom); wily and mischievous; full of craft and cunning

meaning_cn: 旧时指上辈有读书人的家庭。
meaning_en: family with a literary reputation (idiom); literary family

meaning_cn: 才才华。比喻人极有才华。
meaning_en: (idiom) of great talent

meaning_cn: 敌方人数多，我方人数少。形容双方对峙，众寡悬殊。
meaning_en: multitude of enemies, few friends (idiom from Mencius); heavily outnumbered; beaten by the weight of numbers

meaning_cn: 封建礼教束缚妇女的道德标准之一。
meaning_en: Confucian moral injunctions for women, namely: obey in turn three men father, husband and son, plus the four virtues of morality 德[de2], physical charm 容, propriety in speech 言 and efficiency in needlework 功

meaning_cn: 业学业；精精通；于在于；勤勤奋。学业精深是由勤奋得来的。
meaning_en: mastery of study lies in diligence (idiom). You can only master a subject by assiduous study.; Excellence in work is only possible with diligence.; Practice makes perfect.

meaning_cn: 比喻节节胜利，毫无阻碍。
meaning_en: lit. a force to smash bamboo (idiom); fig. irresistible force

meaning_cn: 厌满足。学习总感到不满足。形容好学。
meaning_en: study tirelessly (idiom, from Analects)

meaning_cn: 劫强抢；舍住房。指成帮结伙到人家里抢夺财物。
meaning_en: to break into a house for robbery (idiom)

meaning_cn: 如麻象乱麻一样数不清。杀死的人多得象乱麻。形容杀的人多得数不清。
meaning_en: (lit.) to kill people like scything flax (idiom); (fig.) to kill people like flies

meaning_cn: 包藏隐藏，包含；祸心害人之心。心里怀着害人的恶意。
meaning_en: (idiom) to harbor evil intentions; to conceal malice

meaning_cn: 愚傻，笨，及比得上。愚蠢得别人比不上。形容极其愚笨。
meaning_en: impossibly stupid

meaning_cn: 卒古时指士兵。不出名的小兵。比喻没有名望或地位的人。
meaning_en: insignificant soldier (idiom); a nobody; nonentity

meaning_cn: 五代后周时，赵匡胤在陈桥兵变，部下诸将给他披上黄袍，拥立为天子◇比喻发动政变获得成功。
meaning_en: lit. to take the yellow gown (idiom); fig. to be made emperor; to take the crown

meaning_cn: 怨愤之气冲到天空。形容怨恨情绪极大。
meaning_en: (idiom) extremely resentful

meaning_cn: 不知道好坏。多指不能领会别人的好意。
meaning_en: unable to differentiate good from bad (idiom); not to know what's good for one; unable to recognize others' good intentions

meaning_cn: 形容青少年健康活泼、生命力旺盛的样子。
meaning_en: glowing with health and vivacity (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻白费气力，劳而无功。
meaning_en: using a wicker basket to draw water (idiom); wasted effort

meaning_cn: 抢地触地。大声叫天，用头撞地。形容极度悲伤。
meaning_en: (idiom) to cry out to heaven and knock one's head against the ground (as an expression of anguish)

meaning_cn: 愁肠忧愁的心肠。百结极多的结头。忧愁苦闷的心肠好象凝结成了许多的疙瘩。形容愁绪郁结，难于排遣。
meaning_en: hundred knots of worry in one's intestines (idiom); weighed down with anxiety

meaning_cn: 海水干涸、石头腐烂。形容历时久远。比喻坚定的意志永远不变。
meaning_en: (lit.) until the seas dry up and stones go soft (idiom); (fig.) forever; until the end of time

meaning_cn: 萧何创立了规章制度，死后，曹参做了宰相，仍照着实行。比喻按照前任的成规办事。
meaning_en: lit. Xiao's 蕭何|萧何[Xiao1 He2] governance followed by Cao 曹參|曹参[Cao2 Can1] (idiom); fig. to strictly adhere to the policies of the predecessor; to follow precedent

meaning_cn: 任听任；其代词，他，它。听任人或事物自然发展。
meaning_en: to let things take their course (idiom); to leave it to nature; laissez-faire

meaning_cn: 比喻十分清白。亦比喻非常清楚。
meaning_en: perfectly clean; blameless; unimpeachable (idiom)

meaning_cn: 渊深潭；羡希望得到。意思是站在水边想得到鱼，不如回家去结网。比喻只有愿望而没有措施，对事情毫无好处。
meaning_en: see 臨淵羨魚，不如退而結網|临渊羡鱼，不如退而结网[lin2 yuan1 xian4 yu2 , bu4 ru2 tui4 er2 jie2 wang3]

meaning_cn: 屈短，亏；穷尽。由于理亏而无话可说。
meaning_en: lit. having presented a flawed argument, one has nothing further to add (idiom); fig. unable to provide a convincing argument to support one's position; to not have a leg to stand on

meaning_cn: 抱着头，象老鼠那样惊慌逃跑。形容受到打击后狼狈逃跑。
meaning_en: to cover one's head and sneak away like a rat (idiom); to flee ignominiously

meaning_cn: 被迫离开家乡，漂泊外地。
meaning_en: to wander far from home

meaning_cn: 背宽厚如虎，腰粗壮如熊。形容人身体魁梧健壮。
meaning_en: back of a tiger and waist of a bear; tough and stocky build

meaning_cn: 只有坏处没有好处。
meaning_en: harmful and without benefit (idiom); more harm than good

meaning_cn: 指经历的时间极久。
meaning_en: (idiom) until the end of time

meaning_cn: 脸色呈灰白色。形容惊恐之极。
meaning_en: ashen-faced (idiom)

meaning_cn: 美名永传于后世。
meaning_en: see 流芳百世[liu2 fang1 bai3 shi4]

meaning_cn: 遁逃遁；空门指佛教，因佛教认为世界是一切皆空的。指出家。避开尘世而入佛门。
meaning_en: to take refuge in religious life

meaning_cn: 指不正当的门路、手段或不正经的事情。
meaning_en: lit. devil's gate, crooked path (idiom); corrupt practices; crooked methods; dishonesty

meaning_cn: 猾狡诈。指非常阴险狡诈的人。
meaning_en: cunning; crafty; wily old fox

meaning_cn: 指初虽有失，而终得补偿◇指事犹未晚，尚可补救。
meaning_en: see 失之東隅，收之桑榆|失之东隅，收之桑榆[shi1 zhi1 dong1 yu2 , shou1 zhi1 sang1 yu2]

meaning_cn: 形容不端正。
meaning_en: misshapen; crooked; uneven (idiom)

meaning_cn: 了明白；指掌指着手掌。形容对事物了解得非常清楚，象把东西放在手掌里给人家看一样。
meaning_en: see 了如指掌[liao3 ru2 zhi3 zhang3]

meaning_cn: 象天上的云和地上的泥那样高下不同。比喻地位的高下相差极大。
meaning_en: (idiom) a world of difference

meaning_cn: 年辈不相当而结交为友。
meaning_en: (idiom) friends with a significant age gap

meaning_cn: 迟疑不决，不敢前进。
meaning_en: hesitant to take action

meaning_cn: 分不出谁胜谁负。形容竞赛双方水平、技术相当。
meaning_en: unable to determine victory or defeat (idiom); evenly matched; to come out even; to tie; to draw

meaning_cn: 拍马拍马屁。比喻讨好奉承。
meaning_en: to smooth whiskers and pat a horse's bottom (idiom); to use flatter to get what one wants; to toady; boot-licking

meaning_cn: 比喻刚刚显示出能力或才干。
meaning_en: lit. to first show one's horns (idiom); fig. a first show of emerging talent; first sign of emerging talent; budding genius

meaning_cn: 聚集合，会合。一点一滴的积累，就会由少变多。
meaning_en: see 積少成多|积少成多[ji1 shao3 cheng2 duo1]

meaning_cn: 比喻继续打击已经失败的坏人。
meaning_en: lit. to beat a drowning dog (idiom); fig. to pulverize an (already defeated) enemy; to hit sb when he's down

meaning_cn: 人生如同一场梦。形容世事无定，人生短促。
meaning_en: life is but a dream (idiom)

meaning_cn: 简单爽快。同干脆利落”。
meaning_en: see 乾脆利落|干脆利落[gan1 cui4 li4 luo5]

meaning_cn: ①形容残破不堪。②零星琐碎。③指零星的物品。
meaning_en: bits and pieces; scattered fragments

meaning_cn: 军事命令象山一样不可动摇。旧时形容军队中上级发布的命令，下级必须执行，不得违抗。
meaning_en: military orders are like mountains (idiom); a military order must be obeyed

meaning_cn: 嫣然笑得很美的样子（指女性）。形容女子笑得很美。
meaning_en: (idiom) to smile sweetly

meaning_cn: 形容人精力充沛，风度不凡。
meaning_en: variant of 氣宇軒昂|气宇轩昂[qi4 yu3 xuan1 ang2]

meaning_cn: 闪电的光，燧石的火。原为佛家语，比喻事物瞬息即逝。现多形容事物象闪电和石火一样一瞬间就消逝。
meaning_en: (idiom) in a flash; fleeting; momentary

meaning_cn: 比喻好人和坏人混在一起。
meaning_en: lit. dragons and snakes mingle (idiom); fig. a mix of good people and scumbags

meaning_cn: 指巴结投靠有权势的人以获取富贵。
meaning_en: see 扳龍附鳳|扳龙附凤[ban1 long2 fu4 feng4]

meaning_cn: 被眼前的景物所触动而引起伤感。伤悲哀。
meaning_en: circumstances that evoke mixed feelings (idiom)

meaning_cn: 歃血古代会盟，把牲畜的血涂在嘴唇上，表示诚意；盟宣誓缔约。。泛指发誓订盟。
meaning_en: to smear the lips with blood when taking an oath (idiom); to swear a sacred oath

meaning_cn: 其代词，指敌人。趁敌人还没有防备时进攻。
meaning_en: see 出其不意，攻其不備|出其不意，攻其不备[chu1 qi2 bu4 yi4 , gong1 qi2 bu4 bei4]

meaning_cn: 疆界限。万年长寿，永远生存。用于祝人长寿。
meaning_en: may you enjoy boundless longevity (idiom); long may you live

meaning_cn: 指自己特别擅长的本领。
meaning_en: see 看家本領|看家本领[kan1 jia1 ben3 ling3]

meaning_cn: 有开头没有收尾。指没有把事情做完。
meaning_en: (idiom) to fail to finish off what one started

meaning_cn: 秋毫鸟兽秋天新换的绒毛，比喻极细微的东西；犯侵犯。指军纪严明，丝毫不侵犯人民的利益。
meaning_en: (idiom) (of soldiers) highly disciplined, not committing the slightest offense against civilians

meaning_cn: 春风指笑容。比喻人喜悦舒畅的表情。形容和霭愉快的面容。
meaning_en: see 滿面春風|满面春风[man3 mian4 chun1 feng1]

meaning_cn: 挨按照顺序。按照住户的顺序一家也不漏。同挨门逐户”。
meaning_en: see 挨家挨戶|挨家挨户[ai1 jia1 ai1 hu4]

meaning_cn: 臭气味。身上的奶腥气还没有退尽。对年轻人表示轻蔑的说法。
meaning_en: lit. smell of breast milk not yet dried (idiom); fig. immature and inexperienced; still wet behind the ears

meaning_cn: 心里想的和嘴上说的不一样。形容人的虚伪、诡诈。
meaning_en: heart and mouth at variance (idiom); keeping one's real intentions to oneself; saying one thing but meaning sth different

meaning_cn: 没能够摆脱开自己不以为然的风俗习惯。
meaning_en: unable to break the custom (idiom); bound by conventions

meaning_cn: 人马都很疲乏。形容旅途劳累。
meaning_en: riders tired and horses weary (idiom); worn out; exhausted; spent; fatigued

meaning_cn: 好爱好。各人有各人的爱好。指人的爱好出自人的本性，只应听其自然。
meaning_en: everyone has their likes and dislikes (idiom)

meaning_cn: 比喻将对方控制在自己势力范围内，然后进行有效打击。
meaning_en: lit. shut the door and beat the dog (idiom); fig. seal off the enemy's avenue of retreat, then strike hard

meaning_cn: 低着眉头，两眼流露出顺从的神情。形容驯良、顺从。
meaning_en: docile; submissive

meaning_cn: 徇曲从；枉使歪曲。曲从私情，歪曲和破坏法律，胡乱断案。
meaning_en: see 徇私枉法[xun4 si1 wang3 fa3]

meaning_cn: 这四个字都是文言虚词，讽刺人说话喜欢咬文嚼字。也形容半文不白的话或文章。
meaning_en: (lit.) 之[zhi1], 乎[hu1], 者[zhe3] and 也[ye3] (four grammatical particles of Classical Chinese) (idiom); (fig.) archaic expressions
